timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Formally submits OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 for OSI approval as a permissive license covering heterogeneous AI model materials and all applicable IP regimes.
timeline.point_zh: 正式提交 OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 供 OSI 审批，称其为覆盖异构 AI 模型材料及所有适用知识产权制度的宽松许可证。
timeline.point: Formally submits OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 for OSI approval as a permissive license covering heterogeneous AI model materials and all applicable IP regimes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that copyright-triggered defensive termination is unusually broad and could terminate rights to related materials when a developer brings a legitimate infringement claim.
timeline.point_zh: 担忧由版权诉讼触发的防御性终止条款范围异常宽泛，开发者提出正当侵权主张时可能连带失去相关材料的使用权。
timeline.point: Raises concern that copyright-triggered defensive termination is unusually broad and could terminate rights to related materials when a developer brings a legitimate infringement claim.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes normalizing a clause that could penalize legitimate copyright claims against AI projects and questions whether it fits the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将可能惩罚针对 AI 项目的正当版权主张之条款常态化，并质疑其是否符合开源定义。
timeline.point: Opposes normalizing a clause that could penalize legitimate copyright claims against AI projects and questions whether it fits the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks for historical context on why open-source licenses moved away from terminating copyright grants in response to patent infringement claims.
timeline.point_zh: 询问开源许可证为何在历史上不再因专利侵权主张而终止版权授权。
timeline.point: Asks for historical context on why open-source licenses moved away from terminating copyright grants in response to patent infringement claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether GPLv3 treats initiating patent litigation as a separate prohibited act that terminates the license, rather than merely an example of a further restriction.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 GPLv3 是否把发起专利诉讼视为会终止许可证的独立禁止行为，而不只是“进一步限制”的示例。
timeline.point: Questions whether GPLv3 treats initiating patent litigation as a separate prohibited act that terminates the license, rather than merely an example of a further restriction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OpenMDW 1.1 may conflict with OSD 9 because a claim involving one component could terminate licenses to other separately copyrightable components in the model-materials bundle.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OpenMDW 1.1 可能与 OSD 9 冲突，因为针对一个组件的主张可能终止模型材料包中其他独立受版权保护组件的许可。
timeline.point: Argues OpenMDW 1.1 may conflict with OSD 9 because a claim involving one component could terminate licenses to other separately copyrightable components in the model-materials bundle.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Cites specification-license precedents where defensive termination ends both patent and copyright grants, supporting treatment of overlapping IP rights as one licensing bargain.
timeline.point_zh: 援引规范许可证中防御性终止同时结束专利和版权授权的先例，支持将重叠知识产权视为一项整体许可交易。
timeline.point: Cites specification-license precedents where defensive termination ends both patent and copyright grants, supporting treatment of overlapping IP rights as one licensing bargain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Explains that MPL 2.0 intentionally terminates copyright grants because terminating only the patent grant can be an ineffective deterrent.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 MPL 2.0 有意终止版权授权，因为仅终止专利授权可能缺乏实际威慑力。
timeline.point: Explains that MPL 2.0 intentionally terminates copyright grants because terminating only the patent grant can be an ineffective deterrent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the earlier reading of MPL 2.0: patent assertions trigger termination of both copyright and patent grants, while EPL 2.0 appears narrower.
timeline.point_zh: 更正此前对 MPL 2.0 的解读：专利主张会触发版权与专利授权同时终止，而 EPL 2.0 的范围似乎更窄。
timeline.point: Corrects the earlier reading of MPL 2.0: patent assertions trigger termination of both copyright and patent grants, while EPL 2.0 appears narrower.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends OpenMDW 1.1 as narrowly triggered by offensive claims against the licensed model materials, citing OSI precedents and arguing that copyright symmetry is necessary for model licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OpenMDW 1.1 辩护，称其仅由针对获许可模型材料的主动诉讼触发，并援引 OSI 先例说明模型许可需要版权层面的对等机制。
timeline.point: Defends OpenMDW 1.1 as narrowly triggered by offensive claims against the licensed model materials, citing OSI precedents and arguing that copyright symmetry is necessary for model licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that copyright-triggered termination could prevent creators from enforcing their rights against widely used models and effectively shield large-scale infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 警告由版权诉讼触发的终止条款可能阻碍创作者对广泛使用的模型维权，实质上为大规模侵权提供保护。
timeline.point: Warns that copyright-triggered termination could prevent creators from enforcing their rights against widely used models and effectively shield large-scale infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks how patent litigation interacts with GPLv3 Sections 7 and 8 and whether similar termination logic would also apply under GPLv2.
timeline.point_zh: 询问专利诉讼如何与 GPLv3 第 7、8 节衔接，以及类似的终止逻辑是否也适用于 GPLv2。
timeline.point: Asks how patent litigation interacts with GPLv3 Sections 7 and 8 and whether similar termination logic would also apply under GPLv2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that terminating only patent grants is not a credible deterrent.
timeline.point_zh: 认同仅终止专利授权不足以形成可信的威慑。
timeline.point: Agrees that terminating only patent grants is not a credible deterrent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the MPL 2.0 explanation was not an endorsement of OpenMDW 1.1 and that the rationale may operate differently for AI model materials.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清对 MPL 2.0 的解释并非支持 OpenMDW 1.1，且同一理由在 AI 模型材料场景下可能产生不同效果。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the MPL 2.0 explanation was not an endorsement of OpenMDW 1.1 and that the rationale may operate differently for AI model materials.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license violates the Open Source Definition by creating a single owner and granting immunity to an upstream bad actor, rendering it potentially unenforceable.
timeline.point: Argues the license violates the Open Source Definition by creating a single owner and granting immunity to an upstream bad actor, rendering it potentially unenforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Provides historical context on patent retaliation clauses in MPL 2, noting they were designed for inter-corporate warfare and later extended to copyright defense.
timeline.point: Provides historical context on patent retaliation clauses in MPL 2, noting they were designed for inter-corporate warfare and later extended to copyright defense.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyright termination based on lawsuits is problematic for models because infringement cannot be determined without executing the model, which the claimant is forbidden to do after suing.
timeline.point: Argues that copyright termination based on lawsuits is problematic for models because infringement cannot be determined without executing the model, which the claimant is forbidden to do after suing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Cites GPLv3 rationale to discuss historical precedent for patent assertions leading to termination and how it relates to further restrictions.
timeline.point: Cites GPLv3 rationale to discuss historical precedent for patent assertions leading to termination and how it relates to further restrictions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that GPLv3 section 10 does not specify if a copyright assertion constitutes a 'further restriction' beyond financial charges.
timeline.point: Clarifies that GPLv3 section 10 does not specify if a copyright assertion constitutes a 'further restriction' beyond financial charges.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the date mentioned in the previous message.
timeline.point: Corrects the date mentioned in the previous message.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license is discriminatory against open source developers enforcing their rights and suggests approval would signal OSI opposition to such enforcement.
timeline.point: Argues the license is discriminatory against open source developers enforcing their rights and suggests approval would signal OSI opposition to such enforcement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license improperly imposes its terms on included third-party materials, potentially causing an external MIT licensor to lose their rights if they sue for infringement.
timeline.point: Argues the license improperly imposes its terms on included third-party materials, potentially causing an external MIT licensor to lose their rights if they sue for infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions why termination covers patent and copyright suits but not trade secret suits, and argues the requirement to clear training materials is redundant and creates an impossible positive duty for licensees.
timeline.point: Questions why termination covers patent and copyright suits but not trade secret suits, and argues the requirement to clear training materials is redundant and creates an impossible positive duty for licensees.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Notes OpenMDW-1.0 is in use and suggests OSI consider it, while questioning the definition of 'covered work' and raising potential OSD 9 issues regarding defensive termination.
timeline.point: Notes OpenMDW-1.0 is in use and suggests OSI consider it, while questioning the definition of 'covered work' and raising potential OSD 9 issues regarding defensive termination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues Model Materials might not be released together, creating termination risks for unrelated components, but ultimately states OSD 9 is not relevant.
timeline.point: Argues Model Materials might not be released together, creating termination risks for unrelated components, but ultimately states OSD 9 is not relevant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the concern that the rights-clearance language could be interpreted as a positive obligation and suggests adding clarifying text to ensure no independent duty to obtain clearances is created.
timeline.point: Acknowledges the concern that the rights-clearance language could be interpreted as a positive obligation and suggests adding clarifying text to ensure no independent duty to obtain clearances is created.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that treating a single model release as a unit is reasonable but notes the text lacks this definition, suggesting the Model Materials scope be limited to a specific release for clarity.
timeline.point: Agrees that treating a single model release as a unit is reasonable but notes the text lacks this definition, suggesting the Model Materials scope be limited to a specific release for clarity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that GPLv3, MPLv2, and CDDLv1.1 allow for termination of copyright rights upon patent assertions, concluding such clauses are not anomalous.
timeline.point: Notes that GPLv3, MPLv2, and CDDLv1.1 allow for termination of copyright rights upon patent assertions, concluding such clauses are not anomalous.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that no OSI-approved license terminates rights for copyright assertions, asserting that revoking Freedom 0 based on copyright claims fundamentally undermines software freedom.
timeline.point: Argues that no OSI-approved license terminates rights for copyright assertions, asserting that revoking Freedom 0 based on copyright claims fundamentally undermines software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: States that a termination clause triggered by a copyright assertion is problematic.
timeline.point: States that a termination clause triggered by a copyright assertion is problematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Cites the previously approved OCLC Research Public License 2.0 as an example of an OSI-approved license that terminates upon instituting intellectual property litigation, noting its scope is broader than OpenMDW-1.1.
timeline.point: Cites the previously approved OCLC Research Public License 2.0 as an example of an OSI-approved license that terminates upon instituting intellectual property litigation, noting its scope is broader than OpenMDW-1.1.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Copyrights are automatic and widespread, while patents require intentional filing, making patent licenses unsuitable models for mass copyright liability. The proposed license attempts to shield against mass copyright violations and should not be considered open source.
timeline.point_zh: 版权自动产生且普遍，专利需主动申请，故专利许可证不适合用于大规模版权责任。该许可证试图规避大规模版权侵权，不应被视为开源。
timeline.point: Copyrights are automatic and widespread, while patents require intentional filing, making patent licenses unsuitable models for mass copyright liability. The proposed license attempts to shield against mass copyright violations and should not be considered open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the persuasive response but argues the 'solely responsible' language could still be read as a license condition, citing similar usage in EPL-2.0.
timeline.point: Acknowledges the persuasive response but argues the 'solely responsible' language could still be read as a license condition, citing similar usage in EPL-2.0.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Accepts the explanation regarding Model Materials scope but strongly recommends OpenMDW guidance explicitly enumerate them to clarify termination rights.
timeline.point: Accepts the explanation regarding Model Materials scope but strongly recommends OpenMDW guidance explicitly enumerate them to clarify termination rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the analysis missed a configuration where unmodified code is subject to both licenses, noting that sublicensing could impose additional constraints.
timeline.point: Argues the analysis missed a configuration where unmodified code is subject to both licenses, noting that sublicensing could impose additional constraints.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that missing the fourth configuration does not change the analysis because MIT grants reach all recipients directly, and clarifies that a developer suing for infringement cannot simultaneously exercise the licensor's rights.
timeline.point: Argues that missing the fourth configuration does not change the analysis because MIT grants reach all recipients directly, and clarifies that a developer suing for infringement cannot simultaneously exercise the licensor's rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that CAL-1.0 is not parallel to OpenMDW-1.1 and notes that OSI approval of similar past licenses does not compel approval of new ones, suggesting broader software freedom concerns may justify rejection.
timeline.point: Argues that CAL-1.0 is not parallel to OpenMDW-1.1 and notes that OSI approval of similar past licenses does not compel approval of new ones, suggesting broader software freedom concerns may justify rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions the conclusion that all training data must be explicitly licensed, arguing the license protects developers and that policy dilemmas regarding AI and open source should not encumber the license evaluation.
timeline.point: Questions the conclusion that all training data must be explicitly licensed, arguing the license protects developers and that policy dilemmas regarding AI and open source should not encumber the license evaluation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: States that viewing the license as a regular FOSS license reveals tensions that weigh against approval and emphasizes the OSI's role in protecting the open source community's interests.
timeline.point: States that viewing the license as a regular FOSS license reveals tensions that weigh against approval and emphasizes the OSI's role in protecting the open source community's interests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Summarizes the objection to OpenMDW-1.1 regarding termination rights upon copyright assertion and notes Dolan's clarification that there is no blanket immunity.
timeline.point: Summarizes the objection to OpenMDW-1.1 regarding termination rights upon copyright assertion and notes Dolan's clarification that there is no blanket immunity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license systematically fails the open source ecosystem by forcing developers to choose between giving up infringement claims or using proprietary models.
timeline.point: Argues the license systematically fails the open source ecosystem by forcing developers to choose between giving up infringement claims or using proprietary models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Probes the claim that all code is in every LLM, noting high model abstraction levels and suggesting legal claims may be limited to copies of training materials.

timeline.snippet: Argues that the Mutualist License ignores legal drafting conventions, creating ambiguity even in basic provisions such as upgrade wording, formatting changes, and section headings.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Warns that drafting a reliable open source license requires jurisdiction-specific legal expertise and review, comparing licenses to cryptographic code that fails without domain scrutiny.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒可靠开源许可证需要针对不同法域的法律专业知识和审查，并把许可证类比为缺乏领域审查就会失效的密码学代码。

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Responds to drafting critiques by agreeing to add paragraph numbering, considering clearer terminology for copyright infringement, and defending plain-language headings as a deliberate reader-focused tradeoff.

timeline.point: Responds to drafting critiques by agreeing to add paragraph numbering, considering clearer terminology for copyright infringement, and defending plain-language headings as a deliberate reader-focused tradeoff.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI review must rigorously pressure-test licenses for ecosystem health and legal clarity, because interpretive canons cannot reliably rescue ambiguous drafting.

CompanioNation Public Licence, version 1.0
Proposed SPDX identifier: CNPL-1.0

Note: I am aware that CPL-1.0 is already registered (IBM Common Public
License). CNPL-1.0 is intentionally distinct.

---



## 2. OSD compliance affirmations


I affirm that CNPL-1.0 complies with the Open Source Definition.
Specifically:

- OSD §3 (Derived Works): Section 2 grants unrestricted rights to prepare
and distribute derivative works. ✓
- OSD §5 (No Discrimination Against Persons or Groups): The license places
no restrictions on any person or group. ✓
- OSD §6 (No Discrimination Against Fields of Endeavor): The license
explicitly permits commercial use, SaaS deployment, and any other purpose. ✓
- OSD §9 (License Must Not Restrict Other Software): The license contains
no such restriction. ✓

Full OSD mapping:

§1 Free Redistribution — Sections 2 and 3 grant unconditional
redistribution rights with no royalty. ✓
§2 Source Code — The license imposes no source-withholding restriction. ✓
§3 Derived Works — See above. ✓
§4 Integrity of Author's Source Code — No patch-file or name-change
restriction is imposed. ✓
§5 No Discrimination — See above. ✓
§6 No Field Restriction — See above. ✓
§7 Distribution of License — Rights apply to all downstream recipients
automatically. ✓
§8 Not Specific to a Product — Section 1 defines "Software" generically; no
product dependency. ✓
§9 No Restriction on Other Software — See above. ✓
§10 Technology Neutral — No technology-specific provision exists. ✓

---



## 3. Projects using this license


CNPL-1.0 is a new license. It is currently in use by one project:

  CompanioNation™ — an open-source online dating platform
  https://github.com/CompanioNation/Core

---



## 4. Gap not filled by existing licenses


CNPL-1.0 is a simple permissive license with two features not combined in
any single currently approved license:

a) An explicit, broad patent grant (as in Apache 2.0) combined with
permissive, copyleft-free terms (as in MIT). The MIT License contains no
patent grant. Apache 2.0 contains one, but also imposes a NOTICE file
requirement and has considerably more complexity.

b) A redistribution condition requiring the complete license text (not
merely a copyright notice) to be retained. This ensures downstream
recipients always receive the full grant of rights — including the patent
licence — rather than just a copyright attribution line that may be
stripped of legal context.

The intent is a license that is as simple as MIT, but legally complete:
explicit patent grant, full-text redistribution, and no overhead.

---



## 5. Comparison to similar approved licenses


Most similar: MIT License
- Both are permissive, copyleft-free, and impose minimal conditions.
- MIT requires retention of the copyright notice and permission notice
only. CNPL-1.0 requires retention of the complete license text.
- MIT contains no patent grant. CNPL-1.0 includes an explicit patent grant
with a litigation termination clause.

Also comparable: Apache License 2.0
- Both include explicit patent grants with litigation termination.
- Apache 2.0 requires a NOTICE file, tracks modifications, and is
substantially longer. CNPL-1.0 imposes none of those requirements.
- Apache 2.0 is permissive but complex. CNPL-1.0 is intentionally minimal.

In short: CNPL-1.0 occupies the space between MIT (no patent grant,
notice-only) and Apache 2.0 (patent grant, significant overhead).

---



## 6. Legal review


The license was drafted by the submitter, who is not a lawyer. No formal
legal review has been conducted. I welcome scrutiny of the text on this
list.

---



## 7. Proposed tags


Permissive, Patent-Grant, Simple

---

The license text is attached. I have subscribed to license-review and will
be attentive and responsive to discussion.

Thank you for your consideration.

Drew McPherson
License Steward, CNPL-1.0
drew.mcpherson at gmail.com
https://github.com/CompanioNation/Core

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Presents ModelGo as a model-focused licensing framework in response to limited AI model licensing options, asks whether all nine variants should be submitted, and asks if non-OSD variants can be listed as complementary materials and how MG-BY-OS should handle code licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 提交关于 ModelGo 许可框架的背景与目标，说明模型许可选项不足后提出九个变体是否全部提交、非 OSD 变体能否仅作为补充材料提交，以及 MG-BY-OS 在未强制代码许可下应如何处理。
timeline.point: Presents ModelGo as a model-focused licensing framework in response to limited AI model licensing options, asks whether all nine variants should be submitted, and asks if non-OSD variants can be listed as complementary materials and how MG-BY-OS should handle code licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Warns that licenses with -NC terms should not be submitted because they do not meet OSD and says MG-BY-OS is likely non-compliant when it allows only open weights without requiring open source code.
timeline.point_zh: 警告任何带 -NC 条款的许可不应提交，因为不符合 OSD，并指出仅公开权重而未要求开源代码的 MG-BY-OS 也可能不合规。
timeline.point: Warns that licenses with -NC terms should not be submitted because they do not meet OSD and says MG-BY-OS is likely non-compliant when it allows only open weights without requiring open source code.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the response, clarifies MG-*-OS only requires code delivery without mandatory OSI-approved terms, and asks whether OSAID applies to AI systems and whether model licenses should compel code and data to be under OSI-approved terms.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢回复并澄清 MG-*-OS 仅要求提供代码副本但未强制采用 OSI 批准条款，进而询问 OSAID 是否适用于 AI 系统，以及模型许可是否应强制代码与数据都遵循 OSI 批准许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the response, clarifies MG-*-OS only requires code delivery without mandatory OSI-approved terms, and asks whether OSAID applies to AI systems and whether model licenses should compel code and data to be under OSI-approved terms.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSAID is based on an AI-system definition from the OECD, ties open source “source code” expectations to that mapping, and withholds personal opinions while inviting additional discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 OSAID 已包含 AI 系统定义，强调在 AI 场景中需先明确“程序”对应的 AI 系统才可界定源代码含义，并表示保留个人意见不公开同时邀请继续讨论。
timeline.point: Explains that OSAID is based on an AI-system definition from the OECD, ties open source “source code” expectations to that mapping, and withholds personal opinions while inviting additional discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Warns that open source users should avoid code without explicit licenses and states that, in at least the UK context, copying machine code can require permission even before it is copied into working memory.
timeline.point_zh: 强调负责任的开源实践应避免使用无明确许可的代码，并表示至少在英国情形下，复制机器码甚至在进入工作内存前可能已需许可证授权。
timeline.point: Warns that open source users should avoid code without explicit licenses and states that, in at least the UK context, copying machine code can require permission even before it is copied into working memory.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the clarification, says copyleft-style terms may hurt broad software compatibility, notes model training data often already has free-content licensing, and says he will move forward with OSI review submission materials.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈后指出共用权（copyleft）风格条款可能损害软件生态兼容性，认为模型训练数据常被免费内容许可覆盖且可能不需要 OSI 许可，并表示将继续推进 OSI 审核材料准备。
timeline.point: Thanks for the clarification, says copyleft-style terms may hurt broad software compatibility, notes model training data often already has free-content licensing, and says he will move forward with OSI review submission materials.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits ModelGo Zero License 2.0 for OSI review, describes it as a permissive model-licensing draft with no attribution or modification-notice requirements, and argues existing OSS/RAI/proprietary models leave a gap for model-specific legal terms.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Zero License 2.0 供 OSI 审核，说明其为偏宽松的模型许可草案并未要求署名与修改声明，同时指出现有 OSS、RAI 及专有许可在模型发布中存在法律契合性空白。
timeline.point: Submits ModelGo Zero License 2.0 for OSI review, describes it as a permissive model-licensing draft with no attribution or modification-notice requirements, and argues existing OSS/RAI/proprietary models leave a gap for model-specific legal terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 for OSI review, positions it as an attribution-and-copyleft model variant with source-code redistribution, and compares its model-specific structure to Apache-2.0 and the broader ModelGo family.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 供 OSI 审核，将其定位为要求署名与共用源代码的模型专用许可版本，并说明其模型化结构并与 Apache-2.0 及 ModelGo 家族对照。
timeline.point: Submits ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 for OSI review, positions it as an attribution-and-copyleft model variant with source-code redistribution, and compares its model-specific structure to Apache-2.0 and the broader ModelGo family.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Says the thread is a useful OS AI Definition test case, says MG-BY-OS could be OSD-compatible depending on final text, and warns that this first AI-license evaluation will likely require extended internal discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该讨论可作为 OS AI 定义的实测案例，认为 MG-BY-OS 在文本充分时可能兼容 OSD，同时提醒这是首个 AI 许可评审，可能需要更长时间与更多内部讨论。
timeline.point: Says the thread is a useful OS AI Definition test case, says MG-BY-OS could be OSD-compatible depending on final text, and warns that this first AI-license evaluation will likely require extended internal discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 for OSI review, presents it as a permissive attribution-only model license with required modification notices, and reiterates the need for model-focused terms absent in existing licensing choices.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 参加 OSI 审核，概述其为偏宽松、强调署名的模型许可，并重申现有 OSS、RAI、专有许可难以覆盖模型发布场景的现状。
timeline.point: Submits ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 for OSI review, presents it as a permissive attribution-only model license with required modification notices, and reiterates the need for model-focused terms absent in existing licensing choices.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Raises two principal objections: unspecified annex mechanisms may allow unapproved right toggles, and licensor-based jurisdiction clauses are ambiguous across releases, litigation stages, and derivative disputes, so recommends removing such provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两项主要反对意见：未定义附件体系可能导致未审批的权利勾选变更，以及以许可人所在地/主营地为准的管辖与争议条款在不同时间点和衍生许可争议中含糊不清，建议移除。
timeline.point: Raises two principal objections: unspecified annex mechanisms may allow unapproved right toggles, and licensor-based jurisdiction clauses are ambiguous across releases, litigation stages, and derivative disputes, so recommends removing such provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains Annex A is intended as an informative model sheet for usability and parsing, keeps RAI-variant options separate because they are non-OSD, and proposes amendments to governing-law clauses to improve reusability across jurisdictions.
timeline.point_zh: 解释附件 A 仅作为使用说明性模型清单用于可读性和合规解析，说明 RAI 变体因不兼容 OSD 单独保留，并提议调整适用法与管辖条款以增强跨法域可复用性。
timeline.point: Explains Annex A is intended as an informative model sheet for usability and parsing, keeps RAI-variant options separate because they are non-OSD, and proposes amendments to governing-law clauses to improve reusability across jurisdictions.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Supports opening source model publishing by stating current ML licensing lacks OSD-compatible options, criticizes proprietary-first LLM licensing history, and frames ModelGo as a needed reusable family that enables model derivation without unfair restrictions.
timeline.point_zh: 支持推动开源模型发布，指出当前模型生态缺乏 OSD 兼容选项并反对专有许可主导历史，并将 ModelGo 定位为补齐该缺口、支持衍生和公平共享的可复用许可体系。
timeline.point: Supports opening source model publishing by stating current ML licensing lacks OSD-compatible options, criticizes proprietary-first LLM licensing history, and frames ModelGo as a needed reusable family that enables model derivation without unfair restrictions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Flags the clause requiring compliance with all applicable laws before use as potentially conflicting with OSD 5 and 6, argues that state law already governs legality, and disagrees with treating source data as mandatory for open-source AI status.
timeline.point_zh: 指出“所有使用必须符合法律”条款可能与 OSD 5 与 6 冲突，认为合法性由国家法制执行，不应写入许可约束，并对“必须公开源数据才算开源 AI”结论表示异议。
timeline.point: Flags the clause requiring compliance with all applicable laws before use as potentially conflicting with OSD 5 and 6, argues that state law already governs legality, and disagrees with treating source data as mandatory for open-source AI status.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Defends retaining 2.3(a)(i) by arguing it is not person-group discrimination and that licensors need not guarantee against illegal use, then says model licenses need not cover dataset terms beyond their own scope and should keep output usages open.
timeline.point_zh: 为保留 2.3(a)(i) 条款辩护，认为其并非对特定人群歧视且许可人不应对非法用途担责，同时主张开源模型无需扩展到数据层条款且不应封锁模型输出用途。
timeline.point: Defends retaining 2.3(a)(i) by arguing it is not person-group discrimination and that licensors need not guarantee against illegal use, then says model licenses need not cover dataset terms beyond their own scope and should keep output usages open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Rejects likely approval due to use-restriction wording and warns that jurisdiction clauses and undefined annexes undermine OSI review, because mutable annex content can change a license into non-free form without preserving self-contained legal text.
timeline.point_zh: 明确表示该许可不太可能获批，反对现有用途限制，并警告特定管辖及未定义附件会损害 OSI 审核，因为可变更附件可能在不保持自足文本的情况下将许可转为非自由形式。
timeline.point: Rejects likely approval due to use-restriction wording and warns that jurisdiction clauses and undefined annexes undermine OSI review, because mutable annex content can change a license into non-free form without preserving self-contained legal text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: States jurisdiction-style provisions are usually unnecessary and discouraged, yet not necessarily OSD-violating by themselves; signals only a specific-country compliance obligation could make the clause problematic.
timeline.point_zh: 表示此类管辖条款通常不必要且被建议避免，但单独出现未必构成 OSD 违规；只有强制遵循特定国家法域才可能使其成为问题。
timeline.point: States jurisdiction-style provisions are usually unnecessary and discouraged, yet not necessarily OSD-violating by themselves; signals only a specific-country compliance obligation could make the clause problematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Warns output labeling requirements may be treated as use restrictions, then objects to the phrase “non-transferable, sublicensable” as legally ambiguous and potentially unworkable in cross-jurisdiction transfer scenarios.
timeline.point_zh: 警告对模型输出强制标注可能被认定为使用限制，并反对“不可转让、可分许可”表述存在法律歧义，在企业转让等跨法域情境下可能难以执行。
timeline.point: Warns output labeling requirements may be treated as use restrictions, then objects to the phrase “non-transferable, sublicensable” as legally ambiguous and potentially unworkable in cross-jurisdiction transfer scenarios.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Accepts prior feedback, agrees to remove or tighten problematic text, narrows “annexes” to a named Annex A model sheet to prevent ambiguity, and continues treating the sheet as a usability aid while exploring immutability wording.
timeline.point_zh: 接受评审意见并同意移除或收紧有问题条款，将“附件”细化为指定的「Annex A — Model Sheet」以消除歧义，并继续保留该说明表以提升可用性，同时研究不可变性表述。
timeline.point: Accepts prior feedback, agrees to remove or tighten problematic text, narrows “annexes” to a named Annex A model sheet to prevent ambiguity, and continues treating the sheet as a usability aid while exploring immutability wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Responds that the AI-generated-content notice is intended as attribution rather than field-of-use restriction, says watermarking is not planned, and says potential wording issues will be corrected with lawyer review.
timeline.point_zh: 回应关切认为 AI 生成内容提示用于标识而非限定使用领域，不打算强制输出水印，并称相关表述问题将与律师确认后修订。
timeline.point: Responds that the AI-generated-content notice is intended as attribution rather than field-of-use restriction, says watermarking is not planned, and says potential wording issues will be corrected with lawyer review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits a request to re-open review discussion for the MG-BY-OS variant before amending, while reporting that some MG0 clauses appear non-compliant and the current submission will be revised after consolidating comments.
timeline.point_zh: 提交在重提修订前先启动MG-BY-OS版本评审讨论，说明MG0有若干条款可能不符合OSD并计划汇总意见后提交修订版。
timeline.point: Submits a request to re-open review discussion for the MG-BY-OS variant before amending, while reporting that some MG0 clauses appear non-compliant and the current submission will be revised after consolidating comments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Flags that three ModelGo licenses (Zero, BY, BY-OS) were submitted and asks that feedback focus first on BY-OS, noting it adds section 2.3(ii) through (vi).
timeline.point_zh: 提示作者已提交Zero、BY、BY-OS三版许可证，要求先审阅BY-OS，并指出其与Zero差异是新增2.3(ii)至(vi)部分。
timeline.point: Flags that three ModelGo licenses (Zero, BY, BY-OS) were submitted and asks that feedback focus first on BY-OS, noting it adds section 2.3(ii) through (vi).

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Warns section 2.2 and section 5.1 are legally misplaced for open-source licensing, argues derivative rights are determined by law rather than grant mechanics, and advises removing these clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 警告2.2条与5.1条在开源授权里存在法律层面问题，指出衍生作品权利由法定规则决定，建议移除这些条款。
timeline.point: Warns section 2.2 and section 5.1 are legally misplaced for open-source licensing, argues derivative rights are determined by law rather than grant mechanics, and advises removing these clauses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Revises a prior comment by clarifying section 2.2 again, reiterating that copyright cannot be created in another subject through grant and apologizing for earlier drafting artifacts.
timeline.point_zh: 修正先前对2.2条的说明，重申许可无法令他人获得衍生作品著作权主体，随后说明早先表述有瑕疵并致歉。
timeline.point: Revises a prior comment by clarifying section 2.2 again, reiterating that copyright cannot be created in another subject through grant and apologizing for earlier drafting artifacts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Replies with partial agreement on section 2.2 concerns, explains ML reuse ambiguity, and commits to ask counsel to remove 5.1 and rename Section 5 after reviewing the legal drafting.
timeline.point_zh: 回复时对2.2部分观点部分认同，解释机器学习复用的所有权边界较复杂，并表示会请律师移除5.1并将第5节改名。
timeline.point: Replies with partial agreement on section 2.2 concerns, explains ML reuse ambiguity, and commits to ask counsel to remove 5.1 and rename Section 5 after reviewing the legal drafting.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges a good copyleft start and willingness to approve, but flags wording quality, needs for AI-development expertise, hosted/API and training-data scope questions, ambiguous sublicensing language, an AI-output notice, and possible OSD5 conflict with Singapore-law wording.
timeline.point_zh: 认可该草案为可行的互补版权起点并支持推进，但指出文本质量、AI系统专家评审、托管/API与训练数据边界、2.1.a授权措辞、2.3(a)(i)地域法律条款与输出提示义务等仍存疑问。
timeline.point: Acknowledges a good copyleft start and willingness to approve, but flags wording quality, needs for AI-development expertise, hosted/API and training-data scope questions, ambiguous sublicensing language, an AI-output notice, and possible OSD5 conflict with Singapore-law wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Opposes including all-applicable-law compliance as a license condition, warning it enables private enforcement over user conduct and may set a harmful template for the first OSAID license moving forward.
timeline.point_zh: 反对把“遵守一切适用法律”作为许可条件，认为会让许可人借授权干预用户行为，并担忧首个OSAID许可证会将该范式固化。
timeline.point: Opposes including all-applicable-law compliance as a license condition, warning it enables private enforcement over user conduct and may set a harmful template for the first OSAID license moving forward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Supports Eric's objection to the law-compliance condition and shares a linked article arguing against embedding mandatory legal-behavior controls into open-source licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 支持Eric对“遵守所有适用法律”反对意见，并提供相关文章，说明该类法律行为限制不应进入开源许可。
timeline.point: Supports Eric's objection to the law-compliance condition and shares a linked article arguing against embedding mandatory legal-behavior controls into open-source licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Confirms agreement that the criticized clause is unnecessary and problematic, and commits to removing it in resubmission while crediting prior input on the long-term impact of that pattern.
timeline.point_zh: 确认该争议条款不妥且会被移除于后续修订稿，感谢此前反馈其长期影响。
timeline.point: Confirms agreement that the criticized clause is unnecessary and problematic, and commits to removing it in resubmission while crediting prior input on the long-term impact of that pattern.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Forwards Moming's replies to the license-review list as responses to many earlier questions, helping the thread progress with a consolidated reply context.
timeline.point_zh: 将Moming对先前多项问题的回复转发到许可证审查邮件列表，便于讨论在同一上下文下继续。
timeline.point: Forwards Moming's replies to the license-review list as responses to many earlier questions, helping the thread progress with a consolidated reply context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the output-disclosure clause is intended as AI assistance attribution to reduce misinformation, offers practical compliance examples, and asks whether this common requirement is OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 说明该输出披露条款旨在标明AI辅助生成并降低误导风险，给出可行执行示例，并继续询问其是否兼容OSD。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the output-disclosure clause is intended as AI assistance attribution to reduce misinformation, offers practical compliance examples, and asks whether this common requirement is OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that in research, AI use should be declared in publications, while the specific AI system used is unnecessary as long as purpose of usage is stated.
timeline.point_zh: 指出学术研究需披露AI使用行为，但无须声明具体AI模型，只要说明用途即可。
timeline.point: Notes that in research, AI use should be declared in publications, while the specific AI system used is unnecessary as long as purpose of usage is stated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Opposes the provision as overbroad and value-laden, arguing it mainly serves public labeling rather than licensor benefit and adds friction inconsistent with streamlined open-source licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 反对该披露条款过宽且带价值判断，认为其更偏公共标签化目的而非许可人利益，且会增加不必要摩擦。
timeline.point: Opposes the provision as overbroad and value-laden, arguing it mainly serves public labeling rather than licensor benefit and adds friction inconsistent with streamlined open-source licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the notice requirement may increase friction but argues removing it risks open-source model reuse issues, proposing a narrower scope limited to output collections with original model and license disclosure.
timeline.point_zh: 承认披露要求可能带来摩擦，但认为缺少该规定会影响开源模型复用治理，并建议仅在输出集合分发时披露原模型和许可证信息以缩窄适用范围。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the notice requirement may increase friction but argues removing it risks open-source model reuse issues, proposing a narrower scope limited to output collections with original model and license disclosure.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Opposes requiring AI-origin labels across all output types as overinclusive and hard to operationalize, arguing the clause is public-spirited but low value, low enforceability, and high friction.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将AI来源声明扩展到全部输出类型且难以判定执行，认为该条更多服务公共目的但对许可人和许可人益处有限，且难强制、摩擦很高。
timeline.point: Opposes requiring AI-origin labels across all output types as overinclusive and hard to operationalize, arguing the clause is public-spirited but low value, low enforceability, and high friction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Concludes the notice condition looks like a use restriction rather than a license condition and therefore not open source.
timeline.point_zh: 认定该条款更像对单纯使用的限制而非对下游许可条件，进而否定其开源属性。
timeline.point: Concludes the notice condition looks like a use restriction rather than a license condition and therefore not open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that another participant is analogizing the clause to an attribution-like condition.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该争议条款被另一位参与者类比为归属披露型义务。
timeline.point: Notes that another participant is analogizing the clause to an attribution-like condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Affirms agreement that output should remain user-controlled and distinguishes policy, watermarking, and licensing, arguing this clause is a misplaced advertisement-like control akin to restricting output itself.
timeline.point_zh: 表示同意输出应由用户控制并区分政策水印与许可条款，指出该规定实质上是对输出本身的附加控制，类同错位的广告式义务。
timeline.point: Affirms agreement that output should remain user-controlled and distinguishes policy, watermarking, and licensing, arguing this clause is a misplaced advertisement-like control akin to restricting output itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: States no current opinion on whether the clause is OSD-compliant and withholds judgment for now.
timeline.point_zh: 暂未就该条款是否符合OSD作出意见，先暂缓定论。
timeline.point: States no current opinion on whether the clause is OSD-compliant and withholds judgment for now.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Echoes opposition to the notice approach by citing the Kyle Mitchell proposal precedent and likening it to a forbidden attribution requirement on all outputs of a tool.
timeline.point_zh: 重申反对该通知式条款，引用Kyle Mitchell先例并比拟要求编辑器输出全部文件附署声明，认为此类要求不应获批。
timeline.point: Echoes opposition to the notice approach by citing the Kyle Mitchell proposal precedent and likening it to a forbidden attribution requirement on all outputs of a tool.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Reviews the ModelGo drafts as open-source-style commercial drafting with dangerous ambiguities in Licensed Materials and IP grant scope, warning these issues can block approval unless permissions are clarified and narrowed to pure open-source behavior.
timeline.point_zh: 审查草稿并指出开源风格混入商业化措辞，强调“授权材料/知识产权范围”存在致命歧义，认为应彻底澄清并回归单纯开源授权逻辑以免影响批准。
timeline.point: Reviews the ModelGo drafts as open-source-style commercial drafting with dangerous ambiguities in Licensed Materials and IP grant scope, warning these issues can block approval unless permissions are clarified and narrowed to pure open-source behavior.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Argues that model-output clauses should preserve open-source usefulness rather than enforce legal compliance, frames models like editors that export reusable code fragments, and says attribution is meant only when output is repackaged as datasets.
timeline.point_zh: 强调模型输出条款不应被当作法律合规强制工具，而是要维持开源价值，类比模型更像会输出代码片段的编辑器，并将归属要求限定在将输出打包为数据集时。
timeline.point: Argues that model-output clauses should preserve open-source usefulness rather than enforce legal compliance, frames models like editors that export reusable code fragments, and says attribution is meant only when output is repackaged as datasets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Highlights that the current language only asks for an AI-notice, not attribution or licensing conditions, says the notice obligation is not automatically inherited by derivative training, and questions enforceability where copyrightability of output is uncertain.
timeline.point_zh: 指出当前条文仅要求声明为AI生成，不是署名或许可条件，且该告知义务不会随派生训练自动传递，并质疑若输出版权属性不明确则强制执行基础薄弱。
timeline.point: Highlights that the current language only asks for an AI-notice, not attribution or licensing conditions, says the notice obligation is not automatically inherited by derivative training, and questions enforceability where copyrightability of output is uncertain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that some jurisdictions like the UK treat AI outputs as potentially copyrightable, so obligations on outputs may be feasible there, while warning that U.S. legal treatment remains debated.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒部分法域（如英国）将AI输出视为可受版权约束对象，因此输出义务可能成立，但指出美国法上是否构成版权客体仍在争议中。
timeline.point: Notes that some jurisdictions like the UK treat AI outputs as potentially copyrightable, so obligations on outputs may be feasible there, while warning that U.S. legal treatment remains debated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the review comments, requests additional time, and indicates legal interpretation is still pending while committing to clarify the open questions with outside legal support.
timeline.point_zh: 承认已收到意见并请求更多时间，表示相关问题仍需进一步法务解读，计划借助外部法律支持后再逐项澄清。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the review comments, requests additional time, and indicates legal interpretation is still pending while committing to clarify the open questions with outside legal support.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Concedes the notice can overstep for non-retraining users, offers a narrower option limited to dataset distributors, and justifies retaining source/model notice for MG-BY-OS to preserve copyleft inheritance in model-derived training workflows.
timeline.point_zh: 认可对非训练用户而言该提示可能过宽，提出仅约束分发数据集的替代方案，并认为在MG-BY-OS下仍需保留来源提示以维护copyleft衍生链条。
timeline.point: Concedes the notice can overstep for non-retraining users, offers a narrower option limited to dataset distributors, and justifies retaining source/model notice for MG-BY-OS to preserve copyleft inheritance in model-derived training workflows.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Flags a sublicenseability flaw that can break copyleft transmission, explains sublicensees may avoid output-label obligations, and concludes model-use requirements are enforceable only through direct contractual privity rather than copyright conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 指出可转授缺陷会削弱copyleft链条，认为受让方可能不在“你”之列从而可逃避输出标注义务，并强调模型类约束更依赖合同直接绑定而非版权条件。
timeline.point: Flags a sublicenseability flaw that can break copyleft transmission, explains sublicensees may avoid output-label obligations, and concludes model-use requirements are enforceable only through direct contractual privity rather than copyright conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Appreciates the legal explanation, agrees that the flaw was missed initially, identifies GPL auto-licensing versus sublicensing distinction, and commits to continued legal verification for unresolved licensing defects.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢解释并承认此前遗漏该缺陷，区分GPL自动授权与转授机制，表示将继续与法务核对并修正尚待确认的条款问题。
timeline.point: Appreciates the legal explanation, agrees that the flaw was missed initially, identifies GPL auto-licensing versus sublicensing distinction, and commits to continued legal verification for unresolved licensing defects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the legal view is presented from a U.S. perspective, acknowledges cross-jurisdiction variation, and states interpretation is expected to follow likely U.S. outcomes.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其意见主要基于美国法理，承认不同法域可能存在差异，并表示当前理解应以美国法律体系下的解释为主要判断。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the legal view is presented from a U.S. perspective, acknowledges cross-jurisdiction variation, and states interpretation is expected to follow likely U.S. outcomes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Responds that some license clauses are poorly drafted and not OSD-ready, explains the intended meaning of and/or for optional complementary materials, and accepts planned clarifications on database rights and derivative-material release options.
timeline.point_zh: 回应存在写法与OSD兼容性问题，解释对并/或的设计是考虑补充材料非必需场景，并计划在数据库权与授权方再生材料披露范围上持续澄清。
timeline.point: Responds that some license clauses are poorly drafted and not OSD-ready, explains the intended meaning of and/or for optional complementary materials, and accepts planned clarifications on database rights and derivative-material release options.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits revised MG0-2.0 for OSI review after broad cleanup edits, removal of annexes and restrictive clauses, and added output-as-dataset distribution conditions while positioning it as a permissive model-license option.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的MG0-2.0，说明已移除附录和部分限制条款、明确核心定义，并新增输出数据集分发条件，以将其定位为模型发布场景下较宽松的许可。
timeline.point: Submits revised MG0-2.0 for OSI review after broad cleanup edits, removal of annexes and restrictive clauses, and added output-as-dataset distribution conditions while positioning it as a permissive model-license option.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits revised MG-BY-2.0 with synchronized clause cleanup, updated definitions, and dataset-notice requirements, presenting it as the permissive non-copyleft variant in the ModelGo family.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的MG-BY-2.0，统一进行了删改、定义更新和输出数据集提示要求，定位为ModelGo家族中非copyleft的开源属性变体。
timeline.point: Submits revised MG-BY-2.0 with synchronized clause cleanup, updated definitions, and dataset-notice requirements, presenting it as the permissive non-copyleft variant in the ModelGo family.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits revised MG-BY-OS-2.0, reiterates copyleft alignment with source-code requirements and dataset-attribution clauses, and justifies the project as a model-focused alternative to OSS, OpenRAIL, and proprietary licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订MG-BY-OS-2.0，重申copyleft与源码随分发要求并结合输出数据集归属条款，说明其为针对模型发布、介于OSS与专有/OpenRAIL之间的替代方案。
timeline.point: Submits revised MG-BY-OS-2.0, reiterates copyleft alignment with source-code requirements and dataset-attribution clauses, and justifies the project as a model-focused alternative to OSS, OpenRAIL, and proprietary licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Reasserts that the updated output conditions appear to still impose OSD-incompatible limits on model outputs, and states the reviewer remains confused about how this addresses the earlier restriction concern.
timeline.point_zh: 再次强调新版本仍像是在模型输出上加限制且偏离OSD方向，表达仍不清楚修订为何能消解先前指出的问题。
timeline.point: Reasserts that the updated output conditions appear to still impose OSD-incompatible limits on model outputs, and states the reviewer remains confused about how this addresses the earlier restriction concern.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Defends dataset-level attribution as non-licensing policy and aligns with prior view that output itself is not maker-controlled use terms, arguing only distributed datasets need notices and rejecting conflation of regulation with license conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 维护仅在分发输出数据集时才要求注明来源的做法，重申输出本身应受使用方控制，不应把AI政策要求与许可条件混同。
timeline.point: Defends dataset-level attribution as non-licensing policy and aligns with prior view that output itself is not maker-controlled use terms, arguing only distributed datasets need notices and rejecting conflation of regulation with license conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Challenges the MG0 naming as misleading when mandatory license-copy distribution exists, then critiques grant wording for incomplete copyright and patent permissions and for potentially overbroad defensive termination, warning against weak legal drafting.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑MG0命名不当，因其并非完全“零义务”；并批评授予权利写法缺少完整版权和专利权限、终止条款可能过宽，认为不利于稳健许可。
timeline.point: Challenges the MG0 naming as misleading when mandatory license-copy distribution exists, then critiques grant wording for incomplete copyright and patent permissions and for potentially overbroad defensive termination, warning against weak legal drafting.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Repeats MG0 drafting objections against MG-Attribution, citing the same incomplete rights grant and broad patent-assertion termination, and argues cleaner permission language is needed to avoid ambiguous reservations.
timeline.point_zh: 将MG-Attribution与MG0并列复用同样批评，称权利授予未完整表述且终止机制过宽，建议更严谨写法以避免权利保留引发争议。
timeline.point: Repeats MG0 drafting objections against MG-Attribution, citing the same incomplete rights grant and broad patent-assertion termination, and argues cleaner permission language is needed to avoid ambiguous reservations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Repeats MG0 and MG-BY grant-deficiency concerns, proposes a clearer MG-BY-SA naming path, and flags possible OSD 9 tension between model output attribution obligations and data-information style requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 继续复述MG0与MG-BY文本问题，建议采用更清晰的MG-BY-SA名称，并提示输出归属义务与OSD 9“其他软件”边界之间可能存在张力。
timeline.point: Repeats MG0 and MG-BY grant-deficiency concerns, proposes a clearer MG-BY-SA naming path, and flags possible OSD 9 tension between model output attribution obligations and data-information style requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Critiques the update as a distillation-focused restriction on output, accepts good intent, but argues output-level limits are inconsistent with open-source principles and impractical once outputs are reused through multiple generations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为新版本倾向于压缩蒸馏或合成数据场景，对目标本意表示认可，但称输出层限制不符开源原则且多代重用后无法追踪，难以执行。
timeline.point: Critiques the update as a distillation-focused restriction on output, accepts good intent, but argues output-level limits are inconsistent with open-source principles and impractical once outputs are reused through multiple generations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Affirms MG licenses permit derivative creation and internal use without attribution, says attribution is only a lightweight distribution notice for dataset sharing, and rejects removing dataset provenance for convenience despite potential generational loss.
timeline.point_zh: 确认MG系列允许衍生模型及内部使用无需署名，强调仅在分发数据集时才需要轻量化来源说明，并反对为方便爬取而放弃来源信息。
timeline.point: Affirms MG licenses permit derivative creation and internal use without attribution, says attribution is only a lightweight distribution notice for dataset sharing, and rejects removing dataset provenance for convenience despite potential generational loss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Supports the current ModelGo Zero submission direction, aligning with the discussed review direction and indicating acceptance of existing feedback without adding new technical conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 支持当前 ModelGo Zero 重申提案方向，认可本轮讨论结论并表示与现有反馈保持一致，未再提出新的技术性条件。
timeline.point: Supports the current ModelGo Zero submission direction, aligning with the discussed review direction and indicating acceptance of existing feedback without adding new technical conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the feedback and plans to consult counsel, supports reducing MG0 burdens as a highly permissive license, but objects to encouraging users to delete the license file and disputes the claim that termination wording primarily addresses patent-trap risk.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈并将征求法务意见，认可 MG0 设计应尽量低负担，但反对引导用户删除许可文件，且不认同当前终止条款主要是为了规避所谓专利陷阱。
timeline.point: Thanks for the feedback and plans to consult counsel, supports reducing MG0 burdens as a highly permissive license, but objects to encouraging users to delete the license file and disputes the claim that termination wording primarily addresses patent-trap risk.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Disagrees with mandatory enumeration of grants, arguing cross-jurisdiction rights are easier to preserve when interpreted broadly, accepts some interpretive uncertainty, and asks whether any known license already includes derivative works in patent termination.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意必须把各项授权逐项枚举，认为跨法域下统一理解更能避免误差；虽承认存在解释不确定性，但仍追问是否已有许可文本已将衍生作品纳入专利终止。
timeline.point: Disagrees with mandatory enumeration of grants, arguing cross-jurisdiction rights are easier to preserve when interpreted broadly, accepts some interpretive uncertainty, and asks whether any known license already includes derivative works in patent termination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Reviews all drafts for readability and precision by proposing spelling, punctuation, and definitional edits, flags a potential derivative-text scope issue in Section 6, and flags BY-OS source-code delivery language as ambiguous about the actual recipient.
timeline.point_zh: 审查全部草案文本，提出拼写、标点和定义层面的可读性改进，指出第 6 节可能造成衍生作品意外被绑定，也指出 BY-OS 中“第三方”表述模糊于实际受领方。
timeline.point: Reviews all drafts for readability and precision by proposing spelling, punctuation, and definitional edits, flags a potential derivative-text scope issue in Section 6, and flags BY-OS source-code delivery language as ambiguous about the actual recipient.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Objects that output-linked duties exceed copyright control, argues copyleft conditions can only track distribution artifacts and derivatives, warns broader output or behavior obligations are overreaching, and concludes the single provision risks making the license non-Open Source.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将输出义务写入许可，主张 copyleft 应仅限定于分发物及其衍生物，认为扩展到输出或行为条件属于越界，且该单一条款可能使许可不再开源。
timeline.point: Objects that output-linked duties exceed copyright control, argues copyleft conditions can only track distribution artifacts and derivatives, warns broader output or behavior obligations are overreaching, and concludes the single provision risks making the license non-Open Source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Warns that obligations running with output are unprecedented in open-source, questions whether model attribution has the same basis as software copyright attribution, and says unclear duties for individual generated works impose heavy compliance friction and litigation exposure.
timeline.point_zh: 警告输出层面的持续义务在开源实践中前所未有，质疑模型署名能否与软件版权署名同一逻辑，并认为单件生成作品中的不确定要求会造成较高合规成本与诉讼风险。
timeline.point: Warns that obligations running with output are unprecedented in open-source, questions whether model attribution has the same basis as software copyright attribution, and says unclear duties for individual generated works impose heavy compliance friction and litigation exposure.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the input, distinguishes distillation from pre-training data scarcity, defends first-generation attribution for model-output datasets to prevent unlabelled bypasses, and asks for the specific OSD clause the output rule is claimed to violate.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈并区分蒸馏与预训练数据枯竭问题，主张在首代输出阶段的署名要求可防止无标注绕过，但坚持要求明确指出输出规则究竟违反了 OSD 的哪条款。
timeline.point: Thanks for the input, distinguishes distillation from pre-training data scarcity, defends first-generation attribution for model-output datasets to prevent unlabelled bypasses, and asks for the specific OSD clause the output rule is claimed to violate.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that under non-sublicensable grants every downstream user is effectively a first-generation licensee, and notes that a user of a model trained on output may under US contract law be deemed to have accepted the original license, though low probability.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清非可再授权许可下所有下游接收者原则上属于第一代许可使用者，并说明以输出训练而来的模型用户在美国法下可能被视为已接受原许可，但其发生概率较低。
timeline.point: Clarifies that under non-sublicensable grants every downstream user is effectively a first-generation licensee, and notes that a user of a model trained on output may under US contract law be deemed to have accepted the original license, though low probability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: States that no specific OSD section is likely breached, but emphasizes OSI can reject a license for broader software-freedom reasons; cites review-process precedent where a license may fail for issues not explicitly named in OSD text.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该条款未必直接违背具体 OSD 条文，但强调 OSI 可基于更广泛的软件自由性判断拒绝某许可证，并援引审核流程的先例说明并非必须逐条对应到 OSD 条款。
timeline.point: States that no specific OSD section is likely breached, but emphasizes OSI can reject a license for broader software-freedom reasons; cites review-process precedent where a license may fail for issues not explicitly named in OSD text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Licenses, review
timeline.snippet: Reports the committee is 58 days into a 60-day review window, finds discussion indicates further revisions are still needed before voting, and invites another revision cycle instead of moving to final approval.
timeline.point_zh: 说明委员会距 60 天时限还剩 2 天，讨论表明仍需进一步修订后才能进入表决，提议进入下一轮讨论而非立即提交审批。
timeline.point: Reports the committee is 58 days into a 60-day review window, finds discussion indicates further revisions are still needed before voting, and invites another revision cycle instead of moving to final approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Summarizes legal colleague responses, reopens patent-termination and copyleft ambiguities, and defends retaining output conditions as use-side controls that do not violate OSD wording while accepting that open-source and free-software values can diverge on this point.
timeline.point_zh: 汇总法务同僚意见并回应专利终止与 copyleft 的争议，认为输出控制可作为使用端约束继续保留且未必违背 OSD 表述，并指出开源与自由软件价值在该问题上可出现分歧。
timeline.point: Summarizes legal colleague responses, reopens patent-termination and copyleft ambiguities, and defends retaining output conditions as use-side controls that do not violate OSD wording while accepting that open-source and free-software values can diverge on this point.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Converts a message to text-only formatting for accessibility and requests avoiding color tags in responses, criticizing color-based answer markers as poor UX and hard to read on bright backgrounds.
timeline.point_zh: 将消息改为纯文本以便可读，要求回复不要使用彩色标记，并批评颜色标注答案在明亮界面下可读性差、属于糟糕的交互习惯。
timeline.point: Converts a message to text-only formatting for accessibility and requests avoiding color tags in responses, criticizing color-based answer markers as poor UX and hard to read on bright backgrounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Licenses, review
timeline.snippet: States willingness to submit revised ModelGo licenses after reflecting on discussion, commits to careful amendments, and expresses appreciation for all contributors who helped improve the draft.
timeline.point_zh: 表示经过充分讨论后将认真修订并再次提交许可证，承诺进行细致修改，并感谢所有参与者对改进文本的贡献。
timeline.point: States willingness to submit revised ModelGo licenses after reflecting on discussion, commits to careful amendments, and expresses appreciation for all contributors who helped improve the draft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the earlier display issue, agrees that attribution-on-dataset requirements are misaligned with open-source freedoms, and confirms preparation of another resubmission after further internal stakeholder discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 承认显示问题后认同“对模型生成数据集强制署名”与开源自由背离，并确认将继续与团队讨论后推进下一版提交。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the earlier display issue, agrees that attribution-on-dataset requirements are misaligned with open-source freedoms, and confirms preparation of another resubmission after further internal stakeholder discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Warns against licenses relying on probable noncompliance, argues ambiguous output-based copyleft creates selective enforcement risks, says this can amount to discrimination against certain users, and says no adequate justification has been provided for the output impairment.
timeline.point_zh: 警告不能让许可依赖“大家会不遵守”而设计，指出输出型 copyleft 义务模糊会导致对特定用户选择性执法，认为该做法可能歧视特定群体且缺乏充分正当理由。
timeline.point: Warns against licenses relying on probable noncompliance, argues ambiguous output-based copyleft creates selective enforcement risks, says this can amount to discrimination against certain users, and says no adequate justification has been provided for the output impairment.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Concedes the output condition may be ambiguous and low in practical value when knowledge boundaries are unclear, says unclear clauses reduce clarity, and says further work may remove the rule if a clean distinction between outputs cannot be made.
timeline.point_zh: 承认输出条款在“知识边界”不清下可能不明确且收益有限，认为含糊条款不利于清晰合规，并表示若无法清晰区分输出类型，将考虑移除该条款。
timeline.point: Concedes the output condition may be ambiguous and low in practical value when knowledge boundaries are unclear, says unclear clauses reduce clarity, and says further work may remove the rule if a clean distinction between outputs cannot be made.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains sublicensing versus non-sublicensing effects: where no sublicense is possible the downstream user takes the original license terms, while sublicensees can narrow granted permissions and licensors lack privity with sublicensees, which motivates GPL non-sublicensability.
timeline.point_zh: 解释可再授权与不可再授权差异：若不可再授权，下游用户沿用原始许可权责；可再授权可按原授权范围缩减授予内容，且原许可方与再授权方缺乏合同相对关系，因此 GPL 选择不允许再授权。
timeline.point: Explains sublicensing versus non-sublicensing effects: where no sublicense is possible the downstream user takes the original license terms, while sublicensees can narrow granted permissions and licensors lack privity with sublicensees, which motivates GPL non-sublicensability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Thanks the legal/privity explanation and says it substantially clarifies the earlier concerns about how sublicense structures and licensing obligations should be interpreted.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢该解释，表示对再授权结构及许可义务解释的先前疑问已被明显澄清。
timeline.point: Thanks the legal/privity explanation and says it substantially clarifies the earlier concerns about how sublicense structures and licensing obligations should be interpreted.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits MG-BY-2.0 as a second resubmission with model output restrictions removed, automatic termination added, explicit Section 2.1 grants expanded, derivative scope narrowed, derivative-license language removed from Section 5, and text/formatting errors corrected.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 MG-BY-2.0 第二次重申版本，移除模型输出限制，新增自动终止机制，细化并扩展 2.1 条授权表述，收窄 Derivative Materials 定义，删除第5条许可本体修改措辞，并修订文本与排版问题。
timeline.point: Submits MG-BY-2.0 as a second resubmission with model output restrictions removed, automatic termination added, explicit Section 2.1 grants expanded, derivative scope narrowed, derivative-license language removed from Section 5, and text/formatting errors corrected.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits MG0-2.0 as a second resubmission, removes output restrictions and license-document-carrying requirements, narrows the derivative definition, makes Section 2.1 permissions more explicit, eliminates one derivative-license modification bar, and fixes drafting and formatting issues.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 MG0-2.0 第二次重申版本，移除输出限制及随模型附带许可文本的要求，细化衍生材料定义，明确第2.1条授权，删除对许可文本修改的限制，并修正文本和格式问题。
timeline.point: Submits MG0-2.0 as a second resubmission, removes output restrictions and license-document-carrying requirements, narrows the derivative definition, makes Section 2.1 permissions more explicit, eliminates one derivative-license modification bar, and fixes drafting and formatting issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-ShareAlike License, Version 2.0
