timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Submits Ritchey Permissive License v11 for approval and says it aims for broad permissions, plain language, and a small footprint.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Ritchey Permissive License v11 供批准，并说明其目标是给予广泛权限、采用朴素语言并保持精简。
timeline.point: Submits Ritchey Permissive License v11 for approval and says it aims for broad permissions, plain language, and a small footprint.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that the license adds unnecessary proliferation, lacks legal review and real-world use, and does not improve enough over existing permissive licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证造成不必要的许可证扩散，缺乏法律审查和实际使用，相比现有宽松许可证也没有足够改进。
timeline.point: Argues that the license adds unnecessary proliferation, lacks legal review and real-world use, and does not improve enough over existing permissive licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says the "solely under this license" clause likely acts as copyleft, and urges OSI to disfavor choice-of-law clauses and require legal review for drafting problems.
timeline.point_zh: 认为“仅受此许可证约束”条款很可能构成 copyleft，并敦促 OSI 弱化法律适用条款，且在起草存在问题时要求法律审查。
timeline.point: Says the "solely under this license" clause likely acts as copyleft, and urges OSI to disfavor choice-of-law clauses and require legal review for drafting problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Defends the license as something he has used for years, says it broadens beyond "software," and argues it protects licensors when recipients never see the disclaimer.
timeline.point_zh: 为该许可证辩护，称他已使用多年，认为它比“software”更宽泛，并主张它能在接收者看不到免责声明时保护许可人。
timeline.point: Defends the license as something he has used for years, says it broadens beyond "software," and argues it protects licensors when recipients never see the disclaimer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the license does not force derivatives to be relicensed, and says the jurisdiction clause is meant to anchor interpretation in disputes.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清该许可证并不强制衍生作品重许可，并表示管辖条款是为了在争议中为解释提供依据。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the license does not force derivatives to be relicensed, and says the jurisdiction clause is meant to anchor interpretation in disputes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that blacklisting sublicensing is just copyleft and says the license is poorly thought out and executed.
timeline.point_zh: 指出禁止转授许可本质上就是 copyleft，并认为该许可证构思和执行都很糟糕。
timeline.point: Argues that blacklisting sublicensing is just copyleft and says the license is poorly thought out and executed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Recommends immediate rejection because the submitter admitted there was no legal review.
timeline.point_zh: 建议立即拒绝，因为提交者承认没有进行法律审查。
timeline.point: Recommends immediate rejection because the submitter admitted there was no legal review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Warns that the "lawful" wording may restrict use to legal purposes and asks for motivating examples behind the design choices.
timeline.point_zh: 警告“合法”措辞可能把使用范围限制为合法用途，并要求说明这些设计选择背后的动机实例。
timeline.point: Warns that the "lawful" wording may restrict use to legal purposes and asks for motivating examples behind the design choices.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Replies that "lawful" is meant to avoid endorsing illegal activity and that the blacklist-style drafting was chosen to keep the license short and flexible.
timeline.point_zh: 回应说“合法”是为了避免被理解为支持违法行为，而这种黑名单式写法是为了让许可证保持简短和灵活。
timeline.point: Replies that "lawful" is meant to avoid endorsing illegal activity and that the blacklist-style drafting was chosen to keep the license short and flexible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that lawful use is the wrong frame and that a copyright license must grant specific rights, not merely restate what the law already allows.
timeline.point_zh: 认为“合法使用”并非正确切入点，版权许可证必须明确授予具体权利，而不能只是重复法律本已允许的内容。
timeline.point: Argues that lawful use is the wrong frame and that a copyright license must grant specific rights, not merely restate what the law already allows.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says the layered disclaimer structure is intentional and that no existing license matched all of the author’s goals.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这种分层免责声明结构是有意设计的，并且现有许可证都无法完全满足作者的目标。
timeline.point: Says the layered disclaimer structure is intentional and that no existing license matched all of the author’s goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for reply-to-list confusion and says legal review is not currently a formal prerequisite, even if rejection on that basis would be understandable.
timeline.point_zh: 为回复误发到个人邮箱致歉，并表示虽然因缺乏法律审查而被拒绝可以理解，但当前并没有把法律审查作为正式前置条件。
timeline.point: Apologizes for reply-to-list confusion and says legal review is not currently a formal prerequisite, even if rejection on that basis would be understandable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says only the copyright holder can license the work, and that the 2-Clause BSD comparison is standard practice.
timeline.point_zh: 指出只有版权持有人才能授权该作品，并认为与 2-Clause BSD 的比较是常见做法。
timeline.point: Says only the copyright holder can license the work, and that the 2-Clause BSD comparison is standard practice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says he has no specific case law to cite and quotes the Copyright Act to support his reading of the license terms.
timeline.point_zh: 表示没有可引用的具体判例，并引用《版权法》来支持他对许可证条款的理解。
timeline.point: Says he has no specific case law to cite and quotes the Copyright Act to support his reading of the license terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says the "lawful" condition likely violates the OSD and asks for concrete real-world motivation for the license design.
timeline.point_zh: 认为“合法”条件很可能违反 OSD，并要求给出该许可证设计的具体现实动机。
timeline.point: Says the "lawful" condition likely violates the OSD and asks for concrete real-world motivation for the license design.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Explains that the license was not based on case law, and cites 0BSD as an example of a license that leaves downstream recipients less protected.
timeline.point_zh: 说明该许可证并非基于判例法设计，并以 0BSD 为例说明下游接收者得到的保护更弱。
timeline.point: Explains that the license was not based on case law, and cites 0BSD as an example of a license that leaves downstream recipients less protected.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Recommends rejecting the license because the British Columbia court restriction is bad for everyone, including the courts.
timeline.point_zh: 建议拒绝该许可证，因为仅限不列颠哥伦比亚法院受理的限制对所有人乃至法院本身都不利。
timeline.point: Recommends rejecting the license because the British Columbia court restriction is bad for everyone, including the courts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Explains that the mailing list is public and messages are forwarded to all members, not just the OSI Board.
timeline.point_zh: 解释说该邮件列表是公开的，邮件会转发给所有成员，而不仅仅是 OSI 董事会。
timeline.point: Explains that the mailing list is public and messages are forwarded to all members, not just the OSI Board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI approval should not bless legally dubious instruments and says a meaningful license submission needs legal review.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 不应为法律上可疑的工具背书，并指出有意义的许可证提交需要法律审查。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI approval should not bless legally dubious instruments and says a meaningful license submission needs legal review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Defends the BC venue clause as a way to limit foreign-jurisdiction disputes and give the copyright holder predictable law.
timeline.point_zh: 为不列颠哥伦比亚管辖条款辩护，认为它可以限制外国司法争议，并为版权持有人提供可预期的法律环境。
timeline.point: Defends the BC venue clause as a way to limit foreign-jurisdiction disputes and give the copyright holder predictable law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says stricter legal review would be a good idea, but notes the current process does not require it and cites 0BSD as precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 认为更严格的法律审查是好事，但指出当前流程并未强制要求，并以 0BSD 作为先例。
timeline.point: Says stricter legal review would be a good idea, but notes the current process does not require it and cites 0BSD as precedent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Calls the BSD-0 comparison misleading and points out that 0BSD is simply ISC without attribution and license clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为拿 BSD-0 来类比具有误导性，并指出 0BSD 只是去掉了署名和许可证条款的 ISC。
timeline.point: Calls the BSD-0 comparison misleading and points out that 0BSD is simply ISC without attribution and license clauses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that modifying an existing license without legal expertise carries the same risks as writing one from scratch.
timeline.point_zh: 主张在没有法律专业帮助下修改现有许可证，与从头起草许可证具有同样的风险。
timeline.point: Argues that modifying an existing license without legal expertise carries the same risks as writing one from scratch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says the BC-only venue clause blocks proceedings in Ontario and may conflict with federal jurisdiction over IP disputes.
timeline.point_zh: 指出仅限不列颠哥伦比亚的管辖条款会阻止在安大略提起程序，并可能与联邦对知识产权争议的管辖权冲突。
timeline.point: Says the BC-only venue clause blocks proceedings in Ontario and may conflict with federal jurisdiction over IP disputes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Raises the stronger objection that a BC-only clause may be impossible for licensors in embargoed countries, which would violate OSD5.
timeline.point_zh: 提出更强烈的反对意见：仅限不列颠哥伦比亚的条款可能让受制裁国家的许可人无法使用，从而违反 OSD5。
timeline.point: Raises the stronger objection that a BC-only clause may be impossible for licensors in embargoed countries, which would violate OSD5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Agrees venue restrictions are worth concern, but notes that the Eclipse Public License has also used New York jurisdiction.
timeline.point_zh: 同意对管辖限制应予关注，但指出 Eclipse Public License 也曾使用纽约管辖。
timeline.point: Agrees venue restrictions are worth concern, but notes that the Eclipse Public License has also used New York jurisdiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Says choice-of-law and venue clauses are common in older OSI licenses but should be disfavored because they burden users unevenly.
timeline.point_zh: 表示法律适用和管辖地条款在较早的 OSI 许可证中很常见，但应被弱化，因为它们对用户的负担不均衡。
timeline.point: Says choice-of-law and venue clauses are common in older OSI licenses but should be disfavored because they burden users unevenly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Finds the license ambiguously drafted, especially around "lawful" use, and says the downstream liability scheme is too draconian and potentially incompatible.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证措辞含糊，尤其是“合法”用途部分，而且其下游责任安排过于严苛，且可能存在兼容性问题。
timeline.point: Finds the license ambiguously drafted, especially around "lawful" use, and says the downstream liability scheme is too draconian and potentially incompatible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Defends the short-form drafting, says jurisdiction is used to anchor interpretation of undefined terms, and explains that "lawful" means permitted by the relevant law.
timeline.point_zh: 为这种简短写法辩护，称引入管辖地是为了为未定义术语提供解释基础，并解释“合法”指的是相关法律所允许。
timeline.point: Defends the short-form drafting, says jurisdiction is used to anchor interpretation of undefined terms, and explains that "lawful" means permitted by the relevant law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that the submitter is wrong about BSD-style licensing and should concede the point rather than continue disputing it.
timeline.point_zh: 主张提交者关于 BSD 式许可的说法是错误的，应承认该问题而不是继续争辩。
timeline.point: Argues that the submitter is wrong about BSD-style licensing and should concede the point rather than continue disputing it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyright holders control relicensing permissions and that the cited copyleft guide supports his view.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权持有人控制再许可权限，并认为对方引用的 copyleft 指南支持自己的观点。
timeline.point: Argues that copyright holders control relicensing permissions and that the cited copyleft guide supports his view.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that citing GPL does not answer concerns about the submitter treating BSD-like licensing as copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 主张引用 GPL 不能回应提交者把 BSD 式许可当作 copyleft 的问题。
timeline.point: Argues that citing GPL does not answer concerns about the submitter treating BSD-like licensing as copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Warns that the submitter’s explanations of “lawful” may sound condescending to highly experienced IP lawyers.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒提交者，其对“lawful”的解释面对资深知识产权律师时可能显得居高临下。
timeline.point: Warns that the submitter’s explanations of “lawful” may sound condescending to highly experienced IP lawyers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that neither BSD nor the submitted license is claimed to be copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清自己并未声称 BSD 或所提交的许可证是 copyleft。
timeline.point: Clarifies that neither BSD nor the submitted license is claimed to be copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Asks the submitter to define copyleft in light of statements about keeping material under one license.
timeline.point_zh: 要求提交者结合其“保持在同一许可证下”的说法定义 copyleft。
timeline.point: Asks the submitter to define copyleft in light of statements about keeping material under one license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Explains that he is defending design choices and possible interpretations, not trying to overrule reviewers.
timeline.point_zh: 说明自己是在解释设计选择和可能解释，并非试图否定审查者意见。
timeline.point: Explains that he is defending design choices and possible interpretations, not trying to overrule reviewers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Defines copyleft as a requirement affecting the licensee’s own contributions and explains why he does not view his license that way.
timeline.point_zh: 将 copyleft 定义为影响被许可人自身贡献的要求，并解释为何不认为自己的许可证属于此类。
timeline.point: Defines copyleft as a requirement affecting the licensee’s own contributions and explains why he does not view his license that way.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues bluntly that programmers should not draft legal licenses without the necessary legal skill.
timeline.point_zh: 直言程序员不应在缺乏法律技能时起草法律许可证。
timeline.point: Argues bluntly that programmers should not draft legal licenses without the necessary legal skill.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Argues that the “lawful purposes” clause is outside a license’s proper scope, violates OSD 6, and warrants rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 主张“合法目的”条款超出许可证应有范围，违反 OSD 第 6 条，并足以导致拒绝。
timeline.point: Argues that the “lawful purposes” clause is outside a license’s proper scope, violates OSD 6, and warrants rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Submits the License Committee recommendation that the Ritchey Permissive License v11 not be approved because it is ambiguous and nonconforming.
timeline.point_zh: 提交许可证委员会建议，认为 Ritchey Permissive License v11 含糊且不符合 OSD，不应批准。
timeline.point: Submits the License Committee recommendation that the Ritchey Permissive License v11 not be approved because it is ambiguous and nonconforming.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request - For Approval - Ritchey Permissive License v11
timeline.snippet: Announces that the OSI Board did not approve the Ritchey Permissive License v11.
timeline.point_zh: 公告 OSI 董事会未批准 Ritchey Permissive License v11。
timeline.point: Announces that the OSI Board did not approve the Ritchey Permissive License v11.

timeline.point: Says the license is unlikely to be approved because requiring runtime credit behavior conflicts with the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that runtime notice requirements are not unprecedented, but says similar attribution licenses should still be rejected because they create user-hostile and ineffective obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为运行时通知要求并非前所未有，但仍主张类似的署名型许可证应被拒绝，因为它们会带来对用户不友好的负担且效果不佳。
timeline.point: Argues that runtime notice requirements are not unprecedented, but says similar attribution licenses should still be rejected because they create user-hostile and ineffective obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the proposed license has been reviewed by an attorney, since that is required for consideration.
timeline.point_zh: 询问该许可证是否已经由律师审阅，因为这属于审议前的必要条件。
timeline.point: Asks whether the proposed license has been reviewed by an attorney, since that is required for consideration.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Treats the submission as a useful test case for questions about badgeware, precedent, and how OSI should handle potentially problematic approved licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 把这次提交视为一个很好的测试案例，用来讨论 badgeware、先例，以及 OSI 应如何处理可能有问题的已批准许可证。
timeline.point: Treats the submission as a useful test case for questions about badgeware, precedent, and how OSI should handle potentially problematic approved licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Says the badgeware-style condition is enough reason to decertify those licenses or at least warn authors not to reuse them.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这种 badgeware 式条件已经足以让这些许可证失去认证，至少也应警告作者不要再复用。
timeline.point: Says the badgeware-style condition is enough reason to decertify those licenses or at least warn authors not to reuse them.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the submitted license is the new one under review and that the differences from AAL are mostly grammatical, plus a disclaimer tweak and a binary-only badge requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 说明正在审议的是新提交的许可证，而与 AAL 的差异大多只是语法调整、免责声明修改以及把徽标要求限制在二进制上。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the submitted license is the new one under review and that the differences from AAL are mostly grammatical, plus a disclaimer tweak and a binary-only badge requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Calls the approval history embarrassing, votes to reject the new license over badgeware and other issues, and asks that AAL be forwarded for removal from the approved list.
timeline.point_zh: 认为过去的批准历史很糟糕，主张因 badgeware 及其他问题拒绝新许可证，并要求把 AAL 转交董事会移出已批准名单。
timeline.point: Calls the approval history embarrassing, votes to reject the new license over badgeware and other issues, and asks that AAL be forwarded for removal from the approved list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Says the old process had some mistakes, though not major ones, and that they would not approve them the same way today.
timeline.point_zh: 表示过去的流程确实犯过一些错，但不算大错，如今也不会再那样批准。
timeline.point: Says the old process had some mistakes, though not major ones, and that they would not approve them the same way today.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks whether earlier mistakes should be identified and flagged for future users and submitters.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否应当把过去的错误识别并标注出来，方便未来的使用者和提交者。
timeline.point: Asks whether earlier mistakes should be identified and flagged for future users and submitters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Replies that the license only requires copyright and attribution notices in source and binary distributions, explains the lack of legal review, and says they are open to feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 回应说该许可证只要求在源码和二进制分发中保留版权与署名信息，说明目前没有法律审查，并表示愿意接受反馈。
timeline.point: Replies that the license only requires copyright and attribution notices in source and binary distributions, explains the lack of legal review, and says they are open to feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Points to CPAL as an approved license with prominent-display language and says they are trying to preserve copyright and attribution notices.
timeline.point_zh: 拿 CPAL 作为已有的批准案例，说明他们只是想保留版权和署名信息。
timeline.point: Points to CPAL as an approved license with prominent-display language and says they are trying to preserve copyright and attribution notices.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Adds CPAL 1.0 as a similar approved license example.
timeline.point_zh: 补充指出 CPAL 1.0 是一个类似的已批准许可证。
timeline.point: Adds CPAL 1.0 as a similar approved license example.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that common licenses already cover copyright and attribution retention, and that the real issue is whether those notices must appear in source, binary, or runtime user-facing form.
timeline.point_zh: 说明常见许可证本来就能覆盖版权与署名保留，真正的争议在于这些信息到底要出现在源码、二进制，还是运行时的用户界面中。
timeline.point: Explains that common licenses already cover copyright and attribution retention, and that the real issue is whether those notices must appear in source, binary, or runtime user-facing form.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the goal is to keep original work credit visible in modified works and argues that CPAL shows OSI-approved examples already exist.
timeline.point_zh: 解释说他们只是希望在修改版中保留原作署名，并指出 CPAL 说明 OSI 批准的类似做法早已存在。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the goal is to keep original work credit visible in modified works and argues that CPAL shows OSI-approved examples already exist.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Notes that the GPL has long had a form of requirement (3), and argues the practical issue is whether license terms are conditional enough to be enforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 GPL 早就包含某种第 (3) 类要求，并认为实际问题在于这些条款是否足够条件化、能否在实践中执行。
timeline.point: Notes that the GPL has long had a form of requirement (3), and argues the practical issue is whether license terms are conditional enough to be enforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that GPLv3-style flexibility makes notice requirements acceptable, but a mandatory splash screen is a clear OSD#10 problem because it breaks headless, embedded, and GUI-less use cases.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 GPLv3 式的灵活通知要求是可以接受的，但强制 splash screen 会让无头、嵌入式和无 GUI 场景都无法使用，明显触犯 OSD#10。
timeline.point: Argues that GPLv3-style flexibility makes notice requirements acceptable, but a mandatory splash screen is a clear OSD#10 problem because it breaks headless, embedded, and GUI-less use cases.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that the example language is broader than a splash screen and asks whether the draft should be rewritten in clearer English and tailored to web software.
timeline.point_zh: 认为示例措辞并不等于强制 splash screen，并询问草案是否应改写得更清楚，甚至更适合 Web 软件场景。
timeline.point: Argues that the example language is broader than a splash screen and asks whether the draft should be rewritten in clearer English and tailored to web software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Thanks the submitter, but advises them to consider already-approved alternatives like AGPLv3 or CAL instead of spending more limited resources on a new license.
timeline.point_zh: 先表示感谢，但建议对方考虑 AGPLv3 或 CAL 之类已批准的替代方案，而不是继续把有限资源投入新许可证。
timeline.point: Thanks the submitter, but advises them to consider already-approved alternatives like AGPLv3 or CAL instead of spending more limited resources on a new license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Notes that the submitted license is a minor revision of the existing AAL and asks whether retaining a lawyer is required under those circumstances.
timeline.point_zh: 指出提交的许可证是对现有 AAL 的小幅修订，并询问在此情况下是否必须聘请律师。
timeline.point: Notes that the submitted license is a minor revision of the existing AAL and asks whether retaining a lawyer is required under those circumstances.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSSNL has serious wording issues (e.g., contradictory clauses) and that Syed would be far better off choosing a mainstream license, as even an acceptable custom license would deter adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSSNL 存在严重的措辞和概念问题（如条款自相矛盾），认为 Syed 采用主流许可证是更好的选择，因为即使自定义许可证获得批准也会阻碍采用和贡献。
timeline.point: Argues the OSSNL has serious wording issues (e.g., contradictory clauses) and that Syed would be far better off choosing a mainstream license, as even an acceptable custom license would deter adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the Cryptographic Autonomy License is close to their needs and asks about reselling rights, whether CAPL/ALL will be removed, and whether using an unapproved license would lead to legal action from opensource.org.
timeline.point_zh: 承认密码学自主许可证（CAL）接近其需求，询问转售权利、CAPL/ALL 是否会被移除，以及使用未经批准的许可证是否会招致 opensource.org 的法律行动。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the Cryptographic Autonomy License is close to their needs and asks about reselling rights, whether CAPL/ALL will be removed, and whether using an unapproved license would lead to legal action from opensource.org.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks whether using the unapproved OSSNL license for their own software would result in legal problems from opensource.org, given their domain contains the keyword 'opensource'.
timeline.point_zh: 询问在域名包含'opensource'关键词的情况下，继续使用未经批准的 OSSNL 许可证是否会招致 opensource.org 的法律问题。
timeline.point: Asks whether using the unapproved OSSNL license for their own software would result in legal problems from opensource.org, given their domain contains the keyword 'opensource'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Announces decision to adopt the Cryptographic Autonomy License 1.0 and requests closing the license approval request, sharing a Q&A summary of the CAL terms.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布决定采用密码学自主许可证 1.0，请求关闭许可证审批申请，并分享了 CAL 条款的问答摘要。
timeline.point: Announces decision to adopt the Cryptographic Autonomy License 1.0 and requests closing the license approval request, sharing a Q&A summary of the CAL terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Recommends using the CAL directly without renaming, keeping any Q&A guidance separate from the license text, and wishes good luck with the project.
timeline.point_zh: 建议直接使用 CAL 而不重命名，将问答指南与许可证文本分开，并祝愿项目顺利。
timeline.point: Recommends using the CAL directly without renaming, keeping any Q&A guidance separate from the license text, and wishes good luck with the project.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Confirms the Q&A will be on a separate page and that they will use an unmodified CAL, while still asking whether using an unapproved OSI license could cause legal problems from opensource.org.
timeline.point_zh: 确认问答将放在单独页面，将使用未修改的 CAL，同时仍在询问使用未经批准的 OSI 许可证是否会导致 opensource.org 的法律问题。
timeline.point: Confirms the Q&A will be on a separate page and that they will use an unmodified CAL, while still asking whether using an unapproved OSI license could cause legal problems from opensource.org.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the CAL is suitable given its complexity and novelty, warns that switching from permissive to copyleft is a big shift, and notes the proposed OSSNL has contradictory and overly restrictive attribution terms.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 CAL 是否适合其需求（因复杂且新），警告从宽松许可转为 copyleft 是重大转变，并指出提议的 OSSNL 存在条款矛盾和归属要求过于严格的问题。
timeline.point: Questions whether the CAL is suitable given its complexity and novelty, warns that switching from permissive to copyleft is a big shift, and notes the proposed OSSNL has contradictory and overly restrictive attribution terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Thanks Lukas for the explanation and says they will monitor the thread for 1-2 more days before deciding between CAL or a custom license.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Lukas 的解释，表示将继续关注讨论 1-2 天，再最终决定使用 CAL 还是自定义许可证。
timeline.point: Thanks Lukas for the explanation and says they will monitor the thread for 1-2 more days before deciding between CAL or a custom license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that attorneys are needed for their drafting skills, clarifies OSI has no certification mark on 'Open Source' but warns of legal fraud risk if using an unapproved license while claiming software is open source.
timeline.point_zh: 解释需要律师是因为其专业起草技能，澄清 OSI 没有'Open Source'认证标志，但警告使用未经批准的许可证同时宣称软件是开源的可能面临欺诈法律风险。
timeline.point: Explains that attorneys are needed for their drafting skills, clarifies OSI has no certification mark on 'Open Source' but warns of legal fraud risk if using an unapproved license while claiming software is open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Advises downloading the CAL directly from OpenSource.org and distributing it as a LICENSE file for automated verification, noting that legally words are words.
timeline.point_zh: 建议从 OpenSource.org 直接下载许可证并以 LICENSE 文件形式分发以便自动化工具验证，并指出法律上文字就是文字。
timeline.point: Advises downloading the CAL directly from OpenSource.org and distributing it as a LICENSE file for automated verification, noting that legally words are words.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Rejects Lukas's claim that using an unapproved license carries no legal risk, stating the OSI does not stand behind that statement.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Lukas 关于使用未经批准的许可证没有法律风险的说法，声明 OSI 不支持该立场。
timeline.point: Rejects Lukas's claim that using an unapproved license carries no legal risk, stating the OSI does not stand behind that statement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks where to download the CAL license file, explains they prefer an OSI-approved license to avoid criticism, and plans to hire an attorney for a custom license in the future.
timeline.point_zh: 询问在哪里下载 CAL 许可证文件，解释为避免批评偏好使用 OSI 批准的许可证，并计划未来聘请律师起草自定义许可证。
timeline.point: Asks where to download the CAL license file, explains they prefer an OSI-approved license to avoid criticism, and plans to hire an attorney for a custom license in the future.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Confirms CAL has been approved but not yet uploaded to the website, notes he is no longer the webmaster, and suggests Patrick Mason might help resolve the issue.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 CAL 已获批准但尚未上传到网站，说明自己已不是网站管理员，建议 Patrick Mason 可能帮忙解决此问题。
timeline.point: Confirms CAL has been approved but not yet uploaded to the website, notes he is no longer the webmaster, and suggests Patrick Mason might help resolve the issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Advises that each source file must be updated to reference CAL, and explains that falsely claiming open source status typically attracts negative publicity that forces correction.
timeline.point_zh: 建议每个源文件都必须更新为标注 CAL 许可证，并解释虚假宣称开源通常会招致负面宣传从而迫使改正。
timeline.point: Advises that each source file must be updated to reference CAL, and explains that falsely claiming open source status typically attracts negative publicity that forces correction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: For Approval | Open Source Social Network License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Announces the license has been changed to CAL 1.0 and requests closing the approval request, thanking the community for their help.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布许可证已更改为 CAL 1.0，请求关闭审批申请，并感谢社区的帮助。
timeline.point: Announces the license has been changed to CAL 1.0 and requests closing the approval request, thanking the community for their help.

developers contribute their work freely to be used in this way. It’s time
for Open Source developers to *ask for something *in return for that work.

it is scientifically verified, because so many people are killed or maimed
because their parents deny them vaccination, and because the ignorance that
causes rejection of vaccination is an easily-identifiable evil. There are
no legal ambiguities where rejection of vaccination is concerned, so it is
simple to require it in a license.

around you. It effects people you care about, but you’re unable to
intervene. Or you were, until now.

to reject the Vaccine License.

Argument: *The Vaccine License does not benefit the Open Source Community
sufficiently to be adopted as an Open Source License.*

Source Community, since it requires that those members get their shots, the
Vaccine License is of greater benefit to the community than any other
license that simply governs the use, distribution, and modification of
software.*

<https://opensource.org/osd/#persons-or-groups> of the Open Source

timeline.point_zh: 认为疫苗接种是值得支持的目标，但许可证条款不是合适工具，直接立法会比伦理性许可证条件更有效。
timeline.point: Says vaccination is a worthy cause but license terms are the wrong tool, and that direct law would be more effective than ethical license conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues the vaccine requirement is inappropriate because it imposes conditions logically unrelated to the intellectual-property permissions granted by the license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为疫苗要求并不合适，因为它施加的条件在逻辑上与许可证授予的知识产权权限无关。
timeline.point: Argues the vaccine requirement is inappropriate because it imposes conditions logically unrelated to the intellectual-property permissions granted by the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Tells the submitter to stop trying to moderate the list and leave moderation to the moderators.
timeline.point_zh: 要求提交者不要自行在邮件列表上行使管理职责，而应把管理工作留给版主。
timeline.point: Tells the submitter to stop trying to moderate the list and leave moderation to the moderators.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Says ethically motivated conditions can be discussed, but copyright licenses are the wrong vehicle because enforceability and privacy problems remain; advocacy would be better.
timeline.point_zh: 认为可以讨论带有伦理动机的条件，但版权许可证并不是合适载体，因为仍存在可执行性和隐私问题；倡议宣传会更好。
timeline.point: Says ethically motivated conditions can be discussed, but copyright licenses are the wrong vehicle because enforceability and privacy problems remain; advocacy would be better.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Says he thought on-list discussion of conduct was acceptable and will contact moderators directly next time because their identity was not obvious.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己原以为可以在邮件列表上讨论行为问题，并称下次会直接联系版主，因为版主身份并不明显。
timeline.point: Says he thought on-list discussion of conduct was acceptable and will contact moderators directly next time because their identity was not obvious.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSD and archives do not clearly spell out the rule on unrelated conditions, so people are reverse-engineering it from approved licenses and need clearer written guidance.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD 和邮件归档并未清楚写明与主题无关条件的规则，因此大家只能从已批准许可证中反向推断，亟需更明确的书面指引。
timeline.point: Argues the OSD and archives do not clearly spell out the rule on unrelated conditions, so people are reverse-engineering it from approved licenses and need clearer written guidance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Treats the Vaccine License as a clear textbook example of an unrelated-conditions license and urges the list to create a clear decision that can be cited in future cases.
timeline.point_zh: 把 Vaccine License 视为与主题无关条件许可证的清晰教材案例，并主张形成一个今后可援引的明确决定。
timeline.point: Treats the Vaccine License as a clear textbook example of an unrelated-conditions license and urges the list to create a clear decision that can be cited in future cases.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Simon was speaking only in a personal capacity and not as the head or official voice of the OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 Simon 只是以个人身份发言，并不是 OSI 的负责人或官方立场代表。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Simon was speaking only in a personal capacity and not as the head or official voice of the OSI.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the clarification and says he reviewed the archives but lost track of the EUPL 2.0 discussion because the plaintext archives are hard to follow.
timeline.point_zh: 接受了这一澄清，并表示自己提交前查过归档，但由于纯文本归档难以追踪，他没能继续跟上 EUPL 2.0 的讨论。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the clarification and says he reviewed the archives but lost track of the EUPL 2.0 discussion because the plaintext archives are hard to follow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether unenforceable ethical conditions still have value as statements of intent, and asks whether there is precedent for restricting use in morally objectionable ways.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑即便不可执行，伦理性条件是否仍作为意图声明具有价值，并询问是否存在限制道德上不可接受用途的先例。
timeline.point: Questions whether unenforceable ethical conditions still have value as statements of intent, and asks whether there is precedent for restricting use in morally objectionable ways.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues the license regulates unrelated personal actions rather than software use, and says it clearly violates OSD 5 because chosen communities still count as protected groups.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证规制的是与软件使用无关的个人行为，并明确指出它违反 OSD 5，因为基于选择形成的群体同样属于受保护群体。
timeline.point: Argues the license regulates unrelated personal actions rather than software use, and says it clearly violates OSD 5 because chosen communities still count as protected groups.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues the license discriminates against a group, is hard to apply or enforce under privacy and labor law, and belongs in public law rather than copyright licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证歧视某一群体，在隐私法和劳动法下也难以适用或执行，而且这种激励应当属于公法而非版权许可。
timeline.point: Argues the license discriminates against a group, is hard to apply or enforce under privacy and labor law, and belongs in public law rather than copyright licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Suggests using the submission as a documented example on opensource.org because it is a clear case of an unrelated-conditions license and will not be the last.
timeline.point_zh: 建议把这次提交作为 opensource.org 上的成文案例，因为它是与主题无关条件许可证的清晰例子，而且不会是最后一个。
timeline.point: Suggests using the submission as a documented example on opensource.org because it is a clear case of an unrelated-conditions license and will not be the last.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that the idea should be rejected decisively and says open-source licensing should not be used to solve unrelated social problems.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同应当果断否定这种思路，并认为开源许可不应被拿来解决与其无关的社会问题。
timeline.point: Agrees that the idea should be rejected decisively and says open-source licensing should not be used to solve unrelated social problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the analysis would change if the license were applied to health software directly involved in tracking and planning immunizations.
timeline.point_zh: 询问如果该许可证用于直接涉及免疫跟踪和规划的健康软件，分析结论是否会改变。
timeline.point: Asks whether the analysis would change if the license were applied to health software directly involved in tracking and planning immunizations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues that ethics should be enforced collectively through law, not private license terms, and notes that trying to do this through licenses risks legal uncertainty and copyright-misuse problems.
timeline.point_zh: 认为伦理应通过法律这种集体机制来执行，而不是私人许可条款；若通过许可证这样做，会带来法律不确定性以及版权滥用问题。
timeline.point: Argues that ethics should be enforced collectively through law, not private license terms, and notes that trying to do this through licenses risks legal uncertainty and copyright-misuse problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the vaccine requirement is valid consideration for the license grant and should be treated as an ongoing obligation rather than a condition precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 主张接种要求可以作为许可授权的有效对价，并且应被视为授权后的持续义务，而非先决条件。
timeline.point: Argues that the vaccine requirement is valid consideration for the license grant and should be treated as an ongoing obligation rather than a condition precedent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Reports the committee recommendation to deny approval because the Vaccine License discriminates against unvaccinated people and therefore fails OSD 5.
timeline.point_zh: 转达委员会建议不予批准，理由是 Vaccine License 对未接种者构成歧视，因此不符合 OSD 第5条。
timeline.point: Reports the committee recommendation to deny approval because the Vaccine License discriminates against unvaccinated people and therefore fails OSD 5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Announces that the OSI board voted 9-0 to withhold approval of the Vaccine License.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布 OSI 董事会以 9 比 0 的投票结果决定不批准 Vaccine License。
timeline.point: Announces that the OSI board voted 9-0 to withhold approval of the Vaccine License.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Asks why OSI believes the submitter is willing and able to revise the Vaccine License constructively.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 OSI 依据什么认为提交者愿意且能够建设性地修改 Vaccine License。
timeline.point: Asks why OSI believes the submitter is willing and able to revise the Vaccine License constructively.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Vaccine License
timeline.snippet: Says the submitter should be given the benefit of the doubt and another chance to revise.
timeline.point_zh: 表示愿意对提交者是否愿意修改给予善意推定，并再给一次机会。
timeline.point: Says the submitter should be given the benefit of the doubt and another chance to revise.

board_vote.motion_text: The Board of the Open Source Initiative withholds approval of the Vaccine License as an Open Source Initiative Approved Open Source license
board_vote.discussion: Review of the License Review committee’s decision making and decision.

submissions.rejection_reason: License Committee recommended rejection; Board approved. Violates OSD #5 (No Discrimination Against Persons or Groups) because it conditions use on having received vaccines.

submissions.name: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. Additional terms on top of GPLv3 were seen as violating the spirit of GPLv3's section 7 limitations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Submits a GPLv3-plus-additional-terms license under GPL section 7, arguing it improves warranty, liability, indemnification, and attribution protections while remaining reusable. Notes there has been no legal review.
timeline.point_zh: 提交一份基于 GPL 第7条增加附加条款的 GPLv3 许可证，主张其改进了担保、责任、赔偿和署名保护，同时保持可复用性，并说明尚未经过法律审查。
timeline.point: Submits a GPLv3-plus-additional-terms license under GPL section 7, arguing it improves warranty, liability, indemnification, and attribution protections while remaining reusable. Notes there has been no legal review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says the license may not violate the OSD, but argues it should be rejected because submitting it without legal review puts developers at risk and it should be resubmitted after lawyer review.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该许可证未必违反 OSD，但认为它因缺乏法律审查而会给开发者带来风险，因此应先由律师审查后再重新提交。
timeline.point: Says the license may not violate the OSD, but argues it should be rejected because submitting it without legal review puts developers at risk and it should be resubmitted after lawyer review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Supports the idea in principle and suggests asking the FSF, noting they may be interested in stronger indemnification language.
timeline.point_zh: 原则上支持这一想法，并建议征询 FSF 的意见，认为他们可能会对更强的赔偿条款感兴趣。
timeline.point: Supports the idea in principle and suggests asking the FSF, noting they may be interested in stronger indemnification language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Argues that indemnification is a legitimate open-source licensing concept, asks why GPLv3 permits it only as an added term, and plans to ask the FSF.
timeline.point_zh: 主张赔偿条款在开源许可中是合理概念，并询问 GPLv3 为何只允许将其作为附加条款，同时表示将向 FSF 询问。
timeline.point: Argues that indemnification is a legitimate open-source licensing concept, asks why GPLv3 permits it only as an added term, and plans to ask the FSF.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Argues the submission may merely be a GPLv3 Section 7 supplement, not a wholly new nonfree license, and says an approved Clause 7-based license would be useful.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该提交也许只是 GPLv3 第 7 条下的补充条款，而不是全新的非自由许可证，并认为拥有一个基于第 7 条的已批准许可证会很有用。
timeline.point: Argues the submission may merely be a GPLv3 Section 7 supplement, not a wholly new nonfree license, and says an approved Clause 7-based license would be useful.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI should not review GPLv3 additional restrictions, says the submission is out of scope, and notes the proposed "Notwithstanding" clause is misunderstood.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 不应审查 GPLv3 的附加限制，认为该提交超出审查范围，并指出所提的 “Notwithstanding” 条款被误解了。
timeline.point: Argues OSI should not review GPLv3 additional restrictions, says the submission is out of scope, and notes the proposed "Notwithstanding" clause is misunderstood.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Explains that GPLv3's indemnification-related language was added only to preserve Apache 2.0 compatibility, and dismisses the ToS example as irrelevant.
timeline.point_zh: 解释说 GPLv3 中与赔偿相关的措辞只是为了保持与 Apache 2.0 的兼容性，并认为服务条款示例并不相关。
timeline.point: Explains that GPLv3's indemnification-related language was added only to preserve Apache 2.0 compatibility, and dismisses the ToS example as irrelevant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says that if the text is merely a GPLv3 supplement, that reinforces the view that it falls outside OSI review.
timeline.point_zh: 表示如果该文本只是 GPLv3 的补充条款，那反而进一步说明它不属于 OSI 的审查范围。
timeline.point: Says that if the text is merely a GPLv3 supplement, that reinforces the view that it falls outside OSI review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: States that the added text materially changes GPLv3, so it must be treated as a different license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出所增加的文本实质改变了 GPLv3 的效果，因此必须被视为不同的许可证。
timeline.point: States that the added text materially changes GPLv3, so it must be treated as a different license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says OSI should not grant the FSF special veto status, but should refuse approval unless the combined text stops using the FSF and GPLv3 names.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 不应赋予 FSF 特别否决地位，但如果组合文本继续使用 FSF 和 GPLv3 名称，就不应批准。
timeline.point: Says OSI should not grant the FSF special veto status, but should refuse approval unless the combined text stops using the FSF and GPLv3 names.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the earlier ToS reference was only meant to show that indemnification is a real and relevant concept.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清先前引用服务条款只是为了说明赔偿条款确实是现实且相关的概念。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the earlier ToS reference was only meant to show that indemnification is a real and relevant concept.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Asks whether OSI views the submission as a new license or merely a GPLv3 supplement.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 OSI 会将该提交视为新许可证还是仅仅视为 GPLv3 的补充条款。
timeline.point: Asks whether OSI views the submission as a new license or merely a GPLv3 supplement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says the added terms inspire little confidence because GPLv3 already benefited from extensive lawyer review, and it is unclear whether the new language is actually better.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这些新增条款难以令人信服，因为 GPLv3 已经过大量律师审查，而且无法判断新措辞是否真的更好。
timeline.point: Says the added terms inspire little confidence because GPLv3 already benefited from extensive lawyer review, and it is unclear whether the new language is actually better.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Argues the submission uses GPLv3's exception mechanism rather than a modified GPL, so removing FSF and GPL names may go beyond what the FSF itself requires.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该提交使用的是 GPLv3 的例外机制而非修改 GPL，因此删除 FSF 和 GPL 名称可能超出了 FSF 自身的要求。
timeline.point: Argues the submission uses GPLv3's exception mechanism rather than a modified GPL, so removing FSF and GPL names may go beyond what the FSF itself requires.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says OSI must protect attribution and trademarks consistently, but cannot give the FSF a special veto over license review.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 必须一致地保护署名权和商标，但不能赋予 FSF 对许可证审查的特别否决权。
timeline.point: Says OSI must protect attribution and trademarks consistently, but cannot give the FSF a special veto over license review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Asks whether any GPLv3 Section 7 supplement necessarily creates a different license, or whether supplementation can occur without that result.
timeline.point_zh: 询问任何 GPLv3 第 7 条补充条款是否都会形成不同的许可证，还是说补充条款也可能不导致这种结果。
timeline.point: Asks whether any GPLv3 Section 7 supplement necessarily creates a different license, or whether supplementation can occur without that result.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says OSI has no official view yet, but any added GPL language should be treated as a separate license and may change the open-source outcome significantly.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 目前还没有正式立场，但任何给 GPL 增加的文本都应视为独立许可证，并可能显著改变其开源性质。
timeline.point: Says OSI has no official view yet, but any added GPL language should be treated as a separate license and may change the open-source outcome significantly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Agrees the submission largely uses GPLv3 Section 7 restrictions, but notes one publicity-related restriction was not included.
timeline.point_zh: 认同该提交基本上是在使用 GPLv3 第 7 条允许的限制，但指出其中并未包含一项与宣传用途相关的限制。
timeline.point: Agrees the submission largely uses GPLv3 Section 7 restrictions, but notes one publicity-related restriction was not included.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Says the submission is effectively a new GPLv3-based license and warns that OSI review could encourage proliferation and misuse of Section 7 additional terms.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该提交实质上是一个基于 GPLv3 的新许可证，并警告 OSI 若予以审查，可能会鼓励第 7 条附加条款的泛滥和滥用。
timeline.point: Says the submission is effectively a new GPLv3-based license and warns that OSI review could encourage proliferation and misuse of Section 7 additional terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Asks whether requiring widespread use before approval creates a circular approval problem.
timeline.point_zh: 询问在批准前要求广泛使用，是否会造成一种循环性的审批困境。
timeline.point: Asks whether requiring widespread use before approval creates a circular approval problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Accepts the correction and says the next revision will remove the unnecessary "Notwithstanding" clause.
timeline.point_zh: 接受这一更正，并表示下一版将删除多余的 “Notwithstanding” 条款。
timeline.point: Accepts the correction and says the next revision will remove the unnecessary "Notwithstanding" clause.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Whonix-devel] For Approval: GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms - GPLv3 with improved, legal protections as per GNU GPL version 3 section 7
timeline.snippet: Withdraws the GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms submission to incorporate feedback into a revised version.
timeline.point: Withdraws the GPL-3+-with-whonix-additional-terms submission to incorporate feedback into a revised version.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Contains no substantive archived body beyond the Twente License submission metadata/attachment context.
timeline.point_zh: 除 Twente License 提交元数据/附件语境外，没有可提取的实质归档正文。
timeline.point: Contains no substantive archived body beyond the Twente License submission metadata/attachment context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: States that the Twente License fails OSD 6.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Twente License 不符合 OSD 第 6 条。
timeline.point: States that the Twente License fails OSD 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Argues that privacy and human-rights values belong in law, not software licenses, and that restricting use based on values conflicts with OSD 6.
timeline.point_zh: 主张隐私和人权等价值应由法律而非软件许可证来约束，并认为按价值或用途限制使用会违反 OSD 第 6 条。
timeline.point: Argues that privacy and human-rights values belong in law, not software licenses, and that restricting use based on values conflicts with OSD 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Says the proposal has been narrowed to consent-based privacy rules, acknowledges possible non-approval under OSD 6, and asks for more feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 表示提案已收窄为基于同意的隐私要求，承认其可能无法通过 OSD 第 6 条，并希望继续获得反馈。
timeline.point: Says the proposal has been narrowed to consent-based privacy rules, acknowledges possible non-approval under OSD 6, and asks for more feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: States that the license clearly fails OSD 6 and urges pursuing social-justice goals through community and support choices rather than license terms.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证明显违反 OSD 第 6 条，并建议通过社区治理和支持策略而非许可证条款来实现社会正义目标。
timeline.point: States that the license clearly fails OSD 6 and urges pursuing social-justice goals through community and support choices rather than license terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Agrees there are better ways to encourage corporate responsibility and accepts that the Twente License may be rejected by OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 同意应寻找更好的方式来推动企业责任，并接受 Twente License 可能会被 OSI 拒绝。
timeline.point: Agrees there are better ways to encourage corporate responsibility and accepts that the Twente License may be rejected by OSI.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that the license violates OSD 6 and notes that such restrictions can outlive their original purpose and harm innocent users.
timeline.point_zh: 同意该许可证违反 OSD 第 6 条，并指出此类限制可能在原始背景消失后仍持续存在并伤及无辜用户。
timeline.point: Agrees that the license violates OSD 6 and notes that such restrictions can outlive their original purpose and harm innocent users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Argues the license is unacceptable because privacy and human-rights terms are too subjective for users to know compliance without litigation.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证不可接受，因为隐私和人权条款过于主观，用户在诉讼前无法确定自己是否合规。
timeline.point: Argues the license is unacceptable because privacy and human-rights terms are too subjective for users to know compliance without litigation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that only a consent requirement for collecting and sharing personal data is in the license text, and asks whether that changes the legal analysis.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清许可证正文只保留了对收集和共享个人数据需取得同意的要求，并询问这是否会改变法律分析。
timeline.point: Clarifies that only a consent requirement for collecting and sharing personal data is in the license text, and asks whether that changes the legal analysis.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Says the narrowed consent clause does not obviously violate OSD 6 and asks others to explain if it does.
timeline.point_zh: 表示收窄后的同意条款看起来未必违反 OSD 第 6 条，并请他人解释如果确有违反的话。
timeline.point: Says the narrowed consent clause does not obviously violate OSD 6 and asks others to explain if it does.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes mixing legal or ethical compliance into licenses, arguing open source licenses must not be tools for law enforcement.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对把法律或伦理合规要求写入许可证，认为开源许可证不应成为执法工具。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes mixing legal or ethical compliance into licenses, arguing open source licenses must not be tools for law enforcement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Explains that the goal was to promote privacy rather than enforce law, and says licenses seemed like a useful mechanism for that.
timeline.point_zh: 解释其目标是推动隐私保护而非执法，并表示自己原本认为许可证可以成为实现这一目标的合适工具。
timeline.point: Explains that the goal was to promote privacy rather than enforce law, and says licenses seemed like a useful mechanism for that.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Argues that privacy or legality requirements do not belong in open source licenses, because they discriminate by use and misuse copyright rules.
timeline.point_zh: 主张隐私或合法性要求不应写入开源许可证，因为这会按用途进行歧视，并误用版权规则。
timeline.point: Argues that privacy or legality requirements do not belong in open source licenses, because they discriminate by use and misuse copyright rules.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Provides the JSON license as the earlier example under discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 提供 JSON 许可证作为前文讨论的例子。
timeline.point: Provides the JSON license as the earlier example under discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Replies that the JSON clause was more of a wish or statement than an actual enforceable condition.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称 JSON 的那句话更像愿望或声明，而不是真正可执行的条件。
timeline.point: Replies that the JSON clause was more of a wish or statement than an actual enforceable condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Argues Twente improperly regulates software use, conflicts with OSD and GDPR realities, and suggests transparency requirements or AGPL-style approaches instead.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Twente 不当地规制了软件使用，与 OSD 及 GDPR 的实际情况冲突，并建议改用透明度要求或类似 AGPL 的方案。
timeline.point: Argues Twente improperly regulates software use, conflicts with OSD and GDPR realities, and suggests transparency requirements or AGPL-style approaches instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that transparency requirements may lead to a better license and asks whether that changes the legal objections.
timeline.point_zh: 认同透明度要求可能会带来更好的许可证，并询问这是否会改变相关法律反对意见。
timeline.point: Agrees that transparency requirements may lead to a better license and asks whether that changes the legal objections.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Says a transparency-style requirement is a promising direction and is less likely to conflict with OSD, though implementation details will be difficult.
timeline.point_zh: 表示透明度式要求是一个有前景的方向，且更不容易与 OSD 冲突，但具体实现会很困难。
timeline.point: Says a transparency-style requirement is a promising direction and is less likely to conflict with OSD, though implementation details will be difficult.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Twente License
timeline.snippet: Proposes replacing the privacy restriction with a Data Controller disclosure requirement and asks whether that could remain usable and OSI-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 提出用数据控制者披露要求来替代隐私限制，并询问这种做法是否还能保持可用性并符合 OSI 要求。
timeline.point: Proposes replacing the privacy restriction with a Data Controller disclosure requirement and asks whether that could remain usable and OSI-compliant.

license_texts.message_subject: For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
license_texts.text:
Full Name: Convertible Free Software License Version 1.3
Short Identifier: C-FSL v1.3
URL1: https://www.elstel.org/license/C-FSL-v1.3.pdf
URL2: https://www.elstel.org/license/C-FSL-v1.3.txt

Rationale and Distinguish:
While the BSD license allows the whole world to re-license and while 
re-licensing is virtually impossible with GPL since every contributor 
would need to consent the C-FSL license goes a practical intermediate 
way restricting the right to re-license to a group called the original 
authors. That way open source developers are not excluded from making 
business with others who want to base a proprietary product on the given 
piece of open source software.

Proliferation Category & Legal Review:
Other/Miscellaneous
The license has now been fully reworked by a lawyer. Besides this 
Version 1.3 features easier and more user friendly forking.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
