timeline.point_zh: 认可 v1.3 的改进努力，但认为核心歧视性问题未解决：原始作者而非所有版权持有者掌握再许可和指定新作者的权力。
timeline.point: Acknowledges improvement efforts in v1.3 but argues the core discriminatory issue remains: original authors rather than all copyright holders control re-licensing and appointment of new authors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues that when a license's fundamental goal conflicts with the OSD, rewriting cannot fix the core problem, and v1.3 still suffers from the same deficiency.
timeline.point_zh: 指出当许可证的根本目标与 OSD 冲突时，修订无法解决核心问题，v1.3 仍然存在相同缺陷。
timeline.point: Argues that when a license's fundamental goal conflicts with the OSD, rewriting cannot fix the core problem, and v1.3 still suffers from the same deficiency.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Questions the feasibility of the original authors concept, arguing the clause is essentially disguised copyright assignment that grants disproportionate power to a specific group.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑原始作者概念的可行性，指出该条款本质上是伪装的版权转让，赋予特定群体不成比例的权力。
timeline.point: Questions the feasibility of the original authors concept, arguing the clause is essentially disguised copyright assignment that grants disproportionate power to a specific group.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Believes C-FSL attempts to simulate a CLA through the license, arguing that controlling forks and privileging certain authors is incompatible with the OSD, and section 7.5 can be abused.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 C-FSL 试图用许可证模拟 CLA，控制分叉和赋予特定作者特权与 OSD 不兼容，且第 7.5 条可被滥用。
timeline.point: Believes C-FSL attempts to simulate a CLA through the license, arguing that controlling forks and privileging certain authors is incompatible with the OSD, and section 7.5 can be abused.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Cites historical precedents of successful re-licensing in projects like Toybox and Linux, arguing standard procedures already exist and C-FSL's mechanism is unnecessary.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Toybox、Linux 等项目成功再许可的历史先例，说明已存在标准程序，无需 C-FSL 这种机制。
timeline.point: Cites historical precedents of successful re-licensing in projects like Toybox and Linux, arguing standard procedures already exist and C-FSL's mechanism is unnecessary.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Uses XFree86 as an example to show that license changes do not destroy projects; they only make a particular management organization irrelevant.
timeline.point_zh: 以 XFree86 为例说明许可证变更不会毁灭项目，只是使特定管理方变得无关紧要。
timeline.point: Uses XFree86 as an example to show that license changes do not destroy projects; they only make a particular management organization irrelevant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues through numerous historical cases that the original authors concept does not match reality and that C-FSL is conceptually flawed.
timeline.point_zh: 通过大量历史案例（Linux、buildroot、QEMU 等）论证原始作者概念与现实不符，认为 C-FSL 在概念上就有缺陷。
timeline.point: Argues through numerous historical cases that the original authors concept does not match reality and that C-FSL is conceptually flawed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues C-FSL not only violates the OSD but is also harmful to the community and individual developers, with terms hidden behind language that appear to address everyone but actually apply only to a select few.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 C-FSL 不仅违反 OSD，而且对社区和个别开发者有害，隐藏在面向你的语言背后的条款实际只适用于少数人。
timeline.point: Argues C-FSL not only violates the OSD but is also harmful to the community and individual developers, with terms hidden behind language that appear to address everyone but actually apply only to a select few.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Criticizes the XFree86 analogy as inappropriate through a comparison to world wars, suggesting a better example should be chosen.
timeline.point_zh: 以类比方式批评 XFree86 示例不够恰当，建议换一个更好的例子。
timeline.point: Criticizes the XFree86 analogy as inappropriate through a comparison to world wars, suggesting a better example should be chosen.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that XFree86's split stemmed from developers escaping poor management rather than the license change itself, emphasizing that open source licenses enabling developers to leave bad management is an important feature.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 XFree86 的分裂源于开发者逃离不良管理而非许可证变更本身，强调开源许可证允许开发者脱离不良管理是重要特性。
timeline.point: Clarifies that XFree86's split stemmed from developers escaping poor management rather than the license change itself, emphasizing that open source licenses enabling developers to leave bad management is an important feature.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Draws an analogy comparing democracy being more resilient than monarchy to code surviving after a split, and lists various license conflict events in Unix/Linux history.
timeline.point_zh: 用民主比君主制更有韧性来类比，说明分裂后的代码存续问题，并列举 Unix/Linux 历史上的许可证冲突事件。
timeline.point: Draws an analogy comparing democracy being more resilient than monarchy to code surviving after a split, and lists various license conflict events in Unix/Linux history.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Agrees the original authors concept is flawed but notes not all open source is community-driven; in some cases, giving original developers special rights is not a major issue.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 C-FSL 的原始作者概念有缺陷，但指出并非所有开源都是社区驱动的，公司获得特殊权利在某些情况下问题不大。
timeline.point: Agrees the original authors concept is flawed but notes not all open source is community-driven; in some cases, giving original developers special rights is not a major issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Contends that collective re-licensing by original authors is a fair solution, draws an analogy to CLAs, and questions why no one criticizes Apple for profiting from the FreeBSD kernel.
timeline.point_zh: 主张原始作者集体决定再许可是公平方案，类比 CLA，反问为何不批评苹果利用 FreeBSD 内核牟利。
timeline.point: Contends that collective re-licensing by original authors is a fair solution, draws an analogy to CLAs, and questions why no one criticizes Apple for profiting from the FreeBSD kernel.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Explains the rationale for the 65% code difference threshold: to avoid the contradictory situation of two concurrent groups of original authors arising when the threshold is set below 50%.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 65% 代码差异阈值的设定理由：避免低于 50% 时出现两组并发原始作者的矛盾情况。
timeline.point: Explains the rationale for the 65% code difference threshold: to avoid the contradictory situation of two concurrent groups of original authors arising when the threshold is set below 50%.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues the core purpose of C-FSL is to discriminate among copyright holders, making it incompatible with the OSD; Debian has spent years pointing out its DFSG violations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 C-FSL 的核心目的是在版权持有者之间制造歧视，与 OSD 不兼容，Debian 多年来一直指出其违反 DFSG。
timeline.point: Argues the core purpose of C-FSL is to discriminate among copyright holders, making it incompatible with the OSD; Debian has spent years pointing out its DFSG violations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues in detail that C-FSL forces copyright assignment without being a CLA, that forkers lack symmetrical rights, and that v1.3 only rewords language without addressing the substantive issue.
timeline.point_zh: 详细论证 C-FSL 如何在不等同于 CLA 的情况下强制版权转让，指出分叉者缺乏对称权利，认为 v1.3 只是措辞调整未解决实质问题。
timeline.point: Argues in detail that C-FSL forces copyright assignment without being a CLA, that forkers lack symmetrical rights, and that v1.3 only rewords language without addressing the substantive issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Counters the accusation of hidden provisions, emphasizing the wording is more verbose than legally necessary, with the intent of keeping it understandable for ordinary programmers.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳许可证隐藏条款的指控，强调条款措辞比法律所需更详细，目的是让普通程序员能理解。
timeline.point: Counters the accusation of hidden provisions, emphasizing the wording is more verbose than legally necessary, with the intent of keeping it understandable for ordinary programmers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Responds to criticism of section 5.1.f, suggesting that copyright law already implies the right not to publish defective code and that the lawyer may have omitted the clause as redundant.
timeline.point_zh: 回应第 5.1.f 条的批评，认为版权法已隐含不公开有缺陷代码的权利，若需要可以要求律师恢复该条款。
timeline.point: Responds to criticism of section 5.1.f, suggesting that copyright law already implies the right not to publish defective code and that the lawyer may have omitted the clause as redundant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Rejects Carlo's proposed embedded CLA approach, arguing it would render the original authors clause absurd as anyone could claim a new fork through trivial modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 Carlo 提出的嵌入 CLA 方案，认为这会导致原始作者条款荒谬化，任何人都可通过微小修改声称新分叉。
timeline.point: Rejects Carlo's proposed embedded CLA approach, arguing it would render the original authors clause absurd as anyone could claim a new fork through trivial modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Responds to Rob's concerns about the original authors definition, arguing that anyone publishing code under C-FSL must be a copyright holder, and both original authors and major contributors can republish.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 Rob 关于原始作者定义的质疑，认为发布 C-FSL 代码者必须是版权持有者，原始作者和主要贡献者都可重新发布。
timeline.point: Responds to Rob's concerns about the original authors definition, arguing that anyone publishing code under C-FSL must be a copyright holder, and both original authors and major contributors can republish.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Responds to the boringssl example, arguing it would likely not qualify as a fork that can appoint its own original authors under C-FSL, and questions what the problem is.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 boringssl 示例，认为在 C-FSL 下它不太可能被认定为可指定自己原始作者的分叉，反问其问题何在。
timeline.point: Responds to the boringssl example, arguing it would likely not qualify as a fork that can appoint its own original authors under C-FSL, and questions what the problem is.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues that Freedom Zero of the Free Software Definition should be inherent in the OSD, particularly in OSD 9, noting that its absence leads to bizarre theoretical outcomes.
timeline.point_zh: 以 FSD 自由零（运行程序的自由）的价值为例，认为该概念应内含于 OSD 第 9 条中。
timeline.point: Argues that Freedom Zero of the Free Software Definition should be inherent in the OSD, particularly in OSD 9, noting that its absence leads to bizarre theoretical outcomes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Considers section 5.1.f (requiring all derivative works to be published within one month) a fatal flaw that makes compliance trivially easy to violate, though not a violation of Freedom Zero.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第 5.1.f 条（一个月内公开所有衍生作品）是致命缺陷，极易导致不合规，但不认为这违反自由零。
timeline.point: Considers section 5.1.f (requiring all derivative works to be published within one month) a fatal flaw that makes compliance trivially easy to violate, though not a violation of Freedom Zero.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Systematically explains basic copyright principles: every contributor is a copyright holder, and C-FSL attempts to create a special category that can re-license others' copyrights, something even the FSF did not do in GPLv2.
timeline.point_zh: 系统阐述版权法基本原则：每个贡献者都是版权持有者，C-FSL 试图创造一个能再许可他人版权的特殊类别，连 FSF 在 GPLv2 中也未这样做。
timeline.point: Systematically explains basic copyright principles: every contributor is a copyright holder, and C-FSL attempts to create a special category that can re-license others' copyrights, something even the FSF did not do in GPLv2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Argues that nearly every patch in open source collaboration evidences the intention for contributions to be merged into a unified whole, citing IP lawyer Larry Rosen's supporting view.
timeline.point_zh: 认为开源协作中几乎每个补丁都体现了联合创作的意图，并引用 IP 律师 Larry Rosen 的观点支持此论。
timeline.point: Argues that nearly every patch in open source collaboration evidences the intention for contributions to be merged into a unified whole, citing IP lawyer Larry Rosen's supporting view.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies in the capacity of an IP lawyer that merging patches does not grant the patch author ownership of the patched software, noting a legal distinction between joint works and contributions to derivative works.
timeline.point_zh: 以 IP 律师身份澄清：合并补丁不赋予补丁作者对被修补软件的所有权，联合作品与衍生作品的贡献有法律区别。
timeline.point: Clarifies in the capacity of an IP lawyer that merging patches does not grant the patch author ownership of the patched software, noting a legal distinction between joint works and contributions to derivative works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that C-FSL works as intended for original authors: by using C-FSL, contributors implicitly consent to grant re-licensing rights to the original authors.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 C-FSL 按设计为原始作者服务：通过使用 C-FSL，贡献者隐含同意将再许可权授予原始作者。
timeline.point: Confirms that C-FSL works as intended for original authors: by using C-FSL, contributors implicitly consent to grant re-licensing rights to the original authors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: The discussion focuses on whether C-FSL complies with the OSD rather than whether the license's intent is fulfilled; 'implicit consent' contrasts with CLA's explicit consent, and allowing only original authors to relicense modified code may conflict with OSD principles.
timeline.point_zh: 主张讨论的焦点是C-FSL是否符合OSD，而非许可证的意图是否实现；'隐式同意'与CLA的显式同意形成对比，且仅允许原始作者重新许可修改后的代码可能与OSD原则冲突。
timeline.point: The discussion focuses on whether C-FSL complies with the OSD rather than whether the license's intent is fulfilled; 'implicit consent' contrasts with CLA's explicit consent, and allowing only original authors to relicense modified code may conflict with OSD principles.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: The board's approval process presupposes the Four Freedoms as an evaluation prerequisite, and OSI-approved licenses should ensure equal rights for all users; having one set of rights effectively constitute a non-OSI-approved license has no precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 说明董事会的审批流程以四大自由为评估前提，且OSI批准的许可证应确保所有用户享有平等权利，而C-FSL中一组权利等同于非OSI批准的许可证，这在先例中没有出现过。
timeline.point: The board's approval process presupposes the Four Freedoms as an evaluation prerequisite, and OSI-approved licenses should ensure equal rights for all users; having one set of rights effectively constitute a non-OSI-approved license has no precedent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.3 (C-FSL v1.3)
timeline.snippet: C-FSL-type licenses are designed to allow companies to perform bait-and-switch tactics on users, and labeling such practices as 'open source' is nothing new.
timeline.point_zh: 指出C-FSL这类许可证正是为了允许公司对用户进行诱骗式变更而设计的，将这种行为贴上'开源'标签的做法并不新鲜。
timeline.point: C-FSL-type licenses are designed to allow companies to perform bait-and-switch tactics on users, and labeling such practices as 'open source' is nothing new.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits libpng license v2.0 (zlib terms + Boost disclaimer) for OSI review, proposing four plans for handling the legacy license. Seeks expert advice on the best approach to freeze the perpetually-changing libpng license.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 libpng 许可证 2.0（zlib 条款 + Boost 免责声明）供 OSI 审查，提出四种方案处理旧许可证，寻求专家建议以冻结频繁变更的 libpng 许可证。
timeline.point: Submits libpng license v2.0 (zlib terms + Boost disclaimer) for OSI review, proposing four plans for handling the legacy license. Seeks expert advice on the best approach to freeze the perpetually-changing libpng license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Suggests the submitter seek pro bono legal help from organizations like SPI, Conservancy, or SFLC. Notes that a simpler and shorter license would be valuable for a library embedded in larger applications, and that the Python precedent is a solid reference.
timeline.point_zh: 建议提交者向 SPI、Conservancy 或 SFLC 等组织寻求免费法律援助。认为作为嵌入大型应用的库，更简洁的许可证更有价值，Python 先例是很好的参考。
timeline.point: Suggests the submitter seek pro bono legal help from organizations like SPI, Conservancy, or SFLC. Notes that a simpler and shorter license would be valuable for a library embedded in larger applications, and that the Python precedent is a solid reference.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Finds the submission confusing due to layered licenses for different versions. Raises concerns about the trademark statement's effect on OSD 1 and the license's non-reusability due to embedded authorship statements.
timeline.point_zh: 认为提交内容因多版本许可证叠加而令人困惑，质疑商标声明对 OSD 1 的影响，以及许可证因内嵌作者声明而不可复用。
timeline.point: Finds the submission confusing due to layered licenses for different versions. Raises concerns about the trademark statement's effect on OSD 1 and the license's non-reusability due to embedded authorship statements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Compares the libpng license situation to the Python license tangle, concluding that only the most recent license is actually applicable and earlier versions are inert but cannot be removed.
timeline.point_zh: 将 libpng 许可证情况类比 Python 许可证的混乱状况，认为只有最新版本实际有效，旧版本虽无功能但无法移除。
timeline.point: Compares the libpng license situation to the Python license tangle, concluding that only the most recent license is actually applicable and earlier versions are inert but cannot be removed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Views the legacy license layers as harmless baggage like inert DNA. Considers copying inert licenses into source code a trivial burden, but notes the OSD does not require them to appear in executable code or on end-user screens.
timeline.point_zh: 将旧许可证层视为无害的惰性 DNA 般的包袱，认为在源码中包含它们是轻微负担，但 OSD 不要求在可执行文件或用户界面中展示。
timeline.point: Views the legacy license layers as harmless baggage like inert DNA. Considers copying inert licenses into source code a trivial burden, but notes the OSD does not require them to appear in executable code or on end-user screens.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Notes that the license only requires keeping the license text intact for source distributions, not binary distributions, so the burden is not a major issue.
timeline.point_zh: 注意到许可证仅要求在源码分发时保留许可证文本，二进制分发不受此约束，因此负担不算重大。
timeline.point: Notes that the license only requires keeping the license text intact for source distributions, not binary distributions, so the burden is not a major issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that if only the most recent license applies, this is not really a license approval request but a header formatting request, since the Boost license is already OSI-approved.
timeline.point_zh: 认为如果只有最新许可证生效，这就不是许可证审批请求，而是头部格式化请求，因为 Boost 许可证已获 OSI 批准。
timeline.point: Argues that if only the most recent license applies, this is not really a license approval request but a header formatting request, since the Boost license is already OSI-approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Recommends the submitter consult a lawyer to handle past developers' rights, get approval from them, and switch to a single already-approved license to simplify things.
timeline.point_zh: 建议提交者咨询律师处理过去开发者的权利问题，获取他们的同意，然后切换到一个已批准的许可证以简化流程。
timeline.point: Recommends the submitter consult a lawyer to handle past developers' rights, get approval from them, and switch to a single already-approved license to simplify things.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that the Python license persists because the codebase is accretive with old versions still embedded, removal is not worth the ROI, and previous license holders are unwilling to assign rights.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 Python 许可证延续的原因：代码库是累积性的，旧版本仍嵌入其中，移除不划算，且旧许可证持有者不愿转让权利。
timeline.point: Explains that the Python license persists because the codebase is accretive with old versions still embedded, removal is not worth the ROI, and previous license holders are unwilling to assign rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Drops plans B-D and proposes freezing the accreted libpng license as the only viable path forward. Explains that switching to an already-approved license is not feasible due to strong opposition from PNG Group members and unreachable past contributors.
timeline.point_zh: 放弃方案 B-D，提出冻结累积的 libpng 许可证作为唯一可行路径。解释因 PNG Group 成员的强烈反对和无法联系的旧贡献者，无法切换到已批准的许可证。
timeline.point: Drops plans B-D and proposes freezing the accreted libpng license as the only viable path forward. Explains that switching to an already-approved license is not feasible due to strong opposition from PNG Group members and unreachable past contributors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Suggests that if Cosmin made all the patches himself, he could release without touching the LICENSE file and then seek legal advice later, as this would not be irrevocable. Notes that having a lawyer involved is in his own interest but sees no lasting harm in a quick release.
timeline.point_zh: 建议如果所有补丁都由自己完成，可以先发布而不修改 LICENSE 文件，之后再寻求法律建议，因为这不是不可逆转的。认为有律师参与对自己有利，但快速发布不会对社区造成持久损害。
timeline.point: Suggests that if Cosmin made all the patches himself, he could release without touching the LICENSE file and then seek legal advice later, as this would not be irrevocable. Notes that having a lawyer involved is in his own interest but sees no lasting harm in a quick release.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Questions why a new license version is needed, arguing the existing libpng license is already permissive and allows derivative works under any license choice, so the maintainer can already do almost anything needed.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑为何需要新版本许可证，认为现有 libpng 许可证已经足够宽松，允许衍生作品使用任何许可证，维护者已经可以做几乎所有需要的事。
timeline.point: Questions why a new license version is needed, arguing the existing libpng license is already permissive and allows derivative works under any license choice, so the maintainer can already do almost anything needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains the current license is not reusable across versions or contributors, and embeds directory-specific information. Proposes a four-step plan: withdraw from OSI review, get lawyer review, release under new license, then apply for OSI Legacy Review.
timeline.point_zh: 解释当前许可证不可跨版本或跨贡献者复用，且嵌入了目录特定信息。提出四步计划：撤回 OSI 审查、律师审查、在新许可证下发布、之后申请 OSI 遗留审查。
timeline.point: Explains the current license is not reusable across versions or contributors, and embeds directory-specific information. Proposes a four-step plan: withdraw from OSI review, get lawyer review, release under new license, then apply for OSI Legacy Review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: libpng license, version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Formally withdraws the OSI review request for libpng license v2.0 after others on the list agreed with the proposed plan.
timeline.point_zh: 在列表上其他人同意提议计划后，正式撤回 libpng 许可证 v2.0 的 OSI 审查请求。
timeline.point: Formally withdraws the OSI review request for libpng license v2.0 after others on the list agreed with the proposed plan.

Full Name: Convertible Free Software License Version 1.1
Short Identifier: C-FSL v1.1
URL: https://www.elstel.org/license/C-FSL-v1.1.txt

Rationale and Distinguish:
While the BSD license allows the whole world to re-license and while 
re-licensing is virtually impossible with GPL since every contributor 
would need to consent the C-FSL license goes a practical intermediate 
way restricting the right to re-license to a group called the original 
authors. That way open source developers are not excluded from making 
business with others who want to base a proprietary product on the given 
piece of open source software.

Proliferation Category & Legal Review:
Other/Miscellaneous
A lawyer from the EPA (Environmental Protection Agency, USA) has already 
checked C-FSL for its proliferation properties. He has found the license 
to be compatible with other open source licenses. He decided that C-FSL 
can be used together with the CC0 license in the FDtool (functional 
dependency mining tool) project.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Submits C-FSL v1.1 for OSI approval, describing it as a compromise between BSD and GPL that restricts relicensing rights to original authors, and notes an EPA lawyer has reviewed the license.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 C-FSL v1.1 申请 OSI 审批，称其为 BSD 与 GPL 之间的折中方案，将再许可权限制于原始作者，已有 EPA 律师审查。
timeline.point: Submits C-FSL v1.1 for OSI approval, describing it as a compromise between BSD and GPL that restricts relicensing rights to original authors, and notes an EPA lawyer has reviewed the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether C-FSL Section 7, which allows original copyright holders to decide the licensing of follow-on developers, constitutes discrimination violating OSD clause 5, and preliminarily recommends rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 C-FSL 第 7 节允许原始版权持有者决定后续开发者许可的做法构成歧视，违反 OSD 第 5 条，初步认为应予拒绝。
timeline.point: Questions whether C-FSL Section 7, which allows original copyright holders to decide the licensing of follow-on developers, constitutes discrimination violating OSD clause 5, and preliminarily recommends rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes C-FSL approval, arguing it allows an arbitrarily chosen group to take others' work private without contributor license agreements, notes vague and contradictory language, and suggests rejection as a crayon license.
timeline.point_zh: 反对批准 C-FSL，认为其允许任意一组人将他人的作品私有化，语言模糊矛盾，可能应作为「蜡笔许可证」被拒。
timeline.point: Opposes C-FSL approval, arguing it allows an arbitrarily chosen group to take others' work private without contributor license agreements, notes vague and contradictory language, and suggests rejection as a crayon license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Points out that while other approved licenses contain original contributor language, none grant as much power, and OSI should not be required to approve this on the basis of prior precedents.
timeline.point_zh: 指出虽有其他已批准许可证含「原始贡献者」条款，但未授予如此大的权力，OSI 不应因历史先例而被迫批准。
timeline.point: Points out that while other approved licenses contain original contributor language, none grant as much power, and OSI should not be required to approve this on the basis of prior precedents.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: As a free and open source software user, considers C-FSL dangerous because companies could use it to absorb contributions from open source developers and then close the code for proprietary profit.
timeline.point_zh: 作为自由开源软件用户，认为 C-FSL 危险，可能被公司利用来吸纳开源开发者贡献后关闭为私有。
timeline.point: As a free and open source software user, considers C-FSL dangerous because companies could use it to absorb contributions from open source developers and then close the code for proprietary profit.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Bruce's position, arguing that original contributor language implies a fallacy—that coming first does not mean more importance—and that open source projects should belong to the commons.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 Bruce 的立场，认为「原始贡献者」语言暗含谬误——先参与并不意味着更重要，开源项目应属于公共领域。
timeline.point: Agrees with Bruce's position, arguing that original contributor language implies a fallacy—that coming first does not mean more importance—and that open source projects should belong to the commons.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends C-FSL, arguing that allowing the most contributing members to decide on relicensing is not discrimination, cites Apple's use of FreeBSD code as a case against unrestricted relicensing, and notes the original author group can be extended.
timeline.point_zh: 为 C-FSL 辩护，认为允许贡献最多的人决定再许可并非歧视，援引 Apple 与 FreeBSD 的案例说明自由再许可的弊端，且原始作者群体可扩展。
timeline.point: Defends C-FSL, arguing that allowing the most contributing members to decide on relicensing is not discrimination, cites Apple's use of FreeBSD code as a case against unrestricted relicensing, and notes the original author group can be extended.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues C-FSL should be rejected as a crayon license due to a farcical choice-of-law clause enabling jurisdiction shopping, and questions whether an environmental lawyer has the expertise to review a software license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 C-FSL 应作为蜡笔许可证被拒，法律选择条款荒谬可引发管辖权购物，且环境律师不具备审查软件许可证的专业资质。
timeline.point: Argues C-FSL should be rejected as a crayon license due to a farcical choice-of-law clause enabling jurisdiction shopping, and questions whether an environmental lawyer has the expertise to review a software license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters Alexjan's concern that companies could exploit C-FSL to close code by noting that BSD-like licenses present the same situation, so this is not a valid objection.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Alexjan 关于公司利用 C-FSL 关闭代码的担忧，指出 BSD 类许可证存在同样情况，因此这不构成有效反对理由。
timeline.point: Counters Alexjan's concern that companies could exploit C-FSL to close code by noting that BSD-like licenses present the same situation, so this is not a valid objection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Responds to Carlo's concern about original contributor status being unfair, arguing that prospective contributors can communicate their intention before making a major contribution to be accepted as original authors.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 Carlo 关于原始贡献者地位不公的担忧，认为潜在贡献者可在做出重大贡献前沟通以被接纳为原始作者。
timeline.point: Responds to Carlo's concern about original contributor status being unfair, arguing that prospective contributors can communicate their intention before making a major contribution to be accepted as original authors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Strongly rebuts Elmar's defense, arguing that original contributors and subsequent contributors having different relicensing rights constitutes discrimination against the latter, in clear violation of OSD clause 5.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反驳 Elmar 的辩护，认为原始贡献者与后续贡献者享有不同再许可权利构成对后者的歧视，明确违反 OSD 第 5 条。
timeline.point: Strongly rebuts Elmar's defense, arguing that original contributors and subsequent contributors having different relicensing rights constitutes discrimination against the latter, in clear violation of OSD clause 5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends C-FSL, arguing the implied consent clause is reasonable, that the license encourages developers who would otherwise not release under OSS, and that the software can later be republished under GPL or BSD.
timeline.point_zh: 为 C-FSL 辩护，认为隐含同意条款合理，该许可证鼓励原本不愿开源的开发者发布软件，且后续可转为 GPL 或 BSD 类许可证。
timeline.point: Defends C-FSL, arguing the implied consent clause is reasonable, that the license encourages developers who would otherwise not release under OSS, and that the software can later be republished under GPL or BSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Identifies three major problems with C-FSL: it violates the OSD, it lacks proper legal review, and it is redundant with existing licenses, concluding it should be rejected even after a rewrite on proliferation grounds.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 C-FSL 存在三大问题：违反 OSD、未经专业律师审查、与现有许可证冗余，即使重写也应因增殖理由被拒。
timeline.point: Identifies three major problems with C-FSL: it violates the OSD, it lacks proper legal review, and it is redundant with existing licenses, concluding it should be rejected even after a rewrite on proliferation grounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests OSI make its approval policies more explicit to counter submitters' precedent-based arguments, proposes possible OSD revision or supplementary interpretive history, and suggests writing a paper on the topic.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSI 公开其审批政策以回应提交者以先例为由的抗辩，提出可能修订 OSD 或补充解释性历史，并提议撰写相关论文。
timeline.point: Suggests OSI make its approval policies more explicit to counter submitters' precedent-based arguments, proposes possible OSD revision or supplementary interpretive history, and suggests writing a paper on the topic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Strongly supports McCoy's proposal for OSI to publicize all approval rules, noting that licenses can conform to OSD and still be rejected, and that the current opaque process causes repeated wasted effort on doomed submissions.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈支持 McCoy 的提议，认为 OSI 应公开所有审批规则，指出即使符合 OSD 也可能被拒，现行流程导致不合格提交反复浪费时间。
timeline.point: Strongly supports McCoy's proposal for OSI to publicize all approval rules, noting that licenses can conform to OSD and still be rejected, and that the current opaque process causes repeated wasted effort on doomed submissions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Details multiple legally fatal flaws in C-FSL: Section 3 infringes Freedom Zero, Section 4 exceeds GPL toolchain requirements, Section 5 violates privacy law, Section 6 constitutes badgeware, and Sections 7, 8, and 10 have serious problems.
timeline.point_zh: 详细列出 C-FSL 中多个章节的法律致命缺陷：第 3 条侵犯自由零号权利、第 4 条超出 GPL 工具链要求、第 5 条违反隐私法、第 6 条构成徽章软件、第 7 条违反 OSD 第 5 条、第 8 条和第 10 条有严重问题。
timeline.point: Details multiple legally fatal flaws in C-FSL: Section 3 infringes Freedom Zero, Section 4 exceeds GPL toolchain requirements, Section 5 violates privacy law, Section 6 constitutes badgeware, and Sections 7, 8, and 10 have serious problems.

timeline.snippet: Supports concerns about C-FSL drafting rigor but highlights that the private changes provision reflects a deeper schism between OSI and FSF, and lists prior licenses with similar clauses such as Artistic 2, CDDL, and QPL.
timeline.point_zh: 支持 McCoy 对 C-FSL 起草严谨性的质疑，但指出私有修改条款的分歧反映了 OSI 与 FSF 之间的立场差异，并列举已有类似条款的先例许可证。
timeline.point: Supports concerns about C-FSL drafting rigor but highlights that the private changes provision reflects a deeper schism between OSI and FSF, and lists prior licenses with similar clauses such as Artistic 2, CDDL, and QPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks about the process for OSI to amend the OSD and whether members have a say in it, while humorously noting the contradiction between the bylaws stating the corporation has no members and the existence of paid memberships.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 OSI 修订 OSD 的流程机制，以及成员在其中是否有发言权，同时幽默指出章程中「本组织无成员」条款与付费会员制之间的矛盾。
timeline.point: Asks about the process for OSI to amend the OSD and whether members have a say in it, while humorously noting the contradiction between the bylaws stating the corporation has no members and the existence of paid memberships.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends C-FSL Section 5's contact information requirement, arguing contributors can voluntarily choose whether to participate and that this requirement is crucial for maintaining software quality and tracking security issues.
timeline.point_zh: 为 C-FSL 第 5 条的联系方式要求辩护，认为贡献者可自愿选择是否参与，该要求对维护软件质量和追踪安全问题至关重要。
timeline.point: Defends C-FSL Section 5's contact information requirement, arguing contributors can voluntarily choose whether to participate and that this requirement is crucial for maintaining software quality and tracking security issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes C-FSL's contact information requirement, arguing security measures should not be embedded in licenses, that most developers lack legal counsel, and that OSI should no longer accept licenses drafted by non-attorneys.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 C-FSL 的联系方式要求，认为不应在许可证中嵌入安全措施，且非律师撰写的许可证法律语言不可靠，建议 OSI 不再接受非律师起草的许可证。
timeline.point: Opposes C-FSL's contact information requirement, arguing security measures should not be embedded in licenses, that most developers lack legal counsel, and that OSI should no longer accept licenses drafted by non-attorneys.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Encourages Alexjan to participate in the discussion, noting that he himself created the OSD without being a lawyer and with little knowledge at the time.
timeline.point_zh: 鼓励 Alexjan 积极参与讨论，表示自己创建 OSD 时同样不是律师且所知不多。
timeline.point: Encourages Alexjan to participate in the discussion, noting that he himself created the OSD without being a lawyer and with little knowledge at the time.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters Bruce's criticism about non-lawyers not understanding licenses, arguing C-FSL was intentionally written in language programmers can understand, and asserts the European legal system is superior to the American one.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Bruce 关于非律师无法理解许可证的批评，认为 C-FSL 刻意使用程序员可理解的语言编写，且欧洲法律体系优于美国。
timeline.point: Counters Bruce's criticism about non-lawyers not understanding licenses, arguing C-FSL was intentionally written in language programmers can understand, and asserts the European legal system is superior to the American one.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Sarcastically rebuts Elmar's claim that European courts would better interpret the license, arguing he cannot demonstrate that European courts would follow the intent while American courts would not.
timeline.point_zh: 讽刺性地反驳 Elmar 关于欧洲法院更好解读许可证的说法，认为其无法证明欧洲法院会按意图解读而美国法院不会。
timeline.point: Sarcastically rebuts Elmar's claim that European courts would better interpret the license, arguing he cannot demonstrate that European courts would follow the intent while American courts would not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Emphasizes that software licenses are legal documents, not project management tools, and that the ambiguous choice-of-law provisions reflect structural flaws throughout C-FSL, which should not be approved.
timeline.point_zh: 强调许可证是法律文件而非项目管理工具，模糊的法律选择条款（如「来自」和「家乡」的含义不明确）反映全文的结构性缺陷，C-FSL 不应被批准。
timeline.point: Emphasizes that software licenses are legal documents, not project management tools, and that the ambiguous choice-of-law provisions reflect structural flaws throughout C-FSL, which should not be approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues approved licenses should not be precedential, acknowledges OSI historically approved some subpar licenses for political reasons, and suggests those dissatisfied with OSI's process should create their own.
timeline.point_zh: 认为已批准许可证不应作为先例，承认 OSI 历史上因政治原因批准过不合格许可证，且审批需要保留解释空间以防止钻空子，建议不满意者可自行创建新流程。
timeline.point: Argues approved licenses should not be precedential, acknowledges OSI historically approved some subpar licenses for political reasons, and suggests those dissatisfied with OSI's process should create their own.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Requests that Bruce clarify the meaning of the term 'crayon licence' for those newer to the mailing list's lexicon.
timeline.point_zh: 请求 Bruce 澄清「蜡笔许可证」（crayon licence）这一术语的含义。
timeline.point: Requests that Bruce clarify the meaning of the term 'crayon licence' for those newer to the mailing list's lexicon.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Provides a link to the Wiktionary entry for 'crayon license' to explain its meaning.
timeline.point_zh: 提供维基词典链接以解释「蜡笔许可证」的含义。
timeline.point: Provides a link to the Wiktionary entry for 'crayon license' to explain its meaning.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Explains that 'crayon license' originates from a Monty Python sketch, identifies the core issue as C-FSL being drafted without a lawyer, and notes FSF's position on private modifications extends beyond its Four Freedoms.
timeline.point_zh: 解释「蜡笔许可证」源自蒙蒂·派森草图，核心问题是 C-FSL 未经律师起草，同时指出 FSF 在私有修改问题上的政策超出其四大自由的范围。
timeline.point: Explains that 'crayon license' originates from a Monty Python sketch, identifies the core issue as C-FSL being drafted without a lawyer, and notes FSF's position on private modifications extends beyond its Four Freedoms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Shares a link to the Monty Python 'Lumberjack' sketch video as supplementary reference for the origin of the term 'crayon license'.
timeline.point_zh: 分享蒙蒂·派森的「铅笔」草图视频链接，作为「蜡笔许可证」术语出处的补充。
timeline.point: Shares a link to the Monty Python 'Lumberjack' sketch video as supplementary reference for the origin of the term 'crayon license'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests using 'amateur license' instead of 'crayon license', emphasizes the value of non-legal practitioners, and notes FSF's clear position on the freedom to use private modifications (called Freedom 4).
timeline.point_zh: 建议用「业余许可证」替代「蜡笔许可证」的说法，强调非法律从业者同样有价值，并指出 FSF 在私有修改的自由（他称为「自由四」）上立场明确。
timeline.point: Suggests using 'amateur license' instead of 'crayon license', emphasizes the value of non-legal practitioners, and notes FSF's clear position on the freedom to use private modifications (called Freedom 4).

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that declaring approved licenses non-precedential would reject the common-law mechanism Bruce himself described, while the alternative civil-law approach would require active OSD revision, neither of which OSI consistently practices.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Bruce 将已批准许可证宣布为无先例会违背其自身类比的普通法机制，而 OSI 目前既不一致地遵循先例机制，也不积极修订 OSD。
timeline.point: Argues that declaring approved licenses non-precedential would reject the common-law mechanism Bruce himself described, while the alternative civil-law approach would require active OSD revision, neither of which OSI consistently practices.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: States clearly that OSI does not and has never practiced law, and will not begin doing so.
timeline.point_zh: 明确声明 OSI 从未也永远不会从事法律实践，因此不适用普通法先例机制。
timeline.point: States clearly that OSI does not and has never practiced law, and will not begin doing so.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Cites James Kent's statement on stare decisis to argue that precedent does not mean mechanical adherence, and acknowledges that many early OSI decisions were indeed crude and hasty, warranting revision.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 James Kent 关于 stare decisis 的论述，认为先例不意味着机械遵循，承认 OSI 早期许多审批决定确实粗糙仓促，应勇于修正。
timeline.point: Cites James Kent's statement on stare decisis to argue that precedent does not mean mechanical adherence, and acknowledges that many early OSI decisions were indeed crude and hasty, warranting revision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Observes that the high proportion of license submissions turning into discussions about the approval process itself is symptomatic of an opaque and wasteful system, and suggests drawing on legal principles of predictability and legitimacy.
timeline.point_zh: 指出大量许可证提交都演变为关于审批流程的讨论，说明 OSI 流程不透明且低效，建议从法律体系中借鉴可预测性和合法性方面的经验。
timeline.point: Observes that the high proportion of license submissions turning into discussions about the approval process itself is symptomatic of an opaque and wasteful system, and suggests drawing on legal principles of predictability and legitimacy.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that some process discussion is just training new participants, and that OSI has no need to be more efficient since approving too many new licenses would likely harm the community overall.
timeline.point_zh: 认为部分流程讨论只是培训新参与者，且 OSI 没有必要提高效率，因为过多新许可证可能对社区整体不利。
timeline.point: Argues that some process discussion is just training new participants, and that OSI has no need to be more efficient since approving too many new licenses would likely harm the community overall.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects John's straw man argument, clarifying that the call is not for slavish adherence to precedent but for OSI to publicly acknowledge prior approval logic, make rejection reasons explicit, and ensure transparent decision-making.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 John 的稻草人谬误，强调自己并非主张机械遵循先例，而是要求 OSI 公开承认先前审批逻辑、明确拒绝理由并透明化决策过程。
timeline.point: Rejects John's straw man argument, clarifying that the call is not for slavish adherence to precedent but for OSI to publicly acknowledge prior approval logic, make rejection reasons explicit, and ensure transparent decision-making.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that an efficient process would serve both approval and rejection outcomes, and that tolerating degenerative process problems to avoid substantive issues is a major red flag.
timeline.point_zh: 指出高效流程可同时服务于批准和拒绝两种结果，以流程低效来回避实质性问题是一个严重的危险信号。
timeline.point: Argues that an efficient process would serve both approval and rejection outcomes, and that tolerating degenerative process problems to avoid substantive issues is a major red flag.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Supports establishing a license deprecation mechanism but believes the non-proliferation camp's core issue is not efficiency but the lack of well-formed new license submissions, and suggests a preflight checklist to improve the submitter experience.
timeline.point_zh: 支持建立许可证废弃机制，但认为非增殖派的核心问题不在效率而在缺乏高质量新许可证提交，建议用预检清单或结构化跟踪系统改善提交者体验。
timeline.point: Supports establishing a license deprecation mechanism but believes the non-proliferation camp's core issue is not efficiency but the lack of well-formed new license submissions, and suggests a preflight checklist to improve the submitter experience.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Non-DoD Source] Re: For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.sender: Karan, Cem F CIV USARMY RDECOM ARL
timeline.snippet: Defines a derisive term for licenses written by non-professionals that contain serious deficiencies, which professionals would reject.
timeline.point: Defines a derisive term for licenses written by non-professionals that contain serious deficiencies, which professionals would reject.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the analogy between C-FSL and CDDL, arguing that a clause allowing the licensor to strip all licensee rights upon lawsuit may be illegal.
timeline.point_zh: 驳斥 C-FSL 与 CDDL 的类比，认为允许许可证方在被起诉时剥夺被许可方所有权利的条款可能违法。
timeline.point: Rejects the analogy between C-FSL and CDDL, arguing that a clause allowing the licensor to strip all licensee rights upon lawsuit may be illegal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes retroactive deprecation of approved licenses, suggesting that clarifying current approval criteria is a better approach than removal.
timeline.point_zh: 反对追溯性废弃已批准的许可证，主张应通过澄清审批标准而非废除来解决问题。
timeline.point: Opposes retroactive deprecation of approved licenses, suggesting that clarifying current approval criteria is a better approach than removal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the motion Nigel cited is unrelated to license review and falls under the standards committee's jurisdiction.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Nigel 引用的动议与许可证审查无关，属于标准委员会的职责范围。
timeline.point: Points out that the motion Nigel cited is unrelated to license review and falls under the standards committee's jurisdiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests adding clarifying information to the license review FAQ and asks whether modifying the OSD requires a full membership vote.
timeline.point_zh: 建议将审批标准的澄清信息写入许可证审查 FAQ，并询问 OSD 修改是否需要全体成员投票。
timeline.point: Suggests adding clarifying information to the license review FAQ and asks whether modifying the OSD requires a full membership vote.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Raises the NASA license issue, noting that NASA scientists at multiple international conferences tend to avoid the NASA license in favor of Apache.
timeline.point_zh: 提出 NASA 许可证议题，指出 NASA 科学家在多个国际会议上普遍回避使用 NASA 许可证，倾向于选择 Apache。
timeline.point: Raises the NASA license issue, noting that NASA scientists at multiple international conferences tend to avoid the NASA license in favor of Apache.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that updating the NASA license is still worthwhile since many significant projects remain on NOSA and engineers may not understand the legal implications.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 NASA 许可证更新仍有意义，因为许多重要项目仍使用 NOSA，且工程师可能不了解法律后果。
timeline.point: Argues that updating the NASA license is still worthwhile since many significant projects remain on NOSA and engineers may not understand the legal implications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Contends that the OSD does not require surrendering all intellectual property rights, and open source is about collaboration, not forced sharing.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 不要求放弃知识产权，开源是关于协作而非强制共享。
timeline.point: Contends that the OSD does not require surrendering all intellectual property rights, and open source is about collaboration, not forced sharing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Supports the C-FSL concept, arguing that those who derive closed-source products from open source should contribute back, including through monetary means.
timeline.point_zh: 支持 C-FSL 的理念，认为从开源衍生闭源产品的人应以某种形式（包括金钱）做出贡献。
timeline.point: Supports the C-FSL concept, arguing that those who derive closed-source products from open source should contribute back, including through monetary means.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that dual licensing combined with a CLA is a more mature and legally sound approach than C-FSL for balancing open source and commercial interests.
timeline.point_zh: 认为双重授权配合 CLA 是比 C-FSL 更成熟、更合法的方案，能更好地平衡开源与商业收益。
timeline.point: Argues that dual licensing combined with a CLA is a more mature and legally sound approach than C-FSL for balancing open source and commercial interests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Points out practical difficulties with dual licensing: developers cannot be sure whether they may use contributions from the open source branch, and trivial patches are hard to work around.
timeline.point_zh: 指出双重授权在实际操作中存在困难，开发者无法确定能否使用开源分支的贡献，微小补丁更难以绕过。
timeline.point: Points out practical difficulties with dual licensing: developers cannot be sure whether they may use contributions from the open source branch, and trivial patches are hard to work around.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Advises the author to study how other dual licensing projects handle outside contributions or consult a lawyer, suggesting existing solutions are being overlooked.
timeline.point_zh: 建议作者研究其他双重授权项目的做法或咨询律师，认为作者忽略了现有解决方案。
timeline.point: Advises the author to study how other dual licensing projects handle outside contributions or consult a lawyer, suggesting existing solutions are being overlooked.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that CLAs work for large industry-scale projects but not for small personal projects, where contributors would ignore the CLA or fork wildly.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CLA 对大型项目有效，但对个人小型项目不可行，贡献者会选择忽略 CLA 或随意分叉。
timeline.point: Argues that CLAs work for large industry-scale projects but not for small personal projects, where contributors would ignore the CLA or fork wildly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends C-FSL as not suppressing forks but merely streamlining contribution usage, arguing the original author's leadership advantage will attract cooperation.
timeline.point_zh: 辩护 C-FSL 不压制分叉，只是简化贡献使用流程，原作者的领导力优势会吸引人们配合。
timeline.point: Defends C-FSL as not suppressing forks but merely streamlining contribution usage, arguing the original author's leadership advantage will attract cooperation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Criticizes C-FSL for attempting to restrict forks in violation of OSD #3, suggesting the author actually prefers proprietary development, and notes serious drafting problems in the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 C-FSL 试图限制分叉违反 OSD #3，认为作者实际上偏好专有开发模式，并指出许可证文本存在严重措辞问题。
timeline.point: Criticizes C-FSL for attempting to restrict forks in violation of OSD #3, suggesting the author actually prefers proprietary development, and notes serious drafting problems in the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Recommends UCL v1.0 as an approved alternative that achieves a CLA-like effect by requiring derivative works to be dual-licensed under UCL and Apache.
timeline.point_zh: 推荐已批准的 UCL v1.0 作为替代方案，该许可证通过强制 Apache 双重授权实现类似 CLA 的效果。
timeline.point: Recommends UCL v1.0 as an approved alternative that achieves a CLA-like effect by requiring derivative works to be dual-licensed under UCL and Apache.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that C-FSL does not prevent forks, only allowing upstream use of downstream contributions, which benefits casual users who do not want to sign a CLA.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 C-FSL 不阻止分叉，仅允许上游使用下游贡献，这对不愿签署 CLA 的普通用户是优势。
timeline.point: Reiterates that C-FSL does not prevent forks, only allowing upstream use of downstream contributions, which benefits casual users who do not want to sign a CLA.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Denies having claimed that C-FSL blocks forks, asking the other party to re-read the original comments.
timeline.point_zh: 否认曾声称 C-FSL 阻止分叉，要求对方重新阅读其原始评论。
timeline.point: Denies having claimed that C-FSL blocks forks, asking the other party to re-read the original comments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges UCL as a potential alternative but prefers C-FSL for defining original authors' rights in a single, more developer-readable document.
timeline.point_zh: 认可 UCL 可能是替代方案，但认为双重授权更复杂，C-FSL 在单一文档中定义原作者权利且更易读。
timeline.point: Acknowledges UCL as a potential alternative but prefers C-FSL for defining original authors' rights in a single, more developer-readable document.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the UCL upstream license is Apache 2.0 or later, and explains that 'shall' in legal terms denotes an obligation.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 UCL 的上游许可证是 Apache 2.0，并解释 "shall" 在法律语境中表示义务。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the UCL upstream license is Apache 2.0 or later, and explains that 'shall' in legal terms denotes an obligation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that the legal term 'shall' is controversial due to its ambiguity and contradictory interpretations, with efforts underway to remove it from legal language.
timeline.point_zh: 指出法律界对 "shall" 一词存在争议，其含义模糊且存在矛盾解释，有法律词典编辑正推动淘汰该用法。
timeline.point: Notes that the legal term 'shall' is controversial due to its ambiguity and contradictory interpretations, with efforts underway to remove it from legal language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Humorously attributes the use of 'shall' to the original license author Larry rather than to his own choice.
timeline.point_zh: 幽默地将 "shall" 的使用归因于原始许可证的作者 Larry，而非自己的选择。
timeline.point: Humorously attributes the use of 'shall' to the original license author Larry rather than to his own choice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the UCL license has any known users, given that its original submitter apparently never had the opportunity to use it.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 UCL 许可证是否实际有用户，因为其提交者本人似乎未能使用它。
timeline.point: Questions whether the UCL license has any known users, given that its original submitter apparently never had the opportunity to use it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that at least one UCL usage is going through public release, with a couple more coming.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 UCL 许可证至少有一个使用案例正在公开发布，还有几个即将推出。
timeline.point: Confirms that at least one UCL usage is going through public release, with a couple more coming.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Non-DoD Source] Re: For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.sender: Karan, Cem F CIV USARMY RDECOM ARL
timeline.snippet: Suggests that tooling like CLA-assistant might help address the previous objections raised.
timeline.point: Suggests that tooling like CLA-assistant might help address the previous objections raised.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that having original authors retain copyright is beneficial, as someone responsible for the upstream project is crucial for issues like security, otherwise the burden falls entirely on distributors.
timeline.point_zh: 认为保留原作者版权是有利的，因为有人对上游项目负责在安全等问题上至关重要，否则全部负担落在分发者身上。
timeline.point: Argues that having original authors retain copyright is beneficial, as someone responsible for the upstream project is crucial for issues like security, otherwise the burden falls entirely on distributors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Informs the mailing list that the Board has postponed the C-FSL decision by one month due to unresolved drafting issues and OSD conflicts.
timeline.point_zh: 通知邮件列表：由于 C-FSL 仍存在未解决的起草问题和 OSD 冲突，董事会将决定推迟一个月。
timeline.point: Informs the mailing list that the Board has postponed the C-FSL decision by one month due to unresolved drafting issues and OSD conflicts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters criticism of drafting issues by noting that cited text is not in the actual license, and requests specific OSD conflicts beyond OSD #5.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳关于起草问题的批评，指出批评者引用的文本并不在实际许可证中，并要求指出除 OSD #5 之外的具体冲突。
timeline.point: Counters criticism of drafting issues by noting that cited text is not in the actual license, and requests specific OSD conflicts beyond OSD #5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters drafting criticism by showing that cited text is absent from the actual license, and challenges critics to identify concrete OSD conflicts beyond OSD #5.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳起草问题批评，指出批评者引用的文本不在实际许可证中，要求指出除 OSD #5 以外的具体冲突。
timeline.point: Counters drafting criticism by showing that cited text is absent from the actual license, and challenges critics to identify concrete OSD conflicts beyond OSD #5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Lists four reasons to reject C-FSL: not written by an attorney, violates OSD #5 with discriminatory intent, disadvantages fork developers, and is redundant since CLAs better achieve the same purpose.
timeline.point_zh: 列出四条拒绝 C-FSL 的理由：非律师撰写、违反 OSD #5 歧视性、对分叉开发者不利、CLA 已能更好实现相同目的。
timeline.point: Lists four reasons to reject C-FSL: not written by an attorney, violates OSD #5 with discriminatory intent, disadvantages fork developers, and is redundant since CLAs better achieve the same purpose.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Summarizes open issues with C-FSL, stating that at minimum the drafting problems must be revised and the OSD #3 and #5 conflicts seriously addressed before progress.
timeline.point_zh: 汇总 C-FSL 的未解决问题，认为至少需要修订起草问题并认真处理 OSD #3 和 #5 冲突才能推进。
timeline.point: Summarizes open issues with C-FSL, stating that at minimum the drafting problems must be revised and the OSD #3 and #5 conflicts seriously addressed before progress.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: References their own detailed list of issues submitted earlier, pointing to the author's response to some of those issues.
timeline.point_zh: 引用自己此前提交的详细问题清单，指出作者对其中部分问题的回应。
timeline.point: References their own detailed list of issues submitted earlier, pointing to the author's response to some of those issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for overlooking McCoy's issue list and recommends the author address those issues before resubmitting.
timeline.point_zh: 为遗漏 McCoy 的问题清单致歉，建议作者在重新提交前考虑这些问题。
timeline.point: Apologizes for overlooking McCoy's issue list and recommends the author address those issues before resubmitting.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends C-FSL as not violating OSD #3, arguing it aims to address the problem of unwanted involuntary forks caused by unmaintained upstream projects.
timeline.point_zh: 辩护 C-FSL 不违反 OSD #3，称其旨在解决无维护上游项目导致的非自愿下游分叉问题。
timeline.point: Defends C-FSL as not violating OSD #3, arguing it aims to address the problem of unwanted involuntary forks caused by unmaintained upstream projects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that only big companies can afford to implement CLAs, and C-FSL aims to bring the benefits of dual licensing to ordinary developers.
timeline.point_zh: 认为只有大公司能负担 CLA，C-FSL 旨在将双重授权的好处带给普通开发者。
timeline.point: Argues that only big companies can afford to implement CLAs, and C-FSL aims to bring the benefits of dual licensing to ordinary developers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters that the Harmony Project has already made CLAs accessible to ordinary developers, undermining the justification for a new license.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 CLA 对普通开发者不可用的说法，指出 Harmony Project 已使 CLA 对个人开发者触手可及。
timeline.point: Counters that the Harmony Project has already made CLAs accessible to ordinary developers, undermining the justification for a new license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that by 'ordinary programmer' they mean small-scale starting projects, not large structured projects like Harmony.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清「普通开发者」指的是小规模起步的项目，而非像 Harmony 这样的大型结构化项目。
timeline.point: Clarifies that by 'ordinary programmer' they mean small-scale starting projects, not large structured projects like Harmony.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that CLAs are available to everyone, homebrew licenses are harder to enforce than contracts, and bad actors will not change behavior based on license wording.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CLA 人人可用，自制许可证在执行上不如合同，恶意行为者不会因换用不同许可证而改变行为。
timeline.point: Argues that CLAs are available to everyone, homebrew licenses are harder to enforce than contracts, and bad actors will not change behavior based on license wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions Elmar's understanding of the Harmony Project and suggests using one of their CLAs rather than proposing yet another license.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 Elmar 对 Harmony Project 的理解，建议直接使用其 CLA 而非提出新许可证。
timeline.point: Questions Elmar's understanding of the Harmony Project and suggests using one of their CLAs rather than proposing yet another license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Maintains that CLAs are impractical for small projects because contributors and distributors will not bother signing one for minor changes.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为 CLA 对小型项目不可行，因为贡献者和分发者不会为小项目签署 CLA。
timeline.point: Maintains that CLAs are impractical for small projects because contributors and distributors will not bother signing one for minor changes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: As a maintainer of small projects, assumes that patch contributors intend to become joint authors under the original license, allowing the maintainer to unilaterally change it.
timeline.point_zh: 以小项目维护者身份表示，默认补丁贡献者意在成为共同作者并保留原许可证授权，维护者可单方面修改许可证。
timeline.point: As a maintainer of small projects, assumes that patch contributors intend to become joint authors under the original license, allowing the maintainer to unilaterally change it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that contributions are more likely to be treated as a compilation with individual copyrights rather than a joint work, undermining the assumption of unilateral license changes.
timeline.point_zh: 警告贡献更可能被视为具有独立版权的汇编作品而非共同作品，推翻单方面修改许可证的假设。
timeline.point: Warns that contributions are more likely to be treated as a compilation with individual copyrights rather than a joint work, undermining the assumption of unilateral license changes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Advocates limiting the number of original authors to maintain re-licensing flexibility, arguing that original authors should have control over their contribution share.
timeline.point_zh: 主张限制原始作者数量以保持再许可灵活性，认为原始作者应对其贡献份额拥有控制权。
timeline.point: Advocates limiting the number of original authors to maintain re-licensing flexibility, arguing that original authors should have control over their contribution share.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks Elmar whether he intends to submit a revised license to address the feedback received.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Elmar 是否打算提交修订版许可证以回应社区反馈。
timeline.point: Asks Elmar whether he intends to submit a revised license to address the feedback received.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Expresses willingness to revise the license but finds the feedback too vague and negative to know what specific changes to make.
timeline.point_zh: 表示愿意修订许可证，但认为收到的反馈过于笼统和负面，不清楚具体需要修改什么。
timeline.point: Expresses willingness to revise the license but finds the feedback too vague and negative to know what specific changes to make.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Conveys the OSI board's decision to withhold approval of the C-FSL pending submission of a redrafted version.
timeline.point_zh: 转达 OSI 董事会决定：暂缓批准 C-FSL，等待提交修订版本。
timeline.point: Conveys the OSI board's decision to withhold approval of the C-FSL pending submission of a redrafted version.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks what specific modifications are needed for the C-FSL license and whether hiring a lawyer is necessary for the revision.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 OSI 许可证具体需要哪些修改，以及是否需要聘请律师来修订。
timeline.point: Asks what specific modifications are needed for the C-FSL license and whether hiring a lawyer is necessary for the revision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether revision is worthwhile given that core disputes (original authors retaining re-licensing rights, personal information requirements) are unlikely to change, and requests the board meeting outcome.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑修订是否值得，因为核心争议点（原始作者保留再许可权、提供个人信息）不太可能改变，同时请求董事会会议结果信息。
timeline.point: Questions whether revision is worthwhile given that core disputes (original authors retaining re-licensing rights, personal information requirements) are unlikely to change, and requests the board meeting outcome.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: States that agreement with OSI on required changes is needed before hiring a lawyer to revise the license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示在聘请律师修订前，需要先与 OSI 就修改内容达成一致。
timeline.point: States that agreement with OSI on required changes is needed before hiring a lawyer to revise the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies in the capacity of OSI Chair that the board does not provide legal advice or design licenses; withholding approval was intended to give the submitter the opportunity to act on community feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 以 OSI 主席身份说明：董事会不会提供法律建议或设计许可证，暂缓批准是为给提交者自行改进的机会。
timeline.point: Clarifies in the capacity of OSI Chair that the board does not provide legal advice or design licenses; withholding approval was intended to give the submitter the opportunity to act on community feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Believes some criticisms miss the point and are based on others' comments rather than the license itself; their lawyer sees no obstacle with original authors retaining re-licensing rights, and requests a timeline for submitting the redraft.
timeline.point_zh: 认为部分批评未触及许可证本身，其律师认为原始作者保留再许可权不构成障碍，请求 OSI 确认并询问修订提交期限。
timeline.point: Believes some criticisms miss the point and are based on others' comments rather than the license itself; their lawyer sees no obstacle with original authors retaining re-licensing rights, and requests a timeline for submitting the redraft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Convertible Free Software License, Version 1.1 (C-FSL v1.1)
timeline.snippet: Considers original authors retaining re-licensing rights a major obstacle to approval; if not made reciprocal, it constitutes a discriminatory provision, and suggests extending that right to fork project authors.
timeline.point_zh: 认为原始作者保留再许可权是批准的主要障碍，若不赋予对等权利则构成歧视性条款，建议将该权利扩展至分叉项目的作者。
timeline.point: Considers original authors retaining re-licensing rights a major obstacle to approval; if not made reciprocal, it constitutes a discriminatory provision, and suggests extending that right to fork project authors.

submissions.rejection_reason: License Committee recommended rejection (Dec 2018). Board withheld approval pending redrafting. Key concerns: the license restricted relicensing rights to 'original authors', which could violate OSD #5 and #7.

unique_participants: Karan, Cem F CIV USARMY RDECOM ARL

status_review.rationale: Human-calibrated baseline restore after concurrent-run corruption.
