timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the YetiForce Public License 3.0 for approval, describing it as MIT-based with added mandatory registration and footer-retention conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 YetiForce Public License 3.0 供审批，称其基于 MIT 许可证，并额外加入了强制注册和保留页脚两项条件。
timeline.point: Submits the YetiForce Public License 3.0 for approval, describing it as MIT-based with added mandatory registration and footer-retention conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the YetiForce license should be rejected because it adds novel clauses without specialist legal review and also worsens license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张应拒绝 YetiForce 许可证，因为它在没有专业法律审查的情况下加入了新条款，而且还会加剧许可证泛滥。
timeline.point: Argues the YetiForce license should be rejected because it adds novel clauses without specialist legal review and also worsens license proliferation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that the YetiForce license violates OSD sections 3, 6, and 7, and advises withdrawing the submission because it will not be approved.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 YetiForce 许可证违反 OSD 第3、6、7条，并建议撤回申请，因为该许可证不会获得批准。
timeline.point: Argues that the YetiForce license violates OSD sections 3, 6, and 7, and advises withdrawing the submission because it will not be approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Adds that the license also violates OSD section 5 because it imposes different requirements on companies and individuals.
timeline.point_zh: 补充指出，该许可证还违反 OSD 第5条，因为它对公司和个人施加了不同要求。
timeline.point: Adds that the license also violates OSD section 5 because it imposes different requirements on companies and individuals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the license should not be approved because its badgeware and registration requirements are inconsistent with OSI practice and may be legally unenforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证不应获批，因为其徽标展示和注册要求不符合 OSI 的惯例，而且在法律上可能难以执行。
timeline.point: Argues the license should not be approved because its badgeware and registration requirements are inconsistent with OSI practice and may be legally unenforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval for YetiForce Public License 3.0
timeline.snippet: Reports that the OSI board decided at its November meeting to reject the YetiForce Public License 3.0.

timeline.point: Reports that the OSI board decided at its November meeting to reject the YetiForce Public License 3.0.

license_texts.text:
Zentao Public License
=====================

Submission:
https://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review/2016-June/002800.html

Comments: Submission did not fully follow approval
requirements. Substantive discussion focused on the badgeware issue;
some suggested that legacy approval might be a more appropriate
path. 

Recommendation: Reject.


Upstream Compatibility License v1.0 (UCL-1.0)
=============================================

Submission: https://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review/2016-October/002856.html

Comments: Questions were raised about conformance with the
nondiscrimination policy of OSD 5. It was suggested that the license
be redrafted so that all downstream modifications are licensed under
the Apache License 2.0 (rather than just upstream licensors receiving
a copy under the Apache License 2.0).

Recommendation: At request of license submitter and others, OSI to
provide general guidance by commenting on whether a license that
privileges one class of licensees by giving it greater permissions
relative to other licensees conflicts with OSD or should be
discouraged or disapproved for non-OSD policy reasons.


European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL)
==============================================

Submission: https://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review/2016-December/002902.html

Comments: Suite of three licenses. Some initial questions were raised
on the list but the license submitter has not yet responded.

Recommendation: Encourage further review and discussion on list. 


Octopus License
===============

Submission: https://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review/2016-December/002906.html

Comments: Submission does not conform to all the requirements stated
at https://opensource.org/approval. Submitter has been asked to review
the requirements and provide all requested supporting data.  Some
preliminary discussion has taken place on the list.

Recommendation: No action at this time.


Richard

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Submits the ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE for approval, arguing that it protects the original author by forbidding removal of software notices and branding.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE 以寻求批准，并主张该许可证通过禁止移除软件标识和品牌信息来保护原作者。
timeline.point: Submits the ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE for approval, arguing that it protects the original author by forbidding removal of software notices and branding.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks whether section 2.4 is a badgeware requirement and whether it still applies after the software is modified.
timeline.point_zh: 询问第2.4条是否属于徽标展示要求，以及在软件被修改后该要求是否仍然适用。
timeline.point: Asks whether section 2.4 is a badgeware requirement and whether it still applies after the software is modified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Identifies multiple flaws in ZPL, including company control over interpretation, unclear rights language, service-notice concerns, and possible field-of-use discrimination.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 ZPL 存在多项缺陷，包括公司对解释权的控制、权利表述不清、服务告知条款问题，以及可能的使用领域歧视。
timeline.point: Identifies multiple flaws in ZPL, including company control over interpretation, unclear rights language, service-notice concerns, and possible field-of-use discrimination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Confirms that the license functions as badgeware and says the requirement still applies to modified versions.
timeline.point_zh: 确认该许可证具有徽标展示性质，并表示这一要求在修改版本中仍然适用。
timeline.point: Confirms that the license functions as badgeware and says the requirement still applies to modified versions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Requests a precise explanation of how, where, and when attribution must appear, especially for software that may run without a GUI.
timeline.point_zh: 要求明确说明署名应如何、在何处以及何时展示，尤其是针对可能没有 GUI 的软件。
timeline.point: Requests a precise explanation of how, where, and when attribution must appear, especially for software that may run without a GUI.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Defends ZPL by confirming its badgeware clause, explaining the interpretation and “I” language, and saying the license is intentionally tailored to GUI and web-interface products.
timeline.point_zh: 为 ZPL 辩护，确认其徽标展示条款，解释“解释权”和“I”的含义，并表示该许可证本就是为 GUI 和 Web 界面产品定制的。
timeline.point: Defends ZPL by confirming its badgeware clause, explaining the interpretation and “I” language, and saying the license is intentionally tailored to GUI and web-interface products.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Explains that ZPL is intended only for application software with GUI or browser/server interfaces, and says downstream developers may add their own badges while preserving the original.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 ZPL 仅适用于具有 GUI 或浏览器/服务器界面的应用软件，并表示下游开发者可以在保留原标识的同时添加自己的标识。
timeline.point: Explains that ZPL is intended only for application software with GUI or browser/server interfaces, and says downstream developers may add their own badges while preserving the original.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Questions how the company’s claimed authority to interpret ZPL would work in practice, especially for third-party use or if the company no longer exists.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑公司自称拥有 ZPL 解释权在实践中如何运作，尤其是在第三方使用或公司不再存在的情况下。
timeline.point: Questions how the company’s claimed authority to interpret ZPL would work in practice, especially for third-party use or if the company no longer exists.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says ZPL was drafted to address confusion about permitted use, badge removal, and failure to share code, and that the company-interpretation clause is temporary.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 ZPL 是为解决使用范围不清、标识被移除以及未分享代码等问题而起草的，公司解释权条款只是临时安排。
timeline.point: Says ZPL was drafted to address confusion about permitted use, badge removal, and failure to share code, and that the company-interpretation clause is temporary.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks how end users could remove badges if they are not developers, and whether the concern is really about redistributors of modified versions.
timeline.point_zh: 询问如果终端用户不是开发者，他们如何移除标识；并追问实际担忧是否指发布修改版的开发者。
timeline.point: Asks how end users could remove badges if they are not developers, and whether the concern is really about redistributors of modified versions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should not be approving badgeware licenses and questions why ZPL is still under discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 不应批准徽标展示类许可证，并质疑为何 ZPL 还在继续讨论。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should not be approving badgeware licenses and questions why ZPL is still under discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Agrees that ZPL should not keep being considered as a badgeware license.
timeline.point_zh: 同意对于像 ZPL 这样的徽标展示许可证，不应继续予以考虑。
timeline.point: Agrees that ZPL should not keep being considered as a badgeware license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: States that OSI should not approve badgeware licenses and says ZPL section 2.4 goes beyond prior acceptable attribution terms, so it should be rejected.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 不应批准徽标展示许可证，并认为 ZPL 第2.4条比以往可接受的署名条件更严格，因此应被拒绝。
timeline.point: States that OSI should not approve badgeware licenses and says ZPL section 2.4 goes beyond prior acceptable attribution terms, so it should be rejected.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that badgeware is too narrow and that an OSI-approved license should be usable across all kinds of software and developers.
timeline.point_zh: 认为徽标展示类许可证过于狭窄，OSI 批准的许可证应适用于各种软件和各类开发者。
timeline.point: Argues that badgeware is too narrow and that an OSI-approved license should be usable across all kinds of software and developers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Suggests clarifying on the OSD pages that badgeware is not allowed, because such terms likely violate OSD section 4 and maybe section 3.
timeline.point_zh: 建议在 OSD 页面上明确说明徽标展示条款不被允许，因为这类条款可能违反 OSD 第4条，甚至第3条。
timeline.point: Suggests clarifying on the OSD pages that badgeware is not allowed, because such terms likely violate OSD section 4 and maybe section 3.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Expresses support for the idea.
timeline.point_zh: 对这一想法表示支持。
timeline.point: Expresses support for the idea.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Notes that OSI previously approved CPAL, which likely counts as badgeware, making any new blanket statement on badgeware harder to frame.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 过去曾批准过可能属于徽标展示的 CPAL，因此要对徽标展示作出新的统一表述会更复杂。
timeline.point: Notes that OSI previously approved CPAL, which likely counts as badgeware, making any new blanket statement on badgeware harder to frame.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Points out that CPAL allows attribution only where a GUI exists, unlike ZPL, so it remains usable in non-GUI environments.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 CPAL 只在存在图形界面时才要求展示署名，这与 ZPL 不同，因此它仍可用于无 GUI 的环境。
timeline.point: Points out that CPAL allows attribution only where a GUI exists, unlike ZPL, so it remains usable in non-GUI environments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that ZPL is more rigid than CPAL and effectively imposes a domain restriction, so it fails as written; he also favors rejecting new badgeware licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 ZPL 比 CPAL 更僵硬，实际上形成了领域限制，因此按现状不合格；他同时倾向于不再批准新的徽标展示许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that ZPL is more rigid than CPAL and effectively imposes a domain restriction, so it fails as written; he also favors rejecting new badgeware licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks what prior license applied and why ZPL would improve compliance if developers were already willing to violate the earlier license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问此前适用的许可证是什么，以及如果开发者已经愿意违反旧许可证，ZPL 又为何能提高合规性。
timeline.point: Asks what prior license applied and why ZPL would improve compliance if developers were already willing to violate the earlier license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Proposes a policy of refusing new licenses whose only meaningful difference from existing licenses is a badgeware clause.
timeline.point_zh: 提议制定一项政策：如果新许可证与现有许可证唯一实质差异只是徽标展示条款，就不予批准。
timeline.point: Proposes a policy of refusing new licenses whose only meaningful difference from existing licenses is a badgeware clause.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Explains that downstream developers in China often remove original branding and that LGPL did not clearly address whether logos and badges could be removed.
timeline.point_zh: 解释说，在中国，下游开发者经常移除原有品牌标识，而 LGPL 并未明确规定 logo 和徽标是否可以被移除。
timeline.point: Explains that downstream developers in China often remove original branding and that LGPL did not clearly address whether logos and badges could be removed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that a new license will not solve the problem because people who ignored the old license will probably ignore the new one too.
timeline.point_zh: 认为新许可证无法解决问题，因为无视旧许可证的人很可能也会无视新许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that a new license will not solve the problem because people who ignored the old license will probably ignore the new one too.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Suggests that an attribution license might be a better fit than ZPL for the stated problem.
timeline.point_zh: 建议针对所述问题，署名许可证可能比 ZPL 更合适。
timeline.point: Suggests that an attribution license might be a better fit than ZPL for the stated problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the reported badge-removal problem includes deleting copyright headers from source files.
timeline.point_zh: 询问所说的移除标识问题是否也包括删除源文件中的版权头。
timeline.point: Asks whether the reported badge-removal problem includes deleting copyright headers from source files.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that downstream users remove both source copyright headers and interface branding, which he offers as justification for ZPL’s attribution requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清说，下游使用者既会移除源代码中的版权头，也会移除界面上的品牌标识，并以此作为 ZPL 署名要求的理由。
timeline.point: Clarifies that downstream users remove both source copyright headers and interface branding, which he offers as justification for ZPL’s attribution requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Responds that WordPress does not require logo display and argues a new license will not stop violators; enforcement in court would be more effective.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称 WordPress 并不强制展示 logo，并认为新许可证无法阻止违规者，诉诸法院执行会更有效。
timeline.point: Responds that WordPress does not require logo display and argues a new license will not stop violators; enforcement in court would be more effective.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that violators may ignore any license, but argues ZPL is still needed to create a clear legal basis in China against removing logos.
timeline.point_zh: 承认违规者可能会继续无视任何许可证，但认为 ZPL 仍有必要，以便在中国为禁止移除 logo 提供明确的法律依据。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that violators may ignore any license, but argues ZPL is still needed to create a clear legal basis in China against removing logos.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Suggests narrowing the attribution requirement to a startup notice or instead using a proprietary license, since that would better protect branding.
timeline.point_zh: 建议把署名要求缩窄为启动提示，或者干脆使用专有许可证，因为那样更有利于保护品牌标识。
timeline.point: Suggests narrowing the attribution requirement to a startup notice or instead using a proprietary license, since that would better protect branding.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that changing circumstances may require licenses like ZPL and that stricter protection of attribution may better preserve open source practice in China.
timeline.point_zh: 主张环境变化可能需要像 ZPL 这样的许可证，并认为更严格地保护署名可能更有助于维护中国的开源实践。
timeline.point: Argues that changing circumstances may require licenses like ZPL and that stricter protection of attribution may better preserve open source practice in China.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Defends ZPL as a necessary situation-specific license and argues its badge requirement is flexible because developers can choose where, or whether, to add their own badges.
timeline.point_zh: 为 ZPL 辩护，称其是针对特定情形所必需的许可证，并认为其徽标要求具有灵活性，因为开发者可以选择在何处甚至是否添加自己的标识。
timeline.point: Defends ZPL as a necessary situation-specific license and argues its badge requirement is flexible because developers can choose where, or whether, to add their own badges.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that open source licenses must conform to established principles, and that a license with exclusions or restrictions cannot be approved as open source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张开源许可证必须遵守既有原则，带有排除或限制的许可证不能作为开源许可证获得批准。
timeline.point: Argues that open source licenses must conform to established principles, and that a license with exclusions or restrictions cannot be approved as open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says ZPL has worked for the company’s products and users, and accepts that OSI may view it differently while still valuing the license’s practical benefits.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 ZPL 已在公司产品和用户中发挥作用，并接受 OSI 可能有不同看法，但仍看重该许可证的实际效果。
timeline.point: Says ZPL has worked for the company’s products and users, and accepts that OSI may view it differently while still valuing the license’s practical benefits.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks whether legacy approval might apply and requests a link to one of the products using the license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问这种情况是否可以考虑走 legacy approval，并要求提供一个使用该许可证的软件链接。
timeline.point: Asks whether legacy approval might apply and requests a link to one of the products using the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: States that the ZenTao license should not be described as open source.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 ZenTao 许可证不应被称为开源许可证。
timeline.point: States that the ZenTao license should not be described as open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Explains that scrutiny on the public list is normal and argues that only OSD-compliant licenses should be called open source; using the term for noncompliant licenses misleads users.
timeline.point_zh: 说明公开列表上的严格审查是正常流程，并主张只有符合 OSD 的许可证才能称为开源；把该术语用于不合规许可证会误导用户。
timeline.point: Explains that scrutiny on the public list is normal and argues that only OSD-compliant licenses should be called open source; using the term for noncompliant licenses misleads users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Suggests consulting Kaiyuanshe for a China-specific licensing approach and states that ZPL is unlikely to pass OSI approval, sounding more like shared source or badgeware.
timeline.point_zh: 建议咨询开源社以寻找更适合中国环境的许可方案，并表示 ZPL 不太可能通过 OSI 审批，更像共享源代码或徽标展示许可证。
timeline.point: Suggests consulting Kaiyuanshe for a China-specific licensing approach and states that ZPL is unlikely to pass OSI approval, sounding more like shared source or badgeware.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the 4-clause BSD license was ever OSI-approved and notes that OSI seems to deprecate rather than remove licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 询问四条款 BSD 许可证是否曾获 OSI 批准，并指出 OSI 似乎只会弃用许可证而不会将其移除。
timeline.point: Asks whether the 4-clause BSD license was ever OSI-approved and notes that OSI seems to deprecate rather than remove licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: States that the 4-clause BSD license had already been superseded before OSI existed.
timeline.point_zh: 表示四条款 BSD 许可证在 OSI 成立之前就已经被后续 BSD 版本取代。
timeline.point: States that the 4-clause BSD license had already been superseded before OSI existed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says the clarification changes the analysis and suggests treating the license as a legacy license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示澄清后的情况改变了分析方向，并建议把该许可证按历史遗留许可证处理。
timeline.point: Says the clarification changes the analysis and suggests treating the license as a legacy license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues that 4-clause BSD is only obsolete for code owned by the UC Regents, and that some original 4-clause BSD code still exists under other holders.
timeline.point_zh: 主张四条款 BSD 只在加州大学董事会持有版权的情形下才算过时，其他版权人名下仍有原始四条款 BSD 代码存在。
timeline.point: Argues that 4-clause BSD is only obsolete for code owned by the UC Regents, and that some original 4-clause BSD code still exists under other holders.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Suggests that OSI could vote to treat the 4-clause BSD license as a legacy license.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSI 可以考虑通过表决将四条款 BSD 作为历史遗留许可证处理。
timeline.point: Suggests that OSI could vote to treat the 4-clause BSD license as a legacy license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI never clearly approved 4-clause BSD, but also says current wording wrongly suggests it would fail the OSD. He distinguishes its advertising clause from true badgeware.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 从未明确批准过四条款 BSD，但也认为现有表述错误地暗示其若提交会违反 OSD；他还区分了广告条款与真正的徽标式要求。
timeline.point: Argues OSI never clearly approved 4-clause BSD, but also says current wording wrongly suggests it would fail the OSD. He distinguishes its advertising clause from true badgeware.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says 4-clause BSD is not badgeware because its advertising requirement does not restrict the software itself.
timeline.point_zh: 认为四条款 BSD 不属于徽标式许可证，因为其广告要求并未对软件本身施加限制。
timeline.point: Says 4-clause BSD is not badgeware because its advertising requirement does not restrict the software itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the correction and agrees that notice preservation outside the software is not an OSD 3 or 4 problem.
timeline.point_zh: 接受更正，并同意在软件之外保留声明并不构成 OSD 第 3 或第 4 条的问题。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the correction and agrees that notice preservation outside the software is not an OSD 3 or 4 problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Agrees that this kind of requirement is acceptable because it would not interfere with changes such as moving from a GUI to command-line software.
timeline.point_zh: 同意这种要求是可接受的，因为它不会妨碍例如从图形界面改为命令行软件之类的修改。
timeline.point: Agrees that this kind of requirement is acceptable because it would not interfere with changes such as moving from a GUI to command-line software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Provides a link to a Zentao product as requested.
timeline.point_zh: 按要求提供了 Zentao 产品的链接。
timeline.point: Provides a link to a Zentao product as requested.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says Kaiyuanshe no longer approves licenses, argues no existing Chinese license fits their situation as ZPL does, and explains they submitted the English text for this review.
timeline.point_zh: 表示开源社据其所知已不再审批许可证，认为现有中国许可证都不如 ZPL 适合其处境，并解释此次提交英文文本是为了便于本列表评审。
timeline.point: Says Kaiyuanshe no longer approves licenses, argues no existing Chinese license fits their situation as ZPL does, and explains they submitted the English text for this review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Welcomes the criticism but says their users benefit at scale, which reinforces their commitment to the license and to serving users over strict adherence to existing rules.
timeline.point_zh: 表示愿意听取批评，但认为大量用户确实从产品中受益，这反而加强了他们继续采用该许可证并优先服务用户的决心。
timeline.point: Welcomes the criticism but says their users benefit at scale, which reinforces their commitment to the license and to serving users over strict adherence to existing rules.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says the clarified facts materially change the case and suggests legacy approval may be appropriate, while deferring to others on the final view.
timeline.point_zh: 表示澄清后的事实使情况明显不同，并建议也许可以考虑按历史遗留审批处理，但最终判断仍应由其他人决定。
timeline.point: Says the clarified facts materially change the case and suggests legacy approval may be appropriate, while deferring to others on the final view.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Argues past approval of CPAL or APL does not justify more badgeware. He says CPAL was a grudging compromise, largely unused, and that intrusive badgeware and GPL section 7 misuse should not be treated as acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 CPAL 或 APL 的历史批准并不能为更多徽标式许可证背书；他认为 CPAL 只是勉强接受的折中且几乎无人使用，而侵入式徽标条款及对 GPL 第 7 条的滥用不应被视为可接受。
timeline.point: Argues past approval of CPAL or APL does not justify more badgeware. He says CPAL was a grudging compromise, largely unused, and that intrusive badgeware and GPL section 7 misuse should not be treated as acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says SugarCRM-style section 7 usage went too far, while the GPL text itself is not the core problem. He concludes badgeware is generally inconsistent with the FSD and OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SugarCRM 式的第 7 条用法已经越界，而 GPL 文本本身并非根本问题；他最终认为徽标式要求通常与自由软件定义和开放源代码定义不一致。
timeline.point: Says SugarCRM-style section 7 usage went too far, while the GPL text itself is not the core problem. He concludes badgeware is generally inconsistent with the FSD and OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Says legacy approval is the right path, then asks for review of the Chinese authoritative text, analysis of any direct OSD conflicts, and whether Zentao can revise the terms.
timeline.point_zh: 认为历史遗留审批是正确路径，并提出应审查作为权威文本的中文版本、确认是否存在直接违反 OSD 的条款，以及 Zentao 是否愿意修改条款。
timeline.point: Says legacy approval is the right path, then asks for review of the Chinese authoritative text, analysis of any direct OSD conflicts, and whether Zentao can revise the terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Approval request for ZENTAO PUBLIC LICENSE
timeline.snippet: Explains that ZPL was drafted to protect developers' incentives and income in a market where users often remove attribution, and argues that practical sustainability matters more than absolute software freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 解释称 ZPL 的制定是为了在用户常移除署名的环境下保护开发者的积极性和收入，并主张实践中的可持续性比绝对的软件自由更重要。
timeline.point: Explains that ZPL was drafted to protect developers' incentives and income in a market where users often remove attribution, and argues that practical sustainability matters more than absolute software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Submits Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1 for OSI approval, describing it as a permissive license granting broad permissions to redistributors, creators, and end users.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1 申请 OSI 批准，描述其为一款为再分发者、创建者和终端用户授予广泛权限的宽松许可证。
timeline.point: Submits Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1 for OSI approval, describing it as a permissive license granting broad permissions to redistributors, creators, and end users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Strongly recommends rejection: the license is poorly written, section 5 makes it totally revocable through compulsory and undefined future license terms, section 11 reads as badgeware, and it resembles no existing license due to fundamental flaws.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈建议拒绝：许可证写作质量极差，第5条使其可通过强制且未定义的未来许可条款完全撤销，第11条类似徽章软件，其根本缺陷使其与任何现有许可证都不同。
timeline.point: Strongly recommends rejection: the license is poorly written, section 5 makes it totally revocable through compulsory and undefined future license terms, section 11 reads as badgeware, and it resembles no existing license due to fundamental flaws.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Notes the license is very difficult to understand due to non-idiomatic English, says it would need rewriting and resubmission, and suggests considering existing licenses like GPLv2 or GPLv3 instead.
timeline.point_zh: 指出由于非地道英语导致许可证难以理解，认为需要重写并重新提交，建议考虑使用 GPLv2 或 GPLv3 等现有许可证。
timeline.point: Notes the license is very difficult to understand due to non-idiomatic English, says it would need rewriting and resubmission, and suggests considering existing licenses like GPLv2 or GPLv3 instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: States the license was clearly written without professional advice or clear goals, and advises the submitter to obtain legal or expert advice if they have real licensing needs.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该许可证显然未经专业建议或明确目标编写，建议提交者如有真实许可需求应寻求法律或专家建议。
timeline.point: States the license was clearly written without professional advice or clear goals, and advises the submitter to obtain legal or expert advice if they have real licensing needs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Suggests that license submissions should indicate whether the license text has been reviewed by a lawyer, to provide transparency about the submitter and the license quality.
timeline.point_zh: 建议许可证提交应说明文本是否经律师审查，以提高对提交者和许可证质量的透明度。
timeline.point: Suggests that license submissions should indicate whether the license text has been reviewed by a lawyer, to provide transparency about the submitter and the license quality.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Agrees that the ambiguity is the main problem — a public license submitted to OSI must be clear enough for standalone interpretation, otherwise compliance is uncertain. Endorses Richard's suggestion to rewrite.
timeline.point_zh: 同意歧义是主要问题——提交给 OSI 的公共许可证必须足够清晰以进行独立解读，否则合规性不确定。支持 Richard 重写的建议。
timeline.point: Agrees that the ambiguity is the main problem — a public license submitted to OSI must be clear enough for standalone interpretation, otherwise compliance is uncertain. Endorses Richard's suggestion to rewrite.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Considers it reasonable to ask submitters about legal review during discussion, but opposes making it a required piece of information as it approaches mandating lawyer consultation.
timeline.point_zh: 认为在讨论中询问提交者法律审查情况是合理的，但反对将其作为提交的必需信息，因为这接近于强制要求律师咨询。
timeline.point: Considers it reasonable to ask submitters about legal review during discussion, but opposes making it a required piece of information as it approaches mandating lawyer consultation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Suggests broadening the question to "lawyer or expert" and proposes a standard form question asking what expertise was used in drafting the license.
timeline.point_zh: 建议将问题扩展为「律师或专家」，并提出标准表单问题，询问起草许可证时使用了什么专业知识。
timeline.point: Suggests broadening the question to "lawyer or expert" and proposes a standard form question asking what expertise was used in drafting the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI cannot provide license-drafting advice through license-review: it would require one-on-one volunteer work, there are conflicts of interest, and drafting advice could be misconstrued as pre-approval.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSI 无法通过 license-review 提供起草建议：需要志愿者一对一服务，存在利益冲突，且起草建议可能被误解为预先批准。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI cannot provide license-drafting advice through license-review: it would require one-on-one volunteer work, there are conflicts of interest, and drafting advice could be misconstrued as pre-approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for formatting issues and mail problems, then reports removing the problematic sections (5, 6, 11, 12, 13) and revising section 7 with a new license link.
timeline.point_zh: 为格式和邮件问题道歉，报告已移除有问题的条款（第5、6、11、12、13条）并修改第7条，附上新许可证链接。
timeline.point: Apologizes for formatting issues and mail problems, then reports removing the problematic sections (5, 6, 11, 12, 13) and revising section 7 with a new license link.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Reports removing and updating sections, apologizes for duplicate messages caused by accidentally providing a wrong link, and provides the correct link.
timeline.point_zh: 报告已移除和更新部分条款，为因错误链接导致的重复消息道歉，并提供正确链接。
timeline.point: Reports removing and updating sections, apologizes for duplicate messages caused by accidentally providing a wrong link, and provides the correct link.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Argues the submitter has not demonstrated needs unmet by existing licenses, suggests using LGPL instead, and emphasizes that custom licenses are adoption barriers. Notes that real licenses require professional drafting expertise that OSI cannot provide.
timeline.point_zh: 认为提交者未证明现有许可证无法满足其需求，建议改用 LGPL，并强调自定义许可证会阻碍采用。指出真正的许可证需要 OSI 无法提供的专业起草能力。
timeline.point: Argues the submitter has not demonstrated needs unmet by existing licenses, suggests using LGPL instead, and emphasizes that custom licenses are adoption barriers. Notes that real licenses require professional drafting expertise that OSI cannot provide.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Counters that the GPL requires linking to source code (which his license avoids), and states his goal is to create a license that is shorter and less complex than existing ones.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称 GPL 要求链接到源代码（他的许可证避免了这一点），并表示其目标是创建比现有许可证更简短、更简单的许可证。
timeline.point: Counters that the GPL requires linking to source code (which his license avoids), and states his goal is to create a license that is shorter and less complex than existing ones.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Argues that the proposed license is misguided and unnecessary, noting existing licenses like GPL and MPL already address source code redistribution, and that simple copyleft licenses are inherently defective.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该许可证提案存在严重问题且不必要，指出 GPL 和 MPL 等现有许可证已涵盖源代码再分发要求，且简洁的 copyleft 许可证必然存在严重缺陷。
timeline.point: Argues that the proposed license is misguided and unnecessary, noting existing licenses like GPL and MPL already address source code redistribution, and that simple copyleft licenses are inherently defective.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Defends the link-to-original requirement as protecting against unauthorized claiming of unmodified versions, and clarifies that the copyleft clause is narrowly scoped to modified redistributions only.
timeline.point_zh: 为链接到原始版本的要求辩护，认为其可防止他人将未修改版本据为己有，并澄清 copyleft 条款仅限于修改后的再分发。
timeline.point: Defends the link-to-original requirement as protecting against unauthorized claiming of unmodified versions, and clarifies that the copyleft clause is narrowly scoped to modified redistributions only.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Posts a link to the updated draft of the license for review.
timeline.point_zh: 发布了更新后的许可证草案链接供审查。
timeline.point: Posts a link to the updated draft of the license for review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Strongly criticizes the link-to-original requirement as contrary to open source principles, citing the XEmacs fork as evidence, and warns that ignoring community feedback will likely prevent OSD compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈批评链接到原始版本的要求违背开源原则，以 XEmacs 分支为例说明，并警告无视社区反馈很可能导致无法通过 OSD 审核。
timeline.point: Strongly criticizes the link-to-original requirement as contrary to open source principles, citing the XEmacs fork as evidence, and warns that ignoring community feedback will likely prevent OSD compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Requests that the license proposer include the full formatted license text in emails and annotate changes from previous versions, rather than posting only a link.
timeline.point_zh: 要求许可证提案者在邮件中附上完整格式化的许可证全文，并标注与上一版本的变更内容及变更原因，而非仅发布链接。
timeline.point: Requests that the license proposer include the full formatted license text in emails and annotate changes from previous versions, rather than posting only a link.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Points out the lack of revision tracking makes discussion difficult, criticizes the premature use of the 'Open Source' title, and recommends using an existing standard license instead.
timeline.point_zh: 指出缺少版本追踪使讨论变得困难，批评在未经 OSI 审核前就使用「开源」标题，并建议直接使用现有的标准许可证。
timeline.point: Points out the lack of revision tracking makes discussion difficult, criticizes the premature use of the 'Open Source' title, and recommends using an existing standard license instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the title is just a draft label, agrees to add sub-version numbers, and concedes to replacing the link-to-original requirement with a simple copyright notice.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清标题仅为草案标签，同意添加子版本号，并接受将链接到原始版本的要求替换为简单的版权声明。
timeline.point: Clarifies the title is just a draft label, agrees to add sub-version numbers, and concedes to replacing the link-to-original requirement with a simple copyright notice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License submission for approval for Moritz30-Projects Open Source License Version 1
timeline.snippet: Announces an updated draft that adds a sub-version number, removes the 'original' definition, and replaces the linking requirement with a simple copyright notice, noting the license is now very permissive except that modifications must remain open source.
timeline.point_zh: 发布更新后的草案，添加子版本号、移除「original」定义、将链接要求替换为版权声明，并指出许可证现在非常宽松，唯一要求是修改版本也必须开源。
timeline.point: Announces an updated draft that adds a sub-version number, removes the 'original' definition, and replaces the linking requirement with a simple copyright notice, noting the license is now very permissive except that modifications must remain open source.

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license attempted to enforce a 'non-coercive' philosophy that was seen as potentially violating OSD #6 (No Discrimination Against Fields of Endeavor).

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft	Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0 for OSI review, intended as a CC-0-SA hybrid that renounces creator enforcement rights while requiring derivative works to be similarly licensed.
timeline.point_zh: 提交非强制性 Copyleft 许可证（NCCL）1.0 申请 OSI 审查，旨在成为 CC-0-SA 混合体，在放弃创作者执法权利的同时要求衍生作品采用相同许可证。
timeline.point: Submits the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0 for OSI review, intended as a CC-0-SA hybrid that renounces creator enforcement rights while requiring derivative works to be similarly licensed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Recommends allowing derived works to also be licensed under GPL v3 to avoid creating a sealed-off software commons, noting this is his standard recommendation for new copyleft licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 建议允许衍生作品也可选择 GPL v3 许可证以避免创建封闭的软件公共资源池，并指出这是他对所有新 copyleft 许可证的标准建议。
timeline.point: Recommends allowing derived works to also be licensed under GPL v3 to avoid creating a sealed-off software commons, noting this is his standard recommendation for new copyleft licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the license is practical for open source use given its implication of a single copyright holder through the use of "I", and asks how "I" would be interpreted when distributing derived works.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑该许可证使用"我"暗示单一版权所有者是否适用于开源用途，询问分发衍生作品时"我"应如何解释。
timeline.point: Questions whether the license is practical for open source use given its implication of a single copyright holder through the use of "I", and asks how "I" would be interpreted when distributing derived works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether mandatory dual-licensing with GPL v3 would be fundamentally different from voluntary dual-licensing, and notes the downside of losing the option to ensure nobody can be sued for using derivative works.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑强制双重许可 GPL v3 与自愿双重许可是否有本质区别，并指出这样做的缺点是失去确保无人因使用衍生作品而被起诉的选项。
timeline.point: Questions whether mandatory dual-licensing with GPL v3 would be fundamentally different from voluntary dual-licensing, and notes the downside of losing the option to ensure nobody can be sued for using derivative works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Notes that the use of "I" is inherited from the OSI-approved SimPL 2.0 and asks whether "we" would be less problematic for a single author, expressing willingness to change the wording.
timeline.point_zh: 指出"我"的用法源自已获 OSI 批准的 SimPL 2.0，询问对单一作者而言"我们"是否更合适，表示愿意修改措辞。
timeline.point: Notes that the use of "I" is inherited from the OSI-approved SimPL 2.0 and asks whether "we" would be less problematic for a single author, expressing willingness to change the wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Shares his experience from copyleft-next of using "I" for the licensor, explaining that he preferred "I" over "We" because "We" would seem strange for a single individual licensor.
timeline.point_zh: 分享在 copyleft-next 中使用"我"作为许可方的经验，解释他更倾向于"我"而非"我们"，因为对单一自然人许可方来说"我们"显得奇怪。
timeline.point: Shares his experience from copyleft-next of using "I" for the licensor, explaining that he preferred "I" over "We" because "We" would seem strange for a single individual licensor.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Makes a humorous remark about using "We" being appropriate only for the Queen of England.
timeline.point_zh: 幽默地指出只有英国女王才有资格使用"我们"这个称谓。
timeline.point: Makes a humorous remark about using "We" being appropriate only for the Queen of England.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Quotes Mark Twain humorously noting that only kings, presidents, editors, and people with tapeworms have the right to use the editorial "we".
timeline.point_zh: 引用马克·吐温的幽默名言，指出只有国王、总统、编辑和患有绦虫的人才有权使用编辑性的"我们"。
timeline.point: Quotes Mark Twain humorously noting that only kings, presidents, editors, and people with tapeworms have the right to use the editorial "we".

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues in favor of automatic dual-licensing with GPL v3 to reduce friction, and notes that the NCCL does impose restrictions on derivative works so people can still be sued, suggesting CC0 for complete protection.
timeline.point_zh: 支持与 GPL v3 自动双重许可以减少摩擦，指出 NCCL 确实对衍生作品施加限制，人们仍可能被起诉，建议使用 CC0 以获得完全保护。
timeline.point: Argues in favor of automatic dual-licensing with GPL v3 to reduce friction, and notes that the NCCL does impose restrictions on derivative works so people can still be sued, suggesting CC0 for complete protection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks for an example of how someone could be sued under the NCCL, explaining the intention is that the only restriction is that derivative works are similarly licensed, and noting that CC0-licensed derivative works with restrictive licenses can lead to lawsuits.
timeline.point_zh: 要求提供在 NCCL 下可能被起诉的示例，解释其意图是唯一限制是衍生作品须采用相同许可证，并指出 CC0 许可的衍生作品若采用限制性许可证也可能导致诉讼。
timeline.point: Asks for an example of how someone could be sued under the NCCL, explaining the intention is that the only restriction is that derivative works are similarly licensed, and noting that CC0-licensed derivative works with restrictive licenses can lead to lawsuits.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks two key questions: how can the license be enforced if the right to sue is excluded, and what real need does the license serve that would make a developer prefer it over existing options.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两个关键问题：如果起诉权被排除，许可证如何执行？以及该许可证满足什么实际需求，使开发者倾向于选择它而非现有选项？
timeline.point: Asks two key questions: how can the license be enforced if the right to sue is excluded, and what real need does the license serve that would make a developer prefer it over existing options.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that breach of the NCCL license terms constitutes copyright violation, meaning the infringer loses the right to copy, modify, or distribute the code.
timeline.point_zh: 解释违反 NCCL 许可证条款构成版权侵权，侵权者将失去复制、修改或分发代码的权利。
timeline.point: Explains that breach of the NCCL license terms constitutes copyright violation, meaning the infringer loses the right to copy, modify, or distribute the code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Explains the NCCL aims to be the most permissive edge of copyleft licenses, where the right to sue is excluded by the broad permissions granted, and describes use cases where developers would prefer NCCL over GPL v3 requirements or CC0 protections.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 NCCL 旨在成为 copyleft 许可证中最宽松的一端，通过广泛授权排除起诉权，并描述开发者在什么情况下会选择 NCCL 而非 GPL v3 要求或 CC0 保护。
timeline.point: Explains the NCCL aims to be the most permissive edge of copyleft licenses, where the right to sue is excluded by the broad permissions granted, and describes use cases where developers would prefer NCCL over GPL v3 requirements or CC0 protections.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks what specific sequence of actions would constitute a breach of the NCCL license terms.
timeline.point_zh: 询问什么样的具体行为序列会构成违反 NCCL 许可证条款。
timeline.point: Asks what specific sequence of actions would constitute a breach of the NCCL license terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks for the link to the NCCL license draft text, having lost track of it.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己找不到 NCCL 许可证草案文本的链接，请求重新提供。
timeline.point: Asks for the link to the NCCL license draft text, having lost track of it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes the NCCL, calling it a licensing "landmine" that encourages surprise lawsuits by allowing code distribution without the license attached, describes a scenario where innocent downstream users could be sued, and votes -1 on approval.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对 NCCL，称其为许可证"地雷"，允许代码在不附带许可证的情况下分发会导致意外诉讼，描述了无辜下游用户可能被起诉的场景，并投票反对批准。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes the NCCL, calling it a licensing "landmine" that encourages surprise lawsuits by allowing code distribution without the license attached, describes a scenario where innocent downstream users could be sued, and votes -1 on approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Provides the link to the NCCL draft license text being discussed on the mailing list.
timeline.point_zh: 提供正在讨论的 NCCL 许可证草案文本的邮件列表链接。
timeline.point: Provides the link to the NCCL draft license text being discussed on the mailing list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Counters the lawsuit scenario by noting copyright-naive behavior is not unique to NCCL, argues the practical risk of deliberately removing license references is minimal, and draws an analogy to GPL rarely being used to charge fees.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳诉讼场景，指出版权无知行为并非 NCCL 独有，认为故意删除许可证引用的实际风险极小，并类比 GPL 很少被用于收取费用。
timeline.point: Counters the lawsuit scenario by noting copyright-naive behavior is not unique to NCCL, argues the practical risk of deliberately removing license references is minimal, and draws an analogy to GPL rarely being used to charge fees.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes the NCCL as the first license to encourage distributing code without the license attached, calls it a licensing entrapment, argues it fails to protect users, and provides a detailed scenario showing how innocent developers could unknowingly violate the license.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对 NCCL，称其是首个鼓励不附带许可证分发代码的许可证，认为这是许可证陷阱，未能保护用户，并详细描述了无辜开发者可能在不知情情况下违反许可证的场景。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes the NCCL as the first license to encourage distributing code without the license attached, calls it a licensing entrapment, argues it fails to protect users, and provides a detailed scenario showing how innocent developers could unknowingly violate the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive	Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Notes that some courts will not enforce a license that has not been seen and approved by the licensee, and that many licensors require an explicit acceptance click before download.
timeline.point_zh: 指出某些法院不会执行未经被许可方查看和批准的许可证，许多严肃的许可方要求在下载前点击"我接受许可证"。
timeline.point: Notes that some courts will not enforce a license that has not been seen and approved by the licensee, and that many licensors require an explicit acceptance click before download.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Defends the NCCL against criticism, arguing it merely allows but does not encourage distributing without the license, questions Josh's boycott position, and argues that the license violation scenarios described are no different from those possible with GPL-licensed code.
timeline.point_zh: 为 NCCL 辩护，认为它只是允许而非鼓励不附带许可证分发，质疑 Josh 的抵制立场，并认为所描述的许可证违规场景与 GPL 许可代码可能出现的情况没有本质区别。
timeline.point: Defends the NCCL against criticism, arguing it merely allows but does not encourage distributing without the license, questions Josh's boycott position, and argues that the license violation scenarios described are no different from those possible with GPL-licensed code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Rejects the concept of a CC0-equivalent copyleft license as a fundamental contradiction, arguing that copyleft conditions require complex legal text and cannot coexist with simplicity, and that the NCCL fails to ensure access to modified source code.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CC0 等效 copyleft 许可证是根本矛盾，论证 copyleft 条件需要复杂的法律文本，无法与简洁性共存，并且 NCCL 未能确保修改后源代码的可获取性。
timeline.point: Rejects the concept of a CC0-equivalent copyleft license as a fundamental contradiction, arguing that copyleft conditions require complex legal text and cannot coexist with simplicity, and that the NCCL fails to ensure access to modified source code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the NCCL would be useless to both permissive and copyleft communities, as the BSD crowd would not use copyleft code and it creates an isolated island if not GPL-compatible.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 NCCL 对宽松许可和 copyleft 两个阵营都无用，因为 BSD 群体不会使用 copyleft 代码，且若不与 GPL 兼容则会形成孤立的孤岛。
timeline.point: Argues the NCCL would be useless to both permissive and copyleft communities, as the BSD crowd would not use copyleft code and it creates an isolated island if not GPL-compatible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Formally challenges the submitter to prove the license is open source, necessary, and well-written, demanding evidence of real need, explanation of why existing licenses are inadequate, and legal backing for the license's innovations.
timeline.point_zh: 正式要求提交者证明该许可证是开源的、必要的且编写良好的，要求提供实际需求的证据、解释为何现有许可证不够充分，以及该许可证创新点的法律支持。
timeline.point: Formally challenges the submitter to prove the license is open source, necessary, and well-written, demanding evidence of real need, explanation of why existing licenses are inadequate, and legal backing for the license's innovations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on what courts would actually do when a license hasn't been seen or approved, questioning whether the software would be treated as CC0-licensed, all-rights-reserved, or subject to an implied license.
timeline.point_zh: 要求澄清法院在许可证未被查看或批准时会如何处理，质疑软件会被视为 CC0 许可、完全保留权利，还是适用默示许可。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on what courts would actually do when a license hasn't been seen or approved, questioning whether the software would be treated as CC0-licensed, all-rights-reserved, or subject to an implied license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that the NCCL's simplicity lies in having only one requirement (the copyleft condition), defends against claims of naivety by citing the SimPL's legal pedigree, and presents an economic argument that market forces will ensure source code availability even without explicit publication requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 论证 NCCL 的简洁性在于仅有一个要求（copyleft 条件），引用 SimPL 的法律背景反驳天真的指控，并从经济学角度论证市场力量将确保源代码即使没有明确的发布要求也会被公开。
timeline.point: Argues that the NCCL's simplicity lies in having only one requirement (the copyleft condition), defends against claims of naivety by citing the SimPL's legal pedigree, and presents an economic argument that market forces will ensure source code availability even without explicit publication requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Delivers a comprehensive critique arguing the NCCL is not a workable copyleft license because it lacks the essential requirement of mandating source code publication, conflates economic strategy with legal obligations, and is based on flawed reasoning that would undermine any meaningful copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 进行全面批判，认为 NCCL 不是一个可行的 copyleft 许可证，因为它缺乏强制发布源代码的基本要求，混淆了经济策略与法律义务，其推理存在缺陷，将破坏任何有意义的 copyleft。
timeline.point: Delivers a comprehensive critique arguing the NCCL is not a workable copyleft license because it lacks the essential requirement of mandating source code publication, conflates economic strategy with legal obligations, and is based on flawed reasoning that would undermine any meaningful copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Declares that the NCCL should be rejected, noting that four people have opposed it, two have questioned its provisions, and nobody has spoken in favor of it on the committee.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布 NCCL 应被拒绝，指出四人反对、两人质疑其条款，委员会中无人表示支持。
timeline.point: Declares that the NCCL should be rejected, noting that four people have opposed it, two have questioned its provisions, and nobody has spoken in favor of it on the committee.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Protests that the 30-day review period had not elapsed and expresses intent to provide the detailed response requested, indicating the rejection was premature.
timeline.point_zh: 抗议 30 天审查期尚未结束，表示有意提供所要求的详细回应，认为拒绝决定过于仓促。
timeline.point: Protests that the 30-day review period had not elapsed and expresses intent to provide the detailed response requested, indicating the rejection was premature.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that most submitters prefer faster answers and that the 30-day minimum is not guaranteed. Defers to the Chair's authority on whether to pass the license to the board.
timeline.point_zh: 主张大多数提交者更希望尽快得到答复，30 天并非保证的最短时间。将是否将许可证提交董事会的决定权交给主席。
timeline.point: Argues that most submitters prefer faster answers and that the 30-day minimum is not guaranteed. Defers to the Chair's authority on whether to pass the license to the board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Intends to add his assessment of the NCCL 1.0 since the review process is still pending. Mentions conflicting aims.
timeline.point_zh: 打算对 NCCL 1.0 补充自己的评估意见，因为审查流程仍在进行中。提到目标相互矛盾。
timeline.point: Intends to add his assessment of the NCCL 1.0 since the review process is still pending. Mentions conflicting aims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Defends the NCCL by arguing it addresses a different need from existing licenses -- minimizing coercion rather than duplicating existing terms. Provides a detailed legal analysis under the Berne Convention and New Zealand copyright law to show that removing license notices does not invalidate copyright enforcement. Responds to multiple critics point by point.
timeline.point_zh: 为 NCCL 辩护，主张它满足的是不同于现有许可证的需求——尽量减少法律强制力。详细引用伯尔尼公约和新西兰版权法，论证移除许可证通知不会影响版权强制执行。逐点回应多位批评者。
timeline.point: Defends the NCCL by arguing it addresses a different need from existing licenses -- minimizing coercion rather than duplicating existing terms. Provides a detailed legal analysis under the Berne Convention and New Zealand copyright law to show that removing license notices does not invalidate copyright enforcement. Responds to multiple critics point by point.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Systematically addresses each OSD criterion to argue the NCCL is compliant. Explains how copyleft can ensure source code availability without directly requiring it, drawing parallels to the GPL's effect on free distribution. Questions whether GPL violations actually disprove the NCCL's approach.
timeline.point_zh: 逐一回应 OSD 各条标准，论证 NCCL 符合开源定义。解释 copyleft 如何无需直接要求就能间接确保源代码可用性，类比 GPL 对免费分发的效果。质疑 GPL 违规案例是否真的能反驳 NCCL 的方法。
timeline.point: Systematically addresses each OSD criterion to argue the NCCL is compliant. Explains how copyleft can ensure source code availability without directly requiring it, drawing parallels to the GPL's effect on free distribution. Questions whether GPL violations actually disprove the NCCL's approach.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Dismisses the NCCL as "aspirational copyleft" that is no better than BSD once copyleft is removed. Asks the submitter to stop wasting the committee's time and excuses himself from the discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 NCCL 只是"理想化的 copyleft"，去掉 copyleft 后不比 BSD 更好。要求提交者不要浪费委员会时间，自己退出讨论。
timeline.point: Dismisses the NCCL as "aspirational copyleft" that is no better than BSD once copyleft is removed. Asks the submitter to stop wasting the committee's time and excuses himself from the discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges criticism of the NCCL's warranty disclaimer and other textual issues. Concedes the license text needs substantial revision and agrees to withdraw the approval request temporarily. Invites others who share his intention to write a better implementation.
timeline.point_zh: 承认批评者关于 NCCL 免责声明等问题的意见有道理。同意许可证文本需要大幅修改，暂时撤回审批请求。邀请其他理解其意图的人来写出更好的实现。
timeline.point: Acknowledges criticism of the NCCL's warranty disclaimer and other textual issues. Concedes the license text needs substantial revision and agrees to withdraw the approval request temporarily. Invites others who share his intention to write a better implementation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Points out the unhealthy discussion pattern where the submitter replies to almost every message. Suggests the submitter should read and reflect on feedback rather than responding to every email. Notes this pattern discouraged him from joining the thread.
timeline.point_zh: 指出讨论中不健康的模式——提交者回复了几乎所有邮件。建议提交者应该阅读和思考反馈，而不是逐条回复。表示这种模式让他不愿加入讨论。
timeline.point: Points out the unhealthy discussion pattern where the submitter replies to almost every message. Suggests the submitter should read and reflect on feedback rather than responding to every email. Notes this pattern discouraged him from joining the thread.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Paul's observation about repetitive replies. Supports moving license-review to a different format to avoid duplicative discussions.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Paul 关于重复回复的观察。支持将 license-review 迁移到新的讨论格式，以避免重复性回复。
timeline.point: Agrees with Paul's observation about repetitive replies. Supports moving license-review to a different format to avoid duplicative discussions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval of the Non-Coercive Copyleft Licence (NCCL) 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that a copyleft license cannot be non-coercive by the submitter's definition, because copyleft inherently requires enforcement of conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 copyleft 许可证按提交者的定义不可能是非强制性的，因为 copyleft 本质上需要强制执行条件。
timeline.point: Argues that a copyleft license cannot be non-coercive by the submitter's definition, because copyleft inherently requires enforcement of conditions.

license_texts.title: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
license_texts.message_subject: [License-discuss] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
license_texts.text:
Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
    :: see for the attachement

Link to previous public discussions:
   http://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=+728716
 
http://projects.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review/2013-November/000679.html

    Please heed that potential discussion about OSD or OSS compliance 
should refer to the new license and not point to elder discussion. The 
license has been reworked now two times towards practical issues, 
consistency and OSD compliance.

At least the following programs are currently at stake to be licensed 
under S-FSL:
    http://www.elstel.org/xchroot
    http://www.elstel.org/qemu: confinedrv
    http://www.elstel.org/bundsteg
    http://www.elstel.org/coan/

The following improvements towards v1.3.5 have been incorporated into 
v1.3.6:

* explicit handling of compiled works :: 'automatic derivation process'
* defining where to find  or how to create the necessary changelogs
* the possibility to branch any time you want (more competition, desert 
island test)
* more precise rules for branches
* better naming scheme: suffixing only once (no *-deb-3-ub-7 but only 
*-ub-7)
* explicitly allows shipment of derived works as opposed to original+patches
* rules for usage of patents and trademarks
* paragraphs are numbered


Motivation for a new license:

S-FSL v1.3.x: Motivation for a new license / a revised version of it

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to 
the authors such as concerning their web presence. It should also 
protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another 
site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to 
draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with 
OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the 
primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial 
software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to 
intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software 
not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating 
your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem 
to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source 
or by just in time compilation). The license should still be compatible 
with compiled.

3. Note that S-FSL requires some minimal provisions by the distributor 
regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a 
free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates 
including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone 
who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, 
secure checksums to verify the downloads. Things quite common in the 
open source sector but not with some proprietary systems: Downloaders of 
Windows can not verify their downloads with publicly trusted tools; in 
order to update OS/2 Warp 4 some 'mean tricks' i.e. insider knowledge 
was necessary before I have published that on my personal blog at 
elstel.org.

4. The license has especially been designed for people who want to 
release their shareware under an OSS-compliant version for the first 
time experimenting to get input from a broader public community. As the 
original authors retain full property rights of their software even 
after incorporating patches (compare it in this point with the SRC M3 
license) they may re-publish it under a different license like BSD or 
GPL at any time. It has been designed for the original authors to retain 
a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those 
who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

5. By granting a group of developers to work on a new 'branch' other 
people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an 
affiliated project.

6. The license should be compatible with the usage of patents and 
trademarks without unloading that burden to the end user.

7. The license should set a framework to facilitate contributions.

8. Distribution of programs under S-FSL should be facilitated and 
encouraged.

Note that there seems to be no other license which would even 
rudimentarily fulfill these requirements.


Many Thanks for Your Input and Contribution,

Yours Sincerely,
Elmar Stellnberger

site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to 
draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with

intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software

elstel.org.

time experimenting to get input from a broader public community. As the 
original authors retain full property rights of their software even 
after incorporating patches (compare it in this point with the SRC M3

a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those 
who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an 
affiliated project.

trademarks without unloading that burden to the end user.

encouraged.

rudimentarily fulfill these requirements.

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to 
the authors such as concerning their web presence. It should also 
protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another 
site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to 
draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with 
OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the 
primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial 
software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to 
intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software 
not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating 
your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem 
to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source 
or by just in time compilation). The license should still be compatible 
with compiled.

regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a 
free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates 
including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone 
who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, 
secure checksums to verify the downloads. Things quite common in the 
open source sector but not with some proprietary systems: Downloaders of 
Windows can not verify their downloads with publicly trusted tools; in 
order to update OS/2 Warp 4 some 'mean tricks' i.e. insider knowledge 
was necessary before I have published that on my personal blog at 
elstel.org.

release their shareware under an OSS-compliant version for the first

affiliated project.
