timeline.point_zh: 主张 S-FSL 处理开源中的责任和质量问题，并称维护者可在需要时转移责任或重新许可。
timeline.point: Argues that S-FSL addresses responsibility and quality problems in OSS and that maintainers can transfer responsibility or relicense when needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Explains S-FSL patent handling and says the desired license should combine GPL-like protection for scripts with BSD-like relicensing for original authors.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 S-FSL 的专利处理方式，并称目标许可证应兼具 GPL 对脚本的保护和 BSD 式原作者再许可能力。
timeline.point: Explains S-FSL patent handling and says the desired license should combine GPL-like protection for scripts with BSD-like relicensing for original authors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Answers that sending patches need not mean email, asks critics to read the license, and refers to another message for the private-use objection.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称发送补丁不必是电子邮件，要求批评者阅读许可证，并就私人使用异议指向另一封邮件。
timeline.point: Answers that sending patches need not mean email, asks critics to read the license, and refers to another message for the private-use objection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Argues that S-FSL confuses copyright, trademarks, and patents, and that its patent approach intentionally exposes recipients to lawsuits, making it non-open-source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 S-FSL 混淆版权、商标和专利，并认为其专利方案故意让接收者面临诉讼，因此不是开源许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that S-FSL confuses copyright, trademarks, and patents, and that its patent approach intentionally exposes recipients to lawsuits, making it non-open-source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Counters that APIs and other unprotectable elements do not automatically make dependent programs derivative works of a library.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 API 等不受版权保护的元素不会自动使依赖程序成为库的衍生作品。
timeline.point: Counters that APIs and other unprotectable elements do not automatically make dependent programs derivative works of a library.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Responds that S-FSL is meant to support contributive open-source development, not merely trademark control, and notes trademarks may belong to contributors.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称 S-FSL 旨在支持贡献式开源开发，而不只是商标控制，并指出商标也可能属于贡献者。
timeline.point: Responds that S-FSL is meant to support contributive open-source development, not merely trademark control, and notes trademarks may belong to contributors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL patent terms, arguing GPL and BSD also do not protect users from patent lawsuits and that S-FSL allows continued use in the same context.
timeline.point_zh: 为 S-FSL 的专利条款辩护，称 GPL 和 BSD 也不能保护用户免受专利诉讼，并称 S-FSL 允许在相同上下文中继续使用。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL patent terms, arguing GPL and BSD also do not protect users from patent lawsuits and that S-FSL allows continued use in the same context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Accepts the point that interfaces are not protected by copyright law.
timeline.point_zh: 认可接口不受版权法保护这一观点。
timeline.point: Accepts the point that interfaces are not protected by copyright law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that API copyrightability is nuanced in U.S. law and points to leading U.S. and EU cases on interfaces and interoperability.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 API 的版权保护在美国法下较复杂，并指向关于接口和互操作性的美国与欧盟重要案例。
timeline.point: Clarifies that API copyrightability is nuanced in U.S. law and points to leading U.S. and EU cases on interfaces and interoperability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Warns that continuing the discussion may mislead the submitter into thinking S-FSL has a real chance of approval.
timeline.point_zh: 警告继续讨论可能误导提交者，以为 S-FSL 真有获批机会。
timeline.point: Warns that continuing the discussion may mislead the submitter into thinking S-FSL has a real chance of approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL against OSD objections, arguing that patch-sending duties, original-author rights, branching, and relicensing do not violate the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 针对 OSD 异议为 S-FSL 辩护，主张补丁发送义务、原作者权利、分支和再许可并不违反 OSD。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL against OSD objections, arguing that patch-sending duties, original-author rights, branching, and relicensing do not violate the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Argues that giving original authors additional responsibility and rights is not unfair discrimination under OSD sections 5 or 6.
timeline.point_zh: 主张赋予原作者额外责任和权利并非 OSD 第 5 或第 6 条所禁止的不公平歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that giving original authors additional responsibility and rights is not unfair discrimination under OSD sections 5 or 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Argues that S-FSL clearly does not fit OSI approval, that its goals are contrary to open source, and recommends using an existing OSS license.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 S-FSL 显然不适合 OSI 批准，其目标违背开源，并建议使用现有开源许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that S-FSL clearly does not fit OSI approval, that its goals are contrary to open source, and recommends using an existing OSS license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the criticism as not justified by the OSD and argues that BSD-style licensing is unfairly exploitable compared with an S-FSL-like model.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称相关批评无法由 OSD 支撑，并主张相比类似 S-FSL 的模式，BSD 式许可容易被不公平利用。
timeline.point: Rejects the criticism as not justified by the OSD and argues that BSD-style licensing is unfairly exploitable compared with an S-FSL-like model.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Suggests starting with an S-FSL-like license and later transferring rights to a democratic association acting for the community.
timeline.point_zh: 建议先采用类似 S-FSL 的许可证，待形成社区后将权利转移给代表社区的民主协会。
timeline.point: Suggests starting with an S-FSL-like license and later transferring rights to a democratic association acting for the community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: States that the BSD community has a serious flaw because it is not self-sustainable.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 BSD 社区有严重缺陷，因为它不可自我持续。
timeline.point: States that the BSD community has a serious flaw because it is not self-sustainable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the premise that permissive projects need coercive licensing, citing Apple and other corporate contributions to BSD-style projects.
timeline.point_zh: 反对宽松许可项目需要强制性许可的前提，并以 Apple 及其他企业对 BSD 式项目的贡献为例。
timeline.point: Rejects the premise that permissive projects need coercive licensing, citing Apple and other corporate contributions to BSD-style projects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Defends BSD permissiveness, rejects claims that restrictive relicensing would fund projects, and suggests selling development time or support instead.
timeline.point_zh: 为 BSD 的宽松性辩护，反对限制性再许可可资助项目的说法，并建议改为出售开发时间或支持服务。
timeline.point: Defends BSD permissiveness, rejects claims that restrictive relicensing would fund projects, and suggests selling development time or support instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.6 (S-FSL v1.3.6)
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes BSD and GPL philosophies while saying both should oppose attempts to use open source without following open-source rules.
timeline.point_zh: 区分 BSD 与 GPL 的理念，同时表示两者都应反对不遵守开源规则却想参与开源的人。
timeline.point: Distinguishes BSD and GPL philosophies while saying both should oppose attempts to use open source without following open-source rules.

license_texts.title: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
license_texts.message_subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
license_texts.text:
S-FSL v1.3.x: Motivation for a new license

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to the authors such as concerning their web presence. The primary motivation to publish some software which should now be released under S-FSL was to attract people to the authors web page so that the ability to remove any such reference would have been a pitfall to the developers and publishers. It should also protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source or by just in time compilation).

3. Note that S-FSL requires some minimal provisions by the distributor regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, secure checksums to verify the downloads. Things quite common in the open source sector but not with some proprietary systems: Downloaders of Windows can not verify their downloads with publicly trusted tools; in order to update OS/2 Warp 4 some 'mean tricks' i.e. insider knowledge was necessary before I have published that on my personal blog at elstel.org.

4. The license has especially been designed for people who want to release their shareware under an OSS-compliant version for the first time experimenting to get input from a broader public community. As the original authors retain full property rights of their software even after incorporating patches (compare it in this point with the SRC M3 license) they may re-publish it under a different license like BSD or GPL at any time. It has been designed for the original authors to retain a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

5. By granting a group of developers to work on a new 'branch' other people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an affiliated project. Free branching may be specified in addition to the license terms: "This program is licensed under S-FSL v1.3.x and may be branched for free.".

Link to a previous public discussion:
http://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=+728716
note: this was about an elder version of the license; it is now 
completely reworked
the possibility of submission was pointed out by Debian legal though the 
distributor would prefer an already known license. Unfortunately I could 
not find any such license that would at least satisfy requirement (1) as 
listed above.

Note: Acceptance to several distributions is still pending due to 
unapproved license (openSUSE, Debian);
It should not be a problem to adapt or change the license yet.

Many Thanks for Your Input and Contribution,

Yours Sincerely,
Elmar Stellnberger

Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5) as provided by elstel.org/license

  This program may be used free of charge. It has been designed as research work and comes without claim for fitness to any particular usage purpose and completely without warranty or any kind of liability such as lost revenues, profits, harm or damage of any kind.
  The program may be distributed by a third party given that the program is distributed in its original state completely without any kind of modifications or patches. If you need to re-distribute a patched version of this program you need to distribute the patches separately from the original so that the pristine version can be restored at any time. Any derived work must carry the name of the distributor, vendor or the product in its name (or a unique shorthand for it) preceded by the original unchanged name of the software and its version at the beginning. Modifications applied to this program may not affect the name, original version, copyright, license or any reference given to the authors such as their email addresses or their web presence and/or page in any part of the program or any files attached to the program apart from updates to these references made by the respective authors themselves. You as a distributor need to let your contributors add their names, their email and modifications with date to the changelog. You must not charge for the programs under S-FSL themselves but you may require a reasonable charge for the physical reproduction of the data.
  You may only extend or modify this program given that you do also consent with the following terms. As far as you are not a public distributor you are obliged to send a copy of your patches to the original authors referred to herein as the authors of the first version of the program as being listed in the changelog or program header whenever you publish or exchange your patches with other people. If you have some work in progress you are obliged to send out bundled patches once at least every month. This is to assert the availability and recognition of patches at least by the original authors; a condition which must be held even if you agree not to actively 'send' or 'forward' your patches.
  By distributing patches you do also consent that the original authors may incorporate your patches into future versions of this program. The patched parts of the program and the patches themselves will also become subject to this licensing and may even be used for free in other programs or in the same program under different licensing as soon as you choose to publish any kind of patch; i.e. you need to be ready to share your full intellectual property rights with the original authors whenever you choose to exchange, distribute or publish any kind of patch to this program. Sharing your intellectual property means that both parties - you and the original authors - obtain the full set of rights about your modifications which were initially only associated with you. The original authors will have to resolve whether to incorporate your patches or not into future versions. Any contributor has the right to be listed with full name, patching date and email address in the changelog of this program. 
  If you want to develop a separate branch of this program the original authors need to consent as long as the software may be subject to further development by them; if not that should be indicated by them denominating either new copyright holders with the same right as the original authors or by publishing under a different license. Developing a separate branch means not to use the naming convention proposed in the second paragraph which allows you to add anything at the end of the name-upstreamversion-yourtag identifier. Universal consent to 'free' i.e. any branching may be specified additionally at any time by the distributed application. A new branch will also be under S-FSL of at least the same version and have the same rights as the original concerning the incorporation and management of patches giving the original issuers of the branch equivalent rights as the original authors for the scope of their branch. Branched versions do however need to forward and share patches including the property rights on patches with their parent branch. Branched versions can not re-publish under a different license or use patches as their own intellectual property unless explicit consent from the maintainers of the parent branch is given.
  The term distribution describes shipping an aggregate of software, its documentation and adherent materials. Any distribution which wants to assimilate software under S-FSL needs to take the following minimal provisions: It must be possible to verify the download securely by a publicly available tool and a checksum which is exposed to the broad public. Additional keys may be provided in any kind of way. Security updates and updates against broken functionality must also be available to the public rather than just to a paying customer stock as long as they pertain to software that can either be downloaded or compiled from sources by the public and which pertain to the distribution. Note that updates do not include upgrades to future upstream versions of a program. Available to the public implies here available free of charge apart from connectivity to the internet or a reasonable charge for the reproduction of the data medium and does also pertain to the terms 'public distribution' and 'public distributor'. 
  Public distributions have the advantage of not having to ship patches proactively to the original authors or copyright holders. This does not prevent the same software including its adherent materials to be additionally available at cost or privately somewhere else as long as public availability remains guaranteed at a reasonable level (f.i. download of the free parts of the distribution within some days.). A public distribution may any time also ship with adherent materials at cost such as documentation, support or additional software as long as it remains available to the public free of charge also without these adherent materials. However there must not be any undue hindrance in obtaining the distribution requiring special knowledge not known by users technically experienced in the field of the public software shipped with the distribution.
  Software under S-FSL that should either be used as or in a component, plug-in or add-on of 'non public' or so called 'additional' software or whenever software under S-FSL is required to run such 'non public' or 'additional' software then S-FSL imposes the restriction that the additional or non public software must also either be made available under an OSS-compliant license and free of charge or that you will need to pay for the software under S-FSL being incorporated. A license may be deemed OSS-compliant if it has been accepted by opensource.org.
  If any of the terms stated in this license were not in accordance with local law all other parts of this license should remain valid. If any of the terms about sharing patches should be deemed invalid modifying the software and sharing patches shall no more be granted from the time of the realization of the decision of the court on in the given country or region; already shared and incorporated patches are still subject to the given terms and conditions as far as deemed valid; the license needs to be re-issued then in order to allow further modifications and sharing of patches again.

license_texts.text:
S-FSL v1.3.x: Motivation for a new license

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to the authors such as concerning their web presence. The primary motivation to publish some software which should now be released under S-FSL was to attract people to the authors web page so that the ability to remove any such reference would have been a pitfall to the developers and publishers. It should also protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source or by just in time compilation).

3. Note that S-FSL requires some minimal provisions by the distributor regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, secure checksums to verify the downloads. Things quite common in the open source sector but not with some proprietary systems: Downloaders of Windows can not verify their downloads with publicly trusted tools; in order to update OS/2 Warp 4 some 'mean tricks' i.e. insider knowledge was necessary before I have published that on my personal blog at elstel.org.

4. The license has especially been designed for people who want to release their shareware under an OSS-compliant version for the first time experimenting to get input from a broader public community. As the original authors retain full property rights of their software even after incorporating patches (compare it in this point with the SRC M3 license) they may re-publish it under a different license like BSD or GPL at any time. It has been designed for the original authors to retain a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

5. By granting a group of developers to work on a new 'branch' other people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an affiliated project. Free branching may be specified in addition to the license terms: "This program is licensed under S-FSL v1.3.x and may be branched for free.".

Link to a previous public discussion:
http://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=+728716
note: this was about an elder version of the license; it is now 
completely reworked
the possibility of submission was pointed out by Debian legal though the 
distributor would prefer an already known license. Unfortunately I could 
not find any such license that would at least satisfy requirement (1) as 
listed above.

Note: Acceptance to several distributions is still pending due to 
unapproved license (openSUSE, Debian);
It should not be a problem to adapt or change the license yet.

Many Thanks for Your Input and Contribution,

Yours Sincerely,
Elmar Stellnberger

timeline.point_zh: 主张 S-FSL 的目标带有专有软件假设，并与开源自由及多项 OSD 标准冲突。
timeline.point: Argues that S-FSL’s goals rely on proprietary assumptions and conflict with open source freedoms and several OSD criteria.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL as a less permissive but still OSD-compliant model that preserves author control and encourages release.
timeline.point_zh: 为 S-FSL 辩护，称其是不那么宽松但仍符合 OSD 的模式，可保留作者控制并鼓励发布。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL as a less permissive but still OSD-compliant model that preserves author control and encourages release.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Says the submitter is using a definition of open source different from the OSD and notes several reviewers find noncompliance.
timeline.point_zh: 指出提交者使用的开源定义不同于 OSD，并称已有多名审查者认为其不符合。
timeline.point: Says the submitter is using a definition of open source different from the OSD and notes several reviewers find noncompliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL’s treatment of binaries, naming, changelogs, and patch notification while acknowledging possible wording changes.
timeline.point_zh: 为 S-FSL 对二进制、命名、变更日志和补丁通知的处理辩护，同时承认可修改措辞。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL’s treatment of binaries, naming, changelogs, and patch notification while acknowledging possible wording changes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Challenges critics to provide detailed OSD arguments rather than asserting nonconformance based on dislike.
timeline.point_zh: 要求批评者给出详细 OSD 论证，而不是因不喜欢许可证就声称其不符合。
timeline.point: Challenges critics to provide detailed OSD arguments rather than asserting nonconformance based on dislike.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies and defends S-FSL naming, attribution, changelog, fee, and patch-sharing requirements.

timeline.point: Clarifies and defends S-FSL naming, attribution, changelog, fee, and patch-sharing requirements.

timeline.snippet: Resends a defense of S-FSL’s binary, naming, changelog, and patch-notification provisions.

timeline.point: Resends a defense of S-FSL’s binary, naming, changelog, and patch-notification provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Resends clarifications defending S-FSL’s naming, attribution, changelog, fee, and patch-forwarding terms.
timeline.point_zh: 重发澄清，维护 S-FSL 的命名、署名、变更日志、收费和补丁转发条款。
timeline.point: Resends clarifications defending S-FSL’s naming, attribution, changelog, fee, and patch-forwarding terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Argues that S-FSL’s naming and control provisions are proprietary because open source must allow broad reuse without special permission.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 S-FSL 的命名和控制条款具有专有性质，因为开源必须允许在满足一般条款下广泛复用而无需特别许可。
timeline.point: Argues that S-FSL’s naming and control provisions are proprietary because open source must allow broad reuse without special permission.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL against OSD 1, 3, and 7 objections and asks for detailed criterion-specific arguments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Argues that S-FSL violates OSD freedoms by restricting binaries, patched versions, downstream terms, attribution changes, and forks.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Says the submitter bears the burden to prove S-FSL is open source, legally valid, and needed, and recommends using an existing license.

timeline.point: Says the submitter bears the burden to prove S-FSL is open source, legally valid, and needed, and recommends using an existing license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL’s author-control model, flexible changelogs, patch obligations, protected references, and treatment of patches as derived works.

timeline.point: Defends S-FSL’s author-control model, flexible changelogs, patch obligations, protected references, and treatment of patches as derived works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Considers making free branching standard while preserving S-FSL’s naming and original-author rights model.
timeline.point_zh: 考虑将自由分支设为默认，同时保留 S-FSL 的命名和原作者权利模式。
timeline.point: Considers making free branching standard while preserving S-FSL’s naming and original-author rights model.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Argues explicitly that S-FSL is non-free because it restricts patched versions, downstream terms, invariant sections, and forking.
timeline.point_zh: 明确主张 S-FSL 因限制补丁版本、下游条款、不变章节和分叉而非自由。
timeline.point: Argues explicitly that S-FSL is non-free because it restricts patched versions, downstream terms, invariant sections, and forking.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL’s practical author-control approach and says upcoming revisions will improve issues without sacrificing fitness for strict compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 维护 S-FSL 实用的作者控制做法，并称后续版本会改进问题但不为严格合规牺牲实用性。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL’s practical author-control approach and says upcoming revisions will improve issues without sacrificing fitness for strict compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: States that failure to satisfy OSD/DFSG 3 and 5 makes S-FSL unsuitable for Debian main.
timeline.point_zh: 指出若不满足 OSD/DFSG 第 3 和第 5 条，S-FSL 就不适合进入 Debian main。
timeline.point: States that failure to satisfy OSD/DFSG 3 and 5 makes S-FSL unsuitable for Debian main.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Maintains that S-FSL complies with OSD 3 and 5 because it allows derivatives and does not discriminate against groups.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为 S-FSL 符合 OSD 第 3 和第 5 条，因为它允许派生作品且不歧视群体。
timeline.point: Maintains that S-FSL complies with OSD 3 and 5 because it allows derivatives and does not discriminate against groups.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Says Debian applies the DFSG rather than OSI approval and that S-FSL remains unfit for Debian main.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 Debian 使用 DFSG 而非 OSI 认证来判断自由软件，并称 S-FSL 仍不适合 Debian main。
timeline.point: Says Debian applies the DFSG rather than OSI approval and that S-FSL remains unfit for Debian main.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Argues that open source need not mean unlimited use outside copyright law and that such a view would harm business-oriented OSS models.
timeline.point_zh: 主张开源并不意味着脱离版权法的无限使用，并认为这种理解会损害面向商业的开源模式。
timeline.point: Argues that open source need not mean unlimited use outside copyright law and that such a view would harm business-oriented OSS models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Challenges the claim that open source sits outside copyright law and explains that copyright generally does not control mere use after lawful receipt.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑开源脱离版权法的说法，并解释合法取得软件后版权通常不能控制单纯使用。
timeline.point: Challenges the claim that open source sits outside copyright law and explains that copyright generally does not control mere use after lawful receipt.

timeline.snippet: Agrees the definition should probably say "or any later version," suggests defining machine-accessible more clearly, and explains that the private-use trigger is intentional.
timeline.point_zh: 认为定义大概应写成“或任何后续版本”，建议更明确地定义 machine-accessible，并说明私人使用也触发条款是有意为之。
timeline.point: Agrees the definition should probably say "or any later version," suggests defining machine-accessible more clearly, and explains that the private-use trigger is intentional.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions why OSI approval is being sought for the new license when the software is already planned to be dual-licensed under GPLv3.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑既然软件已计划与 GPLv3 双许可，为何还要为新许可寻求 OSI 批准。
timeline.point: Questions why OSI approval is being sought for the new license when the software is already planned to be dual-licensed under GPLv3.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says a single-license approach is possible, wants to know whether the new license will be more commercially acceptable than GPL, and agrees that releasing under GPL first is a valid fallback.
timeline.point_zh: 表示可以考虑单许可方案，想知道新许可是否会比 GPL 更容易被商业接受，并同意先按 GPL 发布是一个可行的备选方案。
timeline.point: Says a single-license approach is possible, wants to know whether the new license will be more commercially acceptable than GPL, and agrees that releasing under GPL first is a valid fallback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the feedback, keeps the Tidepool name as a possible brand, and asks for wording help on the three-year data-access requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈，认为 Tidepool 名称也许可以保留作品牌，并请对方协助修正三年数据访问条款的表述。
timeline.point: Thanks for the feedback, keeps the Tidepool name as a possible brand, and asks for wording help on the three-year data-access requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the Open Definition citation should likely say "or any," wants clearer language for machine-accessibility, and says internal or private use should still expose data to patients.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Open Definition 的引用大概应改成“或任何”，希望对 machine-accessibility 的表述更清晰，并表示内部或私人使用也应让患者能拿到数据。
timeline.point: Agrees the Open Definition citation should likely say "or any," wants clearer language for machine-accessibility, and says internal or private use should still expose data to patients.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues that CSV or XML/JSON downloads should count as machine-accessible and warns that requiring more would violate OSD #10.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CSV 或 XML/JSON 下载应算作 machine-accessible，并警告若要求更多会违反 OSD 第 10 条。
timeline.point: Argues that CSV or XML/JSON downloads should count as machine-accessible and warns that requiring more would violate OSD #10.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the FAQ should not mandate a specific technology, but perhaps should only encourage better APIs and otherwise keep the license technology-neutral.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 FAQ 不应强制具体技术，但也许只需鼓励更好的 API，许可本身应保持技术中立。
timeline.point: Says the FAQ should not mandate a specific technology, but perhaps should only encourage better APIs and otherwise keep the license technology-neutral.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the wording is technology-agnostic enough and thinks changing the FAQ, rather than the license, is probably the better route.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这句话已经足够技术中立，并觉得改 FAQ 而不是改许可，大概是更好的做法。
timeline.point: Agrees the wording is technology-agnostic enough and thinks changing the FAQ, rather than the license, is probably the better route.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the main concern is the breadth of section 3(C), and argues that requiring data access even for private or internal use clashes with the traditional software-user privacy principle.
timeline.point_zh: 认为主要问题在于第 3(C) 条的范围，并指出即使是私人或内部使用也要求公开数据，会与传统的软件用户隐私原则冲突。
timeline.point: Says the main concern is the breadth of section 3(C), and argues that requiring data access even for private or internal use clashes with the traditional software-user privacy principle.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Raises research and privacy concerns, suggests a different patent clause, and questions whether the three-year retention rule and UI language are workable.
timeline.point_zh: 提出研究和隐私方面的担忧，建议改用不同的专利条款，并质疑三年保存规则和 UI 表述是否可行。
timeline.point: Raises research and privacy concerns, suggests a different patent clause, and questions whether the three-year retention rule and UI language are workable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the license is about data ownership and access, not data-subject privacy, and that privacy only matters in the definition of Open.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清该许可关注的是数据所有权和访问，而不是数据主体隐私；隐私只在 Open 的定义中起作用。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the license is about data ownership and access, not data-subject privacy, and that privacy only matters in the definition of Open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the key issue is continual versus one-time data access, not the file format, and recommends focusing on documented, repeated access instead of REST versus CSV.
timeline.point_zh: 认为关键是持续访问还是一次性访问，而不是文件格式；建议关注有文档、可重复访问的数据获取，而不是 REST 对 CSV。
timeline.point: Says the key issue is continual versus one-time data access, not the file format, and recommends focusing on documented, repeated access instead of REST versus CSV.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions the three-year retention period, proposes a simpler clause tied to how long data exists on the licensee’s systems, and warns about legal and operational burdens.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑三年的保存期限，提出一个以数据在被许可方系统中存在多久为准的更简单条款，并提醒法律和运营负担。
timeline.point: Questions the three-year retention period, proposes a simpler clause tied to how long data exists on the licensee’s systems, and warns about legal and operational burdens.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Praises the new license’s patient-access goal, suggests considering a broader personal-data scope and trademark-based certification, and proposes GPL plus a private certification contract as an alternative.
timeline.point_zh: 肯定新许可的患者访问目标，建议考虑扩大到更广义的个人数据，并用商标认证来实现；同时提出 GPL 加私下认证合同作为替代方案。
timeline.point: Praises the new license’s patient-access goal, suggests considering a broader personal-data scope and trademark-based certification, and proposes GPL plus a private certification contract as an alternative.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the health-data goal is confusing, asks how it fits with HIPAA and PII laws, and questions whether such data can really be open.
timeline.point_zh: 认为健康数据目标令人困惑，追问它如何与 HIPAA 和 PII 法规相容，并质疑这类数据是否真的能“开放”。
timeline.point: Says the health-data goal is confusing, asks how it fits with HIPAA and PII laws, and questions whether such data can really be open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Asks two concrete questions about patient access and research data release, and says Tidewater still needs to figure out how to get there.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两个关于患者访问和研究数据发布的具体问题，并表示 Tidewater 仍需弄清楚如何实现目标。
timeline.point: Asks two concrete questions about patient access and research data release, and says Tidewater still needs to figure out how to get there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Warns that patients may already have a legal right to their data and urges caution about privacy obligations before applying open-source principles to health data.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒患者可能已经依法享有自己的数据，并敦促在把开源原则用于健康数据前先谨慎考虑隐私义务。
timeline.point: Warns that patients may already have a legal right to their data and urges caution about privacy obligations before applying open-source principles to health data.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether genetic code or Henrietta Lacks-style data would count as health data, using that example to probe the license’s scope.
timeline.point_zh: 询问基因代码或 Henrietta Lacks 式的数据是否算健康数据，并借此探查许可范围。
timeline.point: Asks whether genetic code or Henrietta Lacks-style data would count as health data, using that example to probe the license’s scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the thread really reduces to two questions: whether the license is open source, and whether it actually achieves Tidepool’s business goal.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这条讨论其实只剩两个问题：该许可是否算开源，以及它是否真的能实现 Tidepool 的业务目标。
timeline.point: Says the thread really reduces to two questions: whether the license is open source, and whether it actually achieves Tidepool’s business goal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says those are not purely lawyer questions, but agrees that whether the license achieves Tidepool’s goal is beyond what the list can settle.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这些不只是律师问题，但同意该许可是否实现 Tidepool 目标，已经超出列表能定论的范围。
timeline.point: Says those are not purely lawyer questions, but agrees that whether the license achieves Tidepool’s goal is beyond what the list can settle.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the issue needs policy and licensing experts, and suggests taking the discussion to Creative Commons or EFF as well.
timeline.point_zh: 同意这需要政策和许可专家参与，并建议也把讨论带到 Creative Commons 或 EFF。
timeline.point: Agrees the issue needs policy and licensing experts, and suggests taking the discussion to Creative Commons or EFF as well.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Summarizes the feedback, clarifying the health-data scope, machine-accessibility, privacy, patent, UI, and GPL issues, and says Tidepool will revise the draft accordingly.
timeline.point_zh: 总结反馈，澄清健康数据范围、machine-accessibility、隐私、专利、UI 和 GPL 等问题，并表示 Tidepool 会据此修改草案。
timeline.point: Summarizes the feedback, clarifying the health-data scope, machine-accessibility, privacy, patent, UI, and GPL issues, and says Tidepool will revise the draft accordingly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether health data could include software itself, challenges the research-use workaround, and presses for a clearer answer on whether the license is actually open source.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑健康数据是否会把软件本身也包括进去，挑战研究场景下的替代说法，并追问该许可是否真的算开源。
timeline.point: Questions whether health data could include software itself, challenges the research-use workaround, and presses for a clearer answer on whether the license is actually open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues that health data should exclude software, that readable data access is the core requirement, and that the license is meant to drive open-data adoption rather than offer alternate terms for convenience.
timeline.point_zh: 主张“健康数据”不应包含软件，可读的数据访问才是核心要求，并且该许可证旨在推动开放数据采用，而不是因图省事而提供替代条款。
timeline.point: Argues that health data should exclude software, that readable data access is the core requirement, and that the license is meant to drive open-data adoption rather than offer alternate terms for convenience.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license	steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Suggests a law would be more effective than a narrow health-data license because it could protect all patients rather than a limited set of devices.
timeline.point_zh: 主张立法会比狭窄的健康数据许可证更有效，因为法律可以保护所有患者，而不只是少数设备。
timeline.point: Suggests a law would be more effective than a narrow health-data license because it could protect all patients rather than a limited set of devices.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues that licenses are global while laws are regional, and asks whether the license should explicitly require fully informed consent to clarify patient rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张许可证具有全球性而法律具有地域性，并询问许可证是否应明确要求“充分知情同意”以澄清患者权利。
timeline.point: Argues that licenses are global while laws are regional, and asks whether the license should explicitly require fully informed consent to clarify patient rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that legislation could also secure patient access, but says lawmaking is outside the project’s scope and the proposal aims to combine open-source and open-data licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 承认立法也能保障患者访问数据，但表示立法不在项目能力范围内，而该提案旨在结合开源与开放数据许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that legislation could also secure patient access, but says lawmaking is outside the project’s scope and the proposal aims to combine open-source and open-data licensing.

submissions.name: Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The modular approach to licensing was seen as overly complex and potentially OSD-noncompliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source	Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Submits the Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL) for review, which enforces source code redistribution like GPL but without GNU's political agenda, using permissive base terms that can be extended for commercial contexts.
timeline.point_zh: 提交模块化开源软件许可证（MOSL）供审查，该许可证效仿 GPL 的源代码强制再分发但摒弃 GNU 政治议程，以宽松条款为基础并可针对商业场景扩展。
timeline.point: Submits the Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL) for review, which enforces source code redistribution like GPL but without GNU's political agenda, using permissive base terms that can be extended for commercial contexts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Suggests looking at the Sleepycat License, which already achieves similar goals and could easily be generalized.
timeline.point_zh: 建议参考 Sleepycat 许可证，该许可证已实现类似目标且易于泛化。
timeline.point: Suggests looking at the Sleepycat License, which already achieves similar goals and could easily be generalized.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the Sleepycat License suggestion, identifies three areas of conflict with it (scope, fee language, and redistribution conditions), and proposes revised terms based on a permissive model with source code redistribution requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Sleepycat 许可证的建议，指出与之存在三处差异（适用范围、费用措辞和再分发条件），并提出基于宽松模型加源代码再分发要求的修订条款。
timeline.point: Thanks for the Sleepycat License suggestion, identifies three areas of conflict with it (scope, fee language, and redistribution conditions), and proposes revised terms based on a permissive model with source code redistribution requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the license violates OSD #1 by allowing charges for source code beyond copying costs, noting it would be acceptable as a proprietary license but not for OSI review.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该许可证违反 OSD 第一条，因为它允许对源代码收取超出复制成本的费用，认为其作为专有许可证尚可但不适合提交给 OSI 审查。
timeline.point: Points out that the license violates OSD #1 by allowing charges for source code beyond copying costs, noting it would be acceptable as a proprietary license but not for OSI review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Defends the MOSL draft as not requiring royalty fees and being neutral on the issue, countering the claim that it violates OSD #1.
timeline.point_zh: 为 MOSL 草案辩护，认为其并未强制收取费用且在此问题上保持中立，反驳了违反 OSD 第一条的说法。
timeline.point: Defends the MOSL draft as not requiring royalty fees and being neutral on the issue, countering the claim that it violates OSD #1.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Insists that the license permits source code charges unrelated to copying costs, which violates OSD #1 and makes the license unworthy of serious consideration.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为该许可证允许收取与复制成本无关的源代码费用，违反 OSD 第一条，不值得认真考虑。
timeline.point: Insists that the license permits source code charges unrelated to copying costs, which violates OSD #1 and makes the license unworthy of serious consideration.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the intent is to create a neutral license usable in both commercial and non-commercial software, where the base license is OSD-compliant even if commercial forks adding extra terms are not.
timeline.point_zh: 阐明其目标是创建一个中立的许可证，适用于商业和非商业软件，基础许可证本身符合 OSD，即使添加额外条款的商业分叉不符合。
timeline.point: Clarifies the intent is to create a neutral license usable in both commercial and non-commercial software, where the base license is OSD-compliant even if commercial forks adding extra terms are not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that the license requires source code at no more than copying cost for binary recipients, and argues that BSD and MIT also permit additional terms to be added, questioning why the same logic would not apply here.
timeline.point_zh: 重申许可证要求以不超过复制成本的价格向二进制接收者提供源代码，并指出 BSD 和 MIT 也允许添加额外条款，质疑为何不同样适用于此处。
timeline.point: Reiterates that the license requires source code at no more than copying cost for binary recipients, and argues that BSD and MIT also permit additional terms to be added, questioning why the same logic would not apply here.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the license is LGPL-like rather than GPL-like, warns that allowing modifications under the same name creates confusion about OSD compliance, and raises concerns about license proliferation increasing the combinatorial complexity lawyers must study.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清该许可证更接近 LGPL 而非 GPL，警告允许在同一名义下修改会导致 OSD 合规性混淆，并对许可证激增增加律师需研究的组合复杂性表示担忧。
timeline.point: Clarifies the license is LGPL-like rather than GPL-like, warns that allowing modifications under the same name creates confusion about OSD compliance, and raises concerns about license proliferation increasing the combinatorial complexity lawyers must study.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the goal is to allow derivative works to be relicensed under a superset of the original terms (like BSD and MIT), considers basing the license on Sleepycat, and asks whether copyright law permits creating derivative works of the Sleepycat license text.
timeline.point_zh: 阐明目标是允许衍生作品在原始条款超集下重新授权（如 BSD 和 MIT），考虑基于 Sleepycat 许可证，并询问版权法是否允许创建 Sleepycat 许可证文本的衍生作品。
timeline.point: Clarifies the goal is to allow derivative works to be relicensed under a superset of the original terms (like BSD and MIT), considers basing the license on Sleepycat, and asks whether copyright law permits creating derivative works of the Sleepycat license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Warns that without explicit terms on what derivative works can and cannot add, contradictory terms could be introduced, and notes that Sleepycat is a trademark requiring permission to reference.
timeline.point_zh: 警告若不对衍生作品允许和禁止的条款做出明确规定，可能引入相互矛盾的条款，并指出 Sleepycat 是商标，需获得许可方可引用。
timeline.point: Warns that without explicit terms on what derivative works can and cannot add, contradictory terms could be introduced, and notes that Sleepycat is a trademark requiring permission to reference.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Corrects himself that Sleepycat is now owned by Oracle and dismisses the trademark concern as impractical.
timeline.point_zh: 自我更正 Sleepycat 现归 Oracle 所有，认为商标问题不切实际而放弃。
timeline.point: Corrects himself that Sleepycat is now owned by Oracle and dismisses the trademark concern as impractical.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Expresses enthusiasm for a generic OSI-approved version of the Sleepycat License and asks if there is a current recommendation for creating similar licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 对泛化的 OSI 批准版 Sleepycat 许可证表示支持，并询问目前是否有创建类似许可证的建议。
timeline.point: Expresses enthusiasm for a generic OSI-approved version of the Sleepycat License and asks if there is a current recommendation for creating similar licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the redistribution conditions inherently prevent contradictory derivative terms, decides to stick with the MOSL name since Oracle would not grant trademark permission, and asks whether copying Sleepycat license text raises copyright concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 主张再分发条件本身可防止衍生作品引入矛盾条款，决定继续使用 MOSL 名称（因 Oracle 不太可能授权商标），并询问复制 Sleepycat 许可证文本是否涉及版权问题。
timeline.point: Argues that the redistribution conditions inherently prevent contradictory derivative terms, decides to stick with the MOSL name since Oracle would not grant trademark permission, and asks whether copying Sleepycat license text raises copyright concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the license text explicitly states source code must be available at no more than the cost of distribution, refuting the claim that it permits arbitrary charges.
timeline.point_zh: 指出许可证文本明确说明源代码必须以不超过分发成本的价格提供，反驳了其允许任意收费的说法。
timeline.point: Points out that the license text explicitly states source code must be available at no more than the cost of distribution, refuting the claim that it permits arbitrary charges.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Agrees the license wording achieves the stated goals but notes it is not obvious to readers and recommends creating a FAQ to clarify.
timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证措辞确实达到了预期目标，但指出对读者而言不够明确，建议创建常见问题解答页面加以说明。
timeline.point: Agrees the license wording achieves the stated goals but notes it is not obvious to readers and recommends creating a FAQ to clarify.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on whether the license intends original code to remain under unchanged terms while derivative works must include the original terms plus may add arbitrary additional terms.
timeline.point_zh: 询问许可证是否意图为原始代码保持不变的条款，而衍生作品必须包含原始条款并可添加任意额外条款。

submissions.name: Svoboda License

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license was seen as a vanity project that didn't meet OSD requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Submits a very short public-domain-style license for approval and asks for suggestions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交一个很短、近似公有领域风格的许可证供审批，并请大家提出建议。
timeline.point: Submits a very short public-domain-style license for approval and asks for suggestions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Responds to feedback by revising the license to be more explicit and to permit removing notices, while arguing that existing OSI licenses do not cover that use case.
timeline.point_zh: 回应反馈，对许可证作出更明确的修订并允许修改或移除通知，同时认为现有 OSI 许可证并不覆盖这一用例。
timeline.point: Responds to feedback by revising the license to be more explicit and to permit removing notices, while arguing that existing OSI licenses do not cover that use case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Questions why the submitter is creating a near-MIT variant and says a new license should first justify the problem it solves.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑为什么要创建一个近似 MIT 的变体，并认为新的许可证应先说明其要解决的问题。
timeline.point: Questions why the submitter is creating a near-MIT variant and says a new license should first justify the problem it solves.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Defends the Svoboda text as materially different because it allows removing notices, which the submitter says existing OSI licenses do not allow.
timeline.point_zh: 为 Svoboda 文本辩护，认为它因为允许移除通知而实质不同，并称现有 OSI 许可证不允许这样做。
timeline.point: Defends the Svoboda text as materially different because it allows removing notices, which the submitter says existing OSI licenses do not allow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says notice removal is not special, questions the idea of letting users modify the license itself, and asks what problem the new license solves.
timeline.point_zh: 认为移除通知并不特殊，质疑让用户自行修改许可证本身的做法，并再次询问该许可证要解决什么问题。
timeline.point: Says notice removal is not special, questions the idea of letting users modify the license itself, and asks what problem the new license solves.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the need for a replacement license was already explained before, and warns that removing notices may have unwanted legal consequences.
timeline.point_zh: 表示之前已经说明过替代许可证的需求，并警告移除通知可能带来不想要的法律后果。
timeline.point: Says the need for a replacement license was already explained before, and warns that removing notices may have unwanted legal consequences.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the goal is to dedicate the work to the public domain in every jurisdiction.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己的目标是让作品在任何司法辖区都进入公有领域。
timeline.point: Says the goal is to dedicate the work to the public domain in every jurisdiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks why the submitter is not using CC0 instead.
timeline.point_zh: 询问为什么不直接使用 CC0。
timeline.point: Asks why the submitter is not using CC0 instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Rejects CC0 because it is not OSI-approved and is too long for the goal.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CC0 既不是 OSI 认可的许可，也太长，不适合该目标。
timeline.point: Rejects CC0 because it is not OSI-approved and is too long for the goal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Explains that public domain is hard to achieve across jurisdictions and argues CC0 is thorough because it works around that problem.
timeline.point_zh: 解释公有领域在不同法域下难以实现，并认为 CC0 因为周全而能绕开这一问题。
timeline.point: Explains that public domain is hard to achieve across jurisdictions and argues CC0 is thorough because it works around that problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks why the Unlicense is not approved.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Unlicense 为什么没有被批准。
timeline.point: Asks why the Unlicense is not approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says asking the problem first is insightful and can help people solve their own issue.
timeline.point_zh: 认为先问清问题很有见地，也常能帮助对方自己解决问题。
timeline.point: Says asking the problem first is insightful and can help people solve their own issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Mocks the idea of un-copyrighting and says it would require reversing international copyright law.
timeline.point_zh: 嘲讽“去版权化”的想法，并说这需要逆转国际版权法。
timeline.point: Mocks the idea of un-copyrighting and says it would require reversing international copyright law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Defends CC0 as a thorough but necessarily long attempt to waive copyright worldwide and solve the public-domain problem.
timeline.point_zh: 为 CC0 辩护，认为它篇幅长是因为要尽量在全球范围内放弃版权并解决公有领域问题。
timeline.point: Defends CC0 as a thorough but necessarily long attempt to waive copyright worldwide and solve the public-domain problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Dismisses the request to strip notices as a "crayon license" idea.
timeline.point_zh: 把删除所有标识和声明的要求斥为“蜡笔式许可”。
timeline.point: Dismisses the request to strip notices as a "crayon license" idea.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Argues Unlicense was probably never formally submitted, is not really a license, and is likely doomed for approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Unlicense 可能根本没有正式提交，也未必算真正的许可证，获批前景大概率不乐观。
timeline.point: Argues Unlicense was probably never formally submitted, is not really a license, and is likely doomed for approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Agrees that explaining the problem a new license solves should have been required from the beginning.
timeline.point_zh: 同意从一开始就应该要求说明新许可证所解决的问题。
timeline.point: Agrees that explaining the problem a new license solves should have been required from the beginning.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Makes a joking aside that crayons inspire creativity and wonder.
timeline.point_zh: 开玩笑说蜡笔能激发创造力和惊奇感。
timeline.point: Makes a joking aside that crayons inspire creativity and wonder.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the author has read the Open Source FAQ entry on public domain.
timeline.point_zh: 询问对方是否读过开放源代码 FAQ 中关于公有领域的条目。
timeline.point: Asks whether the author has read the Open Source FAQ entry on public domain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Cancels the submission because it does not achieve the desired result and complains that copyright cannot be undone.
timeline.point_zh: 因许可未能实现预期目标而取消提交，并抱怨版权无法被撤销。
timeline.point: Cancels the submission because it does not achieve the desired result and complains that copyright cannot be undone.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks what the author actually wants and suggests existing permissive options instead of wasting time on ultra-short public-domain-style requests.
timeline.point_zh: 追问作者究竟想实现什么，并建议直接选现成的宽松许可，而不是继续折腾超短的类公有领域方案。
timeline.point: Asks what the author actually wants and suggests existing permissive options instead of wasting time on ultra-short public-domain-style requests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the goal is not really possible, but notes he is using the MirOS license for full freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这一目标其实做不到，但补充说自己正在使用 MirOS 许可证以获得完全自由。
timeline.point: Says the goal is not really possible, but notes he is using the MirOS license for full freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Argues that a permissive license like MIT or MirOS still gives full freedom without losing rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张像 MIT 或 MirOS 这样的宽松许可同样能给出完全自由，而且不会让你失去权利。
timeline.point: Argues that a permissive license like MIT or MirOS still gives full freedom without losing rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says he wants full freedom and notes that he is using the MirOS license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己想要完全自由，并说明自己正在使用 MirOS 许可证。
timeline.point: Says he wants full freedom and notes that he is using the MirOS license.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Explains that the changes are meant to reconcile existing legacy licenses and make Python licensing terminology clearer.
timeline.point_zh: 说明这些变更是为了整合既有旧许可证，并把 Python 许可证的表述变得更明确。
timeline.point: Explains that the changes are meant to reconcile existing legacy licenses and make Python licensing terminology clearer.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Questions why Python still needs multiple licenses and urges the foundation to consolidate under a single existing license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问为什么 Python 仍需要多个许可证，并主张尽量统一到一个现有许可证上。
timeline.point: Questions why Python still needs multiple licenses and urges the foundation to consolidate under a single existing license.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Suggests that only the top-level Python license is operative and the older notices persist mainly because they must be carried forward.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Python 主要只有顶层许可证在起作用，旧许可证更多是因为必须随衍生代码保留。
timeline.point: Suggests that only the top-level Python license is operative and the older notices persist mainly because they must be carried forward.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues that stacked permissive notices effectively collapse to the most recent license, while also reiterating his anti-patent view.
timeline.point_zh: 主张层叠的宽松许可证实际上会收敛为最新许可证，同时重申其反专利立场。
timeline.point: Argues that stacked permissive notices effectively collapse to the most recent license, while also reiterating his anti-patent view.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Uses MySQL as an example of how due diligence can expose layered licensing and mistaken assumptions about software ownership.

timeline.point: Uses MySQL as an example of how due diligence can expose layered licensing and mistaken assumptions about software ownership.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point_zh: 支持这次改动是为了区分不同 Python 分发并让 PSF 许可证可单独使用，而不是为了额外创造新权利。
timeline.point: Supports the relicensing work as a clarification effort that distinguishes Python distributions and makes the PSF license usable on its own.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point_zh: 主张顶层许可证并不会消除嵌入组件的义务，专利终止条款也会让多许可证并存变得重要。
timeline.point: Argues that top-level licensing does not erase the obligations of embedded components and patent clauses can still matter.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point_zh: 建议 CNRI 将旧代码改为可按 2.1 分发，并主张 Python 2.1 应明确允许许可证由维护者更新。
timeline.point: Suggests CNRI could relicense its older code under 2.1 and asks for an explicit steward-updated clause in Python 2.1.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says CNRI was not clearly a willing contributor and that Guido relied on informal permission to open-source Python.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 CNRI 并非明确愿意贡献者，而 Guido 是依赖非正式许可才将 Python 开源。
timeline.point: Says CNRI was not clearly a willing contributor and that Guido relied on informal permission to open-source Python.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that the Python licenses are mostly fine but that the brief-summary clause remains the key concern.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 Python 许可证整体没大问题，但“简要总结更改”条款仍是核心顾虑。
timeline.point: Reiterates that the Python licenses are mostly fine but that the brief-summary clause remains the key concern.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Repeats that prior approvals are not controlling and that CNRI should be asked to remove the clause.
timeline.point_zh: 再次强调过去的批准并不具有约束力，并认为应要求 CNRI 删除该条款。
timeline.point: Repeats that prior approvals are not controlling and that CNRI should be asked to remove the clause.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues that the brief-summary clause is OSD-compliant and useful, even if it is somewhat burdensome.
timeline.point_zh: 认为简要总结条款符合 OSD 且有用，尽管它会带来一些负担。
timeline.point: Argues that the brief-summary clause is OSD-compliant and useful, even if it is somewhat burdensome.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point: Rejects the clause as an arbitrary burden that can block redistribution and undermine its own goal.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point_zh: 认为旧版和 PSF Python 许可证大体可接受，但反对“简要总结更改”条款，并希望 CNRI 取消它。
timeline.point: Finds the legacy and PSF Python licenses mostly acceptable but objects to the brief-summary clause and wants CNRI to remove it.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point_zh: 指出过去的批准不约束当前审查，补丁文件类比并不完全相同，并支持向 CNRI 争取删除该条款。
timeline.point: Says past approvals do not bind current review, notes that the patch-file analogy is not exact, and endorses asking CNRI to remove the clause.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Supports the summary requirement as acceptable under the OSD, while still disliking hard-coded license rules.
timeline.point_zh: 认为摘要要求在 OSD 下可接受，同时仍不喜欢把这类规则写死在许可证里。
timeline.point: Supports the summary requirement as acceptable under the OSD, while still disliking hard-coded license rules.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point: Says the clause is either unnecessary or problematic depending on how PSF interprets 'summary', and asks PSF to respond.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes

timeline.point: Agrees to split the discussion into three threads and notes the board meeting date as a useful deadline.
