timeline.snippet: Reiterates that prohibiting sublicensing is not inherently incompatible with open source, drawing an explicit parallel to GPLv3's approach of automatic licensing from original licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 重申禁止再许可并非与开源不兼容，明确类比 GPLv3 从原始许可方自动许可的做法。
timeline.point: Reiterates that prohibiting sublicensing is not inherently incompatible with open source, drawing an explicit parallel to GPLv3's approach of automatic licensing from original licensors.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Submits the netX Public License for OSI approval on behalf of Hilscher Gesellschaft fur Systemaustomation mbH. Notes this is the third submission attempt after previous attempts may not have been properly received.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 Hilscher Gesellschaft fur Systemaustomation mbH 提交 netX 公共许可证供 OSI 审批。说明这是第三次提交，前两次可能未被正确接收。
timeline.point: Submits the netX Public License for OSI approval on behalf of Hilscher Gesellschaft fur Systemaustomation mbH. Notes this is the third submission attempt after previous attempts may not have been properly received.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Identifies that the netX license violates OSD #10 (Technology-Neutral) by requiring changes to be uploaded to a specific website.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 netX 许可证违反 OSD 第 10 条（技术中立性），因为要求将修改上传到特定网站。
timeline.point: Identifies that the netX license violates OSD #10 (Technology-Neutral) by requiring changes to be uploaded to a specific website.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Notes that licenses requiring use of a specific upload site have been rejected before, and warns that the license must remain valid if the website disappears.
timeline.point_zh: 指出此前依赖特定上传网站的许可证曾被拒绝，警告许可证必须在网站消失后仍然有效。
timeline.point: Notes that licenses requiring use of a specific upload site have been rejected before, and warns that the license must remain valid if the website disappears.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Questions the no-sublicensing clause as a potential violation of open source criteria. Asks what happens to existing copies if the license steward ceases to exist.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑禁止再许可条款可能违反开源标准。询问如果许可管理方不复存在，现有副本会怎样。
timeline.point: Questions the no-sublicensing clause as a potential violation of open source criteria. Asks what happens to existing copies if the license steward ceases to exist.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Notes that OSI has not accepted licenses prohibiting sublicensing, and explains the no-sublicensing clause is a patent-avoidance strategy.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 此前未批准过禁止再许可的许可证，说明该条款是中间分销商规避专利负担的策略。
timeline.point: Notes that OSI has not accepted licenses prohibiting sublicensing, and explains the no-sublicensing clause is a patent-avoidance strategy.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Counters that prohibiting sublicensing is not inherently a violation of open source criteria, citing GPLv3 which also prohibits sublicensing. Argues the netX public license achieves the same effect as GPLv3's automatic licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳禁止再许可并非必然违反开源标准，引用 GPLv3 也禁止再许可。认为 netX 公共许可证与 GPLv3 的自动许可效果相同。
timeline.point: Counters that prohibiting sublicensing is not inherently a violation of open source criteria, citing GPLv3 which also prohibits sublicensing. Argues the netX public license achieves the same effect as GPLv3's automatic licensing.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Provides four specific criticisms: the technology-specific submission requirement, need for template placeholders, name conflict with existing NetX project, and poor English translation quality with specific suggestions for improvement.
timeline.point_zh: 提出四项具体批评：技术特定的提交要求、需要模板占位符、与现有 NetX 项目的名称冲突、以及英文翻译质量差并给出具体改进建议。
timeline.point: Provides four specific criticisms: the technology-specific submission requirement, need for template placeholders, name conflict with existing NetX project, and poor English translation quality with specific suggestions for improvement.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether prohibiting sublicensing is necessarily an issue, noting that GPL also forbids sublicensing while still functioning as a public license through direct licensing from copyright holders.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑禁止再许可是否必然是问题，指出 GPL 也禁止再许可，但通过版权持有者的直接许可仍能作为公共许可证运作。
timeline.point: Questions whether prohibiting sublicensing is necessarily an issue, noting that GPL also forbids sublicensing while still functioning as a public license through direct licensing from copyright holders.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Concedes the sublicensing point is not valid, but insists the license must allow normal distribution chains. Notes there are other reasons to reject the license.
timeline.point_zh: 承认再许可问题不成立，但坚持许可证必须允许正常分发链。指出还有其他拒绝理由。
timeline.point: Concedes the sublicensing point is not valid, but insists the license must allow normal distribution chains. Notes there are other reasons to reject the license.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license needs "best effort" language for when the licensor disappears, and reiterates that the technology-specific submission requirement must be removed.
timeline.point_zh: 主张许可证需要添加"尽最大努力"条款以应对许可方消失的情况，重申技术特定的提交要求必须移除。
timeline.point: Argues the license needs "best effort" language for when the licensor disappears, and reiterates that the technology-specific submission requirement must be removed.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Expresses concern that inability to comply with the license's mandatory act (submitting code to a specific site) puts users out of compliance. Mentions the broader issue of orphaned works.
timeline.point_zh: 担心无法执行许可证要求的强制行为（向特定网站提交代码）会使用户不合规。提及开源中孤儿作品的更广泛问题。
timeline.point: Expresses concern that inability to comply with the license's mandatory act (submitting code to a specific site) puts users out of compliance. Mentions the broader issue of orphaned works.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Raises concerns about the license's discriminatory treatment of kernel interfaces, mandatory feedback requirements, and liability limitations that may make it incompatible with permissive licenses like BSD, Apache, and MIT.
timeline.point_zh: 提出对许可证歧视性对待内核接口、强制反馈要求和责任限制的担忧，认为这些可能使其与 BSD、Apache、MIT 等宽松许可证不兼容。
timeline.point: Raises concerns about the license's discriminatory treatment of kernel interfaces, mandatory feedback requirements, and liability limitations that may make it incompatible with permissive licenses like BSD, Apache, and MIT.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that warranty and liability provisions are distinct from copyright and fall outside the scope of the 10 OSI principles. Notes that European law, especially German law, limits liability exclusions, as reflected in the EUPL.
timeline.point_zh: 主张保修和责任条款与版权不同，不在 10 条 OSI 原则范围内。指出欧洲法律（尤其是德国法律）限制免责条款，EUPL 也体现了这一点。
timeline.point: Argues that warranty and liability provisions are distinct from copyright and fall outside the scope of the 10 OSI principles. Notes that European law, especially German law, limits liability exclusions, as reflected in the EUPL.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Schmitz that liability provisions are outside OSI scope, but sides with Bruce and Andy that the license should be rejected for other reasons, particularly the mandatory contribution-back requirement which limits the right to use and modify software.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Schmitz 关于责任条款不在 OSI 范围内的观点，但支持 Bruce 和 Andy 认为许可证应因其他理由被拒绝，特别是强制回馈修改的要求限制了使用和修改软件的权利。
timeline.point: Agrees with Schmitz that liability provisions are outside OSI scope, but sides with Bruce and Andy that the license should be rejected for other reasons, particularly the mandatory contribution-back requirement which limits the right to use and modify software.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that under U.S. law, there is no practical difference between including or excluding intentional misconduct and gross negligence in liability disclaimers, as neither is enforceable. Notes that open source licenses are contracts of adhesion and may be interpreted against the drafter.
timeline.point_zh: 认为在美国法律下，责任免责声明中是否包含故意不当行为和重大过失没有实质区别，因为两者都不可执行。指出开源许可证是附合合同，可能被作不利于起草方的解释。
timeline.point: Argues that under U.S. law, there is no practical difference between including or excluding intentional misconduct and gross negligence in liability disclaimers, as neither is enforceable. Notes that open source licenses are contracts of adhesion and may be interpreted against the drafter.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges Cowan's U.S. law analysis but redirects the discussion, arguing that the liability exclusion provision is outside the scope of OSI's 10 principles and should not be a reason for rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 认可 Cowan 对美国法律的分析，但将讨论引回正题，主张责任免责条款不在 OSI 十条原则范围内，不应成为拒绝理由。
timeline.point: Acknowledges Cowan's U.S. law analysis but redirects the discussion, arguing that the liability exclusion provision is outside the scope of OSI's 10 principles and should not be a reason for rejection.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the netX license creates an incompatible silo by having narrower liability disclaimers than permissive licenses, making it impossible to combine with BSD code without license conflicts.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 netX 许可证因责任免责声明比宽松许可证更窄而创建了不兼容的孤岛，使其无法与 BSD 代码组合而不产生许可证冲突。
timeline.point: Argues that the netX license creates an incompatible silo by having narrower liability disclaimers than permissive licenses, making it impossible to combine with BSD code without license conflicts.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies a misunderstanding about Josh's question regarding returning software. Reiterates that the requirement to submit code to a specific website needs to be changed.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清对 Josh 关于归还软件问题的误解。重申向特定网站提交代码的要求需要修改。
timeline.point: Clarifies a misunderstanding about Josh's question regarding returning software. Reiterates that the requirement to submit code to a specific website needs to be changed.

timeline.subject: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Counters the license conflict argument by noting each licensor disclaims liability only for their own code, so BSD and netX disclaimers can coexist without conflict.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳许可证冲突论点，指出每个许可方只对自己的代码免责，因此 BSD 和 netX 的免责条款可以共存而不冲突。
timeline.point: Counters the license conflict argument by noting each licensor disclaims liability only for their own code, so BSD and netX disclaimers can coexist without conflict.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Responds to netX review comments by asking how to revise the license so porting-related change publication is not treated as a technology-specific kernel-interface requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 netX 审查意见，询问如何修改许可证，使移植相关变更发布要求不被视为针对内核接口的技术特定限制。
timeline.point: Responds to netX review comments by asking how to revise the license so porting-related change publication is not treated as a technology-specific kernel-interface requirement.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that mandatory upstream submission or upload obligations conflict with OSD Sections 1 and 3, and urges removing any required website upload from the netX license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为强制向上游提交或上传变更的义务违反 OSD 第 1 和第 3 条，并敦促从 netX 许可证中移除强制网站上传要求。
timeline.point: Argues that mandatory upstream submission or upload obligations conflict with OSD Sections 1 and 3, and urges removing any required website upload from the netX license.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the prior message to clarify that the submitter should remove any mandatory website upload requirement from the license.
timeline.point_zh: 更正前一封邮件，明确表示提交方应从许可证中移除任何强制网站上传要求。
timeline.point: Corrects the prior message to clarify that the submitter should remove any mandatory website upload requirement from the license.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that the netX license violates the spirit of open source by protecting the originating company rather than users’ freedom to modify software.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 netX 许可证违背开源精神，因为它保护的是原始公司利益，而不是用户修改软件的自由。
timeline.point: Agrees that the netX license violates the spirit of open source by protecting the originating company rather than users’ freedom to modify software.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that netX should use an already-approved license and should not be approved while it retains the upload requirement, which adds unnecessary legal burden.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 netX 应使用已有批准许可证，并且只要保留上传要求就不应获批，因为该要求增加了不必要的法律负担。
timeline.point: Argues that netX should use an already-approved license and should not be approved while it retains the upload requirement, which adds unnecessary legal burden.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Argues that requiring notice or code submission to a named entity creates accumulating downstream burdens and can make reuse impossible if that entity becomes unreachable.
timeline.point_zh: 指出要求向特定实体通知或提交代码会给下游造成累积负担，并可能在该实体无法联系时使再利用变得不可行。
timeline.point: Argues that requiring notice or code submission to a named entity creates accumulating downstream burdens and can make reuse impossible if that entity becomes unreachable.

timeline.subject: AW: For Approval: The netX Public Lisense (in plain text)
timeline.snippet: Notes that impossible notification obligations might become unenforceable, but still argues such clauses are bad drafting because they create avoidable legal uncertainty.
timeline.point_zh: 指出无法履行的通知义务可能变得不可执行，但仍认为此类条款是糟糕起草，因为会制造本可避免的法律不确定性。
timeline.point: Notes that impossible notification obligations might become unenforceable, but still argues such clauses are bad drafting because they create avoidable legal uncertainty.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. License had non-standard terms inconsistent with OSD.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Makes a third-party submission of the WebM license for review, says he has a legitimate interest, and notes a likely mistake that should be addressed through the formal process.
timeline.point_zh: 以第三方身份提交 WebM 许可证供审查，表示自己有正当利害关系，并指出文本中可能存在错误，应通过正式流程修正。
timeline.point: Makes a third-party submission of the WebM license for review, says he has a legitimate interest, and notes a likely mistake that should be addressed through the formal process.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Suggests the WebM license appears redundant because it resembles an existing BSD-style license with a patent grant.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 WebM 许可证看起来像已有的带专利授权的 BSD 式许可证，因此可能是重复造轮子。
timeline.point: Suggests the WebM license appears redundant because it resembles an existing BSD-style license with a patent grant.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Points to AFL 3.0 as an existing, more complete alternative to the WebM license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 AFL 3.0 已经是一个更完整、更成熟的替代方案。
timeline.point: Points to AFL 3.0 as an existing, more complete alternative to the WebM license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Thanks the list for the WebM license update without adding a substantive review position.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 WebM 许可证更新，但未增加实质审查立场。
timeline.point: Thanks the list for the WebM license update without adding a substantive review position.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Asks OSI to pause review while Google assesses compatibility, raises proliferation concerns, and requests more openness around any WebM-related approval discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 OSI 在 Google 内部评估兼容性期间暂缓审查，并提出许可证泛滥和审议透明度方面的担忧。
timeline.point: Asks OSI to pause review while Google assesses compatibility, raises proliferation concerns, and requests more openness around any WebM-related approval discussion.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: States full agreement with Chris DiBona's requests about delaying review, discouraging reuse, and increasing openness around the process.
timeline.point_zh: 表示完全赞同 Chris DiBona 关于暂缓审查、抑制复用以及提高流程透明度的意见。
timeline.point: States full agreement with Chris DiBona's requests about delaying review, discouraging reuse, and increasing openness around the process.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Says delaying discussion is reasonable, but any problems should be resolved early, and argues the best response to proliferation is to use an existing GPL-compatible license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为暂缓讨论是合理的，但问题应尽早解决，并主张为避免许可证泛滥，最好直接采用现有的 GPL 兼容许可证。
timeline.point: Says delaying discussion is reasonable, but any problems should be resolved early, and argues the best response to proliferation is to use an existing GPL-compatible license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that the WebM license may be GPLv2-incompatible, similar to Apache-style compatibility problems.
timeline.point_zh: 提出担忧，认为 WebM 许可证可能像 Apache 风格许可证一样与 GPLv2 不兼容。
timeline.point: Raises concern that the WebM license may be GPLv2-incompatible, similar to Apache-style compatibility problems.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Agrees that possible GPL incompatibility is a meaningful concern and says such incompatibility should be avoided when possible.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同潜在的 GPL 不兼容性是实质性问题，并表示如果可能应避免这种情况。
timeline.point: Agrees that possible GPL incompatibility is a meaningful concern and says such incompatibility should be avoided when possible.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Notes possible GPLv2 incompatibility in the WebM license, though he is unsure how important that issue is.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 WebM 许可证可能与 GPLv2 不兼容，但同时表示尚不确定这一问题有多重要。
timeline.point: Notes possible GPLv2 incompatibility in the WebM license, though he is unsure how important that issue is.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Says Chris's requested process changes are largely unnecessary because OSI already has a non-reusable label and public list discussion, and asks what concrete closedness concern is being raised.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 Chris 提出的流程变更大多没有必要，因为 OSI 已有不可复用标签和公开讨论机制，并询问所谓“不透明”具体指什么。
timeline.point: Says Chris's requested process changes are largely unnecessary because OSI already has a non-reusable label and public list discussion, and asks what concrete closedness concern is being raised.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Requests a pause while Google reviews compatibility, raises proliferation concerns, asks about OSI's corporate status, and calls for more openness in the approval process.
timeline.point_zh: 要求在 Google 评估兼容性期间暂停审查，提出许可证泛滥与 OSI 公司状态问题，并呼吁提高审批流程透明度。
timeline.point: Requests a pause while Google reviews compatibility, raises proliferation concerns, asks about OSI's corporate status, and calls for more openness in the approval process.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Defends OSI's results-focused approach, questions whether more openness would solve any concrete problem, and argues critics should participate directly if they want more influence.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OSI 以结果为导向的做法辩护，质疑更高透明度是否真能解决具体问题，并认为批评者若想影响流程应直接参与其中。
timeline.point: Defends OSI's results-focused approach, questions whether more openness would solve any concrete problem, and argues critics should participate directly if they want more influence.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Withdraws the earlier question about OSI's corporate status after receiving an explanation.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己先前关于 OSI 公司状态的问题已因得到解释而撤回。
timeline.point: Withdraws the earlier question about OSI's corporate status after receiving an explanation.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI should hold itself to a higher standard of openness and says the broader political side discussion is off topic.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 既然评判开放性，就应对自身透明度有更高要求，并认为更广泛的政治争论已经跑题。
timeline.point: Argues OSI should hold itself to a higher standard of openness and says the broader political side discussion is off topic.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Says OSI already conducts license discussion publicly, corporate status is irrelevant to approval, and legal review standards for licenses should be higher.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 的许可证讨论本就公开进行，组织法人状态与审批无关，同时认为许可证的法律审查标准应更高。
timeline.point: Says OSI already conducts license discussion publicly, corporate status is irrelevant to approval, and legal review standards for licenses should be higher.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Disputes the claim that all comparable meetings are closed and says WebM license discussions should be public if Google submits the license.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳“类似会议都应保密”的说法，并表示如果 Google 提交 WebM 许可证，相关讨论应当公开。
timeline.point: Disputes the claim that all comparable meetings are closed and says WebM license discussions should be public if Google submits the license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI only published summary facts about its corporate-status restoration and asks that further discussion move to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 OSI 仅公开了公司状态恢复的概要事实，并建议后续讨论转到 license-discuss 列表。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI only published summary facts about its corporate-status restoration and asks that further discussion move to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion about whether OSI's corporate-status issue was already fixed and says Google is not looking to create an advisory board.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己对 OSI 的公司状态问题是否已解决感到困惑，并说明 Google 目前并不打算设立咨询委员会。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion about whether OSI's corporate-status issue was already fixed and says Google is not looking to create an advisory board.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Says the side argument about organizational openness is irrelevant and that the list can wait until Google is ready to submit the WebM license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为围绕组织开放性的争论与许可证审查无关，列表可以等到 Google 准备好再正式提交 WebM 许可证。
timeline.point: Says the side argument about organizational openness is irrelevant and that the list can wait until Google is ready to submit the WebM license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Says the OSI corporate-status issue seems resolved and recommends that Google use an existing approved license with an explicit patent grant instead of a new WebM license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 OSI 的法人状态问题看起来已解决，并建议 Google 直接采用带明确专利授权的现有已批准许可证，而不是再做新的 WebM 许可证。
timeline.point: Says the OSI corporate-status issue seems resolved and recommends that Google use an existing approved license with an explicit patent grant instead of a new WebM license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Expresses support (+1).
timeline.point_zh: 表示支持（+1）。
timeline.point: Expresses support (+1).

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Briefly thanks Josh in the WebM license discussion without adding substantive review analysis.
timeline.point_zh: 在 WebM 许可证讨论中简短感谢 Josh，未增加实质审查分析。
timeline.point: Briefly thanks Josh in the WebM license discussion without adding substantive review analysis.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Expresses agreement with Josh Berkus that the side discussion is irrelevant to the license review.
timeline.point_zh: 表示赞同 Josh Berkus 的看法，即这些旁支讨论与许可证审查无关。
timeline.point: Expresses agreement with Josh Berkus that the side discussion is irrelevant to the license review.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for the ad hominem attack and asks Google to follow the normal OSI process without extra demands the next time it creates an open source license.
timeline.point_zh: 为人身攻击道歉，并要求 Google 下次制定开源许可证时按 OSI 的常规流程参与，不要附加额外要求。
timeline.point: Apologizes for the ad hominem attack and asks Google to follow the normal OSI process without extra demands the next time it creates an open source license.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Rejects the comparison with private client meetings, says OSI has allowed outside attendance when relevant, and argues WebM discussion is already public.
timeline.point_zh: 反对把 OSI 会议与律师私下会谈相提并论，指出 OSI 在相关情况下曾允许旁听，并认为 WebM 讨论本就已经公开。
timeline.point: Rejects the comparison with private client meetings, says OSI has allowed outside attendance when relevant, and argues WebM discussion is already public.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Defends OSI's current level of transparency, says some secrecy is sometimes necessary, and argues that greater openness is not a universal solution.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OSI 现有透明度辩护，表示某些保密场景确有必要，并认为更高开放性并不是放之四海而皆准的解决方案。
timeline.point: Defends OSI's current level of transparency, says some secrecy is sometimes necessary, and argues that greater openness is not a universal solution.

timeline.subject: WebM license third-party submission
timeline.snippet: Asks that the governance debate be moved off the license-review list to a more appropriate OSI forum.
timeline.point_zh: 要求把这场治理层面的争论从 license-review 列表移到更合适的 OSI 讨论渠道。
timeline.point: Asks that the governance debate be moved off the license-review list to a more appropriate OSI forum.

submissions.name: MXM Public License

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. License had unusual terms that raised concerns about OSD compliance, particularly regarding patent rights.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Submits the MXM Public License for OSI approval on behalf of the MPEG Working Group, explaining modifications to the MPL to remove patent conditions while adding an explicit patent covenant, arguing compliance with the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 MPEG 工作组提交 MXM 公共许可证供 OSI 审批，说明对 MPL 的修改以移除专利条件并添加明确专利契约，主张符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Submits the MXM Public License for OSI approval on behalf of the MPEG Working Group, explaining modifications to the MPL to remove patent conditions while adding an explicit patent covenant, arguing compliance with the OSD.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues the MXM license is non-approvable because it denies implicit patent rights while refusing to grant explicit ones, unlike BSD which provides a solid implicit patent license.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 MXM 许可证不应获批，因为它否认隐含专利权同时拒绝授予明确专利权，而 BSD 提供了坚实的隐含专利许可。
timeline.point: Argues the MXM license is non-approvable because it denies implicit patent rights while refusing to grant explicit ones, unlike BSD which provides a solid implicit patent license.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Expresses skepticism about implicit patent licenses and argues the OSD does not require patent licenses, noting all programmers face submarine patent risks regardless of licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 对隐含专利许可表示怀疑，主张 OSD 并不要求专利许可，指出所有程序员都面临潜水艇专利风险。
timeline.point: Expresses skepticism about implicit patent licenses and argues the OSD does not require patent licenses, noting all programmers face submarine patent risks regardless of licensing.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Cites legal sources on implied patent licenses and argues that OSD specifies what users must be able to do, requiring both copyright and patent rights in practice.
timeline.point_zh: 引用隐含专利许可的法律来源，主张 OSD 规定了用户必须能够做的事情，实践中需要同时授予版权和专利权。
timeline.point: Cites legal sources on implied patent licenses and argues that OSD specifies what users must be able to do, requiring both copyright and patent rights in practice.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that granting OSI approval to a license specifically drafted to remove patent protection would encourage such practices rather than condemn them.
timeline.point_zh: 认为授予 OSI 批准一个专门起草以消除专利保护的许可证会鼓励此类做法而非谴责。
timeline.point: Argues that granting OSI approval to a license specifically drafted to remove patent protection would encourage such practices rather than condemn them.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues the core question is whether a license separating copyright from patent licensing can be OSD-compliant, expressing skepticism about BSD providing patent licenses and noting ISO/IEC reference implementations cannot use OSI-certified licenses under current rules.
timeline.point_zh: 主张核心问题在于分离版权和专利许可的许可证能否符合 OSD，对 BSD 提供专利许可表示怀疑，指出 ISO/IEC 参考实现无法使用当前规则下的 OSI 认证许可证。
timeline.point: Argues the core question is whether a license separating copyright from patent licensing can be OSD-compliant, expressing skepticism about BSD providing patent licenses and noting ISO/IEC reference implementations cannot use OSI-certified licenses under current rules.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues the MXM license is worse than ambiguous because it explicitly denies needed patent rights, and dismisses the submitter's personal position as irrelevant to the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MXM 许可证比模糊更糟，因为它明确拒绝了所需的专利权，并认为提交者的个人观点与许可证文本无关。
timeline.point: Argues the MXM license is worse than ambiguous because it explicitly denies needed patent rights, and dismisses the submitter's personal position as irrelevant to the license text.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Suggests the OSD may be missing provisions to prevent calling software Open Source when the licensor contradicts the license grant through simultaneous patent actions.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSD 可能缺少条款来防止当许可方通过同时进行的专利行为与许可授权相矛盾时将软件称为开源。
timeline.point: Suggests the OSD may be missing provisions to prevent calling software Open Source when the licensor contradicts the license grant through simultaneous patent actions.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Recommends rejection of the MXM license, arguing it violates OSD #6 by excluding commercial exploitation and OSD #7 by requiring separate patent licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 建议拒绝 MXM 许可证，认为其违反 OSD #6（排除商业利用）和 OSD #7（要求单独专利许可）。
timeline.point: Recommends rejection of the MXM license, arguing it violates OSD #6 by excluding commercial exploitation and OSD #7 by requiring separate patent licenses.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Questions whether OSD #1 requires patent grants and suggests the patent covenant likely fails OSD #6, noting the ISO reference implementation will be used regardless of OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 OSD #1 是否要求专利授权，认为专利条款可能不符合 OSD #6，指出 ISO 参考实现无论是否获得 OSI 批准都会被使用。
timeline.point: Questions whether OSD #1 requires patent grants and suggests the patent covenant likely fails OSD #6, noting the ISO reference implementation will be used regardless of OSI approval.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Cites OSD #7 to argue the MXM license fails the Distribution of License requirement, as it does not extend all necessary rights to downstream recipients.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 OSD #7 论证 MXM 许可证未通过分发许可要求，因其未将所有必要权利延伸至下游接收者。
timeline.point: Cites OSD #7 to argue the MXM license fails the Distribution of License requirement, as it does not extend all necessary rights to downstream recipients.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the OSD #7 argument but notes uncertainty about interpreting "the rights attached to the program", comparing it to requiring a separate NDA.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 OSD #7 的论点，但对"程序所附权利"的解释表示不确定，将其类比为要求单独 NDA。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the OSD #7 argument but notes uncertainty about interpreting "the rights attached to the program", comparing it to requiring a separate NDA.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that every OSI-approved license provides patent rights in practice, OSI should not weaken its standards, and the OSD implicitly requires both copyright and patent grants.
timeline.point_zh: 主张每个 OSI 批准的许可证在实践中都提供专利权，OSI 不应降低标准，OSD 隐含地要求同时授予版权和专利权。
timeline.point: Argues that every OSI-approved license provides patent rights in practice, OSI should not weaken its standards, and the OSD implicitly requires both copyright and patent grants.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Maintains that the question of implicit patent licenses is genuinely uncertain, with some licenses providing patent rights and others remaining silent on the subject.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为隐含专利许可的问题确实存在不确定性，一些许可证提供专利权而另一些对此保持沉默。
timeline.point: Maintains that the question of implicit patent licenses is genuinely uncertain, with some licenses providing patent rights and others remaining silent on the subject.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Objects to the idea that software is an exception to the general principle of implicit patent licenses, and notes the Artistic License only survived on appeal.
timeline.point_zh: 反对软件是隐含专利许可一般原则例外的观点，指出 Artistic 许可证仅在上诉中幸存。
timeline.point: Objects to the idea that software is an exception to the general principle of implicit patent licenses, and notes the Artistic License only survived on appeal.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Notes that the Artistic License survived a court test on appeal, partly due to the license writer's use of the word "condition".
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Artistic 许可证在上诉中经受住了法庭检验，部分归功于许可方使用了"条件"一词。
timeline.point: Notes that the Artistic License survived a court test on appeal, partly due to the license writer's use of the word "condition".

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that a good license writer aims to avoid lawsuits rather than set judicial precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 认为优秀的许可证起草者应以避免诉讼为目标，而非设立司法先例。
timeline.point: Argues that a good license writer aims to avoid lawsuits rather than set judicial precedent.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Questions the clarity of implicit patent grants, suggests OSI create a reference software licenses category, and raises strategic concerns about losing relevance to Creative Commons if OSI does not provide preferred terminology.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑隐含专利授权的清晰度，建议 OSI 创建参考软件许可证类别，并对如果 OSI 不提供首选术语将失去相关性给 Creative Commons 表示担忧。
timeline.point: Questions the clarity of implicit patent grants, suggests OSI create a reference software licenses category, and raises strategic concerns about losing relevance to Creative Commons if OSI does not provide preferred terminology.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that BSD/MIT licenses clearly convey all necessary rights including patent-related ones, but the MXM does not meet OSD requirements and should not receive OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 BSD/MIT 许可证明确传达了所有必要权利（包括专利相关），但 MXM 不符合 OSD 要求，不应获得 OSI 批准。
timeline.point: Argues that BSD/MIT licenses clearly convey all necessary rights including patent-related ones, but the MXM does not meet OSD requirements and should not receive OSI approval.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Notes that ambiguity was resolved in later licenses and expresses concern about others defining software license categories if OSI does not.
timeline.point_zh: 指出后续许可证已解决模糊性，并担心如果 OSI 不作为，其他人将定义软件许可证类别。
timeline.point: Notes that ambiguity was resolved in later licenses and expresses concern about others defining software license categories if OSI does not.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Agrees that MXM should not be called open source and suggests OSI should provide a preferred alternative term such as "Shared Source" or "Source-Available Software" for non-open-source licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 MXM 不应被称为开源，并建议 OSI 应为此类许可证提供首选替代术语，如"Shared Source"或"Source-Available Software"。
timeline.point: Agrees that MXM should not be called open source and suggests OSI should provide a preferred alternative term such as "Shared Source" or "Source-Available Software" for non-open-source licenses.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Counters that non-commercial licenses violate multiple OSD provisions, argues OSI's jurisdiction includes software, and that creating a reference software category would be unhelpful and against OSI's purpose.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳非商业许可证违反多项 OSD 条款，主张 OSI 的管辖权包括软件，认为创建参考软件类别无益且违背 OSI 的宗旨。
timeline.point: Counters that non-commercial licenses violate multiple OSD provisions, argues OSI's jurisdiction includes software, and that creating a reference software category would be unhelpful and against OSI's purpose.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Proposes relaxing only one aspect of OSD #6 for reference/academic licenses, notes Creative Commons has a standard licensing model, and suggests OSI could provide license category wrappers.
timeline.point_zh: 建议仅放宽 OSD #6 的一个方面用于参考/学术许可证，指出 Creative Commons 有标准许可模型，建议 OSI 提供许可证类别包装器。
timeline.point: Proposes relaxing only one aspect of OSD #6 for reference/academic licenses, notes Creative Commons has a standard licensing model, and suggests OSI could provide license category wrappers.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Counters that non-commercial licenses violate OSD #1, #5, and #6, argues OSI's jurisdiction is software, and MXM users would have fewer rights than CC BY-NC-SA.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳非商业许可证违反 OSD #1、#5 和 #6，主张 OSI 的管辖权是软件，MXM 用户的权利少于 CC BY-NC-SA。
timeline.point: Counters that non-commercial licenses violate OSD #1, #5, and #6, argues OSI's jurisdiction is software, and MXM users would have fewer rights than CC BY-NC-SA.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: States the MXM license obviously does not comply with OSD #7, but suggests it could be called Source-Available Software rather than open source.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 MXM 许可证明显不符合 OSD #7，但建议可称为源代码可用软件而非开源。
timeline.point: States the MXM license obviously does not comply with OSD #7, but suggests it could be called Source-Available Software rather than open source.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that if BSD truly lacked an implicit patent license, someone would have exploited this by now, suggesting the patent situation is not as ambiguous as claimed.
timeline.point_zh: 认为如果 BSD 真的没有隐含专利许可，早就有人利用了这一点，暗示专利状况并不如声称的那样模糊。
timeline.point: Argues that if BSD truly lacked an implicit patent license, someone would have exploited this by now, suggesting the patent situation is not as ambiguous as claimed.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Suggests no one has exploited the BSD patent ambiguity because potential targets have been advised that BSD-licensed source comes with no patent licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为没有人利用 BSD 专利模糊性是因为潜在目标已被建议 BSD 许可的源代码不附带专利许可。
timeline.point: Suggests no one has exploited the BSD patent ambiguity because potential targets have been advised that BSD-licensed source comes with no patent licenses.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Agrees the license should be called something other than open source, suggests OSI should provide a preferred term, and notes OSI's jurisdiction is currently limited to open source software.
timeline.point_zh: 同意该许可证应称为其他名称，建议 OSI 提供首选术语，并指出 OSI 的管辖权目前仅限于开源软件。
timeline.point: Agrees the license should be called something other than open source, suggests OSI should provide a preferred term, and notes OSI's jurisdiction is currently limited to open source software.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that if anyone believed BSD lacked an implicit patent license, someone would have asserted it by now, and challenges others to prove otherwise with a single counterexample.
timeline.point_zh: 认为如果有人认为 BSD 缺乏隐含专利许可，早就会有人提出，并挑战他人用一个反例来证明这一点。
timeline.point: Argues that if anyone believed BSD lacked an implicit patent license, someone would have asserted it by now, and challenges others to prove otherwise with a single counterexample.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Counters by citing Roy Fielding's email asserting that BSD and GPL have no patent license grant at all, proving someone did challenge the implicit patent license notion.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Roy Fielding 的邮件反驳，该邮件断言 BSD 和 GPL 完全没有专利许可授权，证明确实有人质疑过隐含专利许可的概念。
timeline.point: Counters by citing Roy Fielding's email asserting that BSD and GPL have no patent license grant at all, proving someone did challenge the implicit patent license notion.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Concludes that the MXM Public License does not pass the OSD test.
timeline.point_zh: 得出结论认为 MXM 公共许可证未通过 OSD 测试。
timeline.point: Concludes that the MXM Public License does not pass the OSD test.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues patent licenses should be explicit rather than implicit, criticizes continued recommendation of BSD due to patent ambiguity, and suggests moving the discussion to another list.
timeline.point_zh: 主张专利许可应明确而非隐含，批评继续推荐 BSD 许可证因其专利模糊性，建议将讨论移至其他列表。
timeline.point: Argues patent licenses should be explicit rather than implicit, criticizes continued recommendation of BSD due to patent ambiguity, and suggests moving the discussion to another list.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that he meant no one has publicly distributed BSD-licensed code while explicitly stating they are not granting a patent license.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清他指的是没有人公开分发 BSD 许可代码的同时明确声明不授予专利许可。
timeline.point: Clarifies that he meant no one has publicly distributed BSD-licensed code while explicitly stating they are not granting a patent license.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Cites Fluendo's MP3 decoder as a counterexample where patent-encumbered code is distributed under MIT license without the ability to grant patent rights.
timeline.point_zh: 以 Fluendo 的 MP3 解码器为反例，说明受专利限制的代码在 MIT 许可下分发但无法授予专利权。
timeline.point: Cites Fluendo's MP3 decoder as a counterexample where patent-encumbered code is distributed under MIT license without the ability to grant patent rights.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Dismisses the Fluendo example because Fluendo does not own the patent and cannot sublicense it to downstream recipients of source code.
timeline.point_zh: 驳回 Fluendo 的例子，因为 Fluendo 不拥有专利且无法将其转授权给源代码的下游接收者。
timeline.point: Dismisses the Fluendo example because Fluendo does not own the patent and cannot sublicense it to downstream recipients of source code.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Questions whether Fluendo's claim about GPL incompatibility of their MP3 plug-in is accurate, and considers it irrelevant to the MXM Public License review.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 Fluendo 关于其 MP3 插件与 GPL 不兼容的说法是否准确，并认为这与 MXM Public License 的审查完全无关。
timeline.point: Questions whether Fluendo's claim about GPL incompatibility of their MP3 plug-in is accurate, and considers it irrelevant to the MXM Public License review.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Argues that the Fluendo example demonstrates cases where code is released under MIT/BSD but the patent license is not passed along with it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Fluendo 的例子证明了存在代码以 MIT/BSD 发布但专利许可并未随之转让的情况。
timeline.point: Argues that the Fluendo example demonstrates cases where code is released under MIT/BSD but the patent license is not passed along with it.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges his proposed test for implicit patent licenses may be flawed, and clarifies that a disproof would require someone distributing patent-encumbered code under BSD and then suing recipients.
timeline.point_zh: 承认其关于隐含专利许可的检验方法可能有缺陷，并澄清反证需要有人在 BSD 下分发含专利的代码然后起诉使用者。
timeline.point: Acknowledges his proposed test for implicit patent licenses may be flawed, and clarifies that a disproof would require someone distributing patent-encumbered code under BSD and then suing recipients.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Questions how one would ever discover a patent lawsuit under BSD if the target corporation preferred to settle privately.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑如果被告是倾向于私下和解的大公司，人们如何才能知道在 BSD 许可下发生过专利诉讼。
timeline.point: Questions how one would ever discover a patent lawsuit under BSD if the target corporation preferred to settle privately.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges a single settlement might go unnoticed, but argues companies usually publicize patent matters for prior art purposes, and compares the patent enforcement process to a Mafia protection racket.
timeline.point_zh: 承认单次和解可能不为人知，但认为公司通常会公开专利事务以寻找在先技术，并将专利执法过程比作黑手党的保护费勒索。
timeline.point: Acknowledges a single settlement might go unnoticed, but argues companies usually publicize patent matters for prior art purposes, and compares the patent enforcement process to a Mafia protection racket.

timeline.subject: For approval: MXM Public license
timeline.snippet: Counters that patent lawsuits are recorded and patent trolls typically publicize settlements even without actual lawsuits, so such cases would likely be discoverable.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称专利诉讼有记录，且专利流氓通常会公开和解事实（即使没有实际诉讼），因此此类案例应该是可以被发现的。
timeline.point: Counters that patent lawsuits are recorded and patent trolls typically publicize settlements even without actual lawsuits, so such cases would likely be discoverable.

submissions.name: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence v1.0

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved after extensive discussion. The license introduced a novel 'grace period' concept for copyleft compliance that raised OSD compliance questions.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the TGPPL for approval and argues that a limited grace period should improve outcomes compared with immediate or unlimited disclosure.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 TGPPL 申请批准，并主张有限的宽限期比立即或无限期披露更有价值。
timeline.point: Submits the TGPPL for approval and argues that a limited grace period should improve outcomes compared with immediate or unlimited disclosure.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges compliance in principle but argues that approval is still questionable because enforcement is hard and the source-release effect is unclear.
timeline.point_zh: 承认其原则上合规，但认为执行困难且源码披露效果不清，因此不一定值得批准。
timeline.point: Acknowledges compliance in principle but argues that approval is still questionable because enforcement is hard and the source-release effect is unclear.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Suggests using an exception to OSL 3.0 instead of drafting a new license, as a way to avoid further license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 建议通过 OSL 3.0 的例外条款实现，而不是另起新许可证，以避免继续扩散许可证。
timeline.point: Suggests using an exception to OSL 3.0 instead of drafting a new license, as a way to avoid further license proliferation.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that a waiver-based approach can work without OSI approval if it only relaxes OSL 3.0 conditions, but adding burdens would require a new license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为若只是放宽 OSL 3.0 条件，采用豁免方式即可；若要增加负担，则必须使用新许可证并走 OSI 审批。
timeline.point: Argues that a waiver-based approach can work without OSI approval if it only relaxes OSL 3.0 conditions, but adding burdens would require a new license.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that OSI may not be sufficiently protecting developers from poor license drafting.
timeline.point_zh: 提出担忧：OSI 可能并未充分保护开源开发者免受糟糕许可证写作的影响。
timeline.point: Raises concern that OSI may not be sufficiently protecting developers from poor license drafting.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Defends the need for a separate license by arguing that the grace-period obligation is an added burden that an exception cannot capture.
timeline.point_zh: 为单独新许可证辩护，认为宽限期义务是额外负担，无法用例外条款表达。
timeline.point: Defends the need for a separate license by arguing that the grace-period obligation is an added burden that an exception cannot capture.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that the license needs formal legal review and warns that the community, not just the writer, bears the risk of amateur drafting.
timeline.point_zh: 主张必须有正式法律审查，并警告风险会由使用该许可证的社区承担，而不只是作者本人。
timeline.point: Argues that the license needs formal legal review and warns that the community, not just the writer, bears the risk of amateur drafting.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether a new license is necessary and warns that an exception-based solution may be better because of proliferation concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑是否真有必要新起许可证，并提醒从许可证扩散角度看，例外方案可能更合适。
timeline.point: Questions whether a new license is necessary and warns that an exception-based solution may be better because of proliferation concerns.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the source-code obligation exists and asks whether the desired result could be written as an exception instead.
timeline.point_zh: 承认源码义务确实存在，并询问是否可改写为例外条款来实现。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the source-code obligation exists and asks whether the desired result could be written as an exception instead.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Explains why he chose a separate TGPPL rather than an exception: he believes the exception approach would be legally ambiguous and insufficient.
timeline.point_zh: 解释为何选择单独的 TGPPL 而非例外条款：他认为例外方案在法律上含糊且不够。
timeline.point: Explains why he chose a separate TGPPL rather than an exception: he believes the exception approach would be legally ambiguous and insufficient.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Warns that the license could be abused to claim open source status without legally releasing source.
timeline.point_zh: 警告该许可证可能被滥用为“开源”名义，而无需依法公开源码。
timeline.point: Warns that the license could be abused to claim open source status without legally releasing source.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Critiques the draft as insufficiently reviewed and says the ambiguity objection can be solved with clearer wording and proper legal approval.
timeline.point_zh: 批评该草案缺乏充分审查，并认为只要措辞清楚且有律师确认，所谓歧义问题可以解决。
timeline.point: Critiques the draft as insufficiently reviewed and says the ambiguity objection can be solved with clearer wording and proper legal approval.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0

timeline.point: Thanks Bruce but insists that the grace-period language still needs to stand as a separate license with its own name and approval status.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should be authoritative on interpreting the OSD it wrote, and that users needing their own legal determinations means OSI is failing its role.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 对其编写的 OSD 应具有解释权；如果用户必须自行作法律判断，说明 OSI 没有履行好职责。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should be authoritative on interpreting the OSD it wrote, and that users needing their own legal determinations means OSI is failing its role.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Defends OSI's authority to define open source because it coined the term, and dismisses the view that OSI does not control OSD compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OSI 定义开源的权威性辩护，理由是 OSI 创造了该术语，并驳斥 OSI 不控制 OSD 合规性的观点。
timeline.point: Defends OSI's authority to define open source because it coined the term, and dismisses the view that OSI does not control OSD compliance.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that the OSD implicitly requires source availability for anyone claiming software is open source, even if not stated in those exact words.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 隐含要求声称软件为开源者提供源代码，即使没有用完全相同的文字明说。
timeline.point: Argues that the OSD implicitly requires source availability for anyone claiming software is open source, even if not stated in those exact words.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Russ's example concerns whether companies should defer to OSI authority or assert their own open-source claims, while accepting that legal counsel may still be prudent.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 Russ 的例子关注公司应服从 OSI 权威还是自行宣称开源，同时承认咨询律师仍可能是谨慎做法。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Russ's example concerns whether companies should defer to OSI authority or assert their own open-source claims, while accepting that legal counsel may still be prudent.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: States that although OSI can err, the Microsoft hypothetical is about whom users should believe when OSI rejects a license but the vendor still calls it open source.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 虽可能犯错，但微软假设讨论的是当 OSI 拒绝某许可证而厂商仍称其开源时，用户应相信谁。
timeline.point: States that although OSI can err, the Microsoft hypothetical is about whom users should believe when OSI rejects a license but the vendor still calls it open source.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Disputes that coining a term gives OSI continuing control over the meaning of open source.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳创造术语就赋予 OSI 持续控制“开源”含义的说法。
timeline.point: Disputes that coining a term gives OSI continuing control over the meaning of open source.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0

timeline.point: Suggests the revised TGPPL problem resembles unauthorized release of internal GPL code, where downstream users may be confused about the code's legal status.

timeline.point: Thanks participants, reports that Tahoe contributors have not objected to GPL/TGPPL dual licensing, and asks for time to digest the discussion before replying substantively.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Warns Zooko that TGPPL's intended transitiveness can be defeated by relicensing under OSL near the end of the proprietary period, making a waiver preferable.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 Zooko，TGPPL 期望的传递性可被在专有期末改用 OSL 发布所破坏，因此豁免可能更合适。
timeline.point: Warns Zooko that TGPPL's intended transitiveness can be defeated by relicensing under OSL near the end of the proprietary period, making a waiver preferable.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether Russ's OSL scenario differs from dual licensing, and raises concern that an impermissible OSL fork could arise from nonseparable TGPPL-only code.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Russ 的 OSL 情形与双许可有何不同，并担心不可分离的 TGPPL-only 代码可能产生不应允许的 OSL 分叉。
timeline.point: Questions whether Russ's OSL scenario differs from dual licensing, and raises concern that an impermissible OSL fork could arise from nonseparable TGPPL-only code.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Says Tahoe may be a worthwhile GPL-using project, but its current dual-licensing practice is irrelevant to license approval.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 Tahoe 或许是很好的 GPL 项目，但其当前双许可实践与许可证审批无关。
timeline.point: Says Tahoe may be a worthwhile GPL-using project, but its current dual-licensing practice is irrelevant to license approval.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Recognizes a limited transitive effect in TGPPL, but concludes its benefits over a simple waiver do not justify adding another license.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 TGPPL 有有限的传递效果，但结论是相较简单豁免，其收益不足以证明新增一个许可证的成本合理。
timeline.point: Recognizes a limited transitive effect in TGPPL, but concludes its benefits over a simple waiver do not justify adding another license.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Corrects Russ's phrase 'proprietary use,' emphasizing that use is distinct from creating derivative works and GPL software may be used in any way.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正 Russ 所说的“专有使用”，强调使用不同于创作衍生作品，GPL 软件可以以任何方式使用。
timeline.point: Corrects Russ's phrase 'proprietary use,' emphasizing that use is distinct from creating derivative works and GPL software may be used in any way.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Accepts the correction, explaining that 'proprietary use' was imprecise because proprietary distribution and use are different concepts.
timeline.point_zh: 接受纠正，说明“专有使用”措辞不当，因为专有分发和使用是不同概念。
timeline.point: Accepts the correction, explaining that 'proprietary use' was imprecise because proprietary distribution and use are different concepts.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Transitive Grace Period Public Licence, v1.0
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for the harsh tone while explaining that the GPL use-versus-derivative-work distinction is important to him.
timeline.point_zh: 为语气严厉道歉，并说明 GPL 中使用与衍生作品的区别对他很重要。
timeline.point: Apologizes for the harsh tone while explaining that the GPL use-versus-derivative-work distinction is important to him.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Argues that "you can" is permissive language not implying obligation, agrees the license is OSD-compliant, and shares reluctance to approve it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为「你可以」属于许可性语言而非义务性表述，同意该许可证符合 OSD，但同样对其获批持保留态度。
timeline.point: Argues that "you can" is permissive language not implying obligation, agrees the license is OSD-compliant, and shares reluctance to approve it.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should not automatically approve every compliant license, as proliferation and redundancy would make code reuse needlessly difficult.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 不应自动批准所有合规许可证，因为许可证的泛滥和冗余会使代码复用变得不必要地困难。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should not automatically approve every compliant license, as proliferation and redundancy would make code reuse needlessly difficult.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Submits Beer-Ware license on behalf of Poul-Henning Kamp for OSI approval, noting its long history, widespread use, and clearly open-source intent; classified as Other/Miscellaneous.
timeline.point_zh: 代 PHK 提交 Beer-Ware 许可证供 OSI 批准，说明其历史悠久、使用广泛、意图明确为开源，归类为 Other/Miscellaneous。
timeline.point: Submits Beer-Ware license on behalf of Poul-Henning Kamp for OSI approval, noting its long history, widespread use, and clearly open-source intent; classified as Other/Miscellaneous.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Argues that Beer-Ware, while OSD-compliant, is yet another redundant permissive license lacking a warranty disclaimer; recommends AFL 3.0 or MIT instead, and says if approved it should be immediately marked deprecated.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Beer-Ware 虽符合 OSD 但属无意义的又一宽松许可证、缺乏免责声明，建议改用 AFL/MIT；若批准应立即归入弃用类。
timeline.point: Argues that Beer-Ware, while OSD-compliant, is yet another redundant permissive license lacking a warranty disclaimer; recommends AFL 3.0 or MIT instead, and says if approved it should be immediately marked deprecated.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Pushes back, arguing some people need "blessed" licenses, questioning the necessity of a warranty disclaimer, and maintaining that a simple license is preferable to a complex one.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳，认为有人需要"受祝福"的许可证、质疑免责声明的必要性，并认为简单许可证比复杂的更可取。
timeline.point: Pushes back, arguing some people need "blessed" licenses, questioning the necessity of a warranty disclaimer, and maintaining that a simple license is preferable to a complex one.

timeline.point: Reiterates that the license is redundant and a waste of review time, notes it will be categorized as duplicative with more popular licenses, and calls for a more efficient process for handling pointless submissions.

timeline.point: Notes that openSUSE has about 70 packages using Beer-Ware, praises its extreme permissiveness and avoidance of legalese, but flags the missing warranty disclaimer as potentially dangerous to authors and suggests an OSD risk-coverage clause.

timeline.point: Reiterates that the license is redundant and pointless, that it was a waste of time, and suggests that ignoring it was probably the best approach all along.

timeline.point: Acknowledges the opposing viewpoints, apologizes for wasting time, and politely ends the discussion.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证的存在是为了施加具有法律约束力的条件，而非仅限于道德约束，并指出 BEER-WARE 从未按规定提交至 license-discuss 讨论。
timeline.point: Argues that licenses exist to impose legally enforceable conditions, not merely moral ones, and points out that BEER-WARE was never submitted to license-discuss as required.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point_zh: 认为 BEER-WARE 违反了多项 OSD 条款，包括要求付费（OSD#1）、歧视宗教反对者（OSD#5）、要求执行额外许可（OSD#7）以及依赖特定技术（OSD#10）。
timeline.point: Contends that BEER-WARE violates multiple OSD provisions: requiring a fee (OSD#1), discriminating against religious objectors (OSD#5), requiring additional license execution (OSD#7), and being predicated on individual technology (OSD#10).

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: States that PHK's jurisdiction has no warranty liability risk, considers further pursuit hopeless, and requests the case be closed.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 PHK 所在司法辖区无保修诉讼风险，认为继续推进无望，请求关闭此案。
timeline.point: States that PHK's jurisdiction has no warranty liability risk, considers further pursuit hopeless, and requests the case be closed.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point_zh: 为 BEER-WARE 许可证辩护，认为它不施加真正的法律义务，没有撤销条款，且不违反 Nelson 所声称的任何 OSD 条款。
timeline.point: Defends the BEER-WARE license by arguing it imposes no real legal obligation, contains no rescission clause, and does not violate any OSD provisions as Russ Nelson claimed.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point: Wilson points out that EU law may not allow warranty disclaimer for software, comparable to GPLv3's language addressing jurisdictions where standard disclaimers are invalid.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point: Humorously dismisses the comparison between EU and US beer.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point: Argues that the BEER-WARE license's beer clause is a voluntary offer like a charitable donation request, not a legal obligation, and people with religious objections can simply abstain.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the tongue-in-cheek nature of the discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 承认该讨论带有调侃性质。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the tongue-in-cheek nature of the discussion.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Argues that the BEER-WARE license's lack of specificity and legalese makes it worse, not better, as demonstrated by the fact that reasonable people can disagree about what its terms actually mean.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 BEER-WARE 许可证缺乏具体性和法律术语使其更糟而非更好，因为合理的人们对其条款的实际含义可能产生分歧。
timeline.point: Argues that the BEER-WARE license's lack of specificity and legalese makes it worse, not better, as demonstrated by the fact that reasonable people can disagree about what its terms actually mean.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Questions whether Russ Nelson's Shakespeare reference was a mistake or deliberately subtle.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 Nelson 的莎士比亚引用是失误还是刻意为之的巧妙安排。
timeline.point: Questions whether Russ Nelson's Shakespeare reference was a mistake or deliberately subtle.

timeline.point: Corrects Russ Nelson that the "kill all the lawyers" line in Henry VI is spoken by Dick the Butcher, not a king.

timeline.point: Clarifies that in his original quote it was the playwright's line, not a character speaking it.

timeline.point: Writes a humorous King Lear parody to joke about the Artistic License's clause count.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Argues that any text in a license must impose legal obligations, and that license terms should be interpreted literally rather than charitably.
timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证中的任何文本都必须具有法律约束力，且许可证条款应按字面意思而非善意进行解释。
timeline.point: Argues that any text in a license must impose legal obligations, and that license terms should be interpreted literally rather than charitably.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]
timeline.snippet: Sarcastically challenges the notion that every sentence in a license must carry legal weight, noting that licenses routinely contain non-binding expressions.
timeline.point_zh: 讽刺性地质疑了许可证中每句话都必须具有法律效力的观点，指出许可证中通常包含不具约束力的表述。
timeline.point: Sarcastically challenges the notion that every sentence in a license must carry legal weight, noting that licenses routinely contain non-binding expressions.

timeline.subject: [repost] [j at uriah.heep.sax.de: For Approval: The beer-ware license]

timeline.point: An anonymous contributor cites case law (S.O.S. v. Payday, Sun Microsystems v. Microsoft) to argue that open source licenses as adhesion contracts are construed against the drafter, making ambiguous terms legally risky.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license's informal terms (buy the author a beer) were not seen as a proper open source license.
