timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Announces SSPL v2, explains the Section 13 revisions made to address source-sharing and OSD 9 concerns, and publishes the revised license text.
timeline.point_zh: 发布 SSPL v2，说明已修改第 13 条以回应源码共享和 OSD 9 担忧，并附上完整修订文本。
timeline.point: Announces SSPL v2, explains the Section 13 revisions made to address source-sharing and OSD 9 concerns, and publishes the revised license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says MongoDB’s abrupt replacement of SSPL v1 destroyed trust and that the company needs years of trust-building before OSI treats it as a serious steward.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MongoDB 突然用 v2 替换 v1 破坏了信任，OSI 应先观察其重建信誉后再把它当认真 steward。
timeline.point: Says MongoDB’s abrupt replacement of SSPL v1 destroyed trust and that the company needs years of trust-building before OSI treats it as a serious steward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Disagrees overall but says OSI should clarify its process and avoid ad hoc vetoes or long proving periods for copyleft licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 整体上不同意对方，但认为 OSI 应澄清流程，避免为 copyleft 许可证设立临时性的拖延或事实否决。
timeline.point: Disagrees overall but says OSI should clarify its process and avoid ad hoc vetoes or long proving periods for copyleft licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Section 13 still lets SSPL restrict unrelated proprietary software, making it a departure from copyleft and a violation of OSD 6 and 9.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第 13 条仍然让 SSPL 限制无关的专有软件，已偏离 copyleft，并违反 OSD 6 和 9。
timeline.point: Says Section 13 still lets SSPL restrict unrelated proprietary software, making it a departure from copyleft and a violation of OSD 6 and 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the upgrade clause creates uncertainty and the Major Components carve-out may undermine the license’s purpose, especially for cloud platforms.
timeline.point_zh: 认为升级条款带来不确定性，而 Major Components 的豁免可能削弱许可证目的，尤其对云平台如此。
timeline.point: Says the upgrade clause creates uncertainty and the Major Components carve-out may undermine the license’s purpose, especially for cloud platforms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL is just a license the community can adopt or fork away from, and argues that MongoDB’s for-profit status is not itself a problem.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 只是社区可接受或自行分叉的许可证，并指出 MongoDB 的营利属性本身不是问题。
timeline.point: Says SSPL is just a license the community can adopt or fork away from, and argues that MongoDB’s for-profit status is not itself a problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says all open source licenses should treat for-profit and hobbyist use equally, while OSI may still consider who stewards a license and why.
timeline.point_zh: 认为所有开源许可证都应平等对待营利与业余使用，同时 OSI 也可以考虑许可证 steward 及其动机。
timeline.point: Says all open source licenses should treat for-profit and hobbyist use equally, while OSI may still consider who stewards a license and why.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Reports that Eliot’s messages are visible in the archive but not reaching his mail server.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 Eliot 的邮件能在归档中看到，但没有送到他的邮件服务器。
timeline.point: Reports that Eliot’s messages are visible in the archive but not reaching his mail server.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Eliot’s mails are landing in his spam folder.
timeline.point_zh: 说 Eliot 的邮件进了他的垃圾邮件文件夹。
timeline.point: Says Eliot’s mails are landing in his spam folder.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Eliot’s mail never reaches his server and any filtering is happening upstream.
timeline.point_zh: 说 Eliot 的邮件根本没到他的服务器，如果有过滤也是上游在处理。
timeline.point: Says Eliot’s mail never reaches his server and any filtering is happening upstream.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Reposts Eliot Horowitz’s revised SSPL v2 for convenience.
timeline.point_zh: 为方便起见转贴 Eliot Horowitz 的 SSPL v2 修订版。
timeline.point: Reposts Eliot Horowitz’s revised SSPL v2 for convenience.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says v2 still has the same problems, because Section 13 is effectively limitless if “Service” is undefined, and calls the effort not in good faith.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 v2 仍有同样问题，因为若不定义“Service”，第 13 条的范围就几乎无限，并指责这不是善意努力。
timeline.point: Says v2 still has the same problems, because Section 13 is effectively limitless if “Service” is undefined, and calls the effort not in good faith.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Explains the archive/mail delivery problem is likely caused by the sender’s DMARC policy and mail provider enforcement.
timeline.point_zh: 解释归档/投递问题很可能是发送方的 DMARC 策略和邮件服务商强制执行所致。
timeline.point: Explains the archive/mail delivery problem is likely caused by the sender’s DMARC policy and mail provider enforcement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Explains the DMARC issue as a mail-list delivery problem and describes how Gmail and Mailman interact with it.
timeline.point_zh: 把 DMARC 问题解释为邮件列表投递故障，并说明 Gmail 与 Mailman 如何相互作用。
timeline.point: Explains the DMARC issue as a mail-list delivery problem and describes how Gmail and Mailman interact with it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Concurs with Eric’s criticism of the revised SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 Eric 对修订版 SSPL 的批评。
timeline.point: Concurs with Eric’s criticism of the revised SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Deshpande’s comments show ignorance of open source and contempt for the community.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Deshpande 的言论暴露出对开源的无知以及对社区的轻蔑。
timeline.point: Says Deshpande’s comments show ignorance of open source and contempt for the community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Notes the Commons Clause relationship and quotes a comment that undercuts Deshpande’s own op-ed.
timeline.point_zh: 提到 Commons Clause 的关系，并引用一段对 Deshpande 专栏自我拆台的评论。
timeline.point: Notes the Commons Clause relationship and quotes a comment that undercuts Deshpande’s own op-ed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says MongoDB is trying to find an innovative open source solution, argues service-based copyleft is appropriate, and says SSPL conforms to the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MongoDB 在努力寻找创新的开源方案，主张基于服务的 copyleft 是合适的，并表示 SSPL 符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Says MongoDB is trying to find an innovative open source solution, argues service-based copyleft is appropriate, and says SSPL conforms to the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the service definition is too broad and partly unenforceable, but ultimately votes to approve SSPL as an experimental license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为对“service”的定义过宽且部分不可执行，但最终仍投票支持将 SSPL 作为实验性许可证批准。
timeline.point: Says the service definition is too broad and partly unenforceable, but ultimately votes to approve SSPL as an experimental license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the wording could require source release for non-derived competing software and needs revision to avoid that reading.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这些措辞可能会把不衍生的竞争软件也卷入源代码义务，需修改措辞以消除这种解读。
timeline.point: Says the wording could require source release for non-derived competing software and needs revision to avoid that reading.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Asks what “service” means in Section 13 and whether SSPL is meant to stop downstream distributors of pre-built binaries.
timeline.point_zh: 询问第 13 条中的“service”究竟是什么意思，以及 SSPL 是否意在阻止下游分发预编译二进制。
timeline.point: Asks what “service” means in Section 13 and whether SSPL is meant to stop downstream distributors of pre-built binaries.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that SSPL Section 13 applies to service use, not distribution, and that it covers running software on behalf of others as a SaaS-style service.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 SSPL 第 13 条只适用于以服务方式使用，而不适用于分发，并且其范围包括代他人运行软件的 SaaS 式服务。
timeline.point: Clarifies that SSPL Section 13 applies to service use, not distribution, and that it covers running software on behalf of others as a SaaS-style service.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Explains that the SSPL was not meant to boost commercial license sales, but to prevent SaaS capture, and says the trigger is narrower than AGPL. The sender says they will revise the language to clarify intent.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 SSPL 不是为了推动商业授权销售，而是为了防止 SaaS 捕获，并称其触发条件比 AGPL 更窄。发件人表示还会继续修改措辞以澄清意图。
timeline.point: Explains that the SSPL was not meant to boost commercial license sales, but to prevent SaaS capture, and says the trigger is narrower than AGPL. The sender says they will revise the language to clarify intent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the SSPL is genuinely open source under the OSD, or only effectively open source for most users while failing in the cases it targets.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 是否真正符合 OSD 下的开源定义，还是只是对大多数用户近似开源、但在其针对的场景中并不算开源。
timeline.point: Asks whether the SSPL is genuinely open source under the OSD, or only effectively open source for most users while failing in the cases it targets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the SSPL would force source disclosure for separate aggregated programs used to run the service, not just for derivative works.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 会要求披露用于运行服务的独立聚合程序源码，而不只是衍生作品。
timeline.point: Argues that the SSPL would force source disclosure for separate aggregated programs used to run the service, not just for derivative works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Questions why MongoDB distinguishes between self-hosted use and paying a cloud provider to run the same software, and says the distinction makes no business sense.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 MongoDB 为什么要区分自建部署和付费由云服务商代运维同一软件，并认为这种区分在商业上说不通。
timeline.point: Questions why MongoDB distinguishes between self-hosted use and paying a cloud provider to run the same software, and says the distinction makes no business sense.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that MongoDB may be protecting its business, but the license should not be branded open source and the community is free to decline participation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 MongoDB 可能是在保护其商业模式，但这种许可证不应被称为开源，外界也可以选择不参与。
timeline.point: Argues that MongoDB may be protecting its business, but the license should not be branded open source and the community is free to decline participation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Accuses MongoDB of using SSPL to block competitors from offering managed MongoDB services and says the license is not open source.
timeline.point_zh: 指责 MongoDB 通过 SSPL 阻止竞争者提供托管 MongoDB 服务，并称该许可证不是开源。
timeline.point: Accuses MongoDB of using SSPL to block competitors from offering managed MongoDB services and says the license is not open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the old AGPL fork still exists, but warns the SSPL fork could become a proprietary entry barrier even if users can usually see through it.
timeline.point_zh: 指出旧的 AGPL 分支仍然存在，但警告 SSPL 分支可能成为专有进入壁垒，尽管用户通常能看穿这种做法。
timeline.point: Says the old AGPL fork still exists, but warns the SSPL fork could become a proprietary entry barrier even if users can usually see through it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the review should focus on the license text itself, not MongoDB's stated intent or broader project context.
timeline.point_zh: 主张审查应只看许可证文本本身，而不是 MongoDB 的意图说明或更大的项目背景。
timeline.point: Argues that the review should focus on the license text itself, not MongoDB's stated intent or broader project context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that MongoDB's fork is structurally different from past relicensing cases because ongoing corporate investment will keep it dominant and may help Atlas compete.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 MongoDB 的分支与以往重新授权案例不同，因为持续的公司投入会让它保持优势，甚至可能帮助 Atlas 竞争。
timeline.point: Argues that MongoDB's fork is structurally different from past relicensing cases because ongoing corporate investment will keep it dominant and may help Atlas compete.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Proposes a new Section 13 that defines SaaS and narrows the copyleft trigger so ordinary backend or value-added SaaS use should not trigger it.
timeline.point_zh: 提出新的第 13 条定义 SaaS，并收窄触发条件，使普通后端使用或增值型 SaaS 使用都不应触发。
timeline.point: Proposes a new Section 13 that defines SaaS and narrows the copyleft trigger so ordinary backend or value-added SaaS use should not trigger it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the revision still wrongly reaches separate programs used alongside the licensed program, and that removing that language would improve compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 认为修订版仍然不当地波及与受许可程序一起使用的独立程序，去掉那段过宽的措辞会更接近合规。
timeline.point: Says the revision still wrongly reaches separate programs used alongside the licensed program, and that removing that language would improve compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that the SSPL violates OSD #9 by encumbering unrelated programs and that its distribution workaround does not solve the issue.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 SSPL 通过牵连无关程序而违反 OSD 第 9 条，且其绕开“分发”一词的做法并不能解决问题。
timeline.point: Reiterates that the SSPL violates OSD #9 by encumbering unrelated programs and that its distribution workaround does not solve the issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the revised Section 13 addresses his main objection and looks better, but he still doubts the review process itself.
timeline.point_zh: 认为修订后的第 13 条回应了他最主要的反对点，也更好了，但他仍然怀疑审查流程本身。
timeline.point: Says the revised Section 13 addresses his main objection and looks better, but he still doubts the review process itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL was never OSD-compliant because its intent conflicts with OSD #6 and #9, so it should not be called open source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 从未符合 OSD，因为其意图与第 6 条和第 9 条冲突，因此不应被称为开源。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL was never OSD-compliant because its intent conflicts with OSD #6 and #9, so it should not be called open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL still fails OSD #6 and #9, and that the SaaS wording changes do not matter until those substantive issues are fixed.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 仍然违反 OSD 第 6 条和第 9 条，而 SaaS 表述的修改在解决这些实质问题前只是表面修饰。
timeline.point: Says SSPL still fails OSD #6 and #9, and that the SaaS wording changes do not matter until those substantive issues are fixed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Defends Bruce's right to be heard and notes that the absence of other participants can be read in different ways.
timeline.point_zh: 为 Bruce 有权发言并被倾听辩护，同时指出缺席者的沉默可以有不同解读。
timeline.point: Defends Bruce's right to be heard and notes that the absence of other participants can be read in different ways.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Bruce should be heard, but reflects on the broader debate by describing competing theories about why many people are absent from the list.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Bruce 应该被听见，同时从更大的讨论角度描述了关于许多人为何缺席该列表的两种相互竞争的解释。
timeline.point: Says Bruce should be heard, but reflects on the broader debate by describing competing theories about why many people are absent from the list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the approval list matters because few people want to do this work and others rely on the list to get it right.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这个批准列表很重要，因为愿意参与许可证审批的人很少，而其他人都在依赖这里把事情做对。
timeline.point: Says the approval list matters because few people want to do this work and others rely on the list to get it right.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyleft inevitably discriminates in some sense, so OSD 6 should not be read as banning SSPL-style triggers, and says the debate falls back on authority rather than clear rules.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 copyleft 本来就会在某种意义上“区别对待”，因此 OSD 第 6 条不应被解释为禁止 SSPL 这类触发方式，并称争论最后只能诉诸权威而非清晰规则。
timeline.point: Argues that copyleft inevitably discriminates in some sense, so OSD 6 should not be read as banning SSPL-style triggers, and says the debate falls back on authority rather than clear rules.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL goes beyond the licensed program by pulling in unrelated software, and that such business-oriented licenses should not be branded open source.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 通过牵连无关软件而越界，这类偏商业化的许可证不应被贴上开源标签。
timeline.point: Says SSPL goes beyond the licensed program by pulling in unrelated software, and that such business-oriented licenses should not be branded open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Thanks the reviewers for their work and says he remains skeptical about SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢评审所付出的努力，并表示自己仍然对 SSPL 持怀疑态度。
timeline.point: Thanks the reviewers for their work and says he remains skeptical about SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Withdraws SSPL from OSI consideration because community consensus is lacking, while saying MongoDB still believes the license is compliant and will keep using it.
timeline.point_zh: 由于缺乏社区共识而撤回 SSPL 的 OSI 审查，同时表示 MongoDB 仍认为该许可证合规并会继续使用。
timeline.point: Withdraws SSPL from OSI consideration because community consensus is lacking, while saying MongoDB still believes the license is compliant and will keep using it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Expresses appreciation for Eliot's clarification and the withdrawal update.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Eliot 的澄清和撤回更新表示感谢。
timeline.point: Expresses appreciation for Eliot's clarification and the withdrawal update.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the SSPL deserved serious consideration, and criticizes the review process as a failure for not giving it that hearing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 值得认真审议，并批评审查流程未能给予其应有的对待。
timeline.point: Says the SSPL deserved serious consideration, and criticizes the review process as a failure for not giving it that hearing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the main objections were about OSD 9, drafting clarity, and legal issues, and asks what a fairer approval process would look like.
timeline.point_zh: 表示主要反对意见集中在 OSD 第 9 条、措辞清晰度和法律问题，并询问更公平的审批流程应如何运作。
timeline.point: Says the main objections were about OSD 9, drafting clarity, and legal issues, and asks what a fairer approval process would look like.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the SSPL review already had substantial discussion and that criticism of MongoDB's business model was relevant rather than merely personal attack.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 的审查当时已经有相当充分的讨论，而且对 MongoDB 商业模式的批评是相关的，而不是单纯的人身攻击。
timeline.point: Argues that the SSPL review already had substantial discussion and that criticism of MongoDB's business model was relevant rather than merely personal attack.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the final month of SSPL discussion was not serious enough, that OSI lost perceived impartiality, and that the process needed a fairer hearing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 最后一个月的讨论不够认真，OSI 失去了公正性的观感，而且整个过程需要更公平的审议。
timeline.point: Argues that the final month of SSPL discussion was not serious enough, that OSI lost perceived impartiality, and that the process needed a fairer hearing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that licenses should be judged on openness and drafting quality, not on the drafter's business model, and that experimentation is acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张应根据自由与开放标准以及起草质量来评价许可证，而不是根据起草者的商业模式，并认为实验性尝试并非坏事。
timeline.point: Argues that licenses should be judged on openness and drafting quality, not on the drafter's business model, and that experimentation is acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the SSPL discussion had become smaller and less substantive, and that business-model criticism can be relevant to how the license will work in practice.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 的讨论当时已经缩小且不那么实质，同时商业模式批评若有助于评估许可证实际效果就是相关的。
timeline.point: Says the SSPL discussion had become smaller and less substantive, and that business-model criticism can be relevant to how the license will work in practice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says extended copyleft models can be explored outside the open source label, and that such licenses should not be called open source.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这类扩展型 copyleft 模式可以在不开源名义下实践，但不应被称作开源。
timeline.point: Says extended copyleft models can be explored outside the open source label, and that such licenses should not be called open source.

submissions.rejection_reason: Withdrawn by MongoDB on 2019-03-09 after extensive community opposition. Community consensus did not support approval due to concerns about OSD #9 violation.

status_review.rationale: Human-calibrated baseline restore after concurrent-run corruption.

submissions.name: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: SSPL's Section 13 extends copyleft to encompass essentially all software used to offer the program as a service, violating OSD #9 (License Must Not Restrict Other Software). Community consensus was that SSPL was not OSD-compliant.

timeline.point_zh: 质疑 MongoDB 取代 FSF 作为许可证管理者，询问是否可作为 AGPL 修订提交，并提出在 AWS 等平台上服务源码的实践问题。
timeline.point: Questions MongoDB replacing FSF stewardship, asks whether SSPL could be offered as an AGPL revision, and raises practical issues around service source code on platforms like AWS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Identifies OSD 9 as SSPL’s main policy issue, says section 13 greatly broadens AGPL copyleft, and warns of ambiguity and compatibility problems.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD 9 是 SSPL 的主要政策问题，称第 13 条大幅扩大 AGPL 的 copyleft 范围，并警告存在含糊和兼容性问题。
timeline.point: Identifies OSD 9 as SSPL’s main policy issue, says section 13 greatly broadens AGPL copyleft, and warns of ambiguity and compatibility problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Raises copyright concerns about modifying FSF license text and argues section 13 may violate OSD 9 and 6 by reaching separately aggregated service software.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修改 FSF 许可证文本的版权疑虑，并认为第 13 条可能因触及单独聚合的服务软件而违反 OSD 9 和 6。
timeline.point: Raises copyright concerns about modifying FSF license text and argues section 13 may violate OSD 9 and 6 by reaching separately aggregated service software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the GPL copyright issue appears moot after reviewing the FSF FAQ on modifying GPL text.
timeline.point_zh: 查看 FSF 关于修改 GPL 文本的 FAQ 后，认为 GPL 版权问题似乎已无实际争议。
timeline.point: Says the GPL copyright issue appears moot after reviewing the FSF FAQ on modifying GPL text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should not review SSPL now because MongoDB used no public drafting process for a major copyleft change, and asks MongoDB to withdraw and seek broad public comment.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 现在不应审查 SSPL，因为 MongoDB 对重大的 copyleft 变更未进行公开起草流程，并要求 MongoDB 撤回并开展广泛公开评议。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should not review SSPL now because MongoDB used no public drafting process for a major copyleft change, and asks MongoDB to withdraw and seek broad public comment.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues for outright rejection because SSPL blurs copyleft boundaries, creates uncertainty, and cannot be rescued by FAQ context outside the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 主张直接拒绝 SSPL，因为它模糊了 copyleft 边界、造成不确定性，且不能依靠许可证文本外的 FAQ 背景来补救。
timeline.point: Argues for outright rejection because SSPL blurs copyleft boundaries, creates uncertainty, and cannot be rescued by FAQ context outside the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that criticism of SSPL is aimed at the license, not MongoDB or its drafters, while suggesting review may need insulation from authority bias.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清对 SSPL 的批评针对许可证而非 MongoDB 或起草者，并提出审查可能需要避免权威偏见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that criticism of SSPL is aimed at the license, not MongoDB or its drafters, while suggesting review may need insulation from authority bias.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that OSI was not involved before MongoDB publicly submitted SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 OSI 在 MongoDB 公开提交 SSPL 之前没有参与。
timeline.point: Confirms that OSI was not involved before MongoDB publicly submitted SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSI should formally require public drafting prospectively, but is reluctant to apply that unwritten requirement retroactively to SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 应正式要求公开起草流程，但不愿把这种未成文要求追溯适用于 SSPL。
timeline.point: Says OSI should formally require public drafting prospectively, but is reluctant to apply that unwritten requirement retroactively to SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the public license-review mailing list itself satisfies the public process need, noting submitters can respond to drafting and OSD concerns there.
timeline.point_zh: 询问公开的 license-review 邮件列表本身是否已满足公开流程需求，并指出提交者可在此回应起草和 OSD 问题。
timeline.point: Questions whether the public license-review mailing list itself satisfies the public process need, noting submitters can respond to drafting and OSD concerns there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: States that MongoDB has not yet spoken with the Free Software Foundation but hopes to discuss SSPL with them soon.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 MongoDB 尚未与自由软件基金会沟通，但希望很快就 SSPL 与其讨论。
timeline.point: States that MongoDB has not yet spoken with the Free Software Foundation but hopes to discuss SSPL with them soon.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Raises concerns that SSPL lacks a definition of service, may be impossible to comply with on GNU/Linux, and asks MongoDB to clarify its real deployment goals.
timeline.point_zh: 提出 SSPL 未定义 service、在 GNU/Linux 上可能无法合规，并要求 MongoDB 澄清其真实部署目标。
timeline.point: Raises concerns that SSPL lacks a definition of service, may be impossible to comply with on GNU/Linux, and asks MongoDB to clarify its real deployment goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Defends strong criticism of MongoDB and SSPL as relevant to license review, rejects double-blind review, and warns that approval would wrongly confer copyleft authority on MongoDB.
timeline.point_zh: 为针对 MongoDB 和 SSPL 的强烈批评辩护，认为其与许可证审查相关；反对双盲审查，并警告批准会错误赋予 MongoDB copyleft 权威。
timeline.point: Defends strong criticism of MongoDB and SSPL as relevant to license review, rejects double-blind review, and warns that approval would wrongly confer copyleft authority on MongoDB.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the AGPL history by noting OSI archives exist and that AGPLv3 was submitted in January 2008 and approved in March 2008.
timeline.point_zh: 更正 AGPL 历史，指出 OSI 档案存在，且 AGPLv3 于 2008 年 1 月提交、3 月获批。
timeline.point: Corrects the AGPL history by noting OSI archives exist and that AGPLv3 was submitted in January 2008 and approved in March 2008.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that his earlier caution was personal, not a call to suppress harsh comments, while noting that detachment from license authors may still help avoid contextual bias.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清此前的谨慎只是个人顾虑，并非要求压制尖锐评论；同时指出与许可证作者保持距离可能有助于避免背景偏见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that his earlier caution was personal, not a call to suppress harsh comments, while noting that detachment from license authors may still help avoid contextual bias.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the mailing list is the public process, urges focus on improving SSPL rather than meta-issues, and discloses recusal because MongoDB is a client.
timeline.point_zh: 认为邮件列表就是公开流程，敦促聚焦改进 SSPL 而非元问题，并披露因 MongoDB 是客户而回避审批决定。
timeline.point: Says the mailing list is the public process, urges focus on improving SSPL rather than meta-issues, and discloses recusal because MongoDB is a client.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Defends SSPL as a needed modern extension of copyleft for networked services, invites practical and normative objections, and says MongoDB will consider clarifications.
timeline.point_zh: 为 SSPL 辩护，称其是面向网络服务的现代 copyleft 扩展；邀请就实践和规范问题提出反对意见，并表示 MongoDB 会考虑澄清。
timeline.point: Defends SSPL as a needed modern extension of copyleft for networked services, invites practical and normative objections, and says MongoDB will consider clarifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL's 'all programs' language adds legal uncertainty and that its service trigger gives paying and non-paying users unequal rights, violating OSD principles.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 中“all programs”措辞增加法律不确定性，且其服务触发条件给予付费与非付费用户不平等权利，违反 OSD 原则。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL's 'all programs' language adds legal uncertainty and that its service trigger gives paying and non-paying users unequal rights, violating OSD principles.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether Simon represents MongoDB and requests that the license drafter speak directly.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Simon 是否代表 MongoDB，并要求许可证起草者直接发言。
timeline.point: Asks whether Simon represents MongoDB and requests that the license drafter speak directly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI license-review is too narrow and time-limited to decide a major copyleft expansion, and urges MongoDB to withdraw SSPL for broader community discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 许可证审查范围窄且时间有限，不适合决定重大 copyleft 扩展，并敦促 MongoDB 撤回 SSPL 进行更广泛社区讨论。
timeline.point: Argues OSI license-review is too narrow and time-limited to decide a major copyleft expansion, and urges MongoDB to withdraw SSPL for broader community discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that he neither represents MongoDB nor drafted SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清自己既不代表 MongoDB，也没有起草 SSPL。
timeline.point: Clarifies that he neither represents MongoDB nor drafted SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports the request that MongoDB withdraw SSPL and move copyleft expansion discussion elsewhere.
timeline.point_zh: 支持要求 MongoDB 撤回 SSPL，并将 copyleft 扩展讨论移至其他场所。
timeline.point: Supports the request that MongoDB withdraw SSPL and move copyleft expansion discussion elsewhere.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Also supports withdrawing SSPL for broader discussion, though does not suggest a venue.
timeline.point_zh: 也支持撤回 SSPL 以进行更广泛讨论，但未建议具体场所。
timeline.point: Also supports withdrawing SSPL for broader discussion, though does not suggest a venue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions MongoDB's stated motives, says SSPL is hard to apply and may block GNU/Linux distribution packaging, while acknowledging interest in cloud copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 MongoDB 的动机，认为 SSPL 难以适用且可能阻碍 GNU/Linux 发行版打包，同时承认对云端 copyleft 有兴趣。
timeline.point: Questions MongoDB's stated motives, says SSPL is hard to apply and may block GNU/Linux distribution packaging, while acknowledging interest in cloud copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that SSPL triggers on mere use rather than modification, which may be a major difference from AGPL and a blocker under OSD 6 or Freedom 0.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 SSPL 仅因使用即触发义务而非修改后使用，这可能是相对 AGPL 的重大差异，并可能违反 OSD 第 6 条或自由 0。
timeline.point: Warns that SSPL triggers on mere use rather than modification, which may be a major difference from AGPL and a blocker under OSD 6 or Freedom 0.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports moving the issue to a broader public process, arguing that companies should no longer craft one-off FOSS licenses behind closed doors.
timeline.point_zh: 支持将此问题移至更广泛的公开流程，认为公司不应再闭门制定一次性的 FOSS 许可证。
timeline.point: Supports moving the issue to a broader public process, arguing that companies should no longer craft one-off FOSS licenses behind closed doors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes precedents where OSI-approved licenses treat network service provision or private modifications as triggering obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 指出已有 OSI 批准许可证将网络服务提供或私下修改作为触发义务的先例。
timeline.point: Notes precedents where OSI-approved licenses treat network service provision or private modifications as triggering obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Endorses Bradley Kuhn's criticism and would support asking MongoDB to withdraw for public drafting if he had standing.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 Bradley Kuhn 的批评，并表示若有资格会支持要求 MongoDB 撤回并进行公开起草。
timeline.point: Endorses Bradley Kuhn's criticism and would support asking MongoDB to withdraw for public drafting if he had standing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes OSL and NPOSL from SSPL because they require only original or derivative source, and says OSL already serves server-side needs without SSPL's source-code risk.
timeline.point_zh: 区分 OSL、NPOSL 与 SSPL，因前者只要求原作品或派生作品源码；并称 OSL 已能满足服务端需求且没有 SSPL 的源码风险。
timeline.point: Distinguishes OSL and NPOSL from SSPL because they require only original or derivative source, and says OSL already serves server-side needs without SSPL's source-code risk.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should only judge OSD compliance, not redefine copyleft, and says SSPL should not use OSI review to bypass the copyleft community.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 只应判断是否符合 OSD，而不应重新定义 copyleft；并称 SSPL 不应借 OSI 审查绕过 copyleft 社区。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should only judge OSD compliance, not redefine copyleft, and says SSPL should not use OSI review to bypass the copyleft community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says license-review is poor for revising radical copyleft but disputes that OSI lacks a role, arguing OSI has historically legitimized stronger copyleft for dual licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 license-review 不适合修订激进 copyleft，但不同意 OSI 无角色，并主张 OSI 历来为双重许可者的更强 copyleft 提供合法性。
timeline.point: Says license-review is poor for revising radical copyleft but disputes that OSI lacks a role, arguing OSI has historically legitimized stronger copyleft for dual licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that OSI's role is only to determine whether a license is open source under the OSD, not to define or extend copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 OSI 的职责只是根据 OSD 判断许可证是否开源，而不是定义或扩展 copyleft。
timeline.point: Reiterates that OSI's role is only to determine whether a license is open source under the OSD, not to define or extend copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports withdrawing the matter from license-review because copyleft limits are too complex for a 60-day mailing-list decision.
timeline.point_zh: 支持将此事撤出 license-review，因为 copyleft 边界过于复杂，不适合在 60 天邮件列表审查中决定。
timeline.point: Supports withdrawing the matter from license-review because copyleft limits are too complex for a 60-day mailing-list decision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Moderates the discussion by asking participants to focus license-review on SSPL's current OSD compliance and move broader procedural or philosophical issues elsewhere.
timeline.point_zh: 以主持身份要求参与者将 license-review 聚焦于 SSPL 当前是否符合 OSD，并把更广泛的程序或哲学问题移至其他列表。
timeline.point: Moderates the discussion by asking participants to focus license-review on SSPL's current OSD compliance and move broader procedural or philosophical issues elsewhere.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPL is likely unenforceable under U.S. copyright misuse and impossibility doctrines because it tries to force disclosure of code outside MongoDB's work.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 在美国法下可能因版权滥用和履行不能而不可执行，因为它试图强制披露 MongoDB 作品之外的代码。
timeline.point: Argues SSPL is likely unenforceable under U.S. copyright misuse and impossibility doctrines because it tries to force disclosure of code outside MongoDB's work.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees with copyright misuse concerns and adds that SSPL may also raise patent misuse issues due to an unbounded patent grant tied to all service-supporting programs.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同版权滥用担忧，并补充 SSPL 还可能因与所有支撑服务程序相关的无限专利授权而产生专利滥用问题。
timeline.point: Agrees with copyright misuse concerns and adds that SSPL may also raise patent misuse issues due to an unbounded patent grant tied to all service-supporting programs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Disagrees that SSPL presents patent misuse, but says the patent license's implied scope is immense and may deter adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意 SSPL 构成专利滥用，但认为其专利许可的隐含范围极大，可能阻碍采用。
timeline.point: Disagrees that SSPL presents patent misuse, but says the patent license's implied scope is immense and may deter adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSD-compliant copyleft extensions are welcome on the list, though SSPL is not there yet, and frames OSI as a Free Software organization.
timeline.point_zh: 表示符合 OSD 的 copyleft 扩展可在列表讨论，尽管 SSPL 尚未达到要求，并将 OSI 定位为自由软件组织。
timeline.point: Says OSD-compliant copyleft extensions are welcome on the list, though SSPL is not there yet, and frames OSI as a Free Software organization.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that SSPL inherits AGPLv3's express patent grant and may require a no-charge patent license for Service Source Code, though whether that is a flaw is debatable.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 SSPL 继承 AGPLv3 的明示专利授权，可能要求对 Service Source Code 提供免费专利许可，但这是否为缺陷仍有争议。
timeline.point: Clarifies that SSPL inherits AGPLv3's express patent grant and may require a no-charge patent license for Service Source Code, though whether that is a flaw is debatable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Requests OSI counsel's view on copyright misuse unless SSPL is withdrawn soon, and asks why the drafter is unidentified and absent from discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 要求除非 SSPL 很快撤回，否则需 OSI 律师评估版权滥用问题，并质疑起草者为何未明确身份且未参与讨论。
timeline.point: Requests OSI counsel's view on copyright misuse unless SSPL is withdrawn soon, and asks why the drafter is unidentified and absent from discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the patent grant is express but its Service Source Code scope is massively broad, likely intended as a feature but drafted as a bug.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清专利授权是明示的，但 Service Source Code 定义带来的范围极其宽泛，可能本意是特性却被写成缺陷。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the patent grant is express but its Service Source Code scope is massively broad, likely intended as a feature but drafted as a bug.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that Eliot's initial submission identified Heather Meeker as the lawyer involved.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Eliot 在最初提交中说明参与律师是 Heather Meeker。
timeline.point: Notes that Eliot's initial submission identified Heather Meeker as the lawyer involved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL's undefined term 'functionality' is extremely problematic because it could be read to restrict any software with MongoDB-like functionality.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 未定义的“functionality”极有问题，因为可能被解读为限制任何具有 MongoDB 类似功能的软件。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL's undefined term 'functionality' is extremely problematic because it could be read to restrict any software with MongoDB-like functionality.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the protective aim is intentional and legitimate, but says OSD 6 and 9 set limits that SSPL may exceed and may not enforceably cross.
timeline.point_zh: 承认保护开源创作者的目标是有意且正当的，但认为 OSD 第 6、9 条设定了边界，SSPL 可能越界且未必可执行。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the protective aim is intentional and legitimate, but says OSD 6 and 9 set limits that SSPL may exceed and may not enforceably cross.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that contractual language could use the defined term "public performance" to create a public-performance-like obligation for software, despite copyright law not granting that right for software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张可以在合同语言中使用已有的“公开表演”概念，为软件构造类似公开表演的义务，尽管版权法本身未赋予软件这种权利。
timeline.point: Argues that contractual language could use the defined term "public performance" to create a public-performance-like obligation for software, despite copyright law not granting that right for software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL does not create copyright misuse because it does not bar independent competing implementations, only closed services using MongoDB's own implementation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 不构成版权滥用，因为它并未禁止独立竞争实现，只是限制使用 MongoDB 自身实现提供闭源服务。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL does not create copyright misuse because it does not bar independent competing implementations, only closed services using MongoDB's own implementation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that contract is not necessarily the only legal tool for network copyleft, because later cases blurred the license-contract boundary and adjacent movements use broader approaches.
timeline.point_zh: 主张网络 copyleft 未必只能依赖合同法，因为后续案例模糊了许可证与合同的边界，相关运动也采用了更宽的路径。
timeline.point: Argues that contract is not necessarily the only legal tool for network copyleft, because later cases blurred the license-contract boundary and adjacent movements use broader approaches.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that comments about SSPL are welcome on the thread, while broader procedural or philosophical discussions should move to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清有关 SSPL 的评论仍欢迎在该线程讨论，但更广泛的程序性或哲学性问题应移至 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Clarifies that comments about SSPL are welcome on the thread, while broader procedural or philosophical discussions should move to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL likely creates copyright misuse by extending control to non-derivative software and restricting competition that other open source licenses would allow.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 可能构成版权滥用，因为它把控制扩展到非衍生软件，并限制其他开源许可证本会允许的竞争。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL likely creates copyright misuse by extending control to non-derivative software and restricting competition that other open source licenses would allow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: States that some people disagree with the claim being discussed, without developing a substantive license position.
timeline.point_zh: 表示有人不同意正在讨论的说法，但未展开具体的许可证立场。
timeline.point: States that some people disagree with the claim being discussed, without developing a substantive license position.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says such disagreement may exist, but should no longer be within OSI's scope.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这种分歧可以存在，但不应再属于 OSI 的范围。
timeline.point: Says such disagreement may exist, but should no longer be within OSI's scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should focus on open source as distinct from free software, rather than treating itself as a free software organization.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 应专注于区别于自由软件的开源定位，而不是把自身视为自由软件组织。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should focus on open source as distinct from free software, rather than treating itself as a free software organization.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Directs the list to keep license-review focused on reviewing licenses and move other licensing discussions to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 license-review 列表专注于许可证审查，并将其他许可相关讨论移至 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Directs the list to keep license-review focused on reviewing licenses and move other licensing discussions to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether SSPL review should proceed or be deferred, while saying SSPL is personally a bridge too far and should be assessed from an open source perspective.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 审查应继续还是延期，同时表示个人认为 SSPL 走得太远，并应从开源视角评估。
timeline.point: Asks whether SSPL review should proceed or be deferred, while saying SSPL is personally a bridge too far and should be assessed from an open source perspective.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL has obvious problems and that rejection is inevitable unless MongoDB's drafter engages constructively to fix them.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 存在明显问题，除非 MongoDB 起草方建设性地参与修正，否则被拒不可避免。
timeline.point: Says SSPL has obvious problems and that rejection is inevitable unless MongoDB's drafter engages constructively to fix them.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues for MongoDB that copyright misuse is speculative, rarely successful, and not a reason to reject SSPL because source-code sharing is not anticompetitive.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 MongoDB 主张版权滥用抗辩只是推测且很少成功，不应成为拒绝 SSPL 的理由，因为共享源代码并非反竞争行为。
timeline.point: Argues for MongoDB that copyright misuse is speculative, rarely successful, and not a reason to reject SSPL because source-code sharing is not anticompetitive.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL does not violate OSD 6 because its rules are facially the same for all fields, even if different deployment choices trigger different copyleft obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 不违反 OSD 6，因为其规则表面上适用于所有领域，即使不同部署选择会触发不同 copyleft 义务。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL does not violate OSD 6 because its rules are facially the same for all fields, even if different deployment choices trigger different copyleft obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that MongoDB did not intend compilation to trigger Section 13 service obligations and will consider clarifying the license.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 MongoDB 无意让编译行为触发第 13 条的服务义务，并会考虑是否需要澄清许可证。
timeline.point: Clarifies that MongoDB did not intend compilation to trigger Section 13 service obligations and will consider clarifying the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL violates OSD 6 and 9 by discriminating against service providers and blocking use of AGPL third-party infrastructure software; urges withdrawal until fixed.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 因歧视服务提供者并阻止使用 AGPL 第三方基础设施软件而违反 OSD 6 和 9，建议在修正前撤回。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL violates OSD 6 and 9 by discriminating against service providers and blocking use of AGPL third-party infrastructure software; urges withdrawal until fixed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions the argument that SSPL prevents otherwise lawful copies, suggesting noncompliance with Section 13 would make the copies unlawful and the reasoning circular.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 SSPL 阻止本来合法复制的说法，认为未遵守第 13 条则复制并不合法，因此该论证可能是循环的。
timeline.point: Questions the argument that SSPL prevents otherwise lawful copies, suggesting noncompliance with Section 13 would make the copies unlawful and the reasoning circular.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether MongoDB had permission to base SSPL on the GPL text, saying the license would be dead on arrival if not.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 MongoDB 是否获准以 GPL 文本为基础起草 SSPL，并表示若没有许可则该许可证根本无法成立。
timeline.point: Asks whether MongoDB had permission to base SSPL on the GPL text, saying the license would be dead on arrival if not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL may violate OSD 5 by giving downstream users different rights and urges withdrawal for a broader community process including end users.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 可能因赋予下游用户不同权利而违反 OSD 5，并敦促撤回，改由包含终端用户的社区流程评估。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL may violate OSD 5 by giving downstream users different rights and urges withdrawal for a broader community process including end users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Answers that using GPL text is not an issue because the FSF permits copying its licenses if the preamble is removed.
timeline.point_zh: 回答称使用 GPL 文本不是问题，因为 FSF 允许在删除序言后复制其许可证文本。
timeline.point: Answers that using GPL text is not an issue because the FSF permits copying its licenses if the preamble is removed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL clearly fails OSD 9 and likely OSD 6 because Section 13 reaches non-derivative programs and may be impossible to comply with.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 明显不符合 OSD 9，并可能违反 OSD 6，因为第 13 条触及非衍生程序且实际合规可能不可能。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL clearly fails OSD 9 and likely OSD 6 because Section 13 reaches non-derivative programs and may be impossible to comply with.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that SSPL fails OSD 6 and 9, while noting that some hypotheticals are mooted by the operating system and system libraries exception.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 SSPL 不符合 OSD 6 和 9，但指出部分假设因操作系统和系统库例外而不成立。
timeline.point: Agrees that SSPL fails OSD 6 and 9, while noting that some hypotheticals are mooted by the operating system and system libraries exception.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that Section 13 requires relicensing build tools under SSPL because system-library exceptions do not apply when those tools themselves are the source-code target.
timeline.point_zh: 主张第 13 条要求将构建工具重新许可为 SSPL，因为当这些工具本身成为源码对象时，系统库例外并不适用。
timeline.point: Argues that Section 13 requires relicensing build tools under SSPL because system-library exceptions do not apply when those tools themselves are the source-code target.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL either reaches too far into upstream web-service users or becomes ineffective, and in either case functions like a non-OSD noncommercial restriction violating OSD 6 or 9.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 要么过度延伸到上游网络服务用户，要么失去效果；无论哪种情况都类似不符合 OSD 的非商业限制，并违反 OSD 6 或 9。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL either reaches too far into upstream web-service users or becomes ineffective, and in either case functions like a non-OSD noncommercial restriction violating OSD 6 or 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Urges OSI to continue evaluating SSPL even if withdrawn and, if warranted, state that it violates the OSD to prevent MongoDB from implying open-source status.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促 OSI 即使在 SSPL 被撤回后也继续评估，并在必要时明确其违反 OSD，以防 MongoDB 暗示其开源地位。
timeline.point: Urges OSI to continue evaluating SSPL even if withdrawn and, if warranted, state that it violates the OSD to prevent MongoDB from implying open-source status.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI generally does not declare licenses non-open-source and that non-certification or withdrawal does not itself determine OSD conformance.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 OSI 通常不会公开宣称某许可证不是开源，且未认证或撤回本身并不决定其是否符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI generally does not declare licenses non-open-source and that non-certification or withdrawal does not itself determine OSD conformance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Maintains that SSPL raises copyright misuse and impracticability issues because it tries to control unrelated works and likely would not operate as MongoDB intends.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为 SSPL 存在版权滥用和履行不能问题，因为它试图控制无关作品，且很可能无法按 MongoDB 期望运作。
timeline.point: Maintains that SSPL raises copyright misuse and impracticability issues because it tries to control unrelated works and likely would not operate as MongoDB intends.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks why critics see a paying-user distinction, arguing SSPL triggers on offering functionality as a service regardless of payment and provides source to everyone free of charge.
timeline.point_zh: 询问批评者为何认为存在付费用户区分，并主张 SSPL 无论是否收费都因作为服务提供功能而触发，且源码免费提供给所有人。
timeline.point: Asks why critics see a paying-user distinction, arguing SSPL triggers on offering functionality as a service regardless of payment and provides source to everyone free of charge.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks why SSPL uses "includes, without limitation" in Section 13, suggesting the examples may be redundant and make the license unnecessarily confusing.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 第 13 条为何使用“包括但不限于”措辞，并指出这些示例可能冗余且使许可证不必要地混乱。
timeline.point: Asks why SSPL uses "includes, without limitation" in Section 13, suggesting the examples may be redundant and make the license unnecessarily confusing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether "includes, without limitation" expands Section 13 and says, if so, SSPL gives users different rights based on their business relationship with the service operator.
timeline.point_zh: 询问“包括但不限于”是否扩展第 13 条，并表示若是如此，SSPL 就会根据用户与服务运营者的商业关系赋予不同权利。
timeline.point: Asks whether "includes, without limitation" expands Section 13 and says, if so, SSPL gives users different rights based on their business relationship with the service operator.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues for MongoDB that critics need current case law showing SSPL is prima facie copyright misuse, and that patent misuse analogies do not establish such a rule.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 MongoDB 主张批评者需拿出现行判例证明 SSPL 表面上构成版权滥用，而专利滥用类比并不能确立此规则。
timeline.point: Argues for MongoDB that critics need current case law showing SSPL is prima facie copyright misuse, and that patent misuse analogies do not establish such a rule.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyright misuse is secondary to SSPL's OSD conformance and that review should focus on OSD 9, 5, 6, and impracticability rather than enforceability speculation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权滥用相对于 SSPL 是否符合 OSD 是次要问题，审查应聚焦 OSD 9、5、6 和履行困难，而非可执行性推测。
timeline.point: Argues that copyright misuse is secondary to SSPL's OSD conformance and that review should focus on OSD 9, 5, 6, and impracticability rather than enforceability speculation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Points readers to a StackExchange answer summarizing the SSPL discussion so far.
timeline.point_zh: 指引读者查看一个 StackExchange 回答，其中总结了目前为止的 SSPL 讨论。
timeline.point: Points readers to a StackExchange answer summarizing the SSPL discussion so far.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Summarizes MongoDB's defense of SSPL: it does not facially discriminate, may need compatibility and scope clarifications, inherits GPL source exceptions, and lacks clear misuse problems.
timeline.point_zh: 总结 MongoDB 对 SSPL 的辩护：它表面上不歧视，可能需澄清兼容性和范围，继承 GPL 源码例外，且没有明确的滥用问题。
timeline.point: Summarizes MongoDB's defense of SSPL: it does not facially discriminate, may need compatibility and scope clarifications, inherits GPL source exceptions, and lacks clear misuse problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPLv1 conforms to the OSD, though the OSD may not clearly define copyleft limits and OSI should transparently state any additional criteria.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPLv1 符合 OSD，但 OSD 可能未清楚界定 copyleft 边界，OSI 应透明说明任何额外标准。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPLv1 conforms to the OSD, though the OSD may not clearly define copyleft limits and OSI should transparently state any additional criteria.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that accepting SSPL would create a network-copyleft loophole for restrictions the OSD forbids, so the license should be withdrawn or rejected.
timeline.point_zh: 主张接受 SSPL 会为 OSD 禁止的限制开辟网络 copyleft 漏洞，因此该许可证应撤回或拒绝。
timeline.point: Argues that accepting SSPL would create a network-copyleft loophole for restrictions the OSD forbids, so the license should be withdrawn or rejected.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL sacrifices important freedoms for a profit-oriented dual-licensing business model and should be denied as not open source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 为以利润为导向的双重许可商业模式牺牲重要自由，因此应被拒绝为非开源。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL sacrifices important freedoms for a profit-oriented dual-licensing business model and should be denied as not open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyleft inherently distinguishes among development choices, and that SSPL-like network distinctions are not the discrimination prohibited by OSD 5 or 6.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 copyleft 本身会区分开发选择，而 SSPL 式的网络区分并不是 OSD 5 或 6 所禁止的歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that copyleft inherently distinguishes among development choices, and that SSPL-like network distinctions are not the discrimination prohibited by OSD 5 or 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that copyleft has always fit awkwardly with OSD 5 and 6, noting GPLv3 also imposes different obligations without being treated as OSD 6 discrimination.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 copyleft 一直与 OSD 5 和 6 尤其是 6 存在张力，并指出 GPLv3 也施加不同义务但未被视为违反 OSD 6。
timeline.point: Agrees that copyleft has always fit awkwardly with OSD 5 and 6, noting GPLv3 also imposes different obligations without being treated as OSD 6 discrimination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Defends network copyleft as a profitable FOSS model for developers and argues that software under such a model remains FOSS.
timeline.point_zh: 为网络 copyleft 辩护，认为它是开发者可获利的 FOSS 模式，并主张这种模式下的软件仍是 FOSS。
timeline.point: Defends network copyleft as a profitable FOSS model for developers and argues that software under such a model remains FOSS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSD 5 discrimination concerns inherent characteristics or unrelated behaviors, not choices about consuming, distributing, or modifying software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 5 中的歧视针对固有特征或与软件使用无关的行为，而非消费、分发或修改软件的方式选择。
timeline.point: Argues that OSD 5 discrimination concerns inherent characteristics or unrelated behaviors, not choices about consuming, distributing, or modifying software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPLv1 is a business-oriented hybrid copyleft that does not reflect activist or software-freedom goals, and questions whether broad business support is enough for approval.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPLv1 主要迎合商业和竞争性用途，不符合软件自由或反知识产权立场，并质疑仅有企业支持是否足以批准。
timeline.point: Argues SSPLv1 is a business-oriented hybrid copyleft that does not reflect activist or software-freedom goals, and questions whether broad business support is enough for approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyleft is not discriminatory in the OSD 5/6 sense, and says SSPL does not appear discriminatory even though the sender does not like it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 copyleft 并不构成 OSD 5/6 意义上的歧视，并表示虽然不太喜欢 SSPL，但不认为它构成歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that copyleft is not discriminatory in the OSD 5/6 sense, and says SSPL does not appear discriminatory even though the sender does not like it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that GPL-family licenses and SSPL/LZPL do not bar any person from using software, but says they still violate OSD 9 by imposing terms on other software and deserves a board ruling.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 GPL 系列、SSPL 和 LZPL 都没有排除任何人使用软件，但仍因要求“其他软件”受其约束而违反 OSD 9，并希望董事会裁定。
timeline.point: Argues that GPL-family licenses and SSPL/LZPL do not bar any person from using software, but says they still violate OSD 9 by imposing terms on other software and deserves a board ruling.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSD 9 is the main problem because SSPL’s Service Source Code requirement is far broader than AGPL’s corresponding-source rule, and the carve-outs probably are not enough for OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 认为核心问题在于 OSD 9，因为 SSPL 对“服务源代码”的要求远宽于 AGPL 的对应源代码义务，而系统库等豁免大概不足以满足 OSI。
timeline.point: Says OSD 9 is the main problem because SSPL’s Service Source Code requirement is far broader than AGPL’s corresponding-source rule, and the carve-outs probably are not enough for OSI.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSD 9 is the wrong place to decide how far copyleft may reach, then compares AGPL and SSPL loopholes and defends strong copyleft across networked and containerized deployments.
timeline.point_zh: 主张不要用 OSD 9 来决定 copyleft 到底能延伸多远，并以 AGPL/SSPL 的漏洞为例，为强 copyleft 跨越网络和容器部署辩护。
timeline.point: Argues that OSD 9 is the wrong place to decide how far copyleft may reach, then compares AGPL and SSPL loopholes and defends strong copyleft across networked and containerized deployments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says that putting a GPL component into an application means the application must be GPLed or not distributed.
timeline.point_zh: 认为只要把 GPL 组件放进应用，就必须将整个应用改为 GPL 或停止分发。
timeline.point: Says that putting a GPL component into an application means the application must be GPLed or not distributed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Uses GPLv2 as a reductio to argue that OSD 9 cannot mean any restriction on other software, because that reading would wrongly exclude GPLv2.
timeline.point_zh: 以 GPLv2 作反证，说明 OSD 9 不可能被理解为“任何对其他软件的限制都不行”，否则会把 GPLv2 也排除在外。
timeline.point: Uses GPLv2 as a reductio to argue that OSD 9 cannot mean any restriction on other software, because that reading would wrongly exclude GPLv2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues MongoDB may be using SSPL to pressure users into proprietary licenses, and says the license must be judged in that political context.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MongoDB 可能利用 SSPL 迫使用户购买专有许可，并主张必须结合这一政治背景来评估该许可证。
timeline.point: Argues MongoDB may be using SSPL to pressure users into proprietary licenses, and says the license must be judged in that political context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL’s source-access expansion is excessive and clearly runs into OSD 9, with possible collateral discrimination that already justifies rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 的源代码义务扩张到荒谬范围，明显触碰 OSD 9，并且可能附带违反 OSD 5/6，因此足以据此拒绝。
timeline.point: Says SSPL’s source-access expansion is excessive and clearly runs into OSD 9, with possible collateral discrimination that already justifies rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL should be judged on its own merits, supports strong copyleft and dual licensing, and explicitly backs SSPLv1 as a useful hybrid for companies and future licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 认为应按 SSPL 自身而非其作者意图来评估，支持强 copyleft 和双重许可，并明确表示支持 SSPLv1 作为对公司有用的混合型许可。
timeline.point: Says SSPL should be judged on its own merits, supports strong copyleft and dual licensing, and explicitly backs SSPLv1 as a useful hybrid for companies and future licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues MongoDB’s identity and intent are irrelevant, copyleft is just a tool, and SSPL should be judged on its merits like other strong copyleft licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MongoDB 的身份和意图不应左右判断，copyleft 只是工具，SSPL 应像其他强 copyleft 许可证一样按其自身优劣评估。
timeline.point: Argues MongoDB’s identity and intent are irrelevant, copyleft is just a tool, and SSPL should be judged on its merits like other strong copyleft licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the broad OSD 9 reading as a useful frame, but says SSPL still has an enormous OSD 9 problem and stands by that objection.
timeline.point_zh: 认为把争论框进 OSD 9 并无帮助，但仍坚持 SSPL 存在严重的 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Rejects the broad OSD 9 reading as a useful frame, but says SSPL still has an enormous OSD 9 problem and stands by that objection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)

timeline.point_zh: 认为提交者意图不是关键，copyleft 本就用于排除非自由开发者，SSPL 更强的 copyleft 并不因此构成 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Says submitter intent is beside the point, copyleft is meant to exclude nonfree developers, and SSPL’s stronger copyleft is not itself a problem under OSD 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the thread has drifted outside license-review and he prefers not to comment further.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该子线程已偏离 license-review 的范围，因此不再继续评论。
timeline.point: Says the thread has drifted outside license-review and he prefers not to comment further.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)

timeline.point_zh: 通报 MongoDB 正在跟进反馈，并将发布修订版和汇总回应。
timeline.point: Gives an update that MongoDB is reviewing feedback and will issue a revised SSPL and consolidated response.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the open-core framing avoids consensus about whether open core should be encouraged, then asks whether the old “Open Core” blog post is an official OSI position.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 open core 的讨论可避免是否应鼓励该模式的共识问题，并询问那篇“Open Core”旧博文是否代表 OSI 官方立场。
timeline.point: Argues the open-core framing avoids consensus about whether open core should be encouraged, then asks whether the old “Open Core” blog post is an official OSI position.

timeline.snippet: Says the post was on acoliver’s personal blog, not an official board statement, and the “administrator” label looks like a migration artifact.

timeline.point: Says the post was on acoliver’s personal blog, not an official board statement, and the “administrator” label looks like a migration artifact.

timeline.point_zh: 认为该页面的标注容易误导，因为它显示在“From the Board”下，但仍标为 acoliver 的博客。
timeline.point: Says the page labeling is confusing because the post appears under “From the Board” even though it is still marked as acoliver’s blog.
