submissions.name: License Zero Reciprocal Public License (Rewrite)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Rewritten version of L0-R was also effectively withdrawn by the submitter after continued community opposition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal	Public License
timeline.snippet: Submits a revised License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R) for OSI approval. L0-R implements strong copyleft triggered on modification, development, and running of software (not just distribution), with explicit patent grants and flexible relicensing options for downstream code.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订版 License Zero 互惠公共许可证 (L0-R) 申请 OSI 审批。L0-R 实施强 copyleft，触发条件包括修改、开发和运行软件（不仅限分发），包含明确的专利授权和下游代码灵活的再许可选项。
timeline.point: Submits a revised License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R) for OSI approval. L0-R implements strong copyleft triggered on modification, development, and running of software (not just distribution), with explicit patent grants and flexible relicensing options for downstream code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Praises the rewritten L0-R as beautifully accomplished and OSD conformant. Doubts OSI approval is critical for License Zero's success, noting it would likely be banned by Google regardless.
timeline.point_zh: 赞扬修订后的 L0-R 写得很好且符合 OSD。质疑 OSI 批准对 License Zero 成功的重要性，指出即使获批也可能被 Google 等列入禁止名单。
timeline.point: Praises the rewritten L0-R as beautifully accomplished and OSD conformant. Doubts OSI approval is critical for License Zero's success, noting it would likely be banned by Google regardless.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Expresses gratitude for positive feedback but admits uncertainty about OSD 6 and OSD 9 compliance boundaries. Emphasizes that OSI approval remains a very important objective for L0-R because developers want their work recognized as open source.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢正面反馈，但承认不确定 OSD 6 和 OSD 9 的合规边界。强调 OSI 批准对 L0-R 仍然非常重要，因为开发者希望其作品被认可为开源。
timeline.point: Expresses gratitude for positive feedback but admits uncertainty about OSD 6 and OSD 9 compliance boundaries. Emphasizes that OSI approval remains a very important objective for L0-R because developers want their work recognized as open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises four difficult policy questions about L0-R: whether copyleft can apply to private modifications, whether incorporation into other software triggers copyleft, whether running the software can trigger copyleft on unrelated output, and whether OSI should approve a license primarily designed for dual-licensing. Also asks about FSF free software recognition.
timeline.point_zh: 提出关于 L0-R 的四个困难政策问题：copyleft 能否适用于私有修改、合并到其他软件是否触发 copyleft、运行软件能否对无关输出触发 copyleft，以及 OSI 是否应批准主要为双重许可设计的许可证。还询问 FSF 自由软件认定计划。
timeline.point: Raises four difficult policy questions about L0-R: whether copyleft can apply to private modifications, whether incorporation into other software triggers copyleft, whether running the software can trigger copyleft on unrelated output, and whether OSI should approve a license primarily designed for dual-licensing. Also asks about FSF free software recognition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that clause 5 (requiring source release of software generated by running L0-R software) violates the spirit of OSD 9, even if not the letter. Suggests this exploits a drafting oversight in OSD 9 and that traditional copyleft (GPL/AGPL style) is as far as open source should go.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第 5 条（要求释放由运行 L0-R 软件生成的软件的源码）违反了 OSD 9 的精神，即使不违反字面意思。建议这利用了 OSD 9 的起草疏漏，传统 copyleft（GPL/AGPL 风格）应是开源的极限。
timeline.point: Argues that clause 5 (requiring source release of software generated by running L0-R software) violates the spirit of OSD 9, even if not the letter. Suggests this exploits a drafting oversight in OSD 9 and that traditional copyleft (GPL/AGPL style) is as far as open source should go.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Responds to all four policy questions. Argues that restricting copyleft to distribution-only triggers handicaps it against proprietary licenses. Clarifies that L0-R is not about proprietary relicensing. Acknowledges uncertainty about FSF recognition but notes copyleft's roots in free software philosophy.
timeline.point_zh: 回应四个政策问题。主张将 copyleft 限制为仅分发触发会使其在与专有许可证竞争时处于劣势。澄清 L0-R 不是为了专有再许可。承认对 FSF 认定的不确定性，但指出 copyleft 植根于自由软件哲学。
timeline.point: Responds to all four policy questions. Argues that restricting copyleft to distribution-only triggers handicaps it against proprietary licenses. Clarifies that L0-R is not about proprietary relicensing. Acknowledges uncertainty about FSF recognition but notes copyleft's roots in free software philosophy.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Reinterprets OSD 9 as protecting common carriers (distribution intermediaries) rather than restricting copyleft scope. Argues developer tools are precisely where copyleft should apply, as they are directed at developer-kind and existing copyleft licenses like AGPL don't serve them well. Advocates for OSD revision to preserve rationale.
timeline.point_zh: 重新解读 OSD 9 为保护分发中间商而非限制 copyleft 范围。主张 developer tools 恰恰是 copyleft 应该适用的地方，因为它们面向开发者，且现有 copyleft 许可证如 AGPL 无法很好地服务它们。倡导修订 OSD 以保留其理由。
timeline.point: Reinterprets OSD 9 as protecting common carriers (distribution intermediaries) rather than restricting copyleft scope. Argues developer tools are precisely where copyleft should apply, as they are directed at developer-kind and existing copyleft licenses like AGPL don't serve them well. Advocates for OSD revision to preserve rationale.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues clause 5 violates OSD 6 because it forces relicensing of input programs as open source merely from being processed by L0-R software (e.g., a line counter or compiler). This would make passive users infringers and is absurd in cases like Gentoo building from source.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第 5 条违反 OSD 6，因为仅因被 L0-R 软件处理（如行数统计器或编译器）就强制将输入程序重新许可为开源。这会使被动用户成为侵权者，在 Gentoo 从源码构建等场景下是荒谬的。
timeline.point: Argues clause 5 violates OSD 6 because it forces relicensing of input programs as open source merely from being processed by L0-R software (e.g., a line counter or compiler). This would make passive users infringers and is absurd in cases like Gentoo building from source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises detailed drafting concerns about L0-R: warranty disclaimer conspicuousness under UCC/UCITA, inconsistent copyright/patent language, ambiguous grammar in clause 2, undefined term extension, potential OSD 9 issues with clause 4, and clause 5 violations of OSD 9's logical implications.
timeline.point_zh: 提出 L0-R 的详细起草问题：担保免责声明在 UCC/UCITA 下的显著性、版权/专利语言不一致、第 2 条语法歧义、未定义术语 extension、第 4 条潜在 OSD 9 问题、第 5 条违反 OSD 9 逻辑含义。
timeline.point: Raises detailed drafting concerns about L0-R: warranty disclaimer conspicuousness under UCC/UCITA, inconsistent copyright/patent language, ambiguous grammar in clause 2, undefined term extension, potential OSD 9 issues with clause 4, and clause 5 violations of OSD 9's logical implications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that simple aggregation should not trigger the license, but combination into a single program should. Would prefer the trigger not be limited to creation of a derivative work, since copyright law is unhelpful there.
timeline.point_zh: 同意简单聚合不应触发许可证，但组合成单一程序应该触发。倾向于触发条件不限于创作衍生作品，因为版权法在此方面不够明确。
timeline.point: Agrees that simple aggregation should not trigger the license, but combination into a single program should. Would prefer the trigger not be limited to creation of a derivative work, since copyright law is unhelpful there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Provides reference to the UCC requirement of conspicuous notice (UCC 2-316) and notes that UCITA adds safe harbor provisions for visual appearance of text, with an unresolved conflict with the Magnuson-Moss Act.
timeline.point_zh: 提供 UCC 显著性通知要求（UCC 2-316）的参考，并指出 UCITA 为文本外观增加了安全港条款，与 Magnuson-Moss 法案存在未解决的冲突。
timeline.point: Provides reference to the UCC requirement of conspicuous notice (UCC 2-316) and notes that UCITA adds safe harbor provisions for visual appearance of text, with an unresolved conflict with the Magnuson-Moss Act.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Responds to all drafting critiques: defends warranty disclaimer as conspicuous under UCC/UCITA using asterisks and case law; explains deliberate copyright/patent terminology choices; proposes clause revisions (rearranged patent clause, change instead of modify/extend, combine instead of include); clarifies terms/license language.
timeline.point_zh: 回应所有起草批评：用判例法和星号标记为担保免责声明的显著性辩护；解释版权/专利术语的刻意选择；提出条款修订（重排专利条款、用 change 替代 modify/extend、用 combine 替代 include）；澄清 terms/license 用语。
timeline.point: Responds to all drafting critiques: defends warranty disclaimer as conspicuous under UCC/UCITA using asterisks and case law; explains deliberate copyright/patent terminology choices; proposes clause revisions (rearranged patent clause, change instead of modify/extend, combine instead of include); clarifies terms/license language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes revised clause 4 using combine language following GPL 3.0 section 5, asking if this avoids the OSD 9 concerns about simple aggregation.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修订后的第 4 条，采用 GPL 3.0 第 5 节的 combine 措辞，询问这是否避免了关于简单聚合的 OSD 9 担忧。
timeline.point: Proposes revised clause 4 using combine language following GPL 3.0 section 5, asking if this avoids the OSD 9 concerns about simple aggregation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the revised clause 4 language is better. Expresses concern that derivative work might mean textual inclusion, and prefers expert analysis of what constitutes one program over codifying a definition that technology will outgrow.
timeline.point_zh: 同意修订后的第 4 条语言更好。表达对 derivative work 可能意味着文本包含的担忧，倾向于由专家分析什么构成一个程序，而非编入一个技术会超越的定义。
timeline.point: Agrees the revised clause 4 language is better. Expresses concern that derivative work might mean textual inclusion, and prefers expert analysis of what constitutes one program over codifying a definition that technology will outgrow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that if Open Source can hook copyleft into distribution, it can also hook it into use for developer tools. People using developer tools on source code are developers, and Open Source already expects developers to grapple with copyleft. Proposes revising clause 5 to develop software instead of analyze, modify, or generate.
timeline.point_zh: 主张如果开源能将 copyleft 挂钩到分发，也能将它挂钩到 developer tools 的使用。使用 developer tools 处理源码的人就是开发者，开源已经期望开发者应对 copyleft。提议将第 5 条修改为 develop software 而非 analyze, modify, or generate。
timeline.point: Argues that if Open Source can hook copyleft into distribution, it can also hook it into use for developer tools. People using developer tools on source code are developers, and Open Source already expects developers to grapple with copyleft. Proposes revising clause 5 to develop software instead of analyze, modify, or generate.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD 6 catches L0-R's use cases, making it non-Open Source. Further argues that even if it met the OSD, OSI certification would be dereliction of duty because the license asks too much -- forcing copyright owners to open source their work merely for using L0-R software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 6 捕获了 L0-R 的使用场景，使其不符合开源。进一步认为即使符合 OSD，OSI 认证也属失职，因为许可证要求过多，迫使版权所有者仅因使用 L0-R 软件就开源其作品。
timeline.point: Argues OSD 6 catches L0-R's use cases, making it non-Open Source. Further argues that even if it met the OSD, OSI certification would be dereliction of duty because the license asks too much -- forcing copyright owners to open source their work merely for using L0-R software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States he has not encountered a court that would compel the owner of a large codebase to GPL it over a de minimis copyleft combination.
timeline.point_zh: 表示尚未遇到会强制大型代码库所有者因微量 copyleft 组合而将其 GPL 化的法院。
timeline.point: States he has not encountered a court that would compel the owner of a large codebase to GPL it over a de minimis copyleft combination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Makes it a goal to keep derivative work out of L0-R because the term is unclear and will likely remain so. Prefers developers reach the conclusion about ambiguity themselves rather than needing a lawyer.
timeline.point_zh: 将避免在 L0-R 中使用 derivative work 作为目标，因为该术语不明确且可能一直如此。倾向于让开发者自己得出含糊的结论，而非需要律师。
timeline.point: Makes it a goal to keep derivative work out of L0-R because the term is unclear and will likely remain so. Prefers developers reach the conclusion about ambiguity themselves rather than needing a lawyer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Counters with a rhetorical question: has Bruce met a court that would compel releasing a large proprietary codebase as Open Source after running an L0-R line counter on it?
timeline.point_zh: 反问：Bruce 是否遇到过会强制在对大型专有代码库运行 L0-R 行数统计器后将其开源的法院？
timeline.point: Counters with a rhetorical question: has Bruce met a court that would compel releasing a large proprietary codebase as Open Source after running an L0-R line counter on it?

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that de minimis combination is irrelevant in practice because no one is compelled to GPL over trivial combinations. Restates that the core objection is on principle: L0-R asks for too much (dedicating a work to Open Source) for too little (just the right to run a program), and OSI should not endorse such a poor bargain.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清微量组合在实践中无关紧要，因为没人会因微量组合被强制 GPL。重申核心反对理由是原则性的：L0-R 要求过多（将作品献给开源）而回报太少（仅获得运行程序的权利），OSI 不应认可这种不良交易。
timeline.point: Clarifies that de minimis combination is irrelevant in practice because no one is compelled to GPL over trivial combinations. Restates that the core objection is on principle: L0-R asks for too much (dedicating a work to Open Source) for too little (just the right to run a program), and OSI should not endorse such a poor bargain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that no one is compelled to release code under any copyleft license for any size of combination; specific performance is not a remedy for copyright infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 主张没有任何人因为任何规模的代码组合而被强制以 copyleft 许可证发布代码；特定履行不是版权侵权的救济方式。
timeline.point: Argues that no one is compelled to release code under any copyleft license for any size of combination; specific performance is not a remedy for copyright infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the point on copyright but notes that specific performance exists for breach of contract, citing the Artifex v. Hancom case.
timeline.point_zh: 承认版权方面的观点，但指出违约诉讼中存在特定履行救济，并引用 Artifex v. Hancom 案例。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the point on copyright but notes that specific performance exists for breach of contract, citing the Artifex v. Hancom case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Discusses the Artifex v. Hancom case but argues that even with contract breach claims, judges are unlikely to order release of copyrighted property under terms not chosen by the infringer.
timeline.point_zh: 讨论了 Artifex v. Hancom 案例，但认为即使有违约诉讼，法官也不太可能命令侵权者以非自愿条款发布其版权财产。
timeline.point: Discusses the Artifex v. Hancom case but argues that even with contract breach claims, judges are unlikely to order release of copyrighted property under terms not chosen by the infringer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should make its interpretation of OSD #6 more broadly understood, and defends L0-R as serving the interests of copyleft-leaning toolmakers and open software competing with closed source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 应更广泛地公开其对 OSD #6 的解释，并为 L0-R 辩护，认为它服务于偏向 copyleft 的工具开发者和希望与闭源竞争的开放软件。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should make its interpretation of OSD #6 more broadly understood, and defends L0-R as serving the interests of copyleft-leaning toolmakers and open software competing with closed source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R is not an Open Source license because it requires making unrelated programs open source due to a use-based condition, violating OSD #6 and the first of the Four Freedoms. Calls it the King Midas Touch.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 不是开源许可证，因为它要求基于使用条件将不相关的程序开源，违反了 OSD #6 和四项自由中的第一项，称其为点金手。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R is not an Open Source license because it requires making unrelated programs open source due to a use-based condition, violating OSD #6 and the first of the Four Freedoms. Calls it the King Midas Touch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks Bruce to explicate how OSD #6 prohibits L0-R, noting difficulty reading that prohibition into the text of #6, while agreeing that the Four Freedoms argument applies.
timeline.point_zh: 请求 Bruce 解释 OSD #6 如何禁止 L0-R，认为难以从 #6 的文本中读出这一禁止，但同意四项自由方面的论点。
timeline.point: Asks Bruce to explicate how OSD #6 prohibits L0-R, noting difficulty reading that prohibition into the text of #6, while agreeing that the Four Freedoms argument applies.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains the OSD reading: condition 5 triggers OSD #6 because analysis/modification/generation are fields of endeavor; OSD #2 overrides #6 for the program itself but not for other programs, so GPL is OK but L0-R is not.
timeline.point_zh: 解释了对 OSD 的解读：条件 5 触发 OSD #6，因为分析/修改/生成属于活动领域；OSD #2 覆盖了 #6 对程序本身的要求但不适用于其他程序，因此 GPL 合规但 L0-R 不合规。
timeline.point: Explains the OSD reading: condition 5 triggers OSD #6 because analysis/modification/generation are fields of endeavor; OSD #2 overrides #6 for the program itself but not for other programs, so GPL is OK but L0-R is not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States L0-R was designed to promote a dual licensing business model but is not actually open source; developers can achieve the same outcome with proprietary licensing or pro/community versions without L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 旨在促进双重许可商业模式，但实际上不是开源；开发者可以通过专有许可或专业版/社区版实现相同目标，无需 L0-R。
timeline.point: States L0-R was designed to promote a dual licensing business model but is not actually open source; developers can achieve the same outcome with proprietary licensing or pro/community versions without L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes L0-R condition 5 as flatly infectious and harmful to copyleft, comparing it to the damaging viral characterization the open source community fought against.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对 L0-R 条件 5，认为它具有传染性且有害于 copyleft，将其类比为开源社区曾经抵制的破坏性病毒式描述。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes L0-R condition 5 as flatly infectious and harmful to copyleft, comparing it to the damaging viral characterization the open source community fought against.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that OSI waits for the mailing list to reach a stable consensus before evaluating against mission and principle; the forum itself is the committee, and OSI does not offer opinions on licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSI 等待邮件列表达成稳定共识后再根据使命和原则进行评估；该论坛本身就是委员会，OSI 不会对许可证发表意见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that OSI waits for the mailing list to reach a stable consensus before evaluating against mission and principle; the forum itself is the committee, and OSI does not offer opinions on licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on how field of endeavor works under OSD #6 and whether OSD #2 overrides #6, noting these interpretations should be documented.
timeline.point_zh: 请求澄清 OSD #6 下活动领域的运作方式以及 OSD #2 是否覆盖 #6，认为这些解释应当有文档记录。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on how field of endeavor works under OSD #6 and whether OSD #2 overrides #6, noting these interpretations should be documented.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Admits that the OSD annotations do not fully stand behind them and that one or two annotations miss the purpose and could be improved.
timeline.point_zh: 承认并不完全支持所有 OSD 注解，认为其中一两个注解偏离了目的，可以改进。
timeline.point: Admits that the OSD annotations do not fully stand behind them and that one or two annotations miss the purpose and could be improved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion about the OSI review process, noting the website describes a formal procedure while the actual experience was informal, and requests that /approval be updated.
timeline.point_zh: 对 OSI 审查流程感到困惑，指出网站描述的是正式程序但实际体验是非正式的，并请求更新 /approval 页面。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion about the OSI review process, noting the website describes a formal procedure while the actual experience was informal, and requests that /approval be updated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Tells Kyle the discussion lasted more than the required 30 days, recommends the license not be approved, and suggests trying it with a user community first.
timeline.point_zh: 告诉 Kyle 讨论已超过所需的 30 天，建议不批准该许可证，建议先在用户社区中试行。
timeline.point: Tells Kyle the discussion lasted more than the required 30 days, recommends the license not be approved, and suggests trying it with a user community first.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Corrects a grammatical ambiguity in his prior message about bar admission, clarifying he did not intend to claim he is admitted to the bar.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正了他之前消息中关于律师资格的语法歧义，澄清他并非声称自己拥有律师资格。
timeline.point: Corrects a grammatical ambiguity in his prior message about bar admission, clarifying he did not intend to claim he is admitted to the bar.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Pushes back against being run off, compares the review process to Calvinball, and explains he engaged because community members will call L0-R open source regardless of OSI decision.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳被驱逐的说法，将审查流程比作 Calvinball 游戏，并解释他参与是因为社区成员无论如何都会称 L0-R 为开源。
timeline.point: Pushes back against being run off, compares the review process to Calvinball, and explains he engaged because community members will call L0-R open source regardless of OSI decision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States the L0-R license is dangerous to users as it purports to take their copyrighted property if they simply run a program, resembling a landmine. Recommends denial.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 许可证对用户有危险，因为它声称如果用户运行程序就会夺取其版权财产，类似于地雷。建议拒绝批准。
timeline.point: States the L0-R license is dangerous to users as it purports to take their copyrighted property if they simply run a program, resembling a landmine. Recommends denial.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies his earlier email was not the step 2 board report but was intended to facilitate community discussion, and suggests Kyle may have assumed the review process is more formal than it actually is.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清他之前的邮件不是第二步董事会报告，而是旨在促进社区讨论，并认为 Kyle 可能假定审查流程比实际更正式。
timeline.point: Clarifies his earlier email was not the step 2 board report but was intended to facilitate community discussion, and suggests Kyle may have assumed the review process is more formal than it actually is.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Notes that L0-R does several things no previously OSI-approved license has done, and that reviewing such a license was never going to be fast or straightforward.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 做了几件此前 OSI 批准的许可证从未做过的事情，审查这样的许可证从来不会是快速或简单的。
timeline.point: Notes that L0-R does several things no previously OSI-approved license has done, and that reviewing such a license was never going to be fast or straightforward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States he expected the review to focus on applying the OSD Definition to the license, not on extraneous concerns about the LicenseZero.com business model which is separate from the license itself.
timeline.point_zh: 表示他期望审查集中在将 OSD 定义应用于许可证，而非关注与许可证无关的 LicenseZero.com 业务模式等无关事项。
timeline.point: States he expected the review to focus on applying the OSD Definition to the license, not on extraneous concerns about the LicenseZero.com business model which is separate from the license itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains that acquiring an active user community is important because bad ideas die there, practical use cases replace theoretical ones, and OSI might refuse to consider licenses without a user community to manage workload.
timeline.point_zh: 解释了获取活跃用户社区的重要性：坏想法会在那里消亡，实际用例取代理论假设，OSI 可能拒绝考虑没有用户社区的许可证以管理工作量。
timeline.point: Explains that acquiring an active user community is important because bad ideas die there, practical use cases replace theoretical ones, and OSI might refuse to consider licenses without a user community to manage workload.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Systematically dismantles Bruce's OSD reading as externally inconsistent, arguing it ignores natural readings, introduces rules not grounded in OSD text, and produces interpretations that would disqualify already-approved licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 系统地拆解了 Bruce 对 OSD 的解读，认为其外部不一致，忽略了自然解读，引入了 OSD 文本中没有的规则，并且会排除已批准的许可证。
timeline.point: Systematically dismantles Bruce's OSD reading as externally inconsistent, arguing it ignores natural readings, introduces rules not grounded in OSD text, and produces interpretations that would disqualify already-approved licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes three specific updates to /approval: clarify the board applies its own judgment beyond the Definition, require mailing list consensus before proceeding, and note the informal nature of the process.
timeline.point_zh: 提出对 /approval 的三项具体更新建议：明确董事会在定义之上运用自身判断，要求邮件列表达成共识后再推进，并注明流程的非正式性质。
timeline.point: Proposes three specific updates to /approval: clarify the board applies its own judgment beyond the Definition, require mailing list consensus before proceeding, and note the informal nature of the process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the workload concern is fair, notes that requiring a preexisting user base creates a chicken-and-egg problem, and recommends documenting the approval policy and improving the submission format.
timeline.point_zh: 承认工作量关切是合理的，指出要求已有用户基础会形成鸡生蛋问题，建议记录审批政策并改进提交格式。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the workload concern is fair, notes that requiring a preexisting user base creates a chicken-and-egg problem, and recommends documenting the approval policy and improving the submission format.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Refutes the viral license characterization of reciprocal licenses, arguing courts never order source release, and proposes automatic-forgiveness language giving 30 days to cure inadvertent violations.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳了对互惠许可证的病毒式描述，认为法院从不命令发布源代码，并提出自动宽恕条款，给予 30 天纠正无意违规。
timeline.point: Refutes the viral license characterization of reciprocal licenses, arguing courts never order source release, and proposes automatic-forgiveness language giving 30 days to cure inadvertent violations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Supplements the submission to note L0-R shares common features with RPL 1.5, including release of private changes, required components, SaaS loophole closure, exception sales, and 30-day cure periods.
timeline.point_zh: 补充说明 L0-R 与 RPL 1.5 有许多共同特征，包括发布私有变更、必需组件、SaaS 漏洞关闭、例外销售和 30 天补救期。
timeline.point: Supplements the submission to note L0-R shares common features with RPL 1.5, including release of private changes, required components, SaaS loophole closure, exception sales, and 30-day cure periods.

submissions.rejection_reason: Rewritten version of L0-R was also effectively withdrawn by the submitter after continued community opposition.

status_review.rationale: Human-calibrated baseline restore after concurrent-run corruption.

submissions.name: License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: License Committee recommended rejection. Board chose not to decide because submitter had effectively withdrawn the license from consideration.

Notes:

- I've removed all mention of agent for sale of alternative
  licenses, as well as the automatic waiver of the copyleft
  conditions.  My motivation was twofold. For one, those
  features produced considerable comment, concern, and
  confusion, aside from the main issue of use conditions
  triggering copyleft.  For two, the aim of each can be
  achieved otherwise, outside the license text. As a result,
  the proposal is now _exactly_ BSD-2-Clause, plus new
  conditions 3 and 4.

- The copyleft triggers now speak directly in terms of OSD
  conformance, to catch both source availability and license
  terms requirements.  (The assumption is that L0-R, in some
  form, will eventually be recognized itself, so L0-R code
  can clearly incorporate L0-R code.)  But that aside, I
  think the new language goes more directly to intent, and
  reads more clearly.

- I've split the new conditions across two numbered items.
  This should help clarify that unmodified use alone does
  not trigger share-alike.

- I was tempted to define terms for repeated words and
  phrases, but held the urge back.  BSD-2-Clause doesn't do
  so, and for this kind of license, stylistically, I think
  that's probably best.

-- 
Kyle Mitchell, attorney // Oakland // (510) 712 - 0933
