timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains condition 3 in detail: it triggers copyleft on use rather than distribution, requires source publication but permits any OSI-approved terms, includes a grace period, and has an automatic waiver if alternative licenses cease to be available.
timeline.point_zh: 详细解释条件 3：它在使用而非分发时触发 copyleft，要求发布源代码但允许任何 OSI 批准的条款，包含宽限期，并在替代许可停止提供时自动豁免。
timeline.point: Explains condition 3 in detail: it triggers copyleft on use rather than distribution, requires source publication but permits any OSI-approved terms, includes a grace period, and has an automatic waiver if alternative licenses cease to be available.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States the wording of condition 3 is entirely baffling from a software developer perspective and does not explain the role of the Agent.
timeline.point_zh: 认为从软件开发者的角度看，条件 3 的措辞完全令人困惑，且未解释 Agent 的角色。
timeline.point: States the wording of condition 3 is entirely baffling from a software developer perspective and does not explain the role of the Agent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the tension between keeping license terms short (BSD-style) and making them self-explanatory, and explains the agent role is to vend alternative licenses that allow what the public license prohibits.
timeline.point_zh: 承认保持许可证条款简短（BSD 风格）与自我解释之间的张力，并解释代理人的角色是销售允许公共许可证所禁止事项的替代许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the tension between keeping license terms short (BSD-style) and making them self-explanatory, and explains the agent role is to vend alternative licenses that allow what the public license prohibits.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether a modifier of the software gets to designate their own agent, questioning the assumption of single origin for the software.
timeline.point_zh: 询问修改者是否可以指定自己的代理人，质疑软件单一来源的假设。
timeline.point: Asks whether a modifier of the software gets to designate their own agent, questioning the assumption of single origin for the software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises concerns about burdening users (not just developers) with source publication requirements, confusion about agent changes and waiver status, and potential for agents to disrupt software support businesses.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑将源代码发布负担加在用户（而非开发者）身上，对代理人变更和豁免状态的困惑，以及代理人可能破坏软件支持业务的风险。
timeline.point: Raises concerns about burdening users (not just developers) with source publication requirements, confusion about agent changes and waiver status, and potential for agents to disrupt software support businesses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Addresses two main concerns: downstream compliance issues exist in all copyleft licenses (not unique to L0-R), and proposes replacing agent language with a simpler requirement to preserve notices about alternative license availability.
timeline.point_zh: 回应两个主要关切：下游合规问题在所有 copyleft 许可证中都存在（非 L0-R 独有），并提议用更简单的替代许可可用性通知保留要求取代代理人语言。
timeline.point: Addresses two main concerns: downstream compliance issues exist in all copyleft licenses (not unique to L0-R), and proposes replacing agent language with a simpler requirement to preserve notices about alternative license availability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Disputes that the user-developer distinction dissolves under L0-R, arguing users typically retain use rights even if the downstream developer is out of compliance, and raises concerns about accidental copyleft triggers for private test code.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 L0-R 下用户与开发者区分消失的说法，认为即使下游开发者不合规，用户通常仍保有使用权，并对私有测试代码的意外 copyleft 触发表示担忧。
timeline.point: Disputes that the user-developer distinction dissolves under L0-R, arguing users typically retain use rights even if the downstream developer is out of compliance, and raises concerns about accidental copyleft triggers for private test code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains that L0-R uses direct licensing rather than sublicensing, and that the use-based copyleft trigger and grace period are designed to motivate contributions to Open Source rather than ensnare users.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 L0-R 采用直接许可而非再许可模式，基于使用的 copyleft 触发机制和宽限期旨在激励对开源的贡献，而非让用户无意侵权。
timeline.point: Explains that L0-R uses direct licensing rather than sublicensing, and that the use-based copyleft trigger and grace period are designed to motivate contributions to Open Source rather than ensnare users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Rejects L0-R's approach as coercing contributions rather than encouraging them, and objects to being forced to distribute compatibility patches for old open-source code.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 是在强迫而非鼓励贡献，反对被迫分发为兼容旧操作系统而做的补丁。
timeline.point: Rejects L0-R's approach as coercing contributions rather than encouraging them, and objects to being forced to distribute compatibility patches for old open-source code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Counters the coercion claim by arguing no one is obligated to use copyleft software, and positions L0-R as a natural evolution of copyleft closing loopholes left by GPL and AGPL, while affirming it meets the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳强迫贡献的说法，指出无人有义务使用 copyleft 软件，将 L0-R 定位为填补 GPL 和 AGPL 漏洞的 copyleft 自然演进，同时坚信其符合开源定义。
timeline.point: Counters the coercion claim by arguing no one is obligated to use copyleft software, and positions L0-R as a natural evolution of copyleft closing loopholes left by GPL and AGPL, while affirming it meets the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Accuses L0-R of copyright misuse by stripping away the § 117 software adaptation right through onerous conditions, and argues the license extends beyond the copyright bundle into rights people have always had.
timeline.point_zh: 指控 L0-R 构成版权滥用，通过苛刻条件剥夺了第 117 条软件改编权，认为该许可超越了版权范围，侵犯了人们一直拥有的权利。
timeline.point: Accuses L0-R of copyright misuse by stripping away the § 117 software adaptation right through onerous conditions, and argues the license extends beyond the copyright bundle into rights people have always had.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that L0-R operates within copyright law by citing Vernor v. Autodesk to show that licensees (not owners) face use restrictions, and that use-based copyleft rules can protect freedoms just as distribution-based rules do under GPL.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Vernor v. Autodesk 案论证 L0-R 在版权法范围内运作，许可用户（非所有者）受到使用限制是合法的，基于使用的 copyleft 规则可以像 GPL 中基于分发的规则一样保护自由。
timeline.point: Argues that L0-R operates within copyright law by citing Vernor v. Autodesk to show that licensees (not owners) face use restrictions, and that use-based copyleft rules can protect freedoms just as distribution-based rules do under GPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R is a copyright trap for unsuspecting end users who could be sued for non-compliance, questions its business model viability compared to AGPL or NC licensing, and suggests it is essentially a back-door noncommercial license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 对不知情的终端用户构成版权陷阱，质疑其商业模式相比 AGPL 或 NC 许可的可行性，暗示这实质上是一种变相的非商业许可。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R is a copyright trap for unsuspecting end users who could be sued for non-compliance, questions its business model viability compared to AGPL or NC licensing, and suggests it is essentially a back-door noncommercial license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI review should focus on OSD conformance rather than business model opinions, objects to being called a copyright trap since all license conditions restrict permissions, and challenges reviewers to identify which OSD criteria L0-R fails that AGPL meets.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 审查应聚焦于 OSD 合规性而非商业模式评判，反驳版权陷阱的指控（所有许可条件都限制权限），并要求评审者指出 L0-R 不符合但 AGPL 符合的 OSD 标准。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI review should focus on OSD conformance rather than business model opinions, objects to being called a copyright trap since all license conditions restrict permissions, and challenges reviewers to identify which OSD criteria L0-R fails that AGPL meets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes L0-R as a "single origin license" that privileges the original releaser over downstream redistributors, and fails to adequately address code reuse in larger works, cherry-picking, and community creation around modified versions.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 L0-R 是一种「单一来源许可」，偏向原始发布者而忽视下游再分发者，未充分考虑代码在大型项目中的复用、挑选特定文件以及围绕修改版本创建社区的情况。
timeline.point: Criticizes L0-R as a "single origin license" that privileges the original releaser over downstream redistributors, and fails to adequately address code reuse in larger works, cherry-picking, and community creation around modified versions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions the meaning of "use in the execution or development" with a compiler example, argues that limiting use of software violates OSD criterion 6, and contends that use-based restrictions are fundamentally different from copyleft conditions on modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 以编译器为例质疑「在执行或开发中的使用」的含义，认为限制软件使用直接违反 OSD 第 6 条，主张基于使用的限制与对修改施加的 copyleft 条件有本质区别。
timeline.point: Questions the meaning of "use in the execution or development" with a compiler example, argues that limiting use of software violates OSD criterion 6, and contends that use-based restrictions are fundamentally different from copyleft conditions on modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains how L0-R handles code reuse by analogy to BSD-2-Clause, clarifies that automatic waiver prevents original licensor privilege over community, and asks whether OSI would still approve BSD-2-Clause today if submitted fresh.
timeline.point_zh: 通过类比 BSD-2-Clause 解释 L0-R 如何处理代码复用，澄清自动放弃机制防止原始许可人对社区的特权，并质问 OSI 今天是否还会批准新提交的 BSD-2-Clause。
timeline.point: Explains how L0-R handles code reuse by analogy to BSD-2-Clause, clarifies that automatic waiver prevents original licensor privilege over community, and asks whether OSI would still approve BSD-2-Clause today if submitted fresh.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that embedding dual-licensing in the OSS license text is a radical innovation requiring OSD debate, objects to mandatory agent/contact information as creating practical and legal complications, and finds L0-R's brevity leads to incoherence rather than clarity.
timeline.point_zh: 认为在 OSS 许可文本中嵌入双重许可是一种需要 OSD 讨论的激进创新，反对强制性代理/联系信息带来的实际和法律问题，并认为 L0-R 的简洁导致了晦涩难懂。
timeline.point: Argues that embedding dual-licensing in the OSS license text is a radical innovation requiring OSD debate, objects to mandatory agent/contact information as creating practical and legal complications, and finds L0-R's brevity leads to incoherence rather than clarity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Presents two abuse scenarios where developers could exploit the grace period to demand payment from users, argues these are unique to L0-R's use-based trigger, and questions what constitutes "development" that would trigger the copyleft condition.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两种滥用场景，开发者可能利用宽限期向用户要求付费，认为这些是 L0-R 基于使用的触发机制所独有的问题，并质疑什么行为构成触发 copyleft 条件的「开发」。
timeline.point: Presents two abuse scenarios where developers could exploit the grace period to demand payment from users, argues these are unique to L0-R's use-based trigger, and questions what constitutes "development" that would trigger the copyleft condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that L0-R uses direct licensing rather than sublicensing, argues that automatic waiver is simply relicensing (already possible under existing licenses), and agrees to remove agent information while maintaining the core copyleft innovation.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 L0-R 采用直接许可模式而非再许可，主张自动放弃条款实质上是重新许可（现有许可已允许），并同意移除代理信息同时保留核心 copyleft 创新。
timeline.point: Clarifies that L0-R uses direct licensing rather than sublicensing, argues that automatic waiver is simply relicensing (already possible under existing licenses), and agrees to remove agent information while maintaining the core copyleft innovation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Counters abuse scenarios by arguing they are not L0-R-specific, provides legal mitigations including impossibility doctrine and waiver, and explains that deliberate use of industry terminology like "execute" and "develop" aims for accessibility over legal precision.
timeline.point_zh: 论证滥用场景并非 L0-R 特有，提供法律救济包括不可能原则和弃权，并解释有意使用行业术语「执行」和「开发」是为了可及性而非法律精确性。
timeline.point: Counters abuse scenarios by arguing they are not L0-R-specific, provides legal mitigations including impossibility doctrine and waiver, and explains that deliberate use of industry terminology like "execute" and "develop" aims for accessibility over legal precision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts a revised version of the L0-R license text incorporating feedback from the discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 发布经讨论反馈修订后的 L0-R 许可证文本。
timeline.point: Posts a revised version of the L0-R license text incorporating feedback from the discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Answers Carlo's questions by confirming that "use in the execution and development" is technical terminology intentionally applied to compiled programs, and argues that OSD criterion 6 restricts fields of endeavor, not all limits on use, leaving room for use-based copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 回答 Carlo 的问题，确认「在执行和开发中的使用」是技术术语且有意适用于编译程序，主张 OSD 第 6 条限制的是努力领域而非所有使用限制，为基于使用的 copyleft 留有空间。
timeline.point: Answers Carlo's questions by confirming that "use in the execution and development" is technical terminology intentionally applied to compiled programs, and argues that OSD criterion 6 restricts fields of endeavor, not all limits on use, leaving room for use-based copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Insists that use-based triggering is unique to L0-R and creates problems no other OSI license has, raises concerns about source behind paywalls and lost repositories, demands the license author define what "development" means, and argues the license lacks safeguards against aggressive enforcement.
timeline.point_zh: 坚称基于使用的触发机制是 L0-R 独有的且造成其他 OSI 许可不存在的问题，对付费墙后的源码和消失的仓库表示担忧，要求许可作者定义「开发」的含义，并认为该许可缺乏防止激进执法的保障。
timeline.point: Insists that use-based triggering is unique to L0-R and creates problems no other OSI license has, raises concerns about source behind paywalls and lost repositories, demands the license author define what "development" means, and argues the license lacks safeguards against aggressive enforcement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Addresses each objection in detail: argues the use-vs-distribution distinction is blurring, use-based copyleft has no OSD barrier, the grace period works within the license text, and the choice of industry terminology prioritizes accessibility over legal precision.
timeline.point_zh: 逐一回应反对意见：论证使用与分发的界限正在模糊，基于使用的 copyleft 没有 OSD 障碍，宽限期在许可文本内有效运作，选择行业术语是为优先保障可及性而非法律精确性。
timeline.point: Addresses each objection in detail: argues the use-vs-distribution distinction is blurring, use-based copyleft has no OSD barrier, the grace period works within the license text, and the choice of industry terminology prioritizes accessibility over legal precision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that L0-R plainly violates OSD by restricting use based on the licensing of other software, contends that limiting proprietary software use is no different from limiting use in genetic research, and distinguishes AGPL as only restricting modification in distribution-equivalent scenarios.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 L0-R 明显违反 OSD，因为它根据其他软件的许可来限制使用，认为限制专有软件使用与限制在基因研究中使用无异，区分 AGPL 仅在功能等同于分发的场景中限制修改。
timeline.point: Argues that L0-R plainly violates OSD by restricting use based on the licensing of other software, contends that limiting proprietary software use is no different from limiting use in genetic research, and distinguishes AGPL as only restricting modification in distribution-equivalent scenarios.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Corrects Kyle's assumption that OSI approval is purely mechanical OSD application, stating that the Board also evaluates whether licenses further OSI's broader goals.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正 Kyle 关于 OSI 批准纯粹是机械应用 OSD 的假设，指出董事会还会评估许可是否推进 OSI 的更广泛目标。
timeline.point: Corrects Kyle's assumption that OSI approval is purely mechanical OSD application, stating that the Board also evaluates whether licenses further OSI's broader goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that source behind a paywall does not meet open source availability standards, recommends adding GPL-style protections for free source access and against lost repositories, maintains the developer/user distinction is critical, and asks for the clarification about ceasing development to be added to the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 认为付费墙后的源码不满足开源可用性标准，建议添加 GPL 风格的免费源码访问保护和防止仓库消失的条款，坚持开发者/用户的区分至关重要，并要求将关于停止开发的澄清纳入许可文本。
timeline.point: Argues that source behind a paywall does not meet open source availability standards, recommends adding GPL-style protections for free source access and against lost repositories, maintains the developer/user distinction is critical, and asks for the clarification about ceasing development to be added to the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether OSI has unstated policy goals beyond the published OSD criteria, asking where they are documented and what happens when a license meets the Definition but is still not approved.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 OSI 是否有未公开的、超越已发布 OSD 标准的政策目标，询问这些目标记录在何处，以及当许可符合定义但仍未获批准时会怎样。
timeline.point: Questions whether OSI has unstated policy goals beyond the published OSD criteria, asking where they are documented and what happens when a license meets the Definition but is still not approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes adding "free of charge" to the source availability requirement, suggests clarifying that unmodified use doesn't trigger copyleft, provides pseudocode interpretation of condition 3, and frames the user-vs-developer debate as a long-standing fissure between Free Software and permissive Open Source worldviews.
timeline.point_zh: 提议在源码可用性要求中加入「免费」条款，建议澄清未修改的使用不触发 copyleft，提供条件 3 的伪代码解读，将用户与开发者的辩论定位为自由软件与宽松开源世界观之间的长期分歧。
timeline.point: Proposes adding "free of charge" to the source availability requirement, suggests clarifying that unmodified use doesn't trigger copyleft, provides pseudocode interpretation of condition 3, and frames the user-vs-developer debate as a long-standing fissure between Free Software and permissive Open Source worldviews.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Summarizes Bruce Perens' feedback: OSI considers licensee compliance load beyond OSD, passive users should never need a lawyer, triggering short of modification/distribution would be very hard for OSI to promote, and recommends revising condition 3 for readability and adding a safe zone for unmodified use.
timeline.point_zh: 总结 Bruce Perens 的反馈：OSI 在 OSD 之外还考虑被许可人的合规负担，被动用户永远不应需要律师，触发条件低于修改/分发水平将很难被 OSI 推荐，并建议修订条件 3 以提高可读性并为未修改使用添加安全区。
timeline.point: Summarizes Bruce Perens' feedback: OSI considers licensee compliance load beyond OSD, passive users should never need a lawyer, triggering short of modification/distribution would be very hard for OSI to promote, and recommends revising condition 3 for readability and adding a safe zone for unmodified use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Forwards Bruce Perens’s off-list reply about the License Zero Reciprocal Public License to the review list because Bruce was not subscribed.
timeline.point_zh: 因 Bruce Perens 未订阅列表，转发其关于 License Zero Reciprocal Public License 的线下回复到审查列表。
timeline.point: Forwards Bruce Perens’s off-list reply about the License Zero Reciprocal Public License to the review list because Bruce was not subscribed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks Bruce whether a revised License Zero copyleft trigger would be acceptable without component-use language, while prioritizing clarity and safe harbor for non-developer users.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Bruce 修改后的 License Zero copyleft 触发条件若去掉组件使用措辞是否可接受，并强调优先改善清晰度和非开发者安全港。
timeline.point: Asks Bruce whether a revised License Zero copyleft trigger would be acceptable without component-use language, while prioritizing clarity and safe harbor for non-developer users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Contains no substantive message content beyond an empty forwarded separator.
timeline.point_zh: 除空转发分隔符外没有实质邮件内容。
timeline.point: Contains no substantive message content beyond an empty forwarded separator.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Challenges OSI to document its additional policy goals beyond the OSD, argues that restricting copyleft while allowing permissive evolution creates an anti-copyleft ratchet, and contends that the OSD and FSF definitions leave room for use-based copyleft as a freedom-protecting mechanism.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 OSI 记录其超越 OSD 的额外政策目标，论证限制 copyleft 同时允许宽松许可演进会形成反 copyleft 棘轮效应，并主张 OSD 和 FSF 定义为基于使用的 copyleft 作为自由保护机制留有空间。
timeline.point: Challenges OSI to document its additional policy goals beyond the OSD, argues that restricting copyleft while allowing permissive evolution creates an anti-copyleft ratchet, and contends that the OSD and FSF definitions leave room for use-based copyleft as a freedom-protecting mechanism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts a major revision of L0-R: removes agent and automatic waiver provisions, splits use-based copyleft into two conditions (modification and incorporation), and references OSD conformance directly, making the license exactly BSD-2-Clause plus conditions 3 and 4.
timeline.point_zh: 发布 L0-R 的重大修订：移除代理和自动放弃条款，将基于使用的 copyleft 拆分为两个条件（修改和纳入），直接引用 OSD 合规性，使许可恰好等于 BSD-2-Clause 加条件 3 和 4。
timeline.point: Posts a major revision of L0-R: removes agent and automatic waiver provisions, splits use-based copyleft into two conditions (modification and incorporation), and references OSD conformance directly, making the license exactly BSD-2-Clause plus conditions 3 and 4.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that the revisions address most concerns but raises practical questions about enforcement: what event starts the time limit, how infringement duration would be determined, and whether there is precedent for time-limited licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 承认修订解决了大部分顾虑，但提出执行方面的实际问题：什么事件启动时间限制、如何确定侵权持续时间，以及是否存在限时许可的先例。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that the revisions address most concerns but raises practical questions about enforcement: what event starts the time limit, how infringement duration would be determined, and whether there is precedent for time-limited licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI operates like equity jurisdiction: beyond OSD compliance, the Board approves licenses based on what members believe is right and just, and OSD-conformant licenses have no guarantee of approval.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSI 如衡平法管辖运作：除 OSD 合规外，董事会基于成员认为正确和公正的标准批准许可，符合定义的许可没有获得批准的保证。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI operates like equity jurisdiction: beyond OSD compliance, the Board approves licenses based on what members believe is right and just, and OSD-conformant licenses have no guarantee of approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the time limit lacks clarity but argues fuzziness favors the licensee, proposes sub-variants for how grace periods might work (per-use vs. cumulative), discusses practical enforcement via notice-and-cessation, and suggests keeping the grace period generic as a placeholder.
timeline.point_zh: 承认时间限制缺乏清晰度但认为模糊有利于被许可人，提出宽限期运作方式的子变体（按次使用 vs. 累积），讨论通过通知-停止的实际执法方式，并建议将宽限期保持为通用占位符。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the time limit lacks clarity but argues fuzziness favors the licensee, proposes sub-variants for how grace periods might work (per-use vs. cumulative), discusses practical enforcement via notice-and-cessation, and suggests keeping the grace period generic as a placeholder.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Proposes OSI should maintain a list of additional concerns beyond the OSD: minimizing legal load on simple users who should never need to read the license, avoiding use-coupled responsibilities, preventing license proliferation, rejecting crayon licenses, and limiting additional developer burdens, concluding some OSD-compliant licenses should not be OSI-certified.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSI 应维护一份超越 OSD 的额外关注事项清单：最小化简单用户的法律负担（他们永远不应需要阅读许可），避免使用耦合的责任，防止许可泛滥，拒绝蜡笔许可，限制开发者的额外负担，得出某些 OSD 合规的许可不应获得 OSI 认证的结论。
timeline.point: Proposes OSI should maintain a list of additional concerns beyond the OSD: minimizing legal load on simple users who should never need to read the license, avoiding use-coupled responsibilities, preventing license proliferation, rejecting crayon licenses, and limiting additional developer burdens, concluding some OSD-compliant licenses should not be OSI-certified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Urges OSI to publicly disclose any additional approval criteria beyond the OSD, warns against becoming an opaque body that defines open source inclusively while approving only certain business models, and offers to help refine the Definition or document additional policies even if it excludes L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促 OSI 公开披露超越 OSD 的额外批准标准，警告不要成为一边包容性地定义开源、一边仅批准特定商业模式的不透明机构，并表示愿意帮助完善定义或记录额外政策，即使这意味着排除 L0-R。
timeline.point: Urges OSI to publicly disclose any additional approval criteria beyond the OSD, warns against becoming an opaque body that defines open source inclusively while approving only certain business models, and offers to help refine the Definition or document additional policies even if it excludes L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Counters Kyle's characterization as overstated, clarifying that the Board usually discusses rejection reasons publicly and that the proposed concerns are not additions to the OSD but a parallel list of reasonable considerations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Kyle 的表述言过其实，澄清董事会通常会公开讨论拒绝理由，所提出的关注事项不是对 OSD 的补充，而是一份合理考虑事项的平行清单。
timeline.point: Counters Kyle's characterization as overstated, clarifying that the Board usually discusses rejection reasons publicly and that the proposed concerns are not additions to the OSD but a parallel list of reasonable considerations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Responds to Bruce's concerns: argues L0-R passes the simple-user test since unmodified use triggers nothing, warns against prohibiting attribution requirements, notes software and metadata can reduce license analysis burden, and sees an anti-copyleft ratchet in the additional-load framework.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 Bruce 的关切：论证 L0-R 通过简单用户测试因为未修改的使用不触发任何条件，警告不要禁止归属要求，指出软件和元数据可以减少许可分析负担，并在额外负担框架中看到反 copyleft 棘轮效应。
timeline.point: Responds to Bruce's concerns: argues L0-R passes the simple-user test since unmodified use triggers nothing, warns against prohibiting attribution requirements, notes software and metadata can reduce license analysis burden, and sees an anti-copyleft ratchet in the additional-load framework.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the perception problem may be worse than the reality, urges OSI to update its public webpages to properly set expectations about the approval process, and suggests building a repository of policy concerns from the license-review archives.
timeline.point_zh: 承认公众认知问题可能比实际情况更严重，敦促 OSI 更新公共网页以正确设定批准流程的期望，并建议从许可审查档案中建立政策关注事项的资料库。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the perception problem may be worse than the reality, urges OSI to update its public webpages to properly set expectations about the approval process, and suggests building a repository of policy concerns from the license-review archives.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether use-based terms are needed when modification-based terms exist, notes technical challenges with DRM and automated optimizers stripping notices, and defends copyleft as protecting developers from exploitation by large companies.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑当已有基于修改的条款时是否还需要基于使用的条款，指出 DRM 和自动化优化器剥离通知的技术挑战，并为 copyleft 辩护，认为其保护开发者免受大公司剥削。
timeline.point: Questions whether use-based terms are needed when modification-based terms exist, notes technical challenges with DRM and automated optimizers stripping notices, and defends copyleft as protecting developers from exploitation by large companies.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions the confusing use of "uses" versus "use" in the revised clauses, suggests the intended meaning might be simpler as a publish-under-OSI requirement within a grace period, and raises a potential OSD conformance issue with the wording.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑修订条款中「uses」与「use」的混淆使用，建议预期含义可能更简单地表述为在宽限期内以 OSI 批准许可发布的要求，并指出措辞可能存在的 OSD 合规性问题。
timeline.point: Questions the confusing use of "uses" versus "use" in the revised clauses, suggests the intended meaning might be simpler as a publish-under-OSI requirement within a grace period, and raises a potential OSD conformance issue with the wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Suggests dropping the unenforceable grace period entirely, but then questions whether the resulting license is just a compact LGPL variant with no practical differentiation worth adding to the OSS ecosystem.
timeline.point_zh: 建议完全删除不可执行的宽限期，但随即质疑结果许可是否只是 LGPL 的紧凑变体，没有值得添加到 OSS 生态系统的实际差异。
timeline.point: Suggests dropping the unenforceable grace period entirely, but then questions whether the resulting license is just a compact LGPL variant with no practical differentiation worth adding to the OSS ecosystem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the "uses" vs "use" confusion, explains the dual motivation of distinguishing new use conditions from redistribution and clarifying grace period clocks, and agrees to reconsider the wording while maintaining the BSD-derived structure.
timeline.point_zh: 承认「uses」与「use」的混淆，解释双重动机是区分新的使用条件与分发条件以及澄清宽限期时钟，并同意在保持 BSD 派生结构的同时重新考虑措辞。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the "uses" vs "use" confusion, explains the dual motivation of distinguishing new use conditions from redistribution and clarifying grace period clocks, and agrees to reconsider the wording while maintaining the BSD-derived structure.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the enforceability concern about the grace period and argues L0-R differs materially from LGPL by triggering copyleft in far more situations, such as use as a shared library.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清关于宽限期可执行性的顾虑，论证 L0-R 与 LGPL 有实质性区别，因为在更多场景下触发 copyleft 要求，例如作为共享库使用。
timeline.point: Clarifies the enforceability concern about the grace period and argues L0-R differs materially from LGPL by triggering copyleft in far more situations, such as use as a shared library.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Concisely states that the grace period is infinitely gameable and therefore unenforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 简洁地指出宽限期可以被无限利用，因此不可执行。
timeline.point: Concisely states that the grace period is infinitely gameable and therefore unenforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the 'grace period is gameable' concern but indicates he will attempt to address it in drafting, while expressing some disagreement.
timeline.point_zh: 承认'宽限期可被利用'的关切，表示将在起草中尝试处理，但对此持一定保留意见。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the 'grace period is gameable' concern but indicates he will attempt to address it in drafting, while expressing some disagreement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Points out that Kyle's own message essentially articulates the problems with the grace period concept.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Kyle 自己的回复实际上已经阐明了宽限期概念存在的问题。
timeline.point: Points out that Kyle's own message essentially articulates the problems with the grace period concept.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises detailed drafting concerns about OSD conformance, arguing the grace period likely violates OSD 6, 'uses with modifications' is confusing, and 'uses in development of other software' violates OSD 9. Recommends clearer articulation of license goals.
timeline.point_zh: 提出详细的起草问题，认为宽限期概念可能不符合 OSD 6，'uses with modifications' 表述模糊，'uses in development of other software' 违反 OSD 9。建议更清晰地阐述许可证目标。
timeline.point: Raises detailed drafting concerns about OSD conformance, arguing the grace period likely violates OSD 6, 'uses with modifications' is confusing, and 'uses in development of other software' violates OSD 9. Recommends clearer articulation of license goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Revisits L0-R's goal: a share-alike license triggered in more situations than AGPL but easier to comply with. Provides concrete examples of L0-R conditions in action, proposes language revisions to address OSD conformance concerns, and clarifies that use conditions strike him as more powerful than distribution conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 L0-R 的目标：实现一个比 AGPL 触发范围更广但更易合规的 share-alike 许可证。提供具体案例说明 L0-R 条件的实际运作，提出措辞修改方案以解决 OSD 合规问题，并阐述使用条件比分发条件更具效力的观点。
timeline.point: Revisits L0-R's goal: a share-alike license triggered in more situations than AGPL but easier to comply with. Provides concrete examples of L0-R conditions in action, proposes language revisions to address OSD conformance concerns, and clarifies that use conditions strike him as more powerful than distribution conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Observes that the BSD license may function as both a copyright and patent license, noting that 'use' is a patent term of art while 'redistribution' is a copyright matter.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 BSD 许可证可能同时作为版权和专利许可证运作，认为'redistribution'是版权术语而'use'是专利术语。
timeline.point: Observes that the BSD license may function as both a copyright and patent license, noting that 'use' is a patent term of art while 'redistribution' is a copyright matter.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Questions the meaning of L0-R clauses 3 and 4, arguing that mere use of software cannot be open source or not, and that clause 4 effectively restricts fields of endeavor, which conflicts with even the most restrictive OSI-approved licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 L0-R 条款 3 和 4 的含义，认为软件的单纯使用无所谓开源与否，条款 4 实质上限制了应用领域，与即使最严格的 OSI 批准许可证也相矛盾。
timeline.point: Questions the meaning of L0-R clauses 3 and 4, arguing that mere use of software cannot be open source or not, and that clause 4 effectively restricts fields of endeavor, which conflicts with even the most restrictive OSI-approved licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Florian that L0-R constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction, which he sees as a fundamental problem, while noting that such stipulations might be acceptable in exchange for a free-of-charge license.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Florian 的观点，认为 L0-R 构成了对应用领域的限制，这是一个根本性问题，但同时指出在免费许可的前提下这种条款或许可以接受。
timeline.point: Agrees with Florian that L0-R constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction, which he sees as a fundamental problem, while noting that such stipulations might be acceptable in exchange for a free-of-charge license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that software itself is Open Source, not particular uses. Argues that 'field of endeavor' in OSD 6 must mean purpose or end goal, not licensing methodology, and that use conditions are enforceable in commercial contexts.
timeline.point_zh: 同意软件本身是开源的，而非特定使用方式。主张 OSD 6 中的'应用领域'应指目的或最终目标，而非许可方法论，并指出使用条件在商业许可中是可执行的。
timeline.point: Agrees that software itself is Open Source, not particular uses. Argues that 'field of endeavor' in OSD 6 must mean purpose or end goal, not licensing methodology, and that use conditions are enforceable in commercial contexts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for missing Carlo's earlier reply to Florian and directs him to the relevant message.
timeline.point_zh: 为错过了 Carlo 之前对 Florian 的回复而道歉，并指向相关信息。
timeline.point: Apologizes for missing Carlo's earlier reply to Florian and directs him to the relevant message.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues the community is not requesting more license approvals but is rather frustrated by the proliferation of already-approved licenses. Opposes approving redundant licenses that merely repackage existing ones in simpler language.
timeline.point_zh: 认为社区并非要求更多许可证批准，而是对已批准许可证的泛滥感到沮丧。反对批准只是用更简单语言重新包装现有许可证的冗余许可证。
timeline.point: Argues the community is not requesting more license approvals but is rather frustrated by the proliferation of already-approved licenses. Opposes approving redundant licenses that merely repackage existing ones in simpler language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Proposes that 'field of endeavor' in OSD refers to activities not involving derivative works, meaning a license can restrict incorporation into software but cannot restrict what the software is used to create.
timeline.point_zh: 提出 OSD 中'应用领域'指不涉及衍生作品创作的活动，即许可证可以限制软件被纳入其他软件，但不能限制软件被用来做什么。
timeline.point: Proposes that 'field of endeavor' in OSD refers to activities not involving derivative works, meaning a license can restrict incorporation into software but cannot restrict what the software is used to create.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that L0-R grants the same broad permissions as BSD-2-Clause and does not restrict use to Open Source only; the conditions merely require that modifications or incorporating software become Open Source within a given time.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 L0-R 授予与 BSD-2-Clause 相同的宽泛许可，并不限制只能与开源软件配合使用；条件仅要求修改或合并的软件在规定时间内成为开源。
timeline.point: Clarifies that L0-R grants the same broad permissions as BSD-2-Clause and does not restrict use to Open Source only; the conditions merely require that modifications or incorporating software become Open Source within a given time.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains the origin of the 'field of endeavor' clause from the SPICE license prohibiting use by South African police, and clarifies that under copyright law, use and creation of derivative works are distinct rights.
timeline.point_zh: 解释'应用领域'条款的起源来自 SPICE 许可证禁止南非警察使用，并澄清在版权法下，使用和创作衍生作品是两项独立的权利。
timeline.point: Explains the origin of the 'field of endeavor' clause from the SPICE license prohibiting use by South African police, and clarifies that under copyright law, use and creation of derivative works are distinct rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Warns that OSI risks losing developers who have a more values-driven view of open source, notes that permissive license advocates outnumber copyleft maintainers, and argues for openness to plain-language license variations while explaining SPDX-based tooling for license compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 OSI 有失去价值观驱动型开发者的风险，指出宽松许可证支持者多于 copyleft 维护者，主张对通俗语言许可证变体保持开放态度，同时解释基于 SPDX 的许可证合规工具。
timeline.point: Warns that OSI risks losing developers who have a more values-driven view of open source, notes that permissive license advocates outnumber copyleft maintainers, and argues for openness to plain-language license variations while explaining SPDX-based tooling for license compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Declares that restricting mere use is a show-stopper for OSI approval, as it denies freedom zero, which is a foundational precondition of the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 认为限制纯粹使用是 OSI 批准的致命障碍，因为这否定了自由零——整个开源定义的基本前提。
timeline.point: Declares that restricting mere use is a show-stopper for OSI approval, as it denies freedom zero, which is a foundational precondition of the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that the use restriction is unintentional based on Kyle's responses, but agrees that the wording needs to be changed.
timeline.point_zh: 根据 Kyle 的回复承认使用限制并非有意为之，但同意需要修改措辞。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that the use restriction is unintentional based on Kyle's responses, but agrees that the wording needs to be changed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that unmodified use unrelated to software falls under BSD-2-Clause's general permission, and questions whether Carlo objects to conditions on unmodified use or use with modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清未修改的、与软件无关的使用受 BSD-2-Clause 一般许可保护，并质疑 Carlo 反对的是对未修改使用的限制还是对修改使用的限制。
timeline.point: Clarifies that unmodified use unrelated to software falls under BSD-2-Clause's general permission, and questions whether Carlo objects to conditions on unmodified use or use with modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: States categorically that limiting mere use without distribution is unacceptable in any open source or free software license, regardless of whether the code has been modified.
timeline.point_zh: 断然声明，在任何开源或自由软件许可证中，限制不涉及分发的纯粹使用都是不可接受的，无论代码是否被修改。
timeline.point: States categorically that limiting mere use without distribution is unacceptable in any open source or free software license, regardless of whether the code has been modified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Poses four fundamental questions about the OSD's distinction between distribution and use conditions, challenging whether confining copyleft to distribution triggers still makes sense given ASP and PaaS industry developments.
timeline.point_zh: 就 OSD 对分发条件和使用条件的区分提出四个根本性问题，质疑在 ASP 和 PaaS 行业发展背景下，将 copyleft 限制于分发触发条件是否仍然合理。
timeline.point: Poses four fundamental questions about the OSD's distinction between distribution and use conditions, challenging whether confining copyleft to distribution triggers still makes sense given ASP and PaaS industry developments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Presents a revised draft with conditions 3, 4, and 5 restructured: conditions now state release requirements affirmatively, and the grace period is moved to a separate condition structured as a path to forgiveness similar to GPL-3.0 section 8.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修订草案，将条款 3、4、5 重新构建：条款现在正面陈述发布要求，宽限期移至单独条款，结构类似于 GPL-3.0 第 8 节的宽恕路径。
timeline.point: Presents a revised draft with conditions 3, 4, and 5 restructured: conditions now state release requirements affirmatively, and the grace period is moved to a separate condition structured as a path to forgiveness similar to GPL-3.0 section 8.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI exists to maintain clear standards, not to be inclusive of all approaches. Warns against recasting Open Source as merely a development methodology, opposes the proliferation of near-duplicate licenses, and notes that plain-language licenses may give developers false confidence in their understanding.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 的存在是为了维护明确的标准，而非包容所有做法。警告不要将开源仅仅重新定义为一种开发方法论，反对近乎重复的许可证泛滥，并指出通俗语言许可证可能让开发者对自己的理解产生虚假信心。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI exists to maintain clear standards, not to be inclusive of all approaches. Warns against recasting Open Source as merely a development methodology, opposes the proliferation of near-duplicate licenses, and notes that plain-language licenses may give developers false confidence in their understanding.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Discovers that 'use' in L0-R means user-level use rather than redistribution as in BSD, and raises concerns about users unable to fulfill relicensing obligations while distributors escape liability. Notes the grace period practical issue of starting from discovery.
timeline.point_zh: 发现 L0-R 中的'use'指用户层面的使用而非 BSD 中的再分发，提出用户可能无法履行重新许可义务而分发者逃脱责任的担忧，并指出宽限期从发现之日算起的实际问题。
timeline.point: Discovers that 'use' in L0-R means user-level use rather than redistribution as in BSD, and raises concerns about users unable to fulfill relicensing obligations while distributors escape liability. Notes the grace period practical issue of starting from discovery.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether 'software patch' is a useful legal term, noting that modern development practices like pull requests and container layering don't clearly fit the concept of a patch.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑'软件补丁'是否是一个有用的法律术语，指出拉取请求和容器分层等现代开发实践不能明确归入补丁的概念。
timeline.point: Questions whether 'software patch' is a useful legal term, noting that modern development practices like pull requests and container layering don't clearly fit the concept of a patch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion at Josh's statement that 'use' means copying/redistribution in BSD, since BSD explicitly distinguishes redistribution from use.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Josh 关于 BSD 中'use'等同于复制/再分发的陈述表示困惑，因为 BSD 明确区分了再分发和使用。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion at Josh's statement that 'use' means copying/redistribution in BSD, since BSD explicitly distinguishes redistribution from use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Defines a software patch as merely one form of expressing a modification, and recommends that the license language should refer to publication of modifications rather than patches.
timeline.point_zh: 将软件补丁定义为表达修改的一种形式，建议许可证语言应使用'修改的发布'而非'补丁'。
timeline.point: Defines a software patch as merely one form of expressing a modification, and recommends that the license language should refer to publication of modifications rather than patches.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains that the patch originator bears liability for non-Open Source modifications, acknowledges this is a general copyleft issue not unique to L0-R, clarifies the intended breadth of 'as a component of' and 'in development of', and discusses enforcement mechanisms including litigation discovery.
timeline.point_zh: 解释补丁发起者对非开源修改承担侵权责任，承认这是 copyleft 的普遍问题而非 L0-R 独有，澄清'as a component of'和'in development of'的预期覆盖范围，并讨论包括诉讼发现在内的执行机制。
timeline.point: Explains that the patch originator bears liability for non-Open Source modifications, acknowledges this is a general copyleft issue not unique to L0-R, clarifies the intended breadth of 'as a component of' and 'in development of', and discusses enforcement mechanisms including litigation discovery.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the concern about 'software patch' terminology and proposes replacing it with 'modification constituting a derivative work under copyright law', or alternatively using 'change' instead of 'modification'.
timeline.point_zh: 承认关于'软件补丁'术语的关切，提议将其替换为'构成版权法下衍生作品的修改'，或用'change'替代'modification'。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the concern about 'software patch' terminology and proposes replacing it with 'modification constituting a derivative work under copyright law', or alternatively using 'change' instead of 'modification'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes 'Use with any software patch' as a failure of plain-language drafting, noting it misuses 'use', confused Josh, and 'patch' does not cover all the acts L0-R intends to restrict.
timeline.point_zh: 批评'Use with any software patch'是通俗语言起草的失败案例，指出它误用了'use'，混淆了 Josh，且'patch'未涵盖 L0-R 有意限制的所有行为。
timeline.point: Criticizes 'Use with any software patch' as a failure of plain-language drafting, noting it misuses 'use', confused Josh, and 'patch' does not cover all the acts L0-R intends to restrict.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Observes that the revised wording makes it the act of running a modified program, not modification itself, that triggers the license, and questions how this adds simplicity compared to the original language.
timeline.point_zh: 观察到修改后的措辞使得触发许可证的是运行修改后程序的行为而非修改本身，并质疑这相比原始语言如何增加了简洁性。
timeline.point: Observes that the revised wording makes it the act of running a modified program, not modification itself, that triggers the license, and questions how this adds simplicity compared to the original language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acting as messenger for developer community sentiment, warns that OSI risks irrelevance if developers lose interest. Explains L0-R as born from the values gap between producer and consumer communities. Argues Open Source achieved marketing victory but not values victory, and that strong copyleft is needed to rectify this.
timeline.point_zh: 作为开发者社区意见的传达者，警告 OSI 若失去开发者关注将面临边缘化。阐述 L0-R 诞生于生产者和消费者社区之间的价值观鸿沟。主张开源获得了营销胜利而非价值观胜利，需要强 copyleft 来纠正这一点。
timeline.point: Acting as messenger for developer community sentiment, warns that OSI risks irrelevance if developers lose interest. Explains L0-R as born from the values gap between producer and consumer communities. Argues Open Source achieved marketing victory but not values victory, and that strong copyleft is needed to rectify this.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that 'use' does not map cleanly to copyright holder exclusive rights, but argues that replacing plain language with precise legal terms like '106 rights' would make the license too enterprise-style and drive away potential licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 承认'use'不能精确映射到版权持有者的专有权利，但主张用'106 权利'等精确法律术语替代通俗语言会使许可证过于企业化，从而赶走潜在的许可方。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that 'use' does not map cleanly to copyright holder exclusive rights, but argues that replacing plain language with precise legal terms like '106 rights' would make the license too enterprise-style and drive away potential licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Accepts Bruce's feedback that 'use with any software patch' fails at simple language and reverts to 'use with modification'.
timeline.point_zh: 接受 Bruce 关于'use with any software patch'在通俗语言方面失败的反馈，暂且回退到'use with modification'。
timeline.point: Accepts Bruce's feedback that 'use with any software patch' fails at simple language and reverts to 'use with modification'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Answers that use conditions were excluded from OSD because they were unnecessary and historically backfired. Argues that all desired copyleft effects can be achieved through modification conditions alone, and suggests using permissive exceptions for private development.
timeline.point_zh: 回答说使用条件被排除在 OSD 之外是因为它们不必要且历史上曾适得其反。主张所有期望的 copyleft 效果都可以仅通过修改条件实现，并建议对私人开发使用许可性例外。
timeline.point: Answers that use conditions were excluded from OSD because they were unnecessary and historically backfired. Argues that all desired copyleft effects can be achieved through modification conditions alone, and suggests using permissive exceptions for private development.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that Open Source has already won in terms of industry pervasiveness, and further increases in adoption beyond smaller enterprises are unlikely; suggests focusing on Open Science and Open Publication instead.
timeline.point_zh: 认为开源在行业渗透方面已经取得了胜利，除小型企业外进一步增加采用的可能性不大；建议将注意力转向开放科学和开放出版。
timeline.point: Argues that Open Source has already won in terms of industry pervasiveness, and further increases in adoption beyond smaller enterprises are unlikely; suggests focusing on Open Science and Open Publication instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes between Open Source's marketing victory (name recognition, adoption) and values defeat, arguing the real winners have been proprietary software firms. Presents L0-R as a tool to address the values gap through strong copyleft reciprocity.
timeline.point_zh: 区分开源的营销胜利（品牌认知、采用率）和价值观失败，认为真正的赢家是专有软件公司。将 L0-R 定位为通过强 copyleft 互惠来解决价值观鸿沟的工具。
timeline.point: Distinguishes between Open Source's marketing victory (name recognition, adoption) and values defeat, arguing the real winners have been proprietary software firms. Presents L0-R as a tool to address the values gap through strong copyleft reciprocity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Recommends that Kyle try building copyleft conditions on modification rather than use, with optional private development exceptions, and come back with new license text.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 Kyle 尝试基于修改而非使用来构建 copyleft 条件，并可添加私人开发例外，然后带着新的许可证文本回来讨论。
timeline.point: Recommends that Kyle try building copyleft conditions on modification rather than use, with optional private development exceptions, and come back with new license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Challenges Bruce's blanket opposition to use conditions by asking for specific backfired examples, argues OSD 6 does not prohibit all use-based conditions, and contends that confining copyleft to distribution with modifications would severely limit its power.
timeline.point_zh: 通过要求具体反面案例来挑战 Bruce 对使用条件的全面反对，论证 OSD 6 并未禁止所有基于使用的条件，并主张将 copyleft 限制为带修改的分发将严重限制其效力。
timeline.point: Challenges Bruce's blanket opposition to use conditions by asking for specific backfired examples, argues OSD 6 does not prohibit all use-based conditions, and contends that confining copyleft to distribution with modifications would severely limit its power.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that use restrictions are problematic for passive users, and demonstrates an alternative approach: a modification-triggered requirement with a private-development exception structured as a permission rather than a restriction.
timeline.point_zh: 重申使用限制对被动用户存在问题，并展示了一种替代方案：以修改触发的要求配合私人开发例外，将其构建为许可而非限制。
timeline.point: Reiterates that use restrictions are problematic for passive users, and demonstrates an alternative approach: a modification-triggered requirement with a private-development exception structured as a permission rather than a restriction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Notes that L0-R remains ambiguous about whether an L0-R-licensed text editor can be used to write non-public content, and states that such ambiguity is a fundamental problem for a license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 仍然模糊不清——无法确定 L0-R 许可的文本编辑器是否可用于编写非公开内容，并认为这种歧义是许可证的根本问题。
timeline.point: Notes that L0-R remains ambiguous about whether an L0-R-licensed text editor can be used to write non-public content, and states that such ambiguity is a fundamental problem for a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that permissive licenses are not one-way valves but acts of generosity, notes that industry funded much open source development, and suggests L0-R achieves something similar to CC-BY-SA-NC through a much more complex mechanism.
timeline.point_zh: 认为宽松许可证不是单向阀而是慷慨之举，指出行业资助了大量开源开发，并建议 L0-R 通过更复杂的机制实现了类似于 CC-BY-SA-NC 的效果。
timeline.point: Argues that permissive licenses are not one-way valves but acts of generosity, notes that industry funded much open source development, and suggests L0-R achieves something similar to CC-BY-SA-NC through a much more complex mechanism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the norm of exclusive permissive licensing creates a one-way valve, and that L0-R addresses the sustainability gap between beginner and seasoned developers.
timeline.point_zh: 主张仅使用宽松许可证的规范造成了单向阀效应，L0-R 填补了新手与资深开发者之间的可持续性缺口。
timeline.point: Argues that the norm of exclusive permissive licensing creates a one-way valve, and that L0-R addresses the sustainability gap between beginner and seasoned developers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether inverting a use restriction into a permission grant changes its legal effect under the OSD, and asks for clarification on OSD condition 6.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑将使用限制转化为权限授予是否改变了其在 OSD 下的法律效力，并要求澄清 OSD 条件 6 的含义。
timeline.point: Questions whether inverting a use restriction into a permission grant changes its legal effect under the OSD, and asks for clarification on OSD condition 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Critiques L0-R for putting the copyleft burden on end users rather than modifiers, noting this differs from GPL which triggers only on distribution.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 L0-R 将 copyleft 义务加在终端用户身上而非修改者身上，指出这与 GPL 仅在分发时触发不同。
timeline.point: Critiques L0-R for putting the copyleft burden on end users rather than modifiers, noting this differs from GPL which triggers only on distribution.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains L0-R uses use-based triggers to drive a stronger reciprocity bargain than GPL, and aims to maximize distribution compatibility with BSD-style redistribution terms.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 L0-R 使用基于使用的触发机制以实现比 GPL 更强的互惠要求，同时通过 BSD 风格的再分发条款最大化分发兼容性。
timeline.point: Explains L0-R uses use-based triggers to drive a stronger reciprocity bargain than GPL, and aims to maximize distribution compatibility with BSD-style redistribution terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI license approval is not purely an academic OSD exercise but must consider the organization's broader mission, and suggests the board could reject a conformant license that undermines OSI's role.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 许可证审批并非纯粹的 OSD 学术练习，还需考虑组织的更广泛使命，董事会可能拒绝虽符合 OSD 但损害 OSI 角色的许可证。
timeline.point: Argues OSI license approval is not purely an academic OSD exercise but must consider the organization's broader mission, and suggests the board could reject a conformant license that undermines OSI's role.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks which project will be the first to use L0-R, noting the committee wants confirmed users before approving a license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问哪个项目将是第一个使用 L0-R 的项目，指出委员会希望在批准许可证前有确认的使用者。
timeline.point: Asks which project will be the first to use L0-R, noting the committee wants confirmed users before approving a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes OSD-conformance concerns from policy concerns, calls for transparent codification of any uncodified OSI objectives, and expresses openness to revisions.
timeline.point_zh: 区分 OSD 合规性问题与政策问题，呼吁将任何未编纂的 OSI 目标透明化，并表示愿意修改。
timeline.point: Distinguishes OSD-conformance concerns from policy concerns, calls for transparent codification of any uncodified OSI objectives, and expresses openness to revisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Describes L0-R as intended for licensezero.com users, primarily npm packages, and explains the chicken-and-egg problem of needing OSI approval before promoting adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 L0-R 是为 licensezero.com 用户（主要是 npm 包）设计的，并解释了需要先获 OSI 批准才能推广的先有鸡还是先有蛋问题。
timeline.point: Describes L0-R as intended for licensezero.com users, primarily npm packages, and explains the chicken-and-egg problem of needing OSI approval before promoting adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises concern about the potential harm of aggressive copyleft on the npm ecosystem, and questions whether OSI has rules against approving a license designed to fuel dual-licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 对激进 copyleft 可能对 npm 生态系统造成的危害表示担忧，并质疑 OSI 是否有规则反对批准旨在推动双重许可模式的许可证。
timeline.point: Raises concern about the potential harm of aggressive copyleft on the npm ecosystem, and questions whether OSI has rules against approving a license designed to fuel dual-licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: States OSI approval must be considered in the context of its mission, not just OSD alone, and asks whether L0-R would be recognized by the FSF as a free software license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 批准必须结合其使命而非仅看 OSD，并询问 L0-R 是否会被 FSF 认定为自由软件许可证。
timeline.point: States OSI approval must be considered in the context of its mission, not just OSD alone, and asks whether L0-R would be recognized by the FSF as a free software license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Points to Artistic License 2.0 as precedent for OSI-approved licenses that support dual-licensing business models, and offers to discuss npm concerns offline.
timeline.point_zh: 以 Artistic License 2.0 为例说明 OSI 已批准的许可证支持双重许可商业模式，并提出线下讨论 npm 相关问题。
timeline.point: Points to Artistic License 2.0 as precedent for OSI-approved licenses that support dual-licensing business models, and offers to discuss npm concerns offline.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Proposes inverting L0-R's use restriction into a permission exemption, calling it a simple and OSD-compliant approach that avoids the quirks of coupling use and modification.
timeline.point_zh: 提议将 L0-R 的使用限制反转为权限豁免，认为这是一种简单且符合 OSD 的方式，避免了将使用与修改绑定的怪异写法。
timeline.point: Proposes inverting L0-R's use restriction into a permission exemption, calling it a simple and OSD-compliant approach that avoids the quirks of coupling use and modification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI must be careful that uncodified policy objectives do not provide shelter for concerns contradicting its purpose, and expresses doubt FSF would recognize L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 必须警惕未编纂的政策目标为与其宗旨相悖的担忧提供庇护，并对 FSF 是否会认可 L0-R 表示怀疑。
timeline.point: Argues OSI must be careful that uncodified policy objectives do not provide shelter for concerns contradicting its purpose, and expresses doubt FSF would recognize L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Demands that Kyle elaborate on his implication that OSI board members should seek their own legal counsel regarding licensing matters.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 Kyle 详细说明其暗示 OSI 董事会成员应就许可事宜寻求自己法律顾问的含义。
timeline.point: Demands that Kyle elaborate on his implication that OSI board members should seek their own legal counsel regarding licensing matters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Suggests dismissing the remark as a poor choice of words, characterizing OSI as a non-profit administering a trademark program in a non-arbitrary manner.
timeline.point_zh: 建议将该言论视为措辞不当而不再追究，认为 OSI 是一个以非任意方式管理商标计划的非营利组织。
timeline.point: Suggests dismissing the remark as a poor choice of words, characterizing OSI as a non-profit administering a trademark program in a non-arbitrary manner.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies no accusation was made or intended, describing his comment as standard attorney-client prudence regarding mission, purpose, and tax status of non-profit entities.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清未做也无意做任何指控，说明其言论是关于非营利实体使命、宗旨和税务身份的标准律师审慎意见。
timeline.point: Clarifies no accusation was made or intended, describing his comment as standard attorney-client prudence regarding mission, purpose, and tax status of non-profit entities.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Urges returning to license drafting, noting the main drafting obstacle may be resolved but the license might still lack sufficient merit for OSI certification despite OSD compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促回到许可证起草工作，指出主要起草障碍可能已解决，但许可证可能因缺乏足够价值而无法获得 OSI 认证，尽管符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Urges returning to license drafting, noting the main drafting obstacle may be resolved but the license might still lack sufficient merit for OSI certification despite OSD compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion about next steps after learning a draft was deemed OSD-conformant, and considers either accepting that interpretation or rewriting from scratch.
timeline.point_zh: 在得知某个草案被认为符合 OSD 后对下一步感到困惑，考虑接受该解读或从头重写。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion about next steps after learning a draft was deemed OSD-conformant, and considers either accepting that interpretation or rewriting from scratch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Advises Kyle to adopt the proposed language to resolve the main objection, while cautioning that remaining problems may still prevent board certification.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 Kyle 采用所提议的语言来解决主要异议，同时提醒剩余问题仍可能阻止董事会认证。
timeline.point: Advises Kyle to adopt the proposed language to resolve the main objection, while cautioning that remaining problems may still prevent board certification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R is not truly open source because forcing commercial users to pay is a shared-source dual-licensing model, and claims its intent can be easily circumvented via BSD re-licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 并非真正的开源，因为强制商业用户付费属于共享源码双重许可模式，且其意图可通过 BSD 重新许可轻易规避。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R is not truly open source because forcing commercial users to pay is a shared-source dual-licensing model, and claims its intent can be easily circumvented via BSD re-licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Counters that OSD-compliant copyleft licenses like GPL and AGPL are commonly used for dual-licensing, and clarifies L0-R targets reciprocity on sharing modifications, not commercial use discrimination.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称 GPL 和 AGPL 等符合 OSD 的 copyleft 许可证常被用于双重许可，L0-R 针对的是修改的共享而非商业使用歧视。
timeline.point: Counters that OSD-compliant copyleft licenses like GPL and AGPL are commonly used for dual-licensing, and clarifies L0-R targets reciprocity on sharing modifications, not commercial use discrimination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference does not work as intended because OSD specifies license behavior rather than being a license itself, and urges writing a stand-alone license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为引用 OSD 不能按预期运作，因为 OSD 规定的是许可证行为而非许可证本身，建议编写独立许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference does not work as intended because OSD specifies license behavior rather than being a license itself, and urges writing a stand-alone license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Defends incorporation by reference of OSD as legally sound, acknowledges Bruce's concern about OSD changes, and agrees to write original language in the next revision.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OSD 的引用纳入方式进行法律辩护，承认 Bruce 关于 OSD 变更的担忧，并同意在下次修订中使用原创语言。
timeline.point: Defends incorporation by reference of OSD as legally sound, acknowledges Bruce's concern about OSD changes, and agrees to write original language in the next revision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains OSD's source code provisions specify what a license must allow, argues incorporating OSD by reference is unnecessary when a few sentences can be copied, and recommends requiring modifications under 'this license'.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSD 的源代码条款规定了许可证必须允许的内容，认为复制几句话即可而无需引用 OSD，并建议要求修改使用本许可证。
timeline.point: Explains OSD's source code provisions specify what a license must allow, argues incorporating OSD by reference is unnecessary when a few sentences can be copied, and recommends requiring modifications under 'this license'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees to write original language but notes costs of both copying and rephrasing OSD, and advocates a whitelist approach for derivative works to avoid same-license incompatibility.
timeline.point_zh: 同意使用原创语言但指出复制和改写 OSD 都有代价，并倡导为衍生作品使用白名单方式以避免同许可证不兼容问题。
timeline.point: Agrees to write original language but notes costs of both copying and rephrasing OSD, and advocates a whitelist approach for derivative works to avoid same-license incompatibility.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Warns against incorporating by reference a document not designed for that purpose, which could confuse judges, and recommends embedding relevant OSD language directly or providing a license fallback.
timeline.point_zh: 警告不要将非为此目的设计的文件引用纳入，以免误导法官，并建议直接嵌入相关 OSD 语言或提供许可证后备方案。
timeline.point: Warns against incorporating by reference a document not designed for that purpose, which could confuse judges, and recommends embedding relevant OSD language directly or providing a license fallback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Defends incorporation by reference as established legal practice, argues OSD's 'must' language is not as ambiguous as suggested, and appreciates Bruce's BSD historical context.
timeline.point_zh: 为引用纳入方式辩护，认为其是既定法律实践，主张 OSD 中的必须语言并非如所述那样含糊，并感谢 Bruce 提供的 BSD 历史背景。
timeline.point: Defends incorporation by reference as established legal practice, argues OSD's 'must' language is not as ambiguous as suggested, and appreciates Bruce's BSD historical context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States the license as drafted violates OSD conditions 6 and 9, proposes an 'IP Maximaleft' hypothetical license to explore whether strong copyleft could pass OSD, and doubts companies would accept such terms.
timeline.point_zh: 指出当前草案违反 OSD 条件 6 和 9，提出 IP 最大左翼假设性许可证以探讨强 copyleft 能否通过 OSD，并质疑公司是否会接受此类条款。
timeline.point: States the license as drafted violates OSD conditions 6 and 9, proposes an 'IP Maximaleft' hypothetical license to explore whether strong copyleft could pass OSD, and doubts companies would accept such terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Appreciates McCoy's feedback, agrees to float a more direct rewrite addressing OSD 6 concerns, and asks for clarification on OSD 9 boundaries regarding what constitutes a 'work based on the Program'.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 McCoy 的反馈，同意提出更直接的修订以解决 OSD 6 问题，并请求澄清 OSD 9 关于什么构成基于程序的作品的边界。
timeline.point: Appreciates McCoy's feedback, agrees to float a more direct rewrite addressing OSD 6 concerns, and asks for clarification on OSD 9 boundaries regarding what constitutes a 'work based on the Program'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Announces stepping away from the discussion until Tuesday to focus on an FCC filing and personal matters.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布暂停参与讨论直到周二，以便处理 FCC 申请和私人事务。
timeline.point: Announces stepping away from the discussion until Tuesday to focus on an FCC filing and personal matters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States that non-compliance with Freedom 0 is a show-stopper for the license, regardless of GPL compatibility concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 表示不符合自由 0 是该许可证的致命缺陷，无论 GPL 兼容性如何。
timeline.point: States that non-compliance with Freedom 0 is a show-stopper for the license, regardless of GPL compatibility concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference adds unnecessary complexity and devalues the license, and recommends embedding relevant conditions directly in the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 认为引用 OSD 增加了不必要的复杂性并降低了许可证质量，建议将相关条件直接嵌入许可证文本。
timeline.point: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference adds unnecessary complexity and devalues the license, and recommends embedding relevant conditions directly in the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the discussion has become lengthy and promises that the forthcoming revision will address concerns and help refocus the conversation.

timeline.snippet: Clarifies the OSD 6 concern relates to time-limited termination applying differently to open vs non-open source, and provides two examples of uses that would violate OSD 9.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSD 6 担忧源于限时终止条款对开源与非开源软件的差异化适用，并给出两个违反 OSD 9 的使用示例。
timeline.point: Clarifies the OSD 6 concern relates to time-limited termination applying differently to open vs non-open source, and provides two examples of uses that would violate OSD 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Seeks to confirm understanding of the OSD 6 issue regarding differential treatment of open vs non-open source, and proposes revisiting OSD 9 in context of the forthcoming revision.
timeline.point_zh: 试图确认对 OSD 6 关于开源与非开源差异化处理的理解，并建议在即将发布的修订中重新审视 OSD 9。
timeline.point: Seeks to confirm understanding of the OSD 6 issue regarding differential treatment of open vs non-open source, and proposes revisiting OSD 9 in context of the forthcoming revision.

timeline.snippet: Notes that the OSI board made no decision on L0-R because the submitter appears to have effectively withdrawn the license.
