timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Submits the Open Logistics License v1.2 for approval, a revision of v1.0 based on Apache v2 modified to comply with German law, particularly regarding warranty and liability provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交Open物流许可证1.2版本以供审批，这是基于Apache v2修订的版本，主要修改了保证和责任条款以符合德国法律。
timeline.point: Submits the Open Logistics License v1.2 for approval, a revision of v1.0 based on Apache v2 modified to comply with German law, particularly regarding warranty and liability provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Announces that comments are forthcoming from the perspective of an Italian lawyer.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布将从意大利律师的角度提供一些评论。
timeline.point: Announces that comments are forthcoming from the perspective of an Italian lawyer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Questions the implementation of Section 4’s obligation to ensure recipients incorporate provisions; asks what problem it solves since distributing the license itself seems sufficient.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑第4条义务的实施方式；询问该条款旨在解决什么问题，因为分发许可证本身似乎已经足够。
timeline.point: Questions the implementation of Section 4’s obligation to ensure recipients incorporate provisions; asks what problem it solves since distributing the license itself seems sufficient.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that the parenthetical “with regard to software components” in Section 4 could be interpreted as preventing reproduction and distribution of non-software components.
timeline.point_zh: 对第4条中“关于软件组件”的括号内容表示担忧，认为可能被解读为禁止复制和分发非软件组件。
timeline.point: Raises concern that the parenthetical “with regard to software components” in Section 4 could be interpreted as preventing reproduction and distribution of non-software components.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that if existing FOSS licenses don’t comply with German law, the solution is to redraft those licenses rather than create a new one; otherwise this is pure license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 认为如果现有FOSS许可证不符合德国法律，解决方案是修订那些许可证而非创建新许可证；否则这纯粹是许可证增殖。
timeline.point: Argues that if existing FOSS licenses don’t comply with German law, the solution is to redraft those licenses rather than create a new one; otherwise this is pure license proliferation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Notes that FOSS licenses generally disclaim what local law permits; asks for specific legal references showing German law requires disclaimers to be styled in a particular way.
timeline.point_zh: 指出FOSS许可证通常在法律允许的范围内免责；要求提供具体的法律依据证明德国法律要求免责条款必须以特定方式表述。
timeline.point: Notes that FOSS licenses generally disclaim what local law permits; asks for specific legal references showing German law requires disclaimers to be styled in a particular way.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues this is pure license proliferation; says if German law requires different disclaimers, all FOSS licenses should be redrafted rather than creating a new one; asks for concrete evidence of real harm to users and a more accurate license name.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这纯粹是许可证增殖；指出如果德国法律需要不同的免责条款，应该修订所有FOSS许可证而非创建新许可证；要求提供对用户造成实际损害的具体证据，并建议使用更准确的许可证名称。
timeline.point: Argues this is pure license proliferation; says if German law requires different disclaimers, all FOSS licenses should be redrafted rather than creating a new one; asks for concrete evidence of real harm to users and a more accurate license name.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Warns that overly broad liability disclaimers may trigger product liability under consumer protection law, and that German-origin licenses tend to avoid disclaiming intent and gross negligence.
timeline.point_zh: 警告过于宽泛的免责声明可能触发消费者保护法下的产品责任，德国本土许可证通常会避免免除故意和重大过失的责任。
timeline.point: Warns that overly broad liability disclaimers may trigger product liability under consumer protection law, and that German-origin licenses tend to avoid disclaiming intent and gross negligence.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Notes that the submitted license's liability language differs from the EUPL's language, and questions whether the narrower German-law-specific formulation matters for a license meant to be construed under German law.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该许可证的责任条款语言与 EUPL 不同，但认为既然许可证适用德国法律，该标准在德国法律下应该是正确的。
timeline.point: Notes that the submitted license's liability language differs from the EUPL's language, and questions whether the narrower German-law-specific formulation matters for a license meant to be construed under German law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that choice-of-law provisions provide beneficial certainty about applicable law, and questions what would happen if different parts of a codebase were under different national laws.
timeline.point_zh: 主张法律选择条款能提供有益的确定性，并追问如果同一代码库的不同部分适用不同国家法律会怎样。
timeline.point: Argues that choice-of-law provisions provide beneficial certainty about applicable law, and questions what would happen if different parts of a codebase were under different national laws.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Observes that both liability formulations likely translate from German legal concepts, and raises questions about whether consumer protection law already determines applicable law for end users, and whether the Berne Convention already specifies the binding country.
timeline.point_zh: 认为两种责任表述可能都源自德国法律概念的英文翻译，并质疑消费者保护法是否已为终端用户确定适用法律，以及伯尔尼公约是否已规定受约束的国家。
timeline.point: Observes that both liability formulations likely translate from German legal concepts, and raises questions about whether consumer protection law already determines applicable law for end users, and whether the Berne Convention already specifies the binding country.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes choice-of-law clauses in FOSS licenses, arguing they disrupt egalitarian enforcement worldwide and give licensors inappropriate power; criticizes OSI for considering them acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对在 FOSS 许可证中使用法律选择条款，认为它们会破坏全球平等的许可证执行，给许可方不当权力，批评 OSI 接受此类条款。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes choice-of-law clauses in FOSS licenses, arguing they disrupt egalitarian enforcement worldwide and give licensors inappropriate power; criticizes OSI for considering them acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Provides a reference link to the IFOSS Law Book's chapter on German waiver and liability law as a starting point for the discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 提供了 IFOSS 法律手册中关于德国免责与责任章节的链接，作为讨论的参考起点。
timeline.point: Provides a reference link to the IFOSS Law Book's chapter on German waiver and liability law as a starting point for the discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Asks Bradley Kuhn to explain specifically how choice-of-law clauses cause trouble in FOSS licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 Bradley Kuhn 具体解释法律选择条款如何在 FOSS 许可证中造成问题。
timeline.point: Asks Bradley Kuhn to explain specifically how choice-of-law clauses cause trouble in FOSS licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains that choice-of-law clauses force cross-jurisdictional enforcement that burdens non-lawyers, risk locking FOSS into unfavorable legal regimes, and questions whether the Open Logistics License intentionally seeks GPL incompatibility like CDDL did.
timeline.point_zh: 解释法律选择条款迫使跨司法管辖区执法，给非法律人士造成负担，且存在将 FOSS 锁定在不利法律体系中的风险，质疑 Open Logistics 许可证是否像 CDDL 那样有意与 GPL 不兼容。
timeline.point: Explains that choice-of-law clauses force cross-jurisdictional enforcement that burdens non-lawyers, risk locking FOSS into unfavorable legal regimes, and questions whether the Open Logistics License intentionally seeks GPL incompatibility like CDDL did.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Defends choice-of-law provisions by distinguishing law from jurisdiction, arguing US courts regularly apply foreign law, and that legal certainty from a choice-of-law clause is preferable to the uncertainty of no provision. Challenges the CDDL incompatibility claim.
timeline.point_zh: 为法律选择条款辩护，区分法律与管辖权，指出美国法院经常适用外国法律，认为有法律选择条款的确定性优于无条款的不确定性，并质疑 CDDL 不兼容的说法。
timeline.point: Defends choice-of-law provisions by distinguishing law from jurisdiction, arguing US courts regularly apply foreign law, and that legal certainty from a choice-of-law clause is preferable to the uncertainty of no provision. Challenges the CDDL incompatibility claim.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the IFOSS Law Book reference as valuable and notes the authors are well-regarded.
timeline.point_zh: 认可 IFOSS 法律手册的参考价值，指出其作者享有盛誉。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the IFOSS Law Book reference as valuable and notes the authors are well-regarded.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: As a practitioner, reports that Eclipse removed choice-of-law from EPL-2.0 after 15 years of failing to convince stakeholders of its value, and notes that 95%+ of FOSS uses licenses without choice-of-law, arguing the practical debate is settled.
timeline.point_zh: 以从业者身份指出 Eclipse 在 EPL-2.0 中移除了法律选择条款，15年间未能说服利益相关者其价值，且 95% 以上的 FOSS 使用无法律选择条款的许可证，认为实际辩论已有定论。
timeline.point: As a practitioner, reports that Eclipse removed choice-of-law from EPL-2.0 after 15 years of failing to convince stakeholders of its value, and notes that 95%+ of FOSS uses licenses without choice-of-law, arguing the practical debate is settled.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that choice-of-law is disfavored but expresses frustration that no compelling reason has been provided beyond mere convention.
timeline.point_zh: 承认法律选择条款确实不受欢迎，但表示困惑于至今未获得有说服力的理由，似乎只是约定俗成。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that choice-of-law is disfavored but expresses frustration that no compelling reason has been provided beyond mere convention.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Defends choice-of-law/jurisdiction clauses as fair to licensors, arguing that requiring enforcement in the licensor's jurisdiction protects small licensors from chasing bad actors worldwide, and directly disagrees with Kuhn's blanket rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 为法律选择/管辖权条款辩护，认为要求在许可方所在司法管辖区执法对许可方公平，保护小型许可方无需全球追诉违规者，明确反对 Kuhn 的全盘否定。
timeline.point: Defends choice-of-law/jurisdiction clauses as fair to licensors, arguing that requiring enforcement in the licensor's jurisdiction protects small licensors from chasing bad actors worldwide, and directly disagrees with Kuhn's blanket rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Counters the consumer protection argument by explaining that US law does not generally distinguish consumer from business contracts, argues choice-of-law is neutral between individuals and corporations, and can empower small licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳消费者保护论点，解释美国法律一般不区分消费者与商业合同，认为法律选择条款对个人和企业是中立的，并且可以赋权小型许可方。
timeline.point: Counters the consumer protection argument by explaining that US law does not generally distinguish consumer from business contracts, argues choice-of-law is neutral between individuals and corporations, and can empower small licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains that the license is named after its authoring organization, the Open Logistics Foundation, analogous to how EPL comes from Eclipse.
timeline.point_zh: 解释许可证以其创建组织 Open Logistics Foundation 命名，类似于 EPL 来自 Eclipse。
timeline.point: Explains that the license is named after its authoring organization, the Open Logistics Foundation, analogous to how EPL comes from Eclipse.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Section 4's flow-down clause requires the distributor to guarantee a legal result (that recipients be obligated), which is problematic because the distributor cannot fully control whether that legal effect is achieved.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清第 4 条的传递条款要求分发者保证法律效果（即接收方被约束），这有问题因为分发者无法完全控制该法律效果是否能实现。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Section 4's flow-down clause requires the distributor to guarantee a legal result (that recipients be obligated), which is problematic because the distributor cannot fully control whether that legal effect is achieved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that choice-of-law in public licenses creates confusion when code under different national versions is merged, and that while choice-of-law works for private contracts, public licenses present fundamentally different challenges that make it inadvisable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张公共许可证中的法律选择条款会在不同国家版本代码合并时造成混乱，认为虽然私人合同的法律选择没有问题，但公共许可证面临根本不同的挑战。
timeline.point: Argues that choice-of-law in public licenses creates confusion when code under different national versions is merged, and that while choice-of-law works for private contracts, public licenses present fundamentally different challenges that make it inadvisable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Expresses strong doubt that the Berne Convention covers licensing (as opposed to copyright), and reiterates that choice-of-law provisions are problematic for public licenses, citing Eben Moglen's long-held position.
timeline.point_zh: 对伯尔尼公约是否涵盖许可（而非版权）表示强烈怀疑，重申法律选择条款对公共许可证而言是非常棘手的领域，引用 Eben Moglen 长期以来的观点。
timeline.point: Expresses strong doubt that the Berne Convention covers licensing (as opposed to copyright), and reiterates that choice-of-law provisions are problematic for public licenses, citing Eben Moglen's long-held position.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the parenthetical in the distribution clause is misleading and submits a revised version that clarifies software components must be distributed in Source or Object form.
timeline.point_zh: 承认分发条款中的括号表述有误导性，提交了修改后的版本以明确软件组件须以源代码或目标代码形式分发。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the parenthetical in the distribution clause is misleading and submits a revised version that clarifies software components must be distributed in Source or Object form.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges Carlo's clarification about the Section 4 obligation issue as very helpful.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Carlo 对第 4 条义务问题的澄清非常有帮助。
timeline.point: Acknowledges Carlo's clarification about the Section 4 obligation issue as very helpful.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that Carlo's explanation about choice-of-law in public licenses versus private contracts clarifies the issue.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Carlo 关于公共许可证与私人合同中法律选择差异的解释阐明了问题。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that Carlo's explanation about choice-of-law in public licenses versus private contracts clarifies the issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Accepts Andreas's proposed revision to the distribution clause as addressing her concern, and requests a revised draft consolidating all changes into a single document.
timeline.point_zh: 接受 Andreas 对分发条款的修改作为对其关切的回应，并要求提交包含所有修改的完整修订草案。
timeline.point: Accepts Andreas's proposed revision to the distribution clause as addressing her concern, and requests a revised draft consolidating all changes into a single document.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains that the flow-down clause in Article 4 was intended to cascade the other obligations downstream, and asks for suggestions on how to reformulate it more clearly.
timeline.point_zh: 解释第 4 条末款旨在将第 4 条其他义务向下传递，并询问如何更好地表述。
timeline.point: Explains that the flow-down clause in Article 4 was intended to cascade the other obligations downstream, and asks for suggestions on how to reformulate it more clearly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: States that developer feedback is limited since the license's rationale is purely legal, and requests a developer-oriented FAQ explaining when and why to use this license instead of Apache.
timeline.point_zh: 指出开发者反馈有限，因为许可证的理由完全基于法律解释，并要求提供面向开发者的常见问题解答，说明何时以及为何使用此许可证而非 Apache。
timeline.point: States that developer feedback is limited since the license's rationale is purely legal, and requests a developer-oriented FAQ explaining when and why to use this license instead of Apache.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Endorses the FAQ request and argues that OSI approval should require demonstrating a widespread need beyond the submitting organization's own needs, warning that licenses serving only their author are vanity licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 支持 FAQ 请求，主张 OSI 批准应要求证明许可证服务于超出提交组织自身需求的广泛 FOSS 社区，警告仅为作者自身需求的许可证是虚荣许可证。
timeline.point: Endorses the FAQ request and argues that OSI approval should require demonstrating a widespread need beyond the submitting organization's own needs, warning that licenses serving only their author are vanity licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Suggests reformulating the flow-down clause to follow standard practice: requiring license text inclusion or reference and an appropriate legal notice, citing GPLv3 as an example.
timeline.point_zh: 建议按照标准做法重新表述传递条款：要求随分发包含许可证全文或引用规范在线资源，并附加适当的法律声明，引用 GPLv3 作为范例。
timeline.point: Suggests reformulating the flow-down clause to follow standard practice: requiring license text inclusion or reference and an appropriate legal notice, citing GPLv3 as an example.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the feedback and announces that an updated version of the license incorporating discussed changes will be shared within the next few days.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈，宣布将在几天内分享包含已讨论修改内容的更新版许可证。
timeline.point: Thanks for the feedback and announces that an updated version of the license incorporating discussed changes will be shared within the next few days.
